sum: Understanding sub-surface fault linkage and structural maturity is crucial for assessing earthquake rupture dynamics and seismic hazard. This study examines the ~10 km Roccapreturo normal fault system in the Central Apennines, Italy, which comprises three closely spaced en-echelon strands at the surface. The authors compile a high-resolution field database of bedrock fault scarp strike/dip, slip-vector kinematics, 12 Holocene topographic throw profiles, and 7 geological cross-sections, applying a Kostrov-based geometry-dependent throw-rate model to calculate along-strike horizontal strain rates. Results show wide geometric scatter (strike 072°–183°, dip 42°–82°), a maximum Holocene throw of 8.75 ± 1.75 m (0.58 ± 0.16 mm/yr), and a maximum geological throw of 610 m (throw-to-length ratio of 0.055). Steeper fault dips in the relay zone, convergent slip vectors, and a smooth along-strike strain-rate profile demonstrate for the first time that geometry-dependent throw-rate models can identify unbreached sub-surface fault bends linking immature surface strands.
揭示活动断层深部连通性与构造演化成熟度对评估地震破裂动力学与地震危险性至关重要。本文以意大利中亚平宁山脉由三条地表雁列分支组成的罗卡普雷图罗正断层系为研究对象，开展了高空间分辨率基岩断层陡坎产状、擦痕运动学、12条全新世地形落差剖面及7条地质剖面测量，并基于Kostrov应变率方法计算了沿走向水平应……

t: The authors combine detailed field mapping of fault strike, dip, slip vectors, and Holocene/geological throws with a Kostrov-based equation to compute maximum horizontal strain-rate profiles across 0.5, 1, and 2 km transects.
结合野外断层走向、倾角、滑动矢量及全新世/地质落差测量，利用改进的Kostrov公式计算沿走向水平应变率。

The dataset comprises high-resolution strike, dip, and frictional striae measurements along the 8 km bedrock scarp, 12 Holocene topographic throw profiles (9 new, 3 published), and 7 geological cross-sections.
包含沿8 km基岩陡坎采集的高分辨率构造擦痕数据、12条全新世地形落差剖面及7条地质横剖面。

Fault strike ranges from 072°–183° and dip from 42°–82°, with steeper dips in the relay zone (59.1°–75.2° vs. 52.9°–56.4°), maximum Holocene throw of 8.75 ± 1.75 m, and maximum geological throw of 610 m.

The Middle Aterno Valley West and Succiano faults have poor surface exposure, and the absence of historical earthquakes prevents constraining recurrence intervals or the exact future geometry of surface linkage.
部分断层分支地表露头较差，且缺乏历史地震记录，难以约束复发间隔和未来地表连接的具体几何形态。

Extends the geometry-dependent throw-rate model to relay zones where fault bends exist at depth but have not yet breached the surface, using steepened relay-zone dips to infer sub-surface fault connectivity.
首次将几何依赖落差率模型拓展至深部已弯曲连接但尚未切穿地表的断层转换带，以此推断深部连通性。

kc: Presented a high-spatial-resolution structural, kinematic, Holocene throw, and geological throw dataset for the Roccapreturo normal fault system in the Central Apennines.

Demonstrated that fault strands separated at the surface exhibit steeper dips (59.1°–75.2° vs 52.9°–56.4°) within their overlap relay zone, confirming sub-surface linkage via an incipient fault bend at depth.
Showed that along-strike horizontal strain rates vary smoothly despite complex surface segmentation, confirming that fault geometry and slip are kinematically coupled.

Characterized the Roccapreturo fault system as structurally immature based on high strike standard deviation (18°), multi-scale relay zones, and a low geological throw-to-length ratio (0.055), proposing updates to the Fault2SHA database.
构建了中亚平宁山脉罗卡普雷图罗正断层系的高空间分辨率构造、运动学、全新世落差与地质落差数据集。
发现在地表分离的断层分支在其重叠转换带内表现出更陡的倾角（59.1°–75.2° 对比 52.9°–56.4°），证实了深部通过隐伏断层弯曲实现连接。
证明尽管地表分段复杂，沿走向的水平应变率仍呈平滑变化，证实了断层几何形态与滑动之间的运动学耦合。
基于高走向标准差（18°）、多尺度转换带及低地质落差长度比（0.055），判定该断层系处于低成熟度阶段，并提出了对Fault2SHA数据库的修订建议。
me: High-resolution field structural mapping of carbonate bedrock fault scarps to measure strike, dip, and frictional wear striae (trend and plunge of slip vectors).
Topographic profiling across post-Last Glacial Maximum (15 ± 3 kyr) fault scarps using chain-surveying and laser rangefinder (Trupulse) techniques to constrain Holocene throw and throw rates.
Construction of geological cross-sections from 1:50,000 geological maps to determine cumulative geological throw and throw-to-length (T/L) ratios.
Along-strike horizontal strain-rate tensor calculation across variable transect widths (0.5, 1, and 2 km) using an adaptation of Kostrov's equation and the geometry-dependent throw-rate model.
对碳酸盐岩基岩断层陡坎进行高分辨率野外构造填图，测量走向、倾角及摩擦擦痕（滑动矢量的倾伏向与倾伏角）。
利用测链法与激光测距仪（Trupulse）对末次盛冰期（15±3 kyr）以来的断层陡坎进行地形剖面测量，约束全新世落差及落差率。
基于1:50,000地质图构建地质横剖面，确定累积地质落差及落差-长度比（T/L）。
结合几何依赖落差率模型与改进的Kostrov公式，计算不同条带宽度（0.5、1和2 km）下的沿走向水平应变率张量。
de: Field measurements of fault strike, dip, and slip vector trend/plunge along the ~10 km Roccapreturo, Succiano, and Middle Aterno Valley West fault strands.
Nine newly collected and three previously published Holocene topographic throw profiles across well-preserved carbonate bedrock scarps.
Seven geological cross-sections perpendicular to fault strike derived from published 1:50,000 ISPRA geological sheets.
Regional compilation of geological throw and fault length data from normal faults across the Central Apennines (Fault2SHA database).
沿约10 km长的Roccapreturo、Succiano和Middle Aterno Valley West断层分支采集的野外断层走向、倾角和滑动矢量数据。
跨越保存完好的碳酸盐岩基岩陡坎的9条新采集与3条已发表的全新世地形落差剖面。
基于已发表的1:50,000意大利地质调查局（ISPRA）地质图构建的7条垂直断层走向的地质横剖面。
中亚平宁山脉正断层地质落差与断层长度的区域汇编数据（源自Fault2SHA数据库）。
li: Poor field exposure along the Middle Aterno Valley West, Succiano, and northwestern Roccapreturo traces limited structural mapping resolution and required omitting the Santa Maria Del Ponte West trace.
Lack of historical earthquakes and sparse paleoseismic records (only two events) prevent direct constraint of earthquake recurrence intervals or exact future surface linkage evolution.
Middle Aterno Valley West、Succiano及Roccapreturo西北段野外露头较差，限制了填图分辨率，且在应变率计算中不得不剔除Santa Maria Del Ponte West分支。
缺乏历史地震记录且古地震事件稀少（仅识别出两次事件），无法直接约束地震复发间隔或未来地表断层弯曲演化的具体几何形态。

tm.why: The study investigates fault geometry, structural maturity, relay zones, and sub-surface linkage of an active normal fault system using high-resolution structural mapping and strain-rate analysis.
The paper evaluates how sub-surface fault connectivity and structural maturity control maximum earthquake magnitude, rupture propagation, and seismic hazard assessment in the Central Apennines.
The authors use structural maturity and fault bend geometry to infer potential earthquake rupture dynamics, stress drops, and off-fault damage.

ev.notes: Full preprint text and all 8 figures from the 39-page PDF were analyzed.

sum: Accurate estimates of coseismic seafloor deformation and fault stress drop are vital for understanding megathrust earthquakes and tsunamis, yet simplified homogeneous half-space models are often assumed. This study investigates the 2011 Tohoku earthquake by conducting finite-element method (FEM) slip inversions and forward simulations incorporating realistic 3D seafloor topography (ETOPO1) and subsurface elastic heterogeneity (JIVSM, including a low-rigidity sedimentary wedge), constrained by offshore tsunami and onshore/offshore geodetic data. Incorporating 3D structure reduces maximum slip by ~20% (from 53 to 43 m) and shifts the peak ~20 km landward compared to half-space modeling, while preserving energy-based average stress drop (~3.7 MPa) and magnitude (Mw 8.9). Forward ablation tests reveal that tsunami excitation is increased by ~20% near the trench primarily due to seafloor topography rather than elastic heterogeneity. Conversely, fault stress drop is strongly modulated by along-strike variations in both sediment thickness and bathymetry.
本研究利用三维有限元法（FEM），结合海底海啸及陆海大地测量数据，反演并模拟了2011年日本东北大地震的滑动与同震应力降分布。模型纳入了真实三维海底地形（ETOPO1）和地下弹性非均匀结构（含低刚度沉积楔的JIVSM模型）。结果表明，相比均匀半空间模型，三维结构反演使最大滑动量减小约20%（从53米……

t: The authors compute 3D finite-element Green's functions using PyLith across a five-layer mesh incorporating JIVSM elastic properties and ETOPO1 bathymetry to invert for fault slip and shear stress drop, followed by four ablation forward simulations.
基于JIVSM弹性参数和ETOPO1地形构建五层PyLith三维有限元模型，反演滑动与应力降并开展四组消融正演模拟。

The inversion uses offshore tsunami data and onshore/offshore geodetic observations from Kubota et al. (2022), paired with plate interface geometry and elastic parameters from JIVSM, sediment wedge geometry from Ma (2023), and ETOPO1 bathymetry.
采用近海海啸及陆海大地测量数据，结合JIVSM板块界面与波速结构、三维沉积楔模型及ETOPO1海底地形。

3D inversion reduces peak slip by ~20% (53 to 43 m) and shifts it ~20 km landward while preserving average stress drop (3.7 MPa). Seafloor topography increases near-trench sea-surface uplift by ~20%, whereas thick sediment reduces off-Sanriku shallow stress drop by ~50%.
三维反演使峰值滑动减小约20%并向陆偏移20公里；海底地形使海面隆升增加约20%，沉积楔使三陆浅部应力降减半。

The elastic static modeling omits dynamic rupture amplification and inelastic sediment deformation, exhibits short-wavelength mesh artifacts in stress residuals, and only examines the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
纯弹性静态模型未考虑动力破裂放大与沉积物非弹性变形，且仅针对东北地震单一算例。

Systematically isolates the individual impacts of 3D seafloor topography versus subsurface elastic heterogeneity (including the sedimentary wedge) on both coseismic stress drop distributions and tsunami excitation for the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
系统分离并量化了三维海底地形与地下弹性非均匀性对东北地震海啸激发和同震应力降分布的独立影响。

kc: Performed 3D FEM slip and stress-drop inversion of the 2011 Tohoku earthquake, showing a ~20% reduction in peak slip and a ~20 km landward shift compared to half-space models.
Demonstrated via 3D FEM ablation models that seafloor topography increases near-trench sea-surface uplift by ~20%, whereas thick elastic sedimentary wedges have minimal impact on tsunami excitation.

Showed that interplate stress drop is strongly modulated by along-strike variations in both elastic structure (reducing shallow stress drop by ~50% off Sanriku) and seafloor topography, while preserving first-order average rupture energetics.
开展了纳入三维结构的2011年东北地震滑动与应力降有限元反演，发现相比半空间模型，峰值滑动减小约20%且向陆偏移约20公里。
通过三维有限元消融实验证明，海底地形使近海沟海面隆升增加约20%，而巨厚弹性沉积楔对海啸激发影响甚微。
揭示板间应力降受沿走向弹性结构（三陆近海浅部应力降减半）和地形共同调制，但一阶平均破裂能量特征保持不变。
me: 3D finite-element method (FEM) Green's function computation using PyLith on tetrahedral meshes with five structural layers.
Static slip inversion using Gaussian-shaped slip basis functions and calculation of shear traction changes on a nonplanar fault.
Sea-surface displacement modeling accounting for horizontal movement of sloping seafloor (Tanioka & Satake, 1996) and Kajiura water-column spatial filtering.
Forward ablation simulations comparing full-3D, structure-only, topography-only, and homogeneous half-space configurations.
使用PyLith在五层四面体网格上计算三维有限元（FEM）格林函数。
采用高斯型滑动基函数进行静态滑动反演，并计算非平面断层上的剪应力牵引变化。
考虑倾斜海底水平运动效应及Kajiura水柱空间滤波计算海面垂直位移。
开展全三维、仅结构、仅地形及均匀半空间四种配置的正演消融数值实验。
de: Offshore tsunami waveforms (ocean-bottom pressure gauges) and onshore/offshore geodetic displacement datasets from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake (Kubota et al., 2022).
Subsurface velocity and density structure from the Japan Integrated Velocity Structure Model (JIVSM) and 3D sedimentary wedge geometry from Ma (2023).
Seafloor bathymetry from the ETOPO1 1 arc-minute global relief model.
2011年东北地震的近海海啸波形（海底压力计）以及陆地与海底大地测量位移数据集。
日本综合速度结构模型（JIVSM）的地下速度与密度结构，以及Ma (2023)的三维沉积楔几何模型。
ETOPO1全球地形模型的海底测深数据。
li: Assumes purely elastic deformation and does not account for inelastic/plastic yielding of the soft sedimentary wedge or dynamic rupture amplification.
Short-wavelength artifacts appear in stress drop residuals due to differences in finite-element mesh configurations.
Examines only a single case study (the 2011 Tohoku earthquake), requiring verification across other megathrust events.
假设纯弹性变形，未考虑软沉积楔的非弹性/塑性屈服或动力破裂放大效应。
有限元网格配置差异导致应力降残差中存在短波长人为假象。
仅分析了2011年东北地震单一案例，结论普适性有待更多巨型逆冲地震检验。

tm.why: The study performs slip inversion and evaluates coseismic stress drop distributions and tsunami excitation for the 2011 Tohoku megathrust earthquake.
The paper investigates fault mechanics by calculating interplate shear stress changes, available strain energy, and the mechanical role of deep locking driving shallow slip.
The authors use 3D finite-element modeling (PyLith) on tetrahedral meshes to compute elastic Green's functions, seafloor deformation, and fault traction changes.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all sections, equations, and figures (Figs. 1–4).

sum: The authors present a physics-guided deep learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. By integrating Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling with an active learning paradigm, the method dynamically expands its training dataset with informative samples and their forward responses. A supervised deep learning model is trained using the Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function under a Gaussian assumption. Tested on a seismic velocity model inversion, the workflow successfully reconstructs geological features and velocity distributions with high computational efficiency, requiring only a small fraction of the data compared to full-cube MCMC.
本文提出了一种用于地球物理反演的物理引导深度学习框架。该方法将马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样与主动学习相结合，通过随机采样器输出及其正演响应动态扩展训练集。采用以Jensen-Shannon散度为损失函数的监督深度学习模型，并在高斯假设下进行解析计算。在地震速度模型反演测试中，该工作流成功重建了……

t: A physics-guided deep learning framework integrating MCMC sampling with active learning, using Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function under a Gaussian assumption.
结合MCMC采样与主动学习的物理引导深度学习框架，在高斯假设下以JS散度为损失函数。
Synthetic seismic velocity model data used to test the inversion workflow and reconstruct geological features.
用于测试反演工作流并重建地质特征的合成地震速度模型数据。
The workflow successfully captured velocity distributions matching the reference model with significantly higher computational efficiency than full-cube MCMC.
成功捕获了与参考模型一致的速度分布，且计算效率显著高于全数据MCMC。
The framework assumes a Gaussian distribution for analytical computation of the Jensen-Shannon divergence loss.
损失函数的解析计算依赖于简化的高斯分布假设。
Combining self-supervised active learning with stochastic MCMC sampling to dynamically expand training data for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion.
将自监督主动学习与随机MCMC采样结合，动态扩展训练数据以实现高效贝叶斯反演。

kc: Developed a physics-guided deep learning framework that integrates MCMC sampling with active learning for efficient uncertainty quantification.
Introduced a dynamic training dataset expansion strategy using stochastic sampler outputs and their corresponding forward responses.
Utilized the Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function with a Gaussian assumption for analytical computation in supervised learning.
开发了一种将MCMC采样与主动学习相结合的物理引导深度学习框架，用于高效的不确定性定量评估。
引入了利用随机采样器输出及其对应正演响应动态扩展训练数据集的策略。
在监督学习中采用以Jensen-Shannon散度为损失函数并结合高斯假设进行解析计算的方法。
me: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling for Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
Active learning paradigm to select diverse and informative training samples.
Supervised deep learning with Jensen-Shannon divergence loss function.
用于贝叶斯不确定性定量评估的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样。
用于选择多样且富含信息量训练样本的主动学习范式。
采用Jensen-Shannon散度损失函数的监督深度学习。
de: Synthetic seismic velocity model inversion to capture geological features and velocity distributions.
用于捕获地质特征和速度分布的合成地震速度模型反演。
li: The analytical computation of the loss function relies on a simplifying Gaussian assumption which may not hold for highly non-linear or multi-modal posterior distributions.

tm.why: The paper develops a physics-guided deep learning framework incorporating MCMC sampling to assess uncertainty in geophysical inversion.
The framework utilizes a supervised deep learning model and self-supervised active learning to accelerate the inversion process.
The study focuses on improving the computational efficiency of geophysical inversion and Bayesian inference.
