sum: This study evaluates whether machine learning (ML) improves 30-day earthquake forecasting over modern Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) models in the Sea of Marmara. Using a homogenized, strictly causal KOERI catalog (31,360 events, 2003–2026) verified by a bit-for-bit truncated-catalog self-test, the authors compare an ETAS×ML gradient-boosted hybrid against full cascade Monte-Carlo ETAS baselines. Under pre-specified conjunctive adjudication requiring both likelihood and precision–recall AUC agreement, the ML hybrid adds no ranking skill over ETAS. Furthermore, the authors derive a closed-form scoring artifact identity, a(h) = h - 1 - ln(h), proving that apparent count-scored likelihood gains against binary targets result from pure rescaling. Re-evaluated with a proper Bernoulli score, only a modest active-cell occurrence recalibration remains. For the 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz mainshock, spatial hazard ranked in the top 1–2% all year, while temporal escalation occurred only 36 minutes prior via a foreshock indistinguishable from ~220 false alarms.
本研究评估了在马尔马拉海区域，消除数据泄露和评分伪影后，机器学习（ML）相比现代ETAS模型能否提升30天地震预测能力。基于均一化且通过截断目录自检验证严格因果性的KOERI目录（31,360个事件），作者将ETAS×ML梯度提升混合模型与全联锁蒙特卡洛ETAS基准进行对比。结果表明，ML混合模型未……

t: A log-linear hybrid blending a recursive Monte-Carlo ETAS cascade simulator with Poisson gradient boosting over 19 strictly causal features, audited by bit-for-bit catalog truncation and block-bootstrap conjunctive scoring.
结合递归蒙特卡洛ETAS模拟与基于19个严格因果特征的泊松梯度提升回归，通过逐比特目录截断与块自举联合评分审核。
Homogenized KOERI earthquake catalog (2003–2026, 31,360 events, Mc = 3.0) on a 0.1° grid (1,219 cells) in the Sea of Marmara, paired with GEM active faults and GNSS velocities.
马尔马拉海0.1°网格（1,219个单元）上的均一化KOERI地震目录（2003–2026，31,360个事件，Mc=3…

At M≥3.0/30-day, the hybrid (PR-AUC 0.226) is statistically inseparable from cascade ETAS (0.233); its +0.29 nats/positive count-likelihood gain is a rescaling artifact a(h) = 0.415, reducing to +0.095 under proper Bernoulli scoring.
M≥3.0目标下混合模型（PR-AUC 0.226）与联锁ETAS（0.233）统计不可分；+0.29似然增益属缩放伪影…
The test set contains only 26 temporal windows with a single M≥6 event, was exposed across four amended evaluation passes, and suffers from 28.8× b-value extrapolation uncertainty.
测试集仅含26个时间窗口和1次M≥6地震，经历了四轮修正评估，且受28.8倍b值外推不确定性限制。
Derives the closed-form count-versus-occupancy scoring artifact a(h) = h - 1 - ln(h) and pairs machine-checkable feature causality with coverage-only placebo surrogates for earthquake forecasting.
推导出计数对占有率评分伪影闭合公式a(h)=h-1-ln(h)，并将机器可检因果性与仅覆盖率安慰剂检验结合。

kc: Demonstrates an adjudicated negative result showing an ETAS×ML hybrid adds no spatial ranking skill over properly-fit cascade ETAS baselines under machine-checkable causality.
Derives a closed-form scoring-artifact identity a(h) = h - 1 - ln(h) quantifying the Bregman divergence between count and binary occupancy functionals in clustered forecasts.
Shows via feature ablation and placebo batteries that gradient boosting cannot reconstruct ETAS from catalog features and that apparent GNSS gains are station-availability artifacts.
Introduces an information-arrival analysis and false-alarm denominator for the 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz earthquake, separating tractable spatial ranking from foreshock-bounded timing.
在机器可检的因果控制下证明了ETAS×ML混合模型相比现代联锁ETAS基准不增加任何空间排序技能。
推导出闭合形式的评分伪影恒等式a(h) = h - 1 - ln(h)，量化了成丛预测中计数与二元占有泛函之间的Bregman散度。
通过特征消融和安慰剂检验表明梯度提升树无法从目录特征重建ETAS，且GNSS通道的表观增益仅是台站可用性代理。
针对2025年Mw 6.2地震引入信息到达分析与虚报分母，将可处理的全年空间排序与受限于前震统计的发震时间区分开。
me: Truncated-catalog causality self-test across 5,975,538 feature checks to guarantee zero look-ahead data leakage.
Full recursive cascade Monte-Carlo ETAS simulator with anisotropic aftershock kernels and subcritical branching ratio rescaling.
Log-linear ETAS×ML hybrid blending cascade ETAS rates with Poisson gradient-boosted regression over 19 causal catalog and geophysical features.
Conjunctive stationary block-bootstrap adjudication requiring 95% confidence intervals on both information gain and PR-AUC to exclude zero.
Proper binary Bernoulli log-scoring with 1/K Monte-Carlo debiasing and placebo surrogate batteries (time-shuffled, circularly-shifted, coverage-only).
对5,975,538个特征值执行截断目录因果自检，确保零前瞻数据泄露。
构建具有各向异性余震核与亚临界分支比缩放的全递归联锁蒙特卡洛ETAS模拟器。
建立对数线性ETAS×ML混合模型，融合联锁ETAS率与基于19个因果特征的泊松梯度提升回归。
采用联合平稳块自举裁决规则，要求信息增益和PR-AUC的95%置信区间同时排除零。
应用带1/K去偏的恰当二元伯努利对数评分以及安慰剂替代检验组（时间打乱、循环移位、仅覆盖率）。
de: Homogenized KOERI regional earthquake catalog (2003–2026, 31,360 model-box events, base Mc = 3.0) on a 0.1° grid across the Sea of Marmara.
GEM Global Active Faults Database (97 segments) used for anisotropic kernel orientation and time-causal Okada Coulomb stress change (ΔCFS) calculations.
Nevada Geodetic Laboratory GNSS station velocities (22 continuous stations) and dense sub-Mc3 AFAD catalog tested via placebo batteries.
Community pyCSEP catalog-based consistency tests (number, magnitude, spatial, pseudo-likelihood) and retrospective information-arrival tracking on the 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz event.
马尔马拉海0.1°网格上均一化的KOERI区域地震目录（2003–2026年，31,360个事件，完备震级Mc = 3.0）。
GEM全球活动断层数据库（97个断层段），用于各向异性核定向和因果Okada库仑应力变化（ΔCFS）计算。
内华达大地测量实验室GNSS台站速度场（22个连续站）与密集的AFAD微震目录（用于安慰剂检验）。
基于pyCSEP的目录一致性检验（数量、震级、空间、伪似然）以及对2025年Mw 6.2地震的回顾性信息到达追踪。
li: The test set spans only 26 temporal windows in a single region with only one M≥6 event, making large-event statements reliant on Gutenberg-Richter extrapolation.
The test set was evaluated across four campaigns rather than remaining strictly pristine, though governed by dated, hashed amendments on frozen predictions.
Magnitude law (b-value) uncertainty dominates M≥6 probability extrapolations by a factor of 28.8, and the cascade spatial kernel fails CSEP spatial consistency tests due to over-smoothing.
测试集仅包含单一区域的26个时间窗口和1次M≥6地震，大震结论依赖于古登堡-里克特外推。
测试集经历了四轮评估而非完全原始状态，尽管后续评估均在冻结预测上通过带哈希时间戳的修正案管理。
震级律（b值）不确定性主导了M≥6概率外推（跨度达28.8倍），且联锁模型的空间核因过度平滑未能通过CSEP空间一致性检验。

tm.why: Evaluates a Poisson gradient-boosted regression hybrid model against physics-based ETAS baselines for 30-day earthquake forecasting under strict causality and leakage controls.
Focuses on 30-day probabilistic earthquake forecasting and hazard ranking in the Sea of Marmara seismic gap, including analysis of the 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz earthquake.
Performs extensive catalog homogenization, magnitude typing, completeness analysis, and truncated-catalog causality testing on the KOERI regional bulletin.

ev.notes: Full 37-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 6 figures and 4 main tables. Note that the manuscript title on page 1 ('Machine learning versus ETAS for earthquake forecasting in the Sea of Marmara: a leakage-audited negative result and a closed-form scoring artifact') slightly updates the metadata title, and the deduplicated catalog count is 31,360 in the main text versus 31,329 in the metadata abstract.

sum: The authors apply the Coda Calibration Tool to calibrate coda envelopes for shallow earthquakes in mainland Alaska, referencing NEIC moment magnitudes and spectral ratio apparent stress estimates. This calibration corrects for path attenuation (Q) to yield consistent source spectra across surface and borehole stations. They calculate Mw for 700 events and apparent stress for 200 events, establishing a new orthogonal regression relationship between Mw and ML. To isolate spatial variations in tectonic stress, they introduce detrended apparent stress parameters (ψa and φa) that remove magnitude and depth dependencies. The results reveal elevated apparent stress in south-central Alaska, the Kaktovik region of northern Alaska, and along the Tintina fault.
本文利用尾波包络校正工具（CCT）对阿拉斯加大陆的浅源地震进行校正，获得了700个地震的矩震级（Mw）和200个地震的视应力。该方法有效消除了地表台站低Q值衰减的影响，使地表与井下台站的震源谱高度一致。研究建立了适用于阿拉斯加的Mw与ML正交回归转换关系，并引入了消除震级与深度相关性的新型视应力参数……

t: Coda envelope calibration using the Coda Calibration Tool (CCT) to correct for path attenuation and site effects, combined with orthogonal regression for magnitude conversion.
利用尾波校正工具（CCT）进行尾波包络校正以消除衰减与场址效应，并结合正交回归进行震级转换。
Waveform data from surface and borehole stations in Alaska, calibrated using ~70 reference Mw events and 13 reference apparent stress estimates.
阿拉斯加地表和井下台站的波形数据，基于约70个参考Mw地震和13个参考视应力值进行校正。
Calculated Mw for 700 events and apparent stress for 200 events, revealing high apparent stress in south-central Alaska, northern Alaska, and the Tintina fault.
计算了700个地震的Mw和200个地震的视应力，发现阿拉斯加中南部、北部及廷蒂纳断裂带视应力偏高。
The derived calibration parameters and empirical scaling relationships are restricted to shallow earthquakes within mainland Alaska.
所得的校正参数和经验转换关系仅适用于阿拉斯加大陆区域的浅源地震。
Introduction of magnitude- and depth-detrended apparent stress parameters (ψa and φa) to isolate pure spatial tectonic stress variations.
引入了消除震级和深度趋势的新型视应力参数（ψa和φa），用以准确揭示空间构造应力变化。

kc: Calibrated the coda envelope method for mainland Alaska to produce stable, site-independent source spectra.
Calculated Mw for 700 shallow earthquakes and apparent stress for 200 events.
Developed a new orthogonal regression conversion relationship between Mw and ML for Alaskan earthquakes.
Introduced magnitude- and depth-detrended apparent stress metrics (ψa and φa) to isolate spatial tectonic variations.
针对阿拉斯加大陆进行了尾波包络方法校正，获得了稳定且不依赖台站场址效应的震源谱。
计算了700个浅源地震的矩震级（Mw）以及200个地震的视应力。
建立了适用于阿拉斯加地震的全新Mw与ML正交回归转换关系。
引入了消除震级和深度依赖性的视应力指标（ψa和φa），用以孤立空间构造应力变化。
me: Coda envelope calibration using the Coda Calibration Tool (CCT).
Coda spectral ratios method for reference apparent stress estimation.
Orthogonal regression accounting for uncertainties in both Mw and ML.
Multiple linear regression to detrend apparent stress from magnitude and depth.
使用尾波校正工具（CCT）进行尾波包络校正。
采用尾波谱比值法估算参考视应力。
采用考虑Mw和ML双重误差的正交回归分析。
利用多元线性回归消除视应力对震级和深度的依赖性。
de: Seismic waveforms from surface and borehole stations in mainland Alaska.
Reference dataset of ~70 NEIC moment magnitudes (3.6 < Mw < 5.2) and 13 reference apparent stress estimates.
Dataset of 700 shallow earthquakes for Mw calculation and 200 events for apparent stress analysis.
来自阿拉斯加大陆地表和井下台站的地震波形数据。
包含约70个NEIC矩震级（3.6 < Mw < 5.2）和13个参考视应力估算值的参考数据集。
用于Mw计算的700个浅源地震及用于视应力分析的200个地震事件。
li: The calibration and Mw-ML conversion relationship are regionally specific and only validated for shallow events in mainland Alaska.
该校正结果和Mw-ML转换关系具有区域局限性，仅在阿拉斯加大陆的浅源地震中得到验证。

tm.why: The paper focuses on deriving earthquake source parameters, specifically moment magnitude and apparent stress, using coda envelope calibration.
The study utilizes coda envelope calibration and corrects for low Q attenuation to obtain stable source spectra.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study integrates petrography, whole-rock XRF geochemistry, and laboratory petrophysical measurements (porosity, permeability, density, and ultrasonic P- and S-wave velocities) to evaluate how lava emplacement and post-emplacement alteration control volcanic reservoir quality in the Serra Geral Group, southern Brazil. Comparing the basal Torres Formation (TF, compound pāhoehoe) and overlying Vale do Sol Formation (VSF, rubbly pāhoehoe), the authors find that TF behaves as a nearly closed system with low porosity (1.5–16.7%), negligible permeability, weak alteration (CIA 38–51), and high Vp (up to 5.96 km/s). Conversely, VSF's autobrecciated upper crusts promote open-system behavior with higher porosity (2.0–21.6%), lower density, more variable Vp (2.96–5.37 km/s), and pervasive smectite/zeolite precipitation. Across both units, Vp correlates inversely with porosity rather than bulk geochemical alteration indices due to near-isochemical replacement. The study establishes that rubbly pāhoehoe horizons are prime targets for subsurface fluid and CO2 storage.
本研究结合岩相学、全岩XRF地球化学及实验室岩石物理测量（孔隙度、渗透率、密度及超声波纵横波速度），评估了巴西南部的Serra Geral群玄武岩中熔岩就位与蚀变对火山储层质量的控制。对比Torres组（复合绳状熔岩）与Vale do Sol组（碎石状绳状熔岩）发现，前者呈封闭系统，孔隙度低（1.5……

t: Integrated petrography, whole-rock XRF geochemistry (CIA and MIA(O) indices), nitrogen porosimetry/permeametry, and 1 MHz ultrasonic through-transmission P- and S-wave velocity measurements on 1-inch basalt core plugs.
结合岩相学、XRF地球化学、氮气孔渗测量及1 MHz超声波透射纵横波速度测试。
24 core plugs for petrophysical/ultrasonic testing and 31 samples for XRF geochemistry collected from lava-flow upper crusts across four stratigraphic sections (425–1000 m thick) in southern Brazil.
巴西南部的4条剖面熔岩上部壳层的24个岩石物理岩心塞及31个XRF地球化学样品。
Torres Formation shows 1.5–16.7% porosity, 2.22–2.76 g/cm3 density, and Vp up to 5.96 km/s; Vale do Sol Formation shows 2.0–21.6% porosity, 2.08–2.50 g/cm3 density, and Vp from 2.96 to 5.37 km/s.
Permeability was measured at the 1-inch core-plug matrix scale, which does not capture macroscopic fracture networks that control rock-mass fluid flow at reservoir scales.
渗透率仅在岩心塞基质尺度测量，未反映储层尺度的宏观裂缝流体网络。
Links primary lava emplacement architecture and near-isochemical alteration pathways to ultrasonic elastic velocities and reservoir storage quality in the lower Serra Geral Group.
揭示了熔岩就位结构与近等化学蚀变对玄武岩超声波速及CO2储层质量的控制。

kc: Demonstrates that primary lava emplacement morphology exerts a first-order control on petrophysical and elastic properties in the Serra Geral Group.
Quantifies the decoupling between pervasive thin-section mineralogical replacement and low bulk-rock geochemical alteration indices (CIA and MIA(O)) caused by near-isochemical alteration.
Establishes empirical relationships among ultrasonic P- and S-wave velocities, porosity, density, and effective medium bounds (Voigt-Reuss) for altered flood basalts.
证明了原生熔岩就位形态对Serra Geral群岩石物理和弹性性质起一阶控制作用。
量化了由近等化学蚀变引起的薄片尺度广泛矿物交代与全岩低化学蚀变指数（CIA和MIA(O)）之间的解耦现象。
建立了蚀变溢流玄武岩的超声波纵横波速度、孔隙度、密度与等效介质理论界限（Voigt-Reuss）之间的经验关系。
me: Field stratigraphic logging and petrographic thin-section analysis of lava flow upper crusts.
Laboratory petrophysical measurements using nitrogen gas expansion porosimetry, pulse-decay permeametry (200 psi), and 1 MHz through-transmission ultrasonic Vp and Vs testing.
Whole-rock X-ray fluorescence (XRF) geochemistry and calculation of Chemical Index of Alteration (CIA) and oxidative Mafic Index of Alteration (MIA(O)).
Rock physics modeling using Voigt and Reuss effective medium bounds with varying clay content.
熔岩流上部壳层的野外地层测井与岩相学薄片分析。
利用氮气膨胀孔隙度仪、脉冲衰减渗透率仪（200 psi）及1 MHz透射超声波测试进行实验室岩石物理测量（孔隙度、渗透率、密度、Vp和Vs）。
全岩X射线荧光光谱（XRF）地球化学分析及化学蚀变指数（CIA）与铁镁质氧化蚀变指数（MIA(O)）计算。
结合不同黏土含量的Voigt和Reuss等效介质理论界限进行岩石物理建模。
de: Four stratigraphic sections (425 to ~1000 m thick) logged across the Calha de Torres region, Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil.
24 cylindrical core plugs (1-inch diameter) from upper crust facies tested for porosity, permeability, density, Vp, and Vs.
31 outcrop samples (11 Torres Formation, 20 Vale do Sol Formation) analyzed for whole-rock major element geochemistry via XRF.
巴西南里奥格兰德州Calha de Torres地区测量的4条代表性火山地层剖面（厚425至约1000米）。
采自熔岩流上部壳层相的24个1英寸直径柱状岩心塞的孔隙度、渗透率、密度及纵横波速度实验数据。
31个露头样品（Torres组11个，Vale do Sol组20个）的全岩主量元素XRF地球化学数据。
li: Permeability measurements are restricted to the 1-inch core plug matrix scale and do not capture macroscopic fracture-controlled fluid flow at the reservoir scale.
Samples were collected from surface outcrops, which may experience localized recent meteoric weathering.
Sampling was restricted exclusively to the upper crusts of lava flows, omitting systematic laboratory testing of dense lava cores in this dataset.
渗透率测量局限于1英寸岩心塞的基质尺度，无法捕捉储层尺度受宏观裂缝控制的流体流动。
样品采自地表露头，可能受到局部近代大气降水风化的叠加影响。
采样仅限于熔岩流的上部壳层，数据集中缺乏对致密熔岩核部的系统实验室测试。

tm.why: The study measures laboratory P- and S-wave velocities and petrophysical properties of flood basalts to characterize volcanic reservoir architectures.
The paper investigates the stratigraphic architecture, geochemistry, and elastic properties of continental flood basalts in the Paraná-Etendeka Magmatic Province.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF was provided and analyzed, including all sections, 2 tables, and 16 figures.

sum: This study analyzes continuous seismic records in the Eastern Mediterranean using wavefield coherence. The authors identify a previously unknown, persistent narrowband seismic signal at 0.03 Hz that has been active over a 15-year period. The signal originates from the Nile Fan, a region known for deep fluid reservoirs and active seafloor fluid seepage. To explain the physical mechanism, the authors model the signal as the resonance of a kilometer-scale, fluid-filled crack. They also document a significant seasonal modulation of the signal's strength, highlighting a dynamic interaction between solid Earth fluid processes and oceanic activity.
本研究利用波场相干性分析了东地中海的连续地震记录，发现了一个在0.03 Hz处持续存在了15年的未知窄带地震信号。该信号源自具有深部流体储层和活跃海底流体渗漏的尼罗河扇（Nile Fan）地区。结合地质观测，研究人员将该信号模拟为千米级充液裂缝的共振。此外，研究还记录了信号强度的显著季节性调制，揭示……

t: Continuous seismic wavefield coherence analysis is used to identify weak, persistent narrowband signals within ambient noise.
利用连续地震波场相干性分析方法，从环境噪声中识别微弱且持续的窄带信号。
15 years of continuous seismic records from the Eastern Mediterranean region.
使用覆盖东地中海地区、跨越15年时间的连续地震波形记录。
Identification of a persistent 0.03 Hz signal originating from the Nile Fan, modeled as a kilometer-scale fluid-filled crack resonance with seasonal modulation.
发现源自尼罗河扇的0.03 Hz持续信号，并将其成功模拟为受季节性海洋调制的千米级充液裂缝共振。
The simplified resonance model of a single fluid-filled crack may simplify the complex 3D plumbing system of the Nile Fan.
单一充液裂缝的共振模型可能简化了尼罗河扇复杂的深部三维流体通道系统。
Discovery of a long-term (15-year) persistent 0.03 Hz signal linked to deep fluid seepage and modulated by seasonal ocean processes.
首次发现与深部流体渗漏相关并受季节性海洋活动调制的15年超长周期持续0.03 Hz地震信号。

kc: Discovered a previously unknown, persistent 0.03 Hz narrowband seismic signal in the Eastern Mediterranean active over 15 years.
Located the source of the persistent signal to the Nile Fan region, which is characterized by deep fluid reservoirs.
Modeled the physical mechanism of the signal as the resonance of a kilometer-scale, fluid-filled crack.
Documented a seasonal modulation of the signal strength, demonstrating coupling between oceanic activity and solid Earth fluid processes.
在东地中海发现了一个此前未知的、持续存在15年之久的0.03 Hz窄带地震信号。
将该持续信号的源头定位在具有深部流体储层的尼罗河扇（Nile Fan）地区。
将该信号的物理机制模拟为千米级充液裂缝的共振。
记录了信号强度的季节性调制，展示了海洋活动与固体地球流体过程之间的耦合。
me: Continuous seismic wavefield coherence analysis to detect weak, long-lasting emergent signals.
Seismic source localization to pinpoint the origin of the narrowband signal at the Nile Fan.
Numerical or analytical modeling of fluid-filled crack resonance at kilometer scales.
连续地震波场相干性分析，用于检测微弱且持续的渐现信号。
地震源定位技术，以精确确定尼罗河扇窄带信号的源头。
千米级充液裂缝共振的数值或解析模拟。
de: 15 years of continuous seismic waveform data from stations surrounding the Eastern Mediterranean.
Geological and geophysical data of fluid reservoirs and active seepage in the Nile Fan region.
来自东地中海周边台站的15年连续地震波形数据。
尼罗河扇地区流体储层和活跃渗漏的地质与地球物理数据。
li: The simplified kilometer-scale fluid-filled crack model may not capture the full geometric complexity of the Nile Fan reservoir system.
The exact physical coupling mechanism driving the seasonal modulation remains to be fully quantified.
简化的千米级充液裂缝模型可能无法完全捕获尼罗河扇储层系统的全部几何复杂性。
驱动季节性调制的具体物理耦合机制仍有待完全定量化。

tm.why: The paper analyzes continuous seismic records and wavefield coherence to identify a persistent 0.03 Hz narrowband seismic noise signal.
The signal is modeled as fluid-filled crack resonance with seasonal modulation from ocean-solid Earth interactions.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata from Seismological Research Letters, as no PDF was available.

sum: This preface introduces the Seismological Research Letters Focus Section on Environmental Seismology, motivated by the rapid expansion of the field and a recent SSA topical conference. The authors synthesize 16 contributed papers that utilize a wide array of sensors—including modern broadband seismometers, historical pre-WWII analog instruments, compact nodes, downhole geophones, and distributed acoustic sensing (DAS)—alongside passive and active seismic techniques. The highlighted studies investigate diverse natural, biogenic, and anthropogenic sources such as ocean microseisms, Arctic cryospheric processes, catastrophic landslides, baleen whale calls, sewer pipeline hydraulic shocks, and subsurface lightning strikes. Additionally, several articles image shallow critical-zone velocity structures, permafrost active layers, and environmentally modulated tectonic earthquake swarms (triggered by rainfall or ocean wave loading). Collectively, this synthesis demonstrates how novel instrumentation and processing algorithms bridge traditional earthquake seismology with hazard mitigation, climate tracking, and environmental monitoring.
本文是《地震学研究快报》“环境地震学”专辑的序言，综述了该领域的最新进展与本专辑收录的16篇研究论文。这些研究综合利用现代宽频带地震仪、二战前历史模拟记录、密集节点、井下检波器及分布式声学传感（DAS）等设备，结合主、被动源地震干涉、阵列聚束与深度学习方法，探究了海洋微震、北极冰冻圈、滑坡、鲸鱼叫声……

t: Editorial review and thematic synthesis of 16 papers in the Environmental Seismology Focus Section, spanning passive/active seismic imaging, array beamforming, machine learning, and numerical modeling.
对环境地震学专辑的16篇论文进行主题综述，涵盖主被动源成像、聚束、机器学习与数值建模。
Covers datasets across 16 studies using modern broadband seismometers, pre-WWII legacy analog records, downhole geophones, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), and compact seismic nodes.
涵盖宽频带地震仪、二战前模拟记录、井下检波器、分布式声学传感（DAS）及密集节点数据。

Demonstrates state-of-the-art environmental seismology capabilities, including >95% precision/recall in zero-shot whale call detection, 15-year tracking of 0.03 Hz Mediterranean resonance, and rainfall/ocean-loading modulation of seismicity.
展示了零样本鲸鱼叫声检测（准确率>95%）、15年0.03 Hz共振追踪及降雨/海浪触发地震等成果。

Harsh environmental deployments (such as high-Arctic DAS) pose practical difficulties in cable deployment, repair, and protection, while traditional satellite landslide detection suffers from lag times.
严酷极地环境下的DAS光缆部署与维护存在实际困难，且传统卫星滑坡监测存在滞后性。

Synthesizes the latest wave of environmental seismology driven by DAS, compact nodes, and foundation models, bridging traditional earthquake seismology with human-relevant hazard and climate monitoring.
总结了由DAS、密集节点与基础模型驱动的环境地震学新进展，连接传统地震学与灾害气候监测。

kc: Reviews the historical evolution of environmental seismology from the mid-2000s ambient noise revolution to modern high-density sensing.
Synthesizes 16 new studies spanning microseisms, biogenic/anthropogenic sources, cryoseismology, landslide hazards, near-surface imaging, and environmentally modulated seismicity.
Identifies overarching themes driving the field: novel instrumentation (DAS, compact nodes), diverse active/passive methods, and direct relevance to human hazards and climate.
回顾了环境地震学自2000年代中期背景噪声革命至现代高密度传感的发展历程。
综述了涵盖海洋微震、生物/人为震源、冰冻圈地震学、滑坡灾害、近地表成像及受环境调制的地震活动等16项最新研究。
提炼了驱动该领域发展的核心主题：新型仪器（DAS、紧凑型节点）、多样化主被动分析技术以及对人类灾害与气候监测的直接贡献。
me: Literature synthesis and thematic categorization of 16 Focus Section papers.

Highlights diverse methodologies across the issue: empirical instrument response recovery, noise cross-correlation uncertainty analysis, beamforming, zero-shot vision foundation models, seismic interferometry, joint HVSR/dispersion inversion, and finite-element pore-pressure modeling.
对专辑收录的16篇论文进行文献综述与主题分类。
总结了专辑涵盖的多样化方法：经验仪器响应恢复、噪声互相关不确定性评估、聚束分析、零样本视觉基础模型、地震干涉测量、HVSR与频散联合反演以及孔隙压力有限元建模。
de: Synthesizes studies utilizing historical 1930s analog records, global landslide databases, 15-year ocean buoy and broadband archives, borehole and Arctic surface DAS arrays, nodal arrays, and active-source critical zone surveys.
综述了利用1930年代历史模拟地震记录、全球滑坡数据库、15年海洋浮标与宽频带连续记录、井下与北极地表DAS阵列、密集节点阵列以及主动源关键带勘探数据的多项研究。
li: As an editorial preface, it provides brief high-level summaries rather than primary data or detailed technical evaluations of individual algorithms.
Highlights ongoing field challenges reported by contributors, such as harsh Arctic conditions requiring specialized DAS cable protection and repair.
作为期刊专辑序言，仅提供宏观概述，不包含原始数据或对具体算法的深入技术评估。
指出了各研究中面临的实际挑战，如严酷北极环境下DAS光缆部署、保护与修复的困难。

tm.why: This preface directly introduces the Focus Section on Environmental Seismology, covering cryoseismology, landslides, ocean microseisms, and anthropogenic/biogenic seismic sources.
Many highlighted studies rely on ambient seismic noise cross-correlation, microseism analysis, and seismic interferometry to track surface and near-surface changes.
The preface highlights the rapid adoption of DAS technology in environmental seismology, including Arctic cryoseismology and borehole lightning detection.

ev.notes: Evaluated directly from the full 5-page PDF (ETH Zurich repository cover page + 4 journal pages, pp. 2201-2204 of Seismological Research Letters). The paper is an editorial preface without figures or tables.

sum: This study uses crustal-scale analog modeling to investigate the formation of V-shaped rifts far from plate tectonic rotational poles, using the South China Sea (SCS) as a prototype. The authors demonstrate that the diachronous, eastward-younging, and narrowing V-shaped opening of the SCS was governed by the combined effects of differential extension (driven by along-strike variations in Proto-SCS subduction) and inherited lithospheric strength heterogeneities. Specifically, weak remnants of Mesozoic magmatic arcs in the east and strong continental basement blocks in the west acted as key structural-rheological controls on strain localization and crustal thinning, regulating the necking along the continent-ocean boundary.
本研究采用地壳尺度物理模拟方法，以南海为原型，探讨远离板块旋转极点的V型裂谷形成机制。结果表明，南海自东向西的渐进式、东部年轻且变窄的V型开裂受控于差异伸展（由古南海俯冲的走向变化驱动）与继承性岩石圈强度非均匀性的联合作用。东部中生代岩浆弧残余弱区与西部强大陆基底块体作为关键的结构-流变控制因素，主……

t: Crustal-scale physical analog modeling simulating lithospheric extension with pre-existing rheological heterogeneities.
地壳尺度物理模拟方法，模拟具有先存流变非均匀性的岩石圈伸展过程。
Scaled physical models representing the rheological structure of the South China Sea lithosphere under differential boundary forces.
等比例物理模型，代表在差异边界力作用下南海岩石圈的流变结构。
Models show along-strike variations in Proto-SCS subduction and pre-existing weak/strong blocks produced the eastward younging and narrowing V-shaped SCS rift.
模拟表明古南海俯冲走向变化与先存强/弱块体共同导致了南海向东年轻化和变窄的V型开裂。
The simplified physical setup cannot fully capture the absolute thermodynamic and chemical variations of the lithosphere.
简化的物理模型无法完全捕获岩石圈绝对的热动力学和化学演化。
Explains V-shaped rift propagation far from rotational poles through combined pre-existing strength heterogeneities and differential extension.
通过结合先存强度非均匀性与差异伸展，解释了远离旋转极点的V型裂谷传播机制。

kc: Demonstrated that V-shaped rifts can form far from rotational poles through combined differential extension and strength heterogeneities.
Revealed how Proto-SCS subduction variations drove spatially variable extension and diachronous rift initiation.
Identified the role of Mesozoic magmatic arcs (weak) and pre-existing basement blocks (strong) in controlling strain localization and crustal thinning.
证实了在远离旋转极点区域，差异伸展与强度非均匀性联合作用可形成V型裂谷。
揭示了古南海俯冲变化如何驱动空间差异性伸展及穿时性裂陷启动。
明确了中生代岩浆弧（弱区）与先存基底块体（强区）在控制应变局域化和地壳减薄中的作用。
me: Crustal-scale physical analog modeling to simulate lithospheric extension and rifting processes.
地壳尺度物理模拟方法，用于模拟岩石圈伸展与裂陷演化过程。
de: Analog laboratory experiments designed with scaled rheological layers representing weak magmatic arcs and strong continental basement blocks under differential extension.
物理模拟实验室实验，设计了代表弱岩浆弧和强大陆基底块体的等比例流变分层，并施加差异伸展。
li: Analog models simplify complex 3D thermal and chemical evolution of the lithosphere over geological timescales.
物理模拟简化了地质时间尺度上岩石圈复杂的温压及化学演化过程。

tm.why: The paper uses crustal-scale analog modeling to investigate lithospheric rifting, crustal thinning, and tectonic deformation in the South China Sea.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from JGR: Solid Earth.

sum: This study investigates volcano-tectonic interactions in the Natron Rift (East African Rift System) using 3D finite-element modeling (PyLith). The authors simulate crustal deformation and Coulomb stress changes on the Natron Fault caused by shallow magma reservoir deflation (2007–2008 eruption, constrained by InSAR) and inflation (2016–2023, constrained by TZVOLCANO GNSS data) beneath Ol Doinyo Lengai volcano. Models test homogeneous versus 3D seismic-derived heterogeneous elastic properties, with and without realistic topography. Including topography halves horizontal GNSS WRMS misfits (from 1.2–1.4 mm to 0.6–0.7 mm) and nearly doubles fault stress magnitudes because topographic relief (~2.3 km) matches magma source depth (~2.5–3.0 km), whereas elastic heterogeneity plays a minor role. Results demonstrate that magma inflation clamps the adjacent fault segment (Delta CFS up to -0.093 MPa), inhibiting slip, while deflation unclamps the fault (Delta CFS up to 3.4 MPa, exceeding the 0.1 MPa triggering threshold), promoting oblique normal faulting.
本研究利用PyLith三维有限元模拟探讨东非裂谷纳特龙裂谷的火山-构造相互作用。结合InSAR和GNSS数据，模拟了伦盖火山浅部岩浆房2007-2008年收缩和2016-2023年膨胀引起的地表形变及纳特龙断层库仑应力变化，对比了地形与三维地震速度非均匀介质的影响。结果表明，引入真实地形显著降低了G……

t: The authors build a 3D linear elastic finite-element model in PyLith v4.1.2 to compute surface displacements, fault tractions, and Coulomb stress changes on the Natron Fault induced by pressurized spherical magma reservoirs.
使用PyLith v4.1.2建立三维线弹性有限元模型，计算球形岩浆房压力变化引起的地表位移及纳特龙断层库仑应力变化。

Models use InSAR-derived deflation source parameters (2007–2008 eruption), TZVOLCANO GNSS displacement vectors (2016–2023 inflation), GMTED2010 topography, and a 3D seismic velocity model (Vp, Vs) of the Natron Rift.
结合2007-2008年InSAR收缩源、2016-2023年TZVOLCANO GNSS位移、GMTED2010地形及…

Including topography reduces horizontal GNSS WRMS misfit from 1.2–1.4 mm to 0.6–0.7 mm and increases maximum Coulomb stress changes to -0.093 MPa (clamping) during inflation and +3.4 MPa (unclamping, promoting oblique normal slip) during deflation.
引入地形将水平GNSS残差降至0.6-0.7毫米，膨胀期最大库仑应力为-0.093 MPa，收缩期达+3.4 MPa促进…

The model assumes a purely linear elastic crust, spherical magma sources, planar fault geometry, and neglects viscoelastic relaxation, inelastic deformation, dike intrusions, and far-field plate divergence.
假设纯线弹性介质与球形岩浆源，忽略粘弹性松弛、岩脉侵入及远场板块扩张加载。

First 3D finite-element analysis in the Natron Rift combining realistic steep topography and 3D seismic-derived elastic heterogeneity to quantify magma-fault Coulomb stress transfer across inflation and deflation phases.
首次在纳特龙裂谷结合陡峭地形与三维地震非均匀介质开展有限元模拟，量化充放气周期对边界断层的应力控制。

kc: Demonstrates via 3D finite-element modeling (PyLith) that magma deflation beneath Ol Doinyo Lengai unclamps the adjacent Natron Fault (Delta CFS up to 3.4 MPa), promoting oblique normal slip, whereas inflation clamps the fault (Delta CFS up to -0.093 MPa).

Proves that incorporating steep topographic relief (>2,300 m, comparable to the 2.5–3.0 km magma source depth) reduces horizontal GNSS WRMS misfit from 1.2–1.4 mm to 0.6–0.7 mm and nearly doubles modeled fault stress magnitudes.

Conducts a 64-run sensitivity analysis showing that magma source depth uncertainty has the largest influence on fault normal traction and Coulomb stress changes, while 1-km resolution elastic heterogeneity has minimal impact.
通过三维有限元模拟（PyLith）证实伦盖火山浅部岩浆房收缩解除纳特龙断层闭锁（库仑应力增加达3.4 MPa）并促进斜向正断层滑动，而岩浆膨胀则抑制断层滑动（库仑应力变化达-0.093 MPa）。
证明引入陡峭地形起伏（>2300米，与2.5-3.0千米岩浆源深度相当）可将GNSS水平位移WRMS残差从1.2-1.4毫米降至0.6-0.7毫米，并使断层应力幅值几乎翻倍。
通过64组参数敏感性实验表明，岩浆源深度不确定性对断层正应力和库仑应力变化影响最大，而1千米分辨率的地震波速非均匀性影响微弱。
me: 3D linear elastic finite-element modeling using PyLith v4.1.2 and tetrahedral meshes generated in Gmsh (50 km x 50 km x 30 km domain, refined to 20 m near the spherical magma reservoir).

Comparison of four model setups combining homogeneous vs. 3D seismic-tomography-derived heterogeneous elastic moduli (Roecker et al., 2017; Brocher density relation) with and without GMTED2010 topography.

Calculation of resolved shear traction, normal traction, and Coulomb failure stress changes (Delta CFS, friction coefficient mu = 0.4) on two planar segments of the 50-degree east-dipping Natron Fault.
64-experiment parameter sensitivity analysis testing 1-sigma bounds of magma source location, depth, and volume change, plus friction coefficient variations (mu = 0.2 to 0.8).
利用PyLith v4.1.2和Gmsh生成的四面体网格（50×50×30千米区域，球形岩浆房附近加密至20米）进行三维线弹性有限元数值模拟。
对比均匀介质与基于三维地震层析成像（Roecker et al., 2017）的非均匀弹性模量在包含与不包含GMTED2010地形条件下的四种模型配置。
在50°东倾的纳特龙断层两个平面分段上计算剪切牵引力、法向牵引力以及库仑破裂应力变化（摩擦系数μ=0.4）。
开展64组数值实验的敏感性分析，测试岩浆源位置、深度、体积变化的1σ不确定性范围以及断层摩擦系数（0.2–0.8）的影响。
de: 3D GNSS surface displacement vectors from 5 TZVOLCANO stations (relative to local reference OLO5) spanning June 2016 to August 2023, plus footwall station ENGC during the 2007 rifting episode.

Geodetically constrained spherical magma source parameters beneath Ol Doinyo Lengai: 2016–2023 inflating source at 2.5 km depth (Delta V = 0.12 x 10^6 m^3) and 2007–2008 InSAR-derived deflating source at 3.0 km depth (Delta V = -30.0 x 10^6 m^3).
3D Vp and Vs seismic velocity model of the Natron Rift at 1-km resolution down to 30 km depth (Roecker et al., 2017) and GMTED2010 / SRTM digital elevation models.
2016年6月至2023年8月期间5个TZVOLCANO连续GNSS台站（相对于参考站OLO5）的三维地表位移数据，以及2007年裂谷事件期间下盘ENGC台站位移。
大地测量约束的伦盖火山球形岩浆源参数：2016-2023年2.5千米深膨胀源（体积变化0.12×10^6 m^3）与2007-2008年InSAR反演的3.0千米深收缩源（体积变化-30.0×10^6 m^3）。
纳特龙裂谷30千米深度内1千米分辨率的三维Vp和Vs地震速度模型（Roecker et al., 2017）以及GMTED2010/SRTM数字高程模型。
li: Assumes a purely linear elastic rheology, neglecting viscoelastic relaxation, brittle failure, plastic yielding, or ductile flow over longer timescales.
Models magma reservoirs as simplified hollow spheres and omits the 2007–2008 Lengai and Gelai dike intrusions.
Excludes far-field tectonic extension from Nubia–Somalia plate divergence (~3.8 mm/yr) and models the Natron Fault with simplified uniform planar segments.
假设纯线弹性流变学，未考虑长时间尺度下的粘弹性松弛、脆性破裂、塑性屈服或深部韧性流动。
将岩浆房简化为空心球体源，且未在模型中包含2007-2008年伦盖和盖莱岩脉侵入过程。
未包含努比亚-索马里板块发散引起的远场构造伸展加载（~3.8毫米/年），并将纳特龙断层几何形态简化为均匀倾角的平面分段。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcano-tectonic interactions, specifically magma reservoir inflation and deflation beneath Ol Doinyo Lengai volcano and its stress transfer to the Natron Fault.
The study computes 3D Coulomb stress and normal traction changes to evaluate fault clamping, unclamping, and oblique normal slip potential on the Natron border fault.
The paper models 3D crustal deformation and stress transfer during early-phase magma-assisted continental rifting in the East African Rift System using PyLith.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF examined, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), Figures 1–7, and Tables 1–5.

sum: This study presents new broadband magnetotelluric (MT) data from a 90 km transect across the Santa Quitéria Continental Magmatic Arc in the NW Borborema Province, Brazil. Phase tensor analysis indicates a 3D geoelectric structure, prompting 3D inversion. The resulting resistivity model reveals a heterogeneous crust down to 25 km depth, featuring five conductive and five resistive domains. A prominent westward-dipping conductor (C1) east of the arc is interpreted as a fossil subduction zone with westward polarity. Other conductors are linked to graphite films in high-pressure rocks. Integrating these results with surface geology, the authors propose a single west-dipping subduction system where coesite-bearing retroeclogites exhumed via contrasting pathways (subduction channel vs. diapiric relamination), resolving a long-standing debate on regional paleosubduction polarity.
本研究利用巴西博博雷马省西北部横跨圣基特里亚大陆岩浆弧的90公里宽频大地电磁（MT）剖面数据，通过3D反演构建了深达25公里的地壳电阻率模型。模型揭示了交替分布的导电和高阻体，其中岩浆弧东侧显著的西倾导电异常（C1）被解释为西向俯冲的古俯冲带。结合地表地质，该研究提出了单一西倾俯冲系统模型，解释了超……

t: 3D inversion of broadband magnetotelluric data evaluated using phase tensor parameters to resolve three-dimensional geoelectric structures.
利用相位张量参数评估三维电性结构，并对宽频大地电磁数据进行三维反演成像。
Broadband magnetotelluric data from ten stations along an approximately 90 km NW–SE transect orthogonal to the Santa Quitéria Continental Magmatic Arc.
采集自横跨圣基特里亚大陆岩浆弧、长约90公里的NW-SE向剖面上10个站点的宽频大地电磁数据。
A 3D resistivity model revealing a westward-dipping conductor (C1) east of the arc, interpreted as a fossil subduction zone with westward polarity.
获得深达25公里的电阻率模型，发现岩浆弧东侧显著西倾的导电体，指示西向古俯冲带。
The interpretation of additional conductors relies on the assumed presence of interconnected graphite films along grain boundaries.
部分导电异常的解释依赖于矿物颗粒边界存在连通石墨薄膜的假设。
Provides the first deep geoelectric evidence supporting a single west-dipping subduction system and contrasting exhumation pathways for regional retroeclogites.
首次利用深部电性证据证实了单一西倾俯冲系统，并解释了超高压岩石的两种不同折返机制。

kc: Acquired and inverted a new 90 km broadband magnetotelluric transect across the Santa Quitéria Continental Magmatic Arc.
Imaged a prominent westward-dipping crustal conductor interpreted as a fossil Neoproterozoic subduction zone.
Proposed a unified tectonic model featuring a single west-dipping subduction system with contrasting exhumation pathways for high-pressure rocks.
获取并反演了横跨圣基特里亚大陆岩浆弧的90公里宽频大地电磁新剖面。
成像了地壳深部显著的西倾导电异常，并将其解释为新元古代古俯冲带的电性响应。
提出了一个统一的构造模型，即单一西倾俯冲系统，并解释了高压岩石的不同折返机制。
me: Broadband magnetotelluric (MT) data acquisition along a 90 km NW-SE transect.
Phase tensor analysis to evaluate dimensionality and justify 3D geoelectric inversion.
3D magnetotelluric inversion to image crustal resistivity structure down to 25 km.
沿90公里西北-东南向剖面进行宽频大地电磁（MT）数据采集。
利用相位张量分析评估电性结构维度，论证三维反演的适用性。
进行三维大地电磁反演，成像深达25公里的地壳电阻率结构。
de: Broadband magnetotelluric data collected from ten stations along an approximately 90 km transect in the Northern Borborema Province, Brazil.
采集自巴西博博雷马省北部一条约90公里剖面上10个测站的宽频大地电磁数据。
li: The profile length (90 km) and station spacing (10 stations) limit the lateral resolution of smaller crustal structures.
Interpretation of conductors relies on indirect geological proxies (e.g., interconnected graphite films).
剖面长度（90公里）和测站密度（10个站）限制了较小地壳构造的横向分辨率。
对导电体的解释依赖于间接的地质推断（如相互连通的石墨薄膜）。

tm.why: The paper uses magnetotelluric data to image the crustal electrical architecture and investigate a fossil subduction zone and tectonic evolution.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite in the Cyclades, Greece, to understand the relationship between ancient earthquakes and deformation processes along subduction interfaces. By analyzing structural, petrological, and microstructural records within the metamorphic sole, the authors reconstruct the stress, temperature, and fluid conditions during deformation. The work highlights how localized shear zones and brittle-ductile transitions record paleoseismic events, providing critical field-based constraints on the mechanical behavior of subduction zones.
本研究调查了希腊基克拉泽斯群岛蒂诺斯蛇绿岩的变质底部，以理解俯冲带界面中古地震与变形过程之间的关系。通过分析变质底部内的结构、岩石学和微观结构记录，作者重建了变形期间的应力、温度和流体条件。该工作强调了局域化剪切带和脆韧性转变如何记录古地震事件，为俯冲带的力学行为提供了关键的野外约束。

t: Structural, petrological, and microstructural analysis combined with thermobarometry to characterize deformation conditions.
结合结构、岩石学、微观结构分析与温压计来表征变形条件。
Field observations and rock samples collected from the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite in Greece.
采集自希腊蒂诺斯蛇绿岩变质底部的野外观测和岩石样品。
Identification of localized shear zones and microstructural evidence linking deformation to paleoseismic events along the subduction interface.
识别出局域化剪切带，并提供了将变形与沿俯冲界面的古地震事件联系起来的微观结构证据。
Potential overprinting of primary subduction-related seismic structures during subsequent exhumation phases.
在随后的折返阶段，早期与俯冲相关的地震结构可能存在后期变形的叠加。
Directly linking microstructural deformation features in an ophiolitic metamorphic sole to paleoseismic slip events.
直接将蛇绿岩变质底部中的微观结构变形特征与古地震滑动事件联系起来。

kc: Provides structural and petrological evidence of paleoseismicity within the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite.
Constrains the pressure, temperature, and fluid conditions during deformation along the ancient subduction interface.
Links microstructural deformation mechanisms to macro-scale seismic behavior in ophiolitic systems.
提供了蒂诺斯蛇绿岩变质底部内古地震活动的结构和岩石学证据。
约束了古代俯冲界面变形期间的压力、温度和流体条件。
将蛇绿岩系统中的微观结构变形机制与宏观地震行为联系起来。
me: Field structural mapping and kinematic analysis of the metamorphic sole.
Petrological and microstructural analysis of deformed rocks to determine deformation mechanisms.
Thermobarometry to estimate the pressure-temperature conditions of deformation.
变质底部的野外结构制图和运动学分析。
变形岩石的岩石学和微观结构分析，以确定变形机制。
利用温压计估算变形的压力-温度条件。
de: Rock samples collected from the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite, Cyclades, Greece.
Microstructural observations and mineral chemistry data.
采集自希腊基克拉泽斯群岛蒂诺斯蛇绿岩变质底部的岩石样品。
微观结构观测与矿物化学数据。
li: The study relies on exhumed ancient structures, which may have overprinting from post-seismic or exhumation-related deformation.
该研究依赖于折返的古代结构，这些结构可能受到后期地震或折返相关变形的叠加影响。

tm.why: The paper investigates the relationship between earthquakes and the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite, focusing on fault mechanics and deformation.
It examines the metamorphic sole of an ophiolite, which provides direct insights into the geodynamics and structural evolution of subduction interfaces.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, and metadata indicating a structural and petrological study of the Tinos Ophiolite metamorphic sole and its relation to earthquakes.

sum: This study investigates the stress regime of the subducting Pacific slab beneath southwestern Japan by performing stress tensor inversions and Kostrov strain summations on 28 years of F-net centroid moment tensor (CMT) focal mechanisms for intermediate-depth and deep earthquakes (200–400 km), alongside 3D hypocenter relocations. Across most of the study region, the maximum principal stress (sigma_1) axes align with the plate subduction direction rather than the maximum slab dip direction, indicating a resistive force acting on the subducting slab from the high-viscosity mantle. Conversely, in clusters beneath Takayama and Wakasa Bay, the minimum principal stress (sigma_3) axes are nearly horizontal and parallel to the slab strike (trending N31.4°E and N10.4°W). This high-resolution regional stress characterization provides direct mechanical evidence supporting geodynamic models of Pacific slab thinning at depths >200 km and slab tearing at depths >400 km.
本研究利用28年F-net矩张量目录（200–400 km深度）及三维震源重定位数据，通过应力张量反演与Kostrov应变求和，估算了西南日本下方太平洋俯冲板块的应力状态。结果显示，研究区大部分区域的最大主应力轴平行于板块俯冲方向而非最大倾角方向，表明板块受到高粘度地幔的阻力。相反，在高山和若狭湾下……

t: Grid-search stress tensor inversion of focal mechanisms across seven subregions to estimate principal stress orientations and stress ratios, using both minimum misfit slip-angle and mechanical instability criteria for fault-plane selection.
结合滑动角和断层不稳定性准则，对7个子区域进行网格搜索应力张量反演，估算主应力轴方向和应力比。
28 years of high-quality F-net CMT focal mechanisms (October 1997 to November 2025, depths 200–400 km, Mw 3.9–7.1, variance reduction >80%) and JMA hypocenters relocated in a 3D velocity model.
1997至2025年共28年的F-net高质量CMT解（200-400 km，Mw 3.9-7.1）及三维模型重定位的J…

In most subregions, sigma_1 aligns with the slab subduction direction. Beneath Takayama (S1, R=0.3) and Wakasa Bay (D2), sigma_3 is nearly horizontal and parallel to the slab strike (N31.4°E and N10.4°W).
多数区域最大主应力平行于俯冲方向；高山和若狭湾最小主应力近水平且平行于走向（N31.4°E和N10.4°W）。
Limited data density near the slab surface prevents stress inversion of depth-perpendicular heterogeneity, and the stress ratio in Wakasa Bay (D2) is poorly constrained under the instability method.
板块表层附近数据稀疏限制了垂向非均质性反演，且若狭湾的应力比在不稳定性法下约束较差。
First cluster-scale stress tensor inversion for the Pacific slab beneath southwestern Japan using 28 years of CMT data, providing mechanical evidence for slab tearing and thinning.
首次利用28年数据实现西南日本太平洋板块震群尺度应力反演，为板块撕裂或减薄提供力学证据。

kc: Estimated the 3D stress regime within the Pacific slab beneath southwestern Japan at cluster-scale resolution using 28 years of F-net CMT data.
Demonstrated that sigma_1 axes in most subregions align with the plate subduction direction rather than maximum dip, indicating mantle resistance.
Identified strike-parallel extensional stress regimes (sigma_3 parallel to slab strike) beneath Takayama and Wakasa Bay, supporting slab thinning and tearing models.
利用28年的F-net矩张量数据，以震群尺度的空间分辨率估算了西南日本太平洋板块内部的三维应力体制。
证明大多数子区域的最大主应力轴与板块俯冲方向一致而非最大倾角方向，表明存在地幔阻力。
发现在高山和若狭湾下方存在平行于板块走向的拉张应力体制，为板块减薄和撕裂模型提供了有力支持。
me: Earthquake hypocenter relocation using the 3D velocity structure model of Katsumata and Nishimiya (2025).
Grid-search stress tensor inversion estimating principal stress orientations and stress ratios using both slip-angle and fault-instability selection methods.
Kostrov summation of seismic moment tensors to determine principal strain axes and strain rates at varying distances from the slab surface.
使用Katsumata和Nishimiya（2025）的三维速度结构模型进行震源重定位。
结合滑动角法和断层不稳定性法，利用网格搜索进行应力张量反演，估算主应力轴方向和应力比。
对地震矩张量进行Kostrov求和，以确定距板块表面不同深度处的主应变轴和应变率。
de: Earthquake arrival times from the Seismological Bulletin of Japan (JMA) for 3D hypocenter relocation.
F-net centroid moment tensor (CMT) solutions from October 1997 to November 2025 (Mw 3.9–7.1, depths 200–400 km, variance reduction >80%) divided into seven subregions.
来自日本气象厅（JMA）地震公报的震相到时数据，用于三维震源重定位。
1997年10月至2025年11月期间的F-net矩心矩张量（CMT）解（Mw 3.9–7.1，深度200–400 km，方差缩减>80%），划分为7个子区域进行分析。
li: Sparse earthquake data density near the upper slab surface prevents detailed stress tensor inversion of stress heterogeneity perpendicular to the slab.
The stress ratio in the Wakasa Bay subregion (D2) is poorly constrained and sensitive to sample size and fault-plane selection method.
靠近板块上表面的地震数据密度有限，无法对垂直于板块表面的应力非均质性进行可靠的应力张量反演。
若狭湾子区域（D2）的应力比约束较差，对样本量和断层面选择方法较为敏感。

tm.why: The study estimates the stress regime of the subducting Pacific slab beneath southwestern Japan to investigate geodynamic processes like slab tearing, thinning, and mantle resistance.
The paper analyzes focal mechanisms and moment tensors of intermediate-depth and deep earthquakes to understand their generation mechanisms.
The authors relocate intermediate-depth and deep earthquakes using a 3D velocity structure model to resolve distinct spatial clusters within the slab.

ev.notes: Full text PDF (8 pages plus repository cover page) was analyzed, including all sections, equations, and figures.

sum: Using dense S-net seafloor seismic data and onshore borehole strainmeter records, this study investigates the preparatory and post-mainshock evolution of the 9 November 2025 Mw 6.8 Sanriku-Oki megathrust sequence in the Japan Trench. By applying double-difference hypocenter relocation, empirical Green's function source inversion, repeating earthquake identification, and b-positive analysis, the author resolves the fine-scale interplay between fast rupture and slow slip. Foreshocks began 10 days prior and expanded by ~20 km at an accelerating rate during the final 2 days along the locked patch margin, accompanied by frequent M≥5 events and a b-value drop to ~0.5. The Mw 6.8 mainshock and a subsequent Mw 6.4 event ruptured in opposite directions from opposite ends of the foreshock zone. Within 0.5 days post-mainshock, aftershocks expanded to ~75 km and repeating earthquakes yielded ~11 cm of creep (Mw ~6.7), demonstrating tightly coupled seismic-aseismic slip.
本研究利用密集的S-net海底地震数据和陆上钻孔应变仪记录，结合双差重定位、经验格林函数震源反演、重复地震识别及b-positive方法，研究了2025年11月9日日本海沟三陆冲Mw6.8逆冲序列的孕震与震后演化。前震于主震前10天开始，最后2天在闭锁区边缘加速扩展约20公里，伴随频繁的M≥5地震及……

t: Double-difference relocation with waveform cross-correlation, empirical Green's function deconvolution for finite-fault slip inversion, repeating earthquake creep estimation, and b-positive temporal b-value analysis.
采用结合波形互相关的双差重定位、经验格林函数有限断层反演、重复地震蠕滑估算及b-positive分析。
15,540 M_JMA ≥ 1.0 earthquakes from August 2016 to December 2025 recorded by the offshore S-net seafloor network, alongside onshore borehole strainmeter records at station TU.MY3.
2016年8月至2025年12月S-net海底台网记录的15,540个M≥1.0地震，以及TU.MY3钻孔应变记录。
Foreshocks expanded ~20 km before the Mw 6.8 and Mw 6.4 events ruptured in opposite directions; aftershocks expanded to 75 km within 0.5 days with ~11 cm of aseismic slip (Mw ~6.7).
前震扩展约20公里，主震与强余震反向破裂；震后0.5天余震扩展至75公里，伴随约11厘米无震滑移。
Offshore velocity model uncertainties cause a ~5 km systematic depth offset, and onshore geodetic data cannot conclusively resolve pre-mainshock aseismic slip above background noise.
近海速度模型不确定性导致震源深度系统偏浅5公里，且陆上大地测量难以确凿分辨震前无震滑移。

Provides the first high-resolution offshore tracking of coupled preseismic and postseismic seismic-aseismic slip evolution during a major Sanriku-Oki megathrust sequence using dense S-net seafloor observations.
首次利用密集S-net海底观测高分辨率追踪了三陆冲浅部俯冲带序列震前与震后地震-无震滑移的耦合演化。

kc: Relocated 15,505 earthquakes using S-net data to reveal an accelerating ~20 km expansion of foreshocks along the Mw 6.8 locked patch margin over the final 2 days.
Determined finite-fault slip models for the Mw 6.8 mainshock and Mw 6.4 aftershock, showing they initiated at opposite ends of the foreshock zone and ruptured in opposite directions.
Quantified rapid postseismic expansion (~75 km within 0.5 days) and ~11 cm of aseismic afterslip (Mw ~6.7) using 80 repeating earthquake groups and borehole strainmeter data.
Documented a preseismic b-value decrease to ~0.5 coinciding with frequent M≥5 foreshocks, supporting models of rupture interaction with velocity-strengthening regions.
利用S-net数据重定位了15,505次地震，揭示主震前最后2天前震沿Mw6.8闭锁区边缘加速扩展约20公里。
反演了Mw6.8主震和Mw6.4余震的有限断层滑移分布，发现二者分别起源于前震区两端并向相反方向破裂。
结合80组重复地震和钻孔应变数据，量化了震后0.5天内达75公里的余震快速扩展及约11厘米的无震余滑（Mw~6.7）。
观测到震前b值降至约0.5并伴随频繁M≥5前震，支持破裂与速度强化区相互作用的物理模型。
me: Double-difference hypocenter relocation combining catalog arrival times and waveform cross-correlation differential times.
Positivity-constrained iterative time-domain deconvolution using empirical Green's functions (EGFs) and non-negative least-squares finite-fault slip inversion.
Repeating earthquake detection using relocated centroids and waveform similarity, scaled to creep via the Nadeau and Johnson (1998) relation.
Borehole strainmeter tidal removal using BAYTAP and elastic half-space strain modeling, plus b-positive frequency-magnitude distribution analysis.
结合目录到时与波形互相关走时差的双差震源重定位方法。
基于经验格林函数（EGF）的正约束时间域迭代反褶积及非负最小二乘有限断层滑移反演。
利用重定位质心和波形相似性识别重复地震，并通过Nadeau和Johnson (1998)关系估算无震蠕滑。
使用BAYTAP滤除钻孔应变仪潮汐响应并进行弹性半空间应变建模，以及b-positive震级频度分析。
de: S-net seafloor observation network waveform data and phase picks from the JMA unified catalog and Suzuki et al. (2025) catalog (August 2016 to December 2025, 15,540 initial events).
S-net strong-motion acceleration waveforms low-pass filtered at 0.4 Hz for the Mw 6.8 mainshock, Mw 6.4 aftershock, and Mw 5.0 and 4.7 EGF events.
Borehole strainmeter records from Tohoku University station TU.MY3 and onshore GNSS time series.
2016年8月至2025年12月期间S-net海底观测网波形数据及JMA与Suzuki等(2025)目录震相数据（初始共15,540个事件）。
用于Mw6.8主震、Mw6.4余震以及Mw5.0和4.7经验格林函数事件的0.4 Hz低通滤波S-net加速度波形。
东北大学TU.MY3台站的钻孔应变仪记录及陆上GNSS时间序列。
li: Relocated hypocenter depths are systematically ~5 km shallower than the reference plate interface model due to uncertainties in the offshore velocity model.
Onshore GNSS and borehole strainmeter data lack sufficient signal-to-noise ratio to conclusively resolve pre-mainshock aseismic slip transients above background fluctuations.
由于近海速度模型的不确定性，重定位震源深度系统性地比参考板块界面模型浅约5公里。
陆上GNSS和钻孔应变仪数据的信噪比不足以在背景波动之上确凿地分辨出主震前的无震滑移瞬变。

tm.why: The paper investigates the coupled evolution of seismic rupture and aseismic slip (afterslip, creep, SSEs) along a megathrust fault.
The author performs finite-fault slip inversions for the Mw 6.8 mainshock and Mw 6.4 aftershock using empirical Green's functions.
The study relocates 15,505 earthquakes using double-difference methods and waveform cross-correlation, and detects repeating earthquakes.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the published Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 4 figures and sections 1 through 5.

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of detecting tectonic gravity changes from ongoing rifting in the Gulf of Aden using the upcoming MAGIC satellite mission. By employing 3D finite element and gravitational modeling, the authors show that horizontal motion between oceanic and continental crusts generates a gravity rate of change with peak amplitudes of ±40 nGal/yr. Propagating this signal into orbit simulations with instrumental noise, they demonstrate that MAGIC's instrumentation is sensitive enough to identify a central gravity rate bump of ~6 nGal/yr at a maximum harmonic degree of 70, despite spatial resolution limits and potential temporal aliasing from other geophysical processes.
本研究评估了利用未来的MAGIC卫星任务探测亚丁湾持续裂谷作用引起的构造重力变化的可行性。通过三维有限元和重力建模，研究表明海洋与大陆地壳之间的水平运动会产生峰值振幅达±40 nGal/yr的重力变化率。将该信号传播到包含仪器噪声的轨道模拟中，结果表明，尽管存在空间分辨率限制以及其他地球物理过程的时……

t: 3D finite element and gravitational modeling combined with satellite orbit simulations and spherical harmonic least squares solutions.
结合卫星轨道模拟和球谐最小二乘求解的三维有限元与重力建模方法。
Simulated time-variable gravity field propagated into orbit simulations with instrumental noise, based on a 1.25 cm/yr divergence rate in the Gulf of Aden.
基于亚丁湾1.25 cm/yr张裂速率，将模拟的时变重力场传播至包含仪器噪声的轨道模拟中。
MAGIC instrumentation can identify a central gravity rate bump of ~6 nGal/yr at harmonic degree 70, though individual dipole stripes cannot be resolved.
在谐波次数70时，MAGIC仪器可识别出约6 nGal/yr的中心重力变化率异常。
Detectability becomes unfeasible when considering temporal aliasing from other stronger and faster geophysical mass transport phenomena.
由于其他更强、更快的地球物理质量输运过程产生的时间混叠，实际探测可能不可行。
Demonstrates that steady, non-episodic tectonic rifting processes can induce measurable gravity variations detectable by next-generation satellite gravimetry.
证明了即使在没有幕式地震活动的情况下，稳定的裂谷构造过程也能引起可测量的重力变化。

kc: Demonstrated that non-seismic, steady rifting can produce a potentially measurable gravity rate of change of ±40 nGal/yr.
Evaluated the sensitivity of the upcoming MAGIC satellite mission to regional tectonic signals using 3D finite element and orbit simulations.
Showed that a central gravity rate bump of ~6 nGal/yr can be resolved at harmonic degree 70 despite spatial resolution limits.
证明了非地震的、稳定的裂谷作用可产生高达±40 nGal/yr且潜在可测的重力变化率。
利用三维有限元和轨道模拟评估了未来的MAGIC卫星任务对区域构造信号的敏感性。
表明在最大谐波次数为70时，尽管存在空间分辨率限制，仍可解析出约6 nGal/yr的中心重力变化率异常。
me: 3D finite element modeling of crustal divergence and density contrasts.
Gravitational forward modeling of time-variable gravity fields.
Satellite orbit simulation and spherical harmonic analysis (least squares solutions).
地壳发散和密度对比的三维有限元建模。
时变重力场的重力正演模拟。
卫星轨道模拟和球谐分析（最小二乘解）。
de: Synthetic gravity rate of change simulations based on a 1.25 cm/yr divergence rate and 400 kg/m3 density contrast in the Gulf of Aden.
1-year simulated MAGIC satellite instrument noise and orbit data.
基于亚丁湾1.25 cm/yr张裂速率和400 kg/m3密度对比的合成重力变化率模拟。
为期1年的模拟MAGIC卫星仪器噪声和轨道数据。
li: Detectability is highly vulnerable to temporal aliasing from stronger and faster mass transport processes (e.g., hydrology, oceanography).
The spatial resolution limits of the satellite prevent distinguishing the two opposing narrow gravity stripes of the dipole.
探测能力极易受到来自更强、更快质量输运过程（如水文学、海洋学）的时间混叠干扰。
卫星的空间分辨率限制导致无法区分偶极子中两个相反的窄重力条带。

tm.why: The paper models the gravity rate of change induced by rifting and crustal divergence in the Gulf of Aden.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from GJI, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the shallow crustal structure of the Dongguan Basin (DGB) in South China using a dense seismic array. By applying double-beamforming (DBF) and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) methods to ambient noise data, the authors construct a 3D shear-wave velocity (VS) model from Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves. The model clearly delineates basin-bounding faults and reveals low-velocity anomalies at fault intersections, indicating structural complexity and fluid activity. The results show that bedrock is deeper in the east, whereas Quaternary sediments are thicker in the west. This inverse relationship suggests early differential crustal extension followed by sediment transport from the Pearl River, providing critical constraints on basin geometry, fault systems, and local seismic hazards.
本研究利用密集地震台阵探讨了华南东莞盆地的浅部地壳结构。作者对背景噪声数据应用双波束形成（DBF）和地动位移振幅比（HVSR）方法，基于瑞雷面波频散曲线构建了三维剪切波速度（VS）模型。该模型清晰地描绘了盆地边界断裂，并在断裂交汇处发现了低速异常，指示了结构复杂性和流体活动。结果表明，盆地基底东深西……

t: The study utilizes double-beamforming (DBF) and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) methods applied to ambient noise data to retrieve Rayleigh-wave dispersion and characterize shallow structure.
应用背景噪声双波束形成（DBF）和地动位移振幅比（HVSR）方法提取瑞雷波频散并表征浅部结构。
Continuous ambient noise data recorded by a dense seismic array deployed across the Dongguan Basin in the Pearl River Delta region.
部署在珠江三角洲东莞盆地的密集地震台阵所记录的连续背景噪声数据。
The 3D VS model reveals that bedrock is deeper in the east and shallower in the west, whereas Quaternary sediments show the opposite trend, indicating differential extension and sediment transport.
三维速度模型显示基底东深西浅，而第四纪沉积物西厚东薄，揭示了差异性伸展与泥沙沉积特征。
The study focuses primarily on the shallow crustal structure, leaving deeper crust-mantle interactions unconstrained by this high-frequency dataset.
研究主要聚焦于浅部地壳结构，高频密集台阵数据无法有效约束深部地壳与地幔的相互作用。
Combining DBF and HVSR on dense array data to reveal an inverse relationship between bedrock depth and sediment thickness, explaining the basin's tectonic evolution.
联合DBF与HVSR方法揭示了基底深度与沉积厚度的反比关系，阐明了盆地的构造演化模式。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3D shear-wave velocity model of the shallow crust beneath the Dongguan Basin using a dense seismic array.
Delineated major basin-bounding faults and identified low-velocity zones at their intersections, suggesting potential fluid pathways.
Revealed an inverse relationship between bedrock depth (deeper in the east) and Quaternary sediment thickness (thicker in the west), shedding light on the basin's tectonic evolution.
利用密集台阵构建了东莞盆地下方浅部地壳的高分辨率三维剪切波速度模型。
清晰刻画了盆地主要边界断裂，并在断裂交汇处发现了低速带，指示了潜在的流体通道。
揭示了基底深度（东深西浅）与第四纪沉积物厚度（西厚东薄）之间的反比关系，阐明了盆地的构造演化历史。
me: Double-beamforming (DBF) applied to ambient noise data to extract Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves.
Horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) analysis to estimate sediment thickness and resonance characteristics.
3D shear-wave velocity (VS) inversion from surface-wave dispersion measurements.
对背景噪声数据应用双波束形成（DBF）方法以提取瑞雷波频散曲线。
采用地动位移振幅比（HVSR）分析来估算沉积层厚度和共振特征。
基于面波频散测量进行三维剪切波速度（VS）反演。
de: Ambient noise data recorded by a dense seismic array deployed across the Dongguan Basin, Guangdong Province, China.
部署在中国广东省东莞盆地的密集地震台阵所记录的背景噪声数据。
li: The depth resolution is limited to the shallow crust due to the high-frequency nature of the dense array ambient noise data.
由于密集台阵背景噪声数据偏向高频，深度分辨率仅局限于浅部地壳。

tm.why: The study applies double-beamforming and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio methods to ambient noise data to image the shallow crustal structure.
The authors construct a 3D shear-wave velocity model of the Dongguan basin using Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves.
The paper investigates the shallow crustal structure, fault systems, and tectonic formation of the Dongguan basin.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar as no PDF was available.

sum: Thermal pressurization (TP) of pore fluids during rapid fault slip is a dominant earthquake weakening mechanism, yet the role of varied in situ reservoir fluid properties remains poorly constrained. This study performs intermediate-velocity (0.05 m/s) undrained rotary-shear experiments on crushed Slochteren sandstone gouges from the Groningen gas field saturated with four fluids: deionized water, synthetic brine, and 1 and 5 cSt silicone oils. Although theoretical models predict stronger TP weakening for fluids with higher thermal expansivity (brine) and lower hydraulic diffusivity (5 cSt oil), experiments showed the opposite: brine and 5 cSt oil yielded less weakening than water and 1 cSt oil. Microstructural analyses and Rice's slip-on-a-plane modeling reveal that low-viscosity fluids promote finer grain localization and lower porosity, reducing permeability by an order of magnitude and enhancing TP efficiency. This highlights that fluid-dependent permeability evolution critically modulates dynamic fault weakening in induced seismicity.
快速断层滑动期间孔隙流体的热增压（TP）是主要的地震弱化机制，但不同原位储层流体性质的作用尚不明确。本研究对格罗宁根气田Slochteren砂岩模拟断层泥进行了中速（0.05 m/s）不排水旋转剪切实验，测试了去离子水、合成盐水及1和5 cSt硅油四种流体。尽管模型预测高热膨胀性（盐水）和低水力扩散……

t: Undrained rotary-shear friction experiments at 0.05 m/s on sandstone gouges paired with SEM microstructural characterization, Rice (2006) slip-on-a-plane thermal pressurization modeling, and 1D heat diffusion modeling.
对砂岩断层泥进行0.05 m/s不排水旋剪实验，结合SEM微观结构表征、Rice平面滑移热增压模型及一维热扩散模型。
Crushed Slochteren sandstone gouges from the Groningen gas field sheared under 12 MPa normal stress and 1–2 MPa initial fluid pressure using DI water, synthetic brine, and 1 and 5 cSt silicone oils.
格罗宁根气田Slochteren破碎砂岩断层泥，在12 MPa法向应力和四种流体（水、盐水、1和5 cSt硅油）下进行剪…

Apparent minimum friction decreases in the order brine (0.42–0.49) > DI water (0.33–0.45) > 5 cSt oil > 1 cSt oil (~0.25); a 10-fold permeability reduction (10^-15 to 10^-16 m^2) reconciles models with low-viscosity data.
最小视摩擦系数按盐水>去离子水>5 cSt硅油>1 cSt硅油依次降低；引入一个数量级的渗透率下降可使模型与低粘度数据吻…
High thermal conductivity of the steel piston (16 W/(mK)) causes rapid heat diffusion away from the slip zone, suppressing peak temperatures and overall thermal pressurization efficiency.
高导热钢质活塞（16 W/(mK)）导致热量快速散失，降低了局部温度峰值并抑制了实验整体的热增压效率。

Demonstrates that fluid viscosity alters gouge microstructure and evolving permeability during slip, overturning the expectation that higher pressurization factors and lower diffusivity always yield stronger thermal pressurization weakening.
揭示流体粘度通过改变断层泥微结构和渗透率演化来调控热增压，打破了高增压因子和低扩散率必然导致更强弱化的传统认知。

kc: Demonstrated that thermal pressurization effectively weakens sandstone-derived fault gouges at intermediate slip velocities (0.05 m/s) across aqueous and non-aqueous pore fluids.

Revealed that brine-saturated gouges exhibit less dynamic weakening and higher minimum friction (0.42–0.49) than deionized water-saturated gouges (0.33–0.45), contrary to simple theoretical predictions.
Showed via microstructural analysis and analytical modeling that viscosity-controlled grain-size reduction, Y-shear localization, and a 10-fold permeability drop govern TP efficiency.
证明在中速滑移（0.05 m/s）条件下，热增压能有效弱化含水及非水孔隙流体饱和的砂岩源断层泥。
揭示盐水饱和断层泥比去离子水饱和断层泥表现出更弱的动态弱化和更高的最小摩擦系数（0.42–0.49 对 0.33–0.45），与简单理论预测相反。
通过微观结构分析和解析建模表明，受粘度控制的晶粒细化、Y剪切局部化以及10倍的渗透率下降主导了热增压效率。
me: Undrained intermediate-velocity (0.05 m/s) rotary-shear friction experiments with direct local Pt100 temperature and pore-pressure transducer monitoring.
Post-mortem optical and SEM backscattered electron (BSE) microstructural imaging of deformed gouge layers.
Analytical modeling comparing experimental data against Rice's (2006) slip-on-a-plane thermal pressurization model and a 1D heat diffusion model.
开展不排水中速（0.05 m/s）旋转剪切摩擦实验，并通过局部Pt100温度传感器和孔隙压力传感器进行直接监测。
利用光学显微镜和扫描电镜背散射电子（BSE）对变形断层泥层进行实验后微观结构成像。
将实验数据与Rice（2006）平面滑移热增压解析模型及一维热扩散模型进行对比建模。
de: Ten rotary-shear experiments on 5-mm-thick crushed Slochteren sandstone (SSG) gouges from the Groningen gas field at 12 MPa normal stress, 1–2 MPa initial fluid pressure, and 0.7 m slip.
Four saturating pore fluids tested: deionized water, synthetic Groningen reservoir brine, and Dow Corning 200 silicone oils (1 cSt and 5 cSt).
对来自格罗宁根气田的5毫米厚破碎Slochteren砂岩（SSG）断层泥进行10组旋转剪切实验（法向应力12 MPa，初始流体压力1–2 MPa，位移0.7 m）。
测试了四种饱和孔隙流体：去离子水、合成格罗宁根储层盐水以及道康宁200硅油（1 cSt和5 cSt）。
li: Rapid heat conduction into the high-conductivity steel piston (K = 16 W/(mK)) suppressed peak temperatures and overall TP efficiency compared to natural rock-bounded faults.
Temperature and pressure sensors were positioned at different azimuthal locations, and the brine-saturated thin section suffered fragmentation from salt crystallization during drying.
高导热钢质活塞（K = 16 W/(mK)）的快速热传导抑制了峰值温度和整体热增压效率，与天然岩石边界断层存在差异。
温度和压力传感器位于不同方位角位置，且盐水饱和薄片在干燥过程中因盐结晶而发生碎裂。

tm.why: The paper conducts rotary-shear friction experiments on simulated fault gouges to investigate dynamic slip weakening via thermal pressurization and microstructural evolution.
It models coseismic thermal pressurization and dynamic friction drops that directly control earthquake stress drops and rupture propagation.
The study specifically targets Slochteren sandstone gouges and in situ brine from the Groningen gas reservoir to constrain induced earthquake mechanics.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of GRL paper read and analyzed, including abstract, methods, experimental results, microstructural images, analytical modeling, and conclusions.

sum: This paper introduces a novel approach for classifying volcanic seismicity by employing Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA). RQA is used to extract physically interpretable, non-linear dynamical features from volcanic seismic waveforms. These features are then utilized in a multi-class classification framework to distinguish between different types of volcanic events. The methodology aims to bridge the gap between black-box machine learning models and physical interpretability in volcano monitoring, providing a robust tool for real-time hazard assessment.
本文提出了一种利用递归量化分析（RQA）对火山地震活动进行分类的新方法。该方法从火山地震波形中提取具有物理可解释性的非线性动力学特征，并将其应用于多分类框架中以区分不同类型的火山事件。该研究旨在弥合黑盒机器学习模型与火山监测中物理可解释性之间的差距，为实时灾害评估提供有力工具。

t: Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA) is used to extract non-linear dynamical features from volcanic seismic waveforms for classification.
利用递归量化分析（RQA）从火山地震波形中提取非线性动力学特征进行分类。
Multi-class volcanic seismic event waveforms representing different physical processes within volcanic systems.
代表火山系统内不同物理过程的多分类火山地震事件波形。
Successful multi-class classification of volcanic events using physically interpretable features derived from recurrence plots.
利用源自递归图的物理可解释特征，成功实现了火山事件的多分类。
Sensitivity of RQA features to noise and the selection of embedding dimension and delay parameters.
RQA特征对噪声敏感，且高度依赖于嵌入维度和延迟参数的选择。
Applying non-linear recurrence analysis to bridge the gap between machine learning classification and physical interpretability in volcano seismology.
应用非线性递归分析，弥合了火山地震学中机器学习分类与物理可解释性之间的差距。

kc: Introduced Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA) for feature extraction in volcanic seismicity classification.
Developed a multi-class classification framework using physically interpretable non-linear dynamical features.
Improved the interpretability of machine learning models applied to volcano monitoring.
引入递归量化分析（RQA）用于火山地震分类中的特征提取。
开发了利用物理可解释的非线性动力学特征的多分类框架。
提高了应用于火山监测的机器学习模型的可解释性。

Feature extraction based on recurrence plots.
Multi-class machine learning classification algorithms.

Computational cost of calculating recurrence matrices for long continuous seismic streams.

sum: This paper presents the first comprehensive application of the ten-attribute Distance and Quadrant (DQ) suite for reservoir characterization across four distinct geologic and AVO settings, including gas sands and CO2 storage. The workflow generates attributes directly from migrated near- and far-angle stacks without requiring prior well calibration or wavelet estimation. It serves as an effective preliminary screening tool for structural, stratigraphic, and machine learning analyses.
本文首次在四种不同的地质和AVO背景（包括气砂和二氧化碳储层）中，全面应用了包含十个属性的距离与象限（DQ）属性集。该工作流直接从偏移后的近角和远角叠加数据中生成属性，无需提前进行井校准或子波估算。该方法可作为结构、地层及机器学习分析的有效初步筛选工具。

t: A single DQ processing workflow that generates ten attribute volumes directly from migrated near- and far-angle stack volumes without prior well calibration.
一种直接从偏移近角和远角叠加数据中生成十个属性体的方法，无需井校准。
Seismic data from four contrasting geologic settings: Colony Formation (Canada), Sleipner field (Norway), Kupe field (New Zealand), and Grayback SE field (Texas).
来自加拿大、挪威、新西兰和德克萨斯州四个不同地质背景的地震数据集。
Demonstrated consistent attribute behavior across bright-spot, dim-spot, Class 3, Class 4, and CO2 saturation settings, establishing DQ as a robust screening tool.
在亮斑、暗斑及多种AVO类型中表现出一致的属性特征，证实了其筛选有效性。
The workflow is positioned as a preliminary screening tool prior to quantitative inversion or machine learning, rather than a final quantitative solution.
该方法定位为定量反演或机器学习之前的初步筛选工具。
First comprehensive demonstration of the full ten-attribute DQ suite on real-world datasets across diverse geologic and AVO settings.
首次在多种真实地质和AVO设置中全面演示了完整的十属性DQ工作流。

kc: First comprehensive demonstration of the full ten-attribute DQ suite on real-world datasets.
Development of a workflow that operates directly on migrated stacks without prior well calibration or wavelet estimation.
Validation of the DQ workflow across four contrasting geologic and AVO settings, including CO2 storage and gas fields.
首次在真实数据集上全面演示了完整的十属性DQ（距离与象限）属性集。
开发了一种直接在偏移叠加数据上运行的工作流，无需提前进行井校准或子波估算。
在包括二氧化碳封存和气田在内的四种不同地质和AVO背景下验证了DQ工作流的有效性。

AVO crossplot analysis and attribute volume generation.
Automated interpretation workflow for amplitude and offset information.
距离与象限（DQ）地震道属性计算。
AVO交会图分析与属性体生成。

Offshore CO2 storage reservoir data from the Sleipner field, Norway.
Class 4 AVO gas field data from the Kupe field, New Zealand.

sum: This study characterizes Quaternary vertical deformation across the Septentrional Oriente Fault Zone (SOFZ) in northern Haiti using high-resolution (1.5 m) LiDAR digital elevation models. By mapping Pleistocene marine terrace inner edges and constructing stacked swath profiles over ~200 km of coastline, the authors quantify spatiotemporal variations in uplift across the Northwestern Peninsula and Tortue Island. Results reveal contrasting deformation regimes on either side of the SOFZ. North of the SOFZ on Tortue Island, an eastward uplift gradient, fault inversion, and northward tilting reflect active shortening within the Hispaniola accretionary prism. South of the SOFZ, a 30-km long-wavelength southward tilt is superimposed by short-wavelength NW-trending folds. The novelty lies in linking the long-wavelength upper-plate tilt to the lateral rheological transition within the underthrusting North American plate, where thicker continental/volcanic crust to the west induces flexural uplift of the overriding Caribbean plate.
本研究利用1.5米高分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型，通过提取海地北部约200公里海岸线的更新世海成阶地内缘并构建叠加条带剖面，定量刻画了Septentrional Oriente断裂带（SOFZ）两侧的第四纪垂向变形。结果表明断裂带南北两侧变形样式截然不同：北侧托尔蒂岛表现为向东的隆升梯度、断层反转和……

t: The authors mapped marine terrace inner edges and faults on a 1.5 m LiDAR DEM, then projected the inner edges onto stacked parallel topographic swath profiles to quantify cumulative vertical tectonic deformation.
利用1.5米LiDAR DEM提取阶地内缘和断层，并投影至叠加条带剖面以量化累积垂向变形。

High-resolution (1.5 m) LiDAR DEM covering ~200 km of northern Haiti coastline and Tortue Island, supplemented by existing U/Th terrace ages (MIS 5 and 7) and offshore Haiti-SIS seismic reflection data.
覆盖海地北部约200公里海岸线的1.5米LiDAR DEM，结合已有U/Th测年和海上地震反射剖面。

Northwestern Peninsula terraces reach 700 m and exhibit a 30-km long-wavelength southward tilt plus short-wavelength folding, whereas Tortue Island terraces reach 300 m and show an eastward uplift gradient, fault inversion, and a 2.5-km northward tilt.
西北半岛阶地高达700米并呈30公里长波长向南倾斜；托尔蒂岛阶地高达300米并呈向东隆升梯度与断层反转。
Strong erosion and a NE-SW fracture network on western Tortue Island disrupt upper terraces (>100 m), making it impossible to map or correlate them reliably across faults.
托尔蒂岛西部强烈侵蚀和断裂网络破坏了100米以上高阶地连续性，无法可靠测绘与对比。

Links contrasting Quaternary terrace deformation across the SOFZ to total strain partitioning in the Septentrional sliver and upper-plate flexure caused by lateral crustal thickness variations in the downgoing North American plate.
将SOFZ两侧差异变形归因于块体完全应变分配及下伏北美板块横向地壳厚度变化引起的上盘挠曲。

kc: Mapped Pleistocene coastal terrace sequences along ~200 km of coastline in northern Haiti and Tortue Island using 1.5 m LiDAR DEMs.
Demonstrated contrasting Quaternary vertical deformation patterns north and south of the Septentrional Oriente Fault Zone (SOFZ) using stacked swath profiles.
Identified active short-wavelength folding, fault inversion, and an eastward uplift gradient on Tortue Island driven by accretionary prism widening.
Proposed that the 30-km long-wavelength southward tilt of the Northwestern Peninsula results from upper-plate flexure above thicker underthrusting North American crust.
利用1.5米分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型，绘制了海地北部和托尔蒂岛约200公里海岸线的更新世海岸阶地序列。
利用叠加条带剖面揭示了Septentrional Oriente断裂带（SOFZ）南北两侧截然不同的第四纪垂向变形样式。
识别出托尔蒂岛受增生楔展宽驱动的短波长活动褶皱、断层反转及向东隆升梯度。
提出西北半岛30公里长波长的向南倾斜源于较厚的下伏北美地壳俯冲引起的上盘板块挠曲。
me: Geomorphic mapping of marine terrace inner edges and fault traces using slope maps and hillshades from a 1.5 m LiDAR DEM.
Stacked topographic swath profile analysis oriented parallel and perpendicular to major tectonic structures to quantify regional tilt and folding.
Integration of onshore morphotectonic markers with offshore seismic reflection profiles, Bouguer gravity anomalies, and geodetic strain fields.
基于1.5米LiDAR DEM生成的坡度图和山体阴影图，对海成阶地内缘及断层迹线进行地貌测绘。
沿平行和垂直于主要构造方向构建叠加地形条带剖面，定量分析区域倾斜和褶皱变形。
将陆上构造地貌标志与海上地震反射剖面、布格重力异常及大地测量应变场相结合进行综合解释。
de: High-resolution (1.5 m) LiDAR Digital Elevation Model from the 2010 OpenTopography Haiti Earthquake dataset.
Previously published U/Th coral dating constraints for Marine Isotope Stages (MIS) 5a, 5c, 5e, and 7 terraces.
Seismic reflection profile H12-103 from the Haiti-SIS marine campaign.
来自2010年OpenTopography海地地震数据集的高分辨率（1.5米）LiDAR数字高程模型。
前人发表的MIS 5a、5c、5e和7期珊瑚阶地的U/Th测年约束数据。
Haiti-SIS海洋航次采集的H12-103地震反射剖面。
li: Strong erosion and dense NE-SW fracture networks on western Tortue Island prevent reliable mapping and correlation of upper terraces above 100 m.
Chronological constraints rely on sparse previously published U/Th dates limited to the lowest terraces at Môle St-Nicolas and Jean-Rabel.
托尔蒂岛西部强烈的侵蚀和密集的NE-SW向断裂网络阻碍了100米以上高阶地的可靠测绘与横向对比。
年代学约束依赖于前人发表的稀疏U/Th测年数据，且仅限于Môle St-Nicolas和Jean-Rabel地区的最低几级阶地。

tm.why: The paper investigates Quaternary vertical deformation, strain partitioning, and upper-plate flexural response driven by oblique convergence and underthrusting of the North American plate beneath the Caribbean plate.
It characterizes fault kinematics, fault inversion, and strain partitioning across the Septentrional Oriente Fault Zone and adjacent reverse and strike-slip structures.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF including abstract, text, references, and Figures 1 through 7 was examined and used as primary evidence.

sum: This study presents an 8500-year paleoseismic record from a 13.5-m-deep trench at the Wuzunxiao site on the central Altyn Tagh fault (ATF), Northwest China. Using high-resolution rhythmic stratigraphy, 42 radiocarbon dates, one OSL sample, and Bayesian OxCal chronological modeling, the authors identify 13 surface-rupturing paleoearthquakes. These events exhibit an average recurrence interval of 601 ± 529 years and a coefficient of variation of 0.90, reflecting weak quasi-periodic behavior divided into an early clustered phase (7.8–5.6 ka) and a later slower phase (since 4.3 ka). Correlating this record with adjacent sites shows that 17–36% of events breached the Pingding Shan geometric barrier (earthquake gate), matching empirical passing probabilities from historical surface ruptures. The novelty lies in obtaining an exceptionally deep, continuous 8500-year stratigraphic record that bridges field paleoseismology with dynamic rupture simulations and empirical earthquake gate models.
本研究在阿尔金断裂中段乌尊硝尔站点开挖了13.5米深的探槽，利用高分辨率韵律地层、42个碳十四和1个光释光测年样品及OxCal贝叶斯年龄建模，重建了过去8500年的古地震序列。研究识别出13次古地震事件，平均复发间隔为601±529年，变异系数0.90，呈弱准周期特征，包含早期的丛集期和后期的平静期……

t: Excavated a 13.5-m-deep trench on the Altyn Tagh fault, ranked stratigraphic deformation indicators from 1 to 4, and modeled 42 radiocarbon and 1 OSL dates in OxCal to correlate multi-site rupture histories.
在阿尔金断裂开挖13.5米深探槽，对变形标志进行1-4级评级，并利用OxCal对42个碳十四和1个光释光年龄建模以对比多…
77 distinct rhythmic stratigraphic units across 17 m of section in Trench T6 at the Wuzunxiao site, dated with 42 radiocarbon samples and 1 OSL sample, alongside regional ATF trench catalogs.
乌尊硝尔站点T6探槽17米厚地层中的77个韵律单元、42个碳十四和1个光释光测年数据，以及区域古地震目录。
Thirteen paleoearthquakes over 8500 years show an average recurrence interval of 601 ± 529 yr (COV = 0.90) in two phases, with 17–36% of events breaching the Pingding Shan earthquake gate.
8500年间识别出13次古地震，平均复发间隔601±529年（COV=0.90），分两阶段，17–36%的事件突破了平顶…
Dating methods cannot resolve separate earthquakes occurring within short intervals across adjacent sections, and slow sedimentation periods could miss events separated by only a few decades.
测年方法无法区分短时间内相继发生的独立地震，且低沉积速率期可能遗漏间隔仅数十年的事件。

Provides the longest continuous 8500-year paleoseismic record on the Altyn Tagh fault, directly validating empirical passing probabilities across a complex geometric earthquake gate against dynamic rupture models.
提供了阿尔金断裂长达8500年的连续古地震记录，实测验证了复杂几何地震门的经验破裂穿透概率。

kc: Established an 8500-year-long, 13-event paleoseismic chronology from a 13.5-m-deep trench at the Wuzunxiao site on the central Altyn Tagh fault.
Demonstrated two-phase irregular recurrence behavior (average RI = 601 ± 529 yr, COV = 0.90) driven by surrounding fault geometric complexities.
Quantified that 17–36% of ruptures breached the Pingding Shan earthquake gate, validating empirical statistical models of historical surface ruptures.
在阿尔金断裂中段乌尊硝尔站点通过13.5米深探槽建立了长达8500年、包含13次事件的古地震年代序列。
揭示了受周边断层几何复杂性控制的两阶段不规则复发行为（平均复发间隔601±529年，变异系数0.90）。
量化了突破平顶山地震门的破裂比例（17–36%），验证了基于历史地表破裂的经验统计模型。
me: Paleoseismic trench excavation (93 m long, 13.5 m deep) and high-resolution stratigraphic logging of 77 distinct units.
Event horizon identification and quality ranking (scale 1 to 4) based on morphological and sedimentological deformation indicators.
Radiocarbon (42 samples) and optically stimulated luminescence (1 sample) dating integrated into an OxCal v4.4.4 Bayesian chronological model.
Multi-site paleoseismic event correlation and rupture passing probability estimation across geometric bends and stepovers.
古地震探槽开挖（长93米，深13.5米）及77个精细地层单元的高分辨率编录。
基于构造变形和沉积响应标志识别古地震事件层位，并进行1至4级的证据质量评级。
结合42个碳十四和1个光释光测年数据，利用OxCal v4.4.4构建贝叶斯年代学模型。
开展多站点古地震事件对比，并估算跨越几何弯曲和阶区的破裂穿透概率。

sum: This study conducts a 36-year time-series analysis (1990–2025) to evaluate the role of extreme rainfall in triggering phreatic eruptions and magmatic activity at Shinmoedake volcano, Japan. By introducing a new 'T&I Day' index (defined by daily rainfall ≥100 mm), the paper establishes a statistical correlation between intense precipitation events and volcanic unrest. The results suggest that rapid rainwater infiltration alters pore pressure and thermal regimes in the shallow hydrothermal system, acting as a critical external trigger for phreatic activity.
本研究对日本新燃岳火山进行了36年（1990-2025年）的时间序列分析，评估了极端降雨在触发蒸汽喷发和岩浆活动中的作用。通过引入日降雨量≥100毫米的“T&I Day”新指标，建立了强降雨事件与火山活跃度之间的统计关联。结果表明，雨水的快速入渗改变了浅部热液系统的孔隙压力和热状态，是触发蒸汽喷发的……

A 36-year dataset (1990–2025) of daily rainfall measurements and volcanic eruption catalogs at Shinmoedake volcano, Japan.

Relies primarily on statistical correlation, requiring further physical modeling of pore-pressure diffusion to confirm the exact triggering pathways.

sum: This paper presents the first results from the Coupled atmospHere Interior modeL Intercomparison (CHILI) project, benchmarking planetary evolution codes for the primordial magma oceans of Earth and Venus. The study reveals that nominal Earth models predict magma ocean solidification within 4 Myr, whereas Venus scenarios show prolonged magma ocean stages up to 50 Myr. The intercomparison highlights that model-specific treatments of volatile partitioning, vertical energy transport, mantle geodynamics, convection, melting curves, rheological properties, and radiative transfer introduce substantial variance in cooling timescales and outgassed atmospheres. It identifies critical sensitivities in volatile partitioning, escape processes, mantle viscosity, and melting, which are essential for validating early planetary histories and interpreting exoplanet observations.
本文展示了耦合大气-内部模型比对（CHILI）项目的首批成果，对地球和金星原始岩浆洋的行星演化数值模拟代码进行了基准测试。研究表明，地球模型预测岩浆洋在400万年内固结，而金星在特定条件下可维持长达5000万年的岩浆洋阶段。比对发现，挥发分分配、垂直能量传输、地幔动力学、对流、熔融曲线、流变学性质及……

Synthetic evolutionary scenarios of Earth and Venus with varying initial volatile (C-H-O) budgets and planetary parameters.
