Earth's magma ocean solidifies within 4 Myr, while Venus can sustain a magma ocean for 50 Myr, with high sensitivity to volatile partitioning and mantle viscosity.
地球岩浆洋在400万年内固结，而金星可维持达5000万年，且对挥发分分配和地幔粘度高度敏感。
Divergent evolutionary behaviors arise from model-specific treatments of volatile partitioning, vertical energy transport, and mantle geodynamics.

First systematic model intercomparison (CHILI) benchmarking coupled interior-atmosphere codes for early terrestrial planets.

sum: This study investigates the application of the generalized mean rupture distance (Rp) to ground-motion models (GMMs) for large subduction interface earthquakes. By recalibrating the path term of a published GMM (Parker et al., 2022) using Rp derived from distributed slip models (DSMs), the authors show that incorporating spatially variable slip information fits strong-motion data at least as well as traditional Rrup-based models. The Rp-based approach successfully addresses near-fault ground-motion saturation and reduces model uncertainty, particularly for peak ground velocity (PGV) and acceleration, by accounting for the entire rupture geometry rather than assuming uniform slip.
本研究探讨了广义平均破裂距离（Rp）在大型俯冲带界面地震地面运动模型（GMM）中的应用。作者利用分布式滑移模型（DSM）计算的Rp，对已发表的GMM（Parker等，2022）中的路径项进行了重新标定。残差分析表明，该模型对强震数据的拟合效果不亚于传统的基于Rrup的模型。通过引入空间变化的滑移信息……

sum: Estimating geological slip rates for slowly deforming intraplate strike-slip faults is challenging due to small cumulative offsets and distributed deformation. This study constrains the late Quaternary slip rate along the Dangu–Dasan area of the northern Yangsan Fault (YSF), southeastern Korea, integrating 0.5-m LiDAR DEMs, 1977 aerial photogrammetry, optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating, statistical terrace-riser restoration, and paleoseismic trenching. Reconstructing the best-preserved T2–T1 fluvial terrace riser yields a dextral horizontal offset of 19.03 ± 1.45 m, while five OSL samples from the T2 surface give a weighted mean age of 103.14 ± 3.17 ka. These constraints establish a minimum dextral slip rate of 0.15–0.23 mm/yr (representative 0.18 ± 0.02 mm/yr). Paleoseismic trenches reveal a near-vertical main strike-slip zone alongside oblique subsidiary reverse faults and pop-up mounds. The slip rate matches nearby Byeokgye estimates but is much lower than Bangok rates, demonstrating that along-strike segmentation and distributed deformation govern slip rate variability.
针对板内慢速走滑断层滑动速率难以准确估计的问题，本研究综合高分辨率LiDAR、1977年历史航片SfM地形、光释光（OSL）测年、阶地坎统计恢复及古地震探槽，约束了韩国东南部梁山断层（YSF）北段Dangu–Dasan地区的晚第四纪滑动速率。保存最好的T2–T1河流阶地坎恢复出19.03 ± 1.4……

t: The authors combined 0.5-m LiDAR DEMs and 1977 SfM aerial photogrammetry with a statistical Python projection code to measure terrace-riser offsets, paired with quartz SAR-OSL dating and paleoseismic trenching.
结合0.5米LiDAR和1977年航片SfM地形、Python阶地坎统计投影代码、石英SAR-OSL测年及古地震探槽分析…

Data include 2017 airborne LiDAR (0.5 m/pixel), three 1977 aerial photos, two paleoseismic trenches, seven test pits, and ten coarse-quartz OSL samples from alluvial fan and fluvial terraces T1 and T2.
包含2017年LiDAR数据、3张1977年航片、2个古地震探槽、7个探坑及冲积扇和T1、T2阶地的10个OSL样品。
Five OSL ages on T2 yield a weighted mean age of 103.14 ± 3.17 ka, and the T2–T1 riser shows a 19.03 ± 1.45 m dextral offset, constraining a minimum slip rate of 0.15–0.23 mm/yr.
T2阶地5个OSL年龄加权平均为103.14±3.17 ka，T2–T1阶地坎右旋位错19.03±1.45 m，最小滑动…

Using T2 depositional ages as a maximum age bound and omitting strain partitioned onto subsidiary oblique reverse structures means the derived slip rate is only a conservative minimum for the main strand.

首次获得Dangu–Dasan段基于地形与OSL的晚第四纪滑动速率，证实分段和分布式变形控制了梁山断层速率差异。

kc: Quantified a robust minimum late Quaternary dextral slip rate of 0.15–0.23 mm/yr (0.18 ± 0.02 mm/yr) on the northern Yangsan Fault using a 19.03 ± 1.45 m terrace riser offset and a 103.14 ± 3.17 ka OSL age.

Demonstrated through paleoseismic trenching (Trenches A and B) and swath profiles that deformation is partitioned between a near-vertical main strike-slip strand and oblique subsidiary contractional structures.
Showed that slip rate discrepancies along the northern Yangsan Fault reflect along-strike structural segmentation and distributed off-fault deformation rather than a single uniform fault slip rate.
利用19.03 ± 1.45 m的阶地坎位错和103.14 ± 3.17 ka的光释光年龄，定量约束了梁山断层北段晚第四纪最小右旋滑动速率为0.15–0.23 mm/yr（0.18 ± 0.02 mm/yr）。
通过古地震探槽（探槽A和B）和条带剖面证明，变形在近直立的主走滑断层分支和斜交的次级挤压构造之间发生了分配。
阐明了梁山断层北段滑动速率的差异反映了走向构造分段和分布式断层外变形，不能用单一均匀的滑动速率代表整个断层系统。
me: Multi-temporal geomorphic mapping combining 2017 airborne LiDAR DEM (0.5 m/pixel) and 1977 historical aerial photographs processed with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) photogrammetry.

Statistical terrace-riser lateral offset reconstruction using a Python code that partitions proximal and distal risers into 10 segments to compute 100 intersection pairs via root-mean-square linear regression.
Optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating of coarse-grained (90–250 μm) quartz using the single-aliquot regenerative dose (SAR) protocol and inverse-variance weighted mean age calculation.
Paleoseismic trenching across the main fault strand (Trench A) and an oblique subsidiary reverse fault (Trench B) paired with 10 cross-fault topographic swath profiles.
结合2017年机载LiDAR数字高程模型（0.5米分辨率）与1977年历史航片运动恢复结构（SfM）摄影测量进行多时相地貌填图。
使用Python代码进行阶地坎水平位错统计重建，将近端和远端阶地坎划分为10个片段，通过均方根线性回归计算100组交点距离。
采用单片再生剂量（SAR）法对粗颗粒（90–250 μm）石英进行光释光（OSL）测年，并利用逆方差加权计算平均沉积年龄。
在主断层分支（探槽A）和斜交次级逆断层（探槽B）开挖古地震探槽，并结合10条跨断层地形条带剖面分析垂直位错。
de: Airborne LiDAR DEM (0.5 m/pixel, acquired in 2017) and three 1977 aerial photographs covering the Dangu–Dasan area of the northern Yangsan Fault.
Ten quartz OSL dating samples collected from 7 test pits: 3 from alluvial fan deposits (DGAF-1 to 3), 2 from lower terrace T1 (DST1-1, 2), and 5 from upper terrace T2 (DST2-1 to 5).
Two paleoseismic trenches (Trench A on the main NNE–SSW trace and Trench B on an NW–SE subsidiary reverse fault) and 10 swath topographic profiles.

2个古地震探槽（主断层NNE–SSW迹线上的探槽A和NW–SE向次级逆断层上的探槽B）以及10条地形条带剖面。
li: The T2 depositional age (103.14 ± 3.17 ka) represents a maximum age constraint for the T2–T1 riser abandonment, and off-fault distributed deformation is not fully captured, making the slip rate a conservative minimum.
Terrace T1 yielded late Holocene ages (2.9–3.9 ka) affected by fluvial reworking and anthropogenic modification, preventing its direct use as a lower age bracket for the riser.
Fluvial terrace diachroneity, potential incomplete OSL bleaching, and differences in averaging timescales (103 ka vs. 698 ka at Bangok) introduce inherent uncertainties in along-strike comparisons.
T2阶地沉积年龄（103.14 ± 3.17 ka）仅提供T2–T1阶地坎废弃的最大年龄约束，且未完全计入断层外分布式变形，所得滑动速率为保守下限。
T1阶地测年结果较年轻（2.9–3.9 ka），受晚期河流改造和人类活动干扰，无法作为阶地坎形成的下限年龄约束。
河流阶地穿时性、潜在的OSL晒退不完全以及时间尺度差异（本研究103 ka对比Bangok段698 ka）给走向对比带来固有不确定性。

tm.why: The study quantifies late Quaternary geological slip rates, strain partitioning, and segment-scale fault mechanics along the slowly deforming intraplate Yangsan Fault.
The paper investigates intraplate strike-slip fault kinematics, crustal deformation, and tectonic geomorphology in southeastern Korea.
Fault slip rates and paleoseismic trench observations provide essential parameters for evaluating long-term fault behavior and regional seismic hazard.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF text, figures, and tables were analyzed directly.

sum: Statistical prediction of seismic activity from historical earthquake catalogs is challenging due to non-stationary, multi-scale, and clustered time-series dynamics. This paper proposes a unified benchmarking framework combining hierarchical deep learning (Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting, N-HITS) with metaheuristic hyperparameter optimization using the Gray Langurs Optimizer (GLO). Using the Canadian earthquake catalog (101,365 events, 1985–2020) and a supplementary 2021 global USGS dataset (28,872 events), the authors benchmark five deep architectures (N-HITS, N-BEATS, DeepAR, ConvLSTM, Reformer) and ten metaheuristic optimizers under standardized preprocessing. Standalone N-HITS outperformed other baselines (R2 = 0.921, MSE = 0.00234). After GLO hyperparameter tuning and binary feature selection, N-HITS achieved R2 = 0.9892 ± 0.0049, MSE = 7.980e-05 ± 7.980e-07, and the lowest training time (48.3 s) and memory footprint (312.4 MB). The novelty lies in the controlled joint benchmarking of model architectures and optimizers for scalable statistical seismic trend monitoring.
针对历史地震目录非平稳、多尺度和丛集特征带来的预测难题，本文提出了结合神经分层插值时间序列预测（N-HITS）与灰叶猴优化算法（GLO）的深度学习框架。研究基于加拿大地震目录（1985–2020年，101,365个事件）和2021年USGS全球目录（28,872个事件），在统一预处理下系统对比了5种……

t: Combines the Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting (N-HITS) architecture with the bio-inspired Gray Langurs Optimizer (GLO) for binary feature selection and 5-fold cross-validation hyperparameter tuning.
将神经分层插值预测架构（N-HITS）与灰叶猴优化算法（GLO）结合，用于特征选择与五折交叉验证超参数调优。
Uses the Canadian earthquake catalog (1985–2020, 101,365 events, magnitudes -1.9 to 7.7) split chronologically (70/15/15%), supplemented by the 2021 global USGS catalog (28,872 events).
采用加拿大地震目录（1985–2020年，101,365条事件）按时间70/15/15%划分，并辅以2021年USGS全…
Baseline N-HITS achieved R2 = 0.921 and MSE = 0.00234; GLO-optimized N-HITS improved performance to R2 = 0.9892 ± 0.0049, MSE = 7.980e-05 ± 7.980e-07, and fastest training time (48.3 s).
基线N-HITS的R2为0.921；经GLO优化后R2达0.9892±0.0049，MSE降至7.980e-05，且训练…

Relies solely on single-split historical catalog data without physical tectonic drivers or probabilistic uncertainty bounds, providing statistical trend estimates rather than physical earthquake predictions.
仅依赖历史目录变量而无物理构造驱动或概率不确定性量化，输出仅为统计趋势估计。

Establishes a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework jointly isolating and evaluating five deep time-series architectures and ten metaheuristic optimizers under identical preprocessing and training conditions.
构建了统一的标准化基准框架，在相同条件下协同评估多种深度架构与元启发式优化器的交互作用。

kc: Developed a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework combining five deep time-series models (N-HITS, N-BEATS, DeepAR, ConvLSTM, Reformer) with ten metaheuristic optimizers for catalog-based seismic forecasting.
Applied the Gray Langurs Optimizer (GLO) for both binary feature selection (bGLO) and mixed discrete-continuous hyperparameter tuning of N-HITS.
Demonstrated substantial accuracy gains on the Canadian earthquake catalog, improving R2 from 0.921 (baseline N-HITS) to 0.9892 (GLO+N-HITS) and reducing MSE to 7.980e-05.

Conducted comprehensive computational resource profiling showing GLO+N-HITS achieves the fastest training (48.3 s) and lowest memory usage (312.4 MB), along with SHAP-based feature importance analysis.
开发了统一且可复现的基准测试框架，将5种深度时间序列模型与10种元启发式优化器相结合用于地震目录预测。
引入灰叶猴优化器（GLO）用于二进制特征选择（bGLO）及N-HITS模型的离散-连续混合超参数调优。
在加拿大地震目录上显著提升了预测精度，将R2从基线N-HITS的0.921提高到0.9892，MSE降低至7.980e-05。
进行了全面的计算资源评估与SHAP可解释性分析，证明GLO+N-HITS具有最快的训练速度（48.3秒）和最低的内存占用（312.4 MB）。
me: Data preprocessing pipeline: schema standardization, median/mode imputation, temporal feature decomposition (cyclical sine/cosine encoding), monthly frequency aggregation, smoothing diagnostics (SMA, EWMA, Savitzky-Golay), and outlier strategy comparisons (Winsorized, Capped, Z-score removal).
Deep time-series forecasting using Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting (N-HITS), benchmarked against N-BEATS, DeepAR, ConvLSTM, and Reformer.
Binary metaheuristic feature selection and 5-fold cross-validation hyperparameter optimization using Gray Langurs Optimizer (GLO) compared against PSO, WOA, GA, BA, BBO, DE, SFS, APO, and MVO.
Model interpretability via SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and statistical validation via Shapiro-Wilk normality tests, Q-Q plots, and computational profiling.
数据预处理流程：结构标准化、中位数/众数插补、时间特征分解（正余弦周期编码）、月度时间序列聚合、平滑诊断（SMA、EWMA、Savitzky-Golay）及异常值处理策略对比。
基于N-HITS的深度时间序列预测，并与N-BEATS、DeepAR、ConvLSTM和Reformer进行基线对比。
采用灰叶猴优化算法（GLO）进行二进制特征选择和五折交叉验证超参数优化，并与PSO、WOA、GA、BA、BBO、DE、SFS、APO、MVO对比。
利用SHAP值进行特征可解释性分析，并通过Shapiro-Wilk正态性检验、Q-Q图及计算资源监控进行统计评估。
de: Primary dataset: Earthquakes Canada catalog (Natural Resources Canada) spanning January 1, 1985 to January 1, 2020 with 101,365 events (magnitudes -1.9 to 7.7, depths -2.6 to 214 km), split chronologically into 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing.

Supplementary dataset (Appendix A & B): Global USGS Earthquake Hazards Program catalog covering January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2021 with 28,872 events (magnitudes 2.5 to 8.2, depths -3.4 to 669.5 km).
主数据集：加拿大自然资源部地震目录（1985年1月1日至2020年1月1日），共101,365条记录（震级-1.9至7.7，深度-2.6至214 km），按时间顺序划分为70%训练集、15%验证集和15%测试集。
补充数据集（附录A与B）：美国地质调查局（USGS）2021年全年全球地震目录，共28,872条记录（震级2.5至8.2，深度-3.4至669.5 km）。
li: Relies exclusively on historical catalog variables without physical or geophysical drivers (e.g., tectonic stress, fault mechanics, geodetic deformation, or geochemical precursors), yielding statistical trend estimates rather than physical earthquake predictions.
Primary evaluation focuses on a single national catalog (Canada) and a 1-year global catalog without broad multi-region tectonic cross-validation.
Generates deterministic point predictions without explicit probabilistic uncertainty quantification or confidence intervals.

Uses a single fixed chronological train-validation-test split rather than rolling-origin or walk-forward validation, and lacks controlled ablation against randomized-search baselines to fully isolate GLO's specific contribution.
仅依赖历史地震目录统计变量，未纳入构造应力、断层力学或大地测量形变等地球物理驱动因素，输出仅为统计趋势估计而非物理地震预测。
主要基于单一国家地震目录（加拿大）和一年期全球目录，缺乏跨不同构造区域的广泛泛化验证。
仅生成确定性点预测，缺乏显式的概率不确定性量化或预测置信区间估计。
采用固定的时间顺序训练-验证-测试集划分而非滚动窗口验证，且缺乏随机搜索消融实验以完全分离GLO算法的独立贡献。

tm.why: The paper develops a deep learning time-series forecasting framework (N-HITS) combined with metaheuristic hyperparameter optimization (Gray Langurs Optimizer) to predict earthquake magnitudes from catalog data.
The study performs statistical analysis, preprocessing, and time-series forecasting directly on historical national (Canadian) and global (USGS) earthquake catalogs.
The work is framed around data-centered seismic hazard analysis and statistical trend monitoring of seismic activity.

ev.notes: Full 56-page PDF analyzed, including main text, all 30 figures, 27 tables, and Appendices A and B.

sum: The 2020 southwestern Puerto Rico seismic sequence, featuring a mainshock of Mw 6.4, caused significant damage but lacked consensus on its fault source. This study presents high-resolution marine seismic reflection data identifying a 20 km long, north-verging curved normal fault (the Guayanilla Canyon fault) that likely ruptured during the Mw 6.4 event. The fault bounds a 1 km deep asymmetric basin and controls the Guayanilla canyon system. The data do not support previously proposed major faults in the area. Additionally, imaging of the Investigator fault reveals buried low-angle thrusts, representing the boundary between the inactive upper accretionary prism of the Muertos trough and a buried back-arc basin.
2020年波多黎各西南部发生Mw 6.4地震序列，但其发震断层一直存在争议。本研究利用高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面，识别出一条长约20公里的北倾弧形正断层（瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层），该断层极有可能是Mw 6.4地震的破裂源。该断层控制着一个深约1公里的不对称盆地及瓜亚尼亚峡谷系统的发育。数据否定了此前该区域存……

t: High-resolution marine seismic reflection profiling combined with sediment isopach and magnetic anomaly mapping to image active fault structures.
结合高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面、沉积物等厚图和磁异常图对活动断层进行成像。
High-resolution marine seismic reflection profiles, sediment isopach maps, and magnetic anomaly maps of the southwestern offshore region of Puerto Rico.
波多黎各西南部海域的高分辨率地震反射剖面、沉积物等厚度数据和磁异常图。
Identification of the 20 km long Guayanilla Canyon fault as the source of the Mw 6.4 earthquake, and reinterpretation of the Investigator fault as a major tectonic boundary.
确定20公里长的瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层为Mw 6.4地震源，并将调查者断层重新解释为板块边界。
Lack of direct co-seismic slip measurements on the seafloor to uniquely resolve the contribution of strike-slip versus normal faulting components.
缺乏直接的海底同震滑动观测，难以完全厘清正断层与走滑断层分量的具体贡献。
Discovery of the Guayanilla Canyon fault and the refutation of previously proposed major seismogenic faults (e.g., Northern Boqueron Bay-Punta Montalva fault) in the epicentral area.
首次发现瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层，并否定了该区域先前假定的多条大型发震断层。

kc: Identified the 20 km long Guayanilla Canyon fault as the primary source of the 2020 Mw 6.4 earthquake.
Demonstrated that the Guayanilla Canyon fault controls the geomorphology of the only submarine drainage system in southern Puerto Rico.
Refuted the existence of several previously proposed major seismogenic faults in the region.
Imaged the Investigator fault to re-interpret it as a boundary between an inactive accretionary prism and a buried back-arc basin.
识别出20公里长的瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层，并确定其为2020年Mw 6.4地震的主要发震构造。
证实了瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层控制着波多黎各南部唯一的海底排水系统的地貌发育。
否定了该地区先前假定的几条主要发震断层的存在。
对调查者断层进行成像，将其重新解释为不活跃增生棱柱与隐伏弧后盆地之间的边界。
me: High-resolution marine seismic reflection profiling.
Sediment isopach mapping.
Magnetic anomaly mapping.
高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面探测。
沉积物等厚图绘制。
磁异常图分析。
de: High-resolution seismic reflection profiles across the Guayanilla canyon and southern shelf of Puerto Rico.
Regional magnetic anomaly and sediment thickness datasets.
横跨波多黎各瓜亚尼亚峡谷和南部陆架的高分辨率地震反射剖面。
区域磁异常和沉积物厚度数据集。
li: The study relies primarily on structural imaging, which cannot definitively prove the exact slip distribution of the 2020 rupture without co-seismic geodetic or seismological joint inversion.
该研究主要依赖结构成像，在缺乏同震大地测量或地震学联合反演的情况下，无法绝对证实2020年破裂的具体滑动分布。

tm.why: The paper uses high-resolution seismic reflection data to image active faults and regional tectonic structures in southern Puerto Rico.
The study investigates the fault sources and rupture locations responsible for the 2020 Mw 6.4 southern Puerto Rico earthquake sequence.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Seismological Research Letters.

sum: Raman and infrared anomalies associated with H-bond symmetrization in delta-AlOOH occur at 5–10 GPa, much lower than the 30–40 GPa predicted by static harmonic theory. To resolve this discrepancy, the authors combine harmonic phonon calculations with SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) and phonon quasiparticle (PHQ) analysis at 300 K from 0 to 140 GPa. By extracting temperature- and pressure-dependent frequencies and linewidths from long-time MD trajectories and incorporating non-analytical corrections for directional LO-TO splitting, the framework reproduces the observed branch reorganization, mode softening, and rapid linewidth broadening at 5–10 GPa. It also achieves near-quantitative agreement with the ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman multiplet. The novelty lies in demonstrating that the spectroscopic anomalies originate from finite-temperature coupled proton-lattice dynamics and progressive loss of spectral coherence in the H-bond disordering regime, well before any static harmonic instability occurs.
针对δ-AlOOH在5–10 GPa下的拉曼和红外光谱异常显著低于静态简谐理论预测（30–40 GPa）的问题，本文结合简谐声子计算、基于SCAN泛函的深度势分子动力学（DPMD）模拟以及300 K下的声子准粒子（PHQ）分析方法，并引入纵向-横向光学声子（LO-TO）劈裂的非解析修正。通过从长时分……

t: Combines SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics at 300 K with phonon quasiparticle analysis (via mode-projected velocity autocorrelation functions) and non-analytical LO-TO splitting corrections.
结合300 K下的SCAN深度势分子动力学、声子准粒子分析及非解析LO-TO劈裂修正。
8,192-atom NPT and 512-atom NVT SCAN-DPMD trajectories (up to 0.4 ns, 0.2 fs timestep) at 300 K across 0–18 GPa (P21nm) and 0–140 GPa (Pnnm), benchmarked against experimental Raman/IR spectra.
0–140 GPa下8192与512原子的300 K DPMD轨迹（步长0.2 fs），并与拉曼/红外实验对比。

Quasiparticle renormalization lowers 0 GPa OH-stretch frequencies by 139–149 cm^-1; with LO-TO splitting (up to ~370 cm^-1), it matches ambient Raman peaks. Over 0–4 GPa, the low-frequency A1 linewidth grows from ~50 to 400 cm^-1.
0 GPa下OH伸缩频率重整化降低139–149 cm^-1；0–4 GPa内A1模线宽从50增至400 cm^-1。
Classical trajectories omit nuclear quantum effects, and the single-average-structure projection leaves the lowest-frequency ambient OH-stretching Raman peak (~2,121 cm^-1) unresolved.
未显式包含核量子效应，且单一平均结构未能解析2121 cm^-1处的最低频OH峰。

Resolves the 5–10 GPa vs. 30 GPa anomaly discrepancy in delta-AlOOH by showing that finite-temperature H-bond disordering drives quasiparticle frequency renormalization and coherence loss before static harmonic softening.
揭示有限温度氢键无序引发的准粒子重整化与退相干解释了5–10 GPa光谱异常。

kc: Combined SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) with phonon quasiparticle (PHQ) analysis to extract anharmonic phonon frequencies and lifetimes of delta-AlOOH at 300 K up to 140 GPa.
Resolved the long-standing pressure discrepancy between experimental Raman/IR anomalies (5–10 GPa) and static 0 K harmonic phonon predictions (~30 GPa).
Demonstrated that directional near-Gamma LO-TO splitting plus quasiparticle renormalization quantitatively reproduces the main components of the ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman multiplet.
Identified the 5–10 GPa low-frequency A1 Raman anomaly as a progressive loss of spectral coherence and overdamping of a coupled proton-lattice antiferrodistortive vibration.
结合基于SCAN的深度势分子动力学（DPMD）与声子准粒子（PHQ）分析，提取了300 K、0–140 GPa下δ-AlOOH的非谐声子频率与寿命。
解决了实验拉曼/红外光谱异常压力（5–10 GPa）与静态0 K简谐声子预测压力（约30 GPa）之间长期存在的不一致。
证明了结合近Γ点方向性LO-TO劈裂与准粒子重整化可定量重现常压下OH伸缩拉曼多重峰的主要成分。
阐明了5–10 GPa低频A1拉曼异常源于耦合质子-晶格反铁畸变振动的谱相干性逐渐丧失与过阻尼。
me: SCAN-based Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics (SCAN-DPMD) in NPT (8,192 atoms) and NVT (512 atoms) ensembles at 300 K using LAMMPS and DeePMD-kit.
Space-group-constrained (P21nm and Pnnm) internal-coordinate optimization of time-averaged primitive cells using ASE and BFGS.
Harmonic phonon calculations via finite-displacement method using PhonoPy, VASP (SCAN-DFT), and PhonoLAMMPS.
Non-analytical corrections (NAC) near Gamma using VASP-computed Born effective charges and dielectric tensors to account for anisotropic LO-TO splitting.
Phonon quasiparticle (PHQ) extraction via mode-projected velocity autocorrelation functions (VAF) and Lorentzian spectral fitting using DynaPhoPy.
利用LAMMPS和DeePMD-kit在300 K下进行基于SCAN的深度势分子动力学（SCAN-DPMD）NPT（8192原子）和NVT（512原子）系综模拟。
使用ASE和BFGS对时间平均原胞进行空间群约束（P21nm和Pnnm）的内部坐标优化。
结合PhonoPy、VASP（SCAN-DFT）和PhonoLAMMPS，采用有限位移法计算简谐声子。
基于VASP计算的Born有效电荷与介电张量引入近Γ点非解析修正（NAC），以计入各向异性LO-TO劈裂。
利用DynaPhoPy计算模式投影速度自相关函数（VAF）并进行洛伦兹谱拟合，提取声子准粒子（PHQ）性质。
de: 300 K NPT DPMD trajectories (0.4 ns, 0.2 fs timestep) in 8x8x16 supercells from 0 to 18 GPa (P21nm) and 0 to 140 GPa (Pnnm).
300 K NVT DPMD production trajectories (0.4 ns for low-pressure anomaly set; 80 ps for high-pressure Pnnm extension) in 4x4x4 supercells.
Published high-pressure Raman and infrared spectroscopic measurements of delta-AlOOH and empirical OH-frequency vs. bond-length correlations for benchmarking.
0–18 GPa（P21nm）与0–140 GPa（Pnnm）下8×8×16超胞的300 K NPT系综DPMD轨迹（0.4 ns，步长0.2 fs）。
4×4×4超胞的300 K NVT系综DPMD采样轨迹（低压异常组0.4 ns，高压Pnnm扩展组80 ps）。
已发表的δ-AlOOH高压拉曼与红外光谱实验数据，以及含氢矿物OH频率-键长经验关系用于基准对比。
li: Nuclear quantum effects (NQE) were not explicitly included in the classical DPMD trajectories.
Single-average-structure PHQ projection cannot resolve the lowest-frequency ambient OH-stretching peak (~2,121 cm^-1) arising from local configurational splitting.
Single-mode Lorentzian quasiparticle tracking breaks down near 4–5 GPa when linewidths become comparable to oscillation frequencies and branches severely overlap.
经典DPMD轨迹中未显式包含核量子效应（NQE）。
单一平均结构PHQ投影无法解析由局域构型劈裂引起的常压最低频OH伸缩峰（约2121 cm^-1）。
当4–5 GPa附近线宽与振荡频率相当且能带严重重叠时，单模洛伦兹准粒子追踪失效。

tm.why: The study investigates the lattice dynamics and phase transitions of delta-AlOOH, a prototypical dense hydrous mineral phase relevant to water transport and elasticity in the deep mantle.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 17-page PDF (12-page main text plus 5-page supplementary material).

sum: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) measures strain or strain-rate along fiber-optic cables rather than particle velocity, requiring extra conversion steps in traditional seismic modeling. This study introduces a first-order coupled elastic wave equation formulated in terms of acceleration and strain-rate for VTI anisotropic and acoustic media. Because its mathematical structure closely mirrors the standard velocity-stress formulation, existing staggered-grid finite-difference solvers, stability conditions, and absorbing boundaries can be adapted with minimal modification. Furthermore, the author demonstrates that deriving the acoustic counterpart requires explicitly omitting shear strain-rate equations to avoid physically inconsistent shear wavefields. Numerical experiments on a two-layer VTI model and the complex Marmousi elastic model using a rotated staggered-grid scheme show that the proposed formulation matches traditional velocity-stress simulations within a relative difference of 10^-6 to 10^-7, eliminating computational overhead and signal conversion errors for DAS applications.
分布式声学传感（DAS）记录光纤轴向应变或应变率，传统波动模拟需进行数据转换。本文推导了基于加速度和应变率的一阶耦合弹性波与声波方程（含VTI各向异性），其数学结构与传统速度-应力格式高度对称，可直接复用现有的交错网格有限差分算法与边界条件。研究还指出声波近似下需显式剔除剪切应变率分量以避免非物理剪……

t: Derives a nine-equation first-order coupled PDE system in acceleration and strain-rate for VTI media, discretized via a fourth-order spatial, second-order temporal rotated staggered-grid finite-difference scheme.
推导VTI介质中加速度与应变率的九方程一阶耦合偏微分系统，采用四阶空间、二阶时间旋转交错网格有限差分求解。
Evaluated using 2D finite-difference numerical experiments on a 2 km x 2 km two-layer VTI model (20 Hz Ricker source) and a resampled elastic Marmousi model (10 Hz source) on 5 m x 5 m grids.
采用5 m网格的二维双层VTI模型（20 Hz震源）和重采样Marmousi弹性模型（10 Hz震源）进行数值实验。

Strain-rate wavefields computed by the acceleration-strain-rate formulation match conventional velocity-stress results with negligible relative differences of 10^-7 in the layered model and 10^-6 in the Marmousi model.
新格式计算的应变率波场与传统速度-应力结果高度一致，层状模型相对误差仅10^-7，Marmousi模型仅10^-6。
Simulations are tested in 2D synthetic domains, and naive acoustic simplification without explicitly dropping shear strain-rate equations generates physically contradictory shear deformations.
仅在二维合成模型验证；声波近似若不显式剔除剪切应变方程会产生非物理剪切应变。
Formulates elastodynamics directly in acceleration and strain-rate as a first-order system mirroring velocity-stress, avoiding mixed-order PDEs or post-simulation velocity-to-strain conversions.
构建了与速度-应力完全对称的一阶加速度-应变率方程，避免混合阶方程或波场后处理转换。

kc: Derives a first-order coupled elastic wave equation in terms of particle acceleration and strain-rate that mirrors the standard velocity-stress system.
Establishes a physically consistent acoustic approximation by explicitly omitting shear strain-rate equations to prevent non-physical shear deformations.
Validates the formulation using rotated staggered-grid finite-difference modeling on VTI layered and Marmousi models, achieving 10^-6 to 10^-7 relative accuracy.
推导了与标准速度-应力系统结构对称的加速度-应变率一阶耦合弹性波方程。
通过显式省略剪切应变率方程，建立了物理自洽的声波近似方程，避免了非物理剪切形变。
利用旋转交错网格有限差分在VTI层状模型和Marmousi模型上进行了验证，相对精度达10^-6至10^-7。
me: First-order acceleration and strain-rate elastodynamic PDE formulation in VTI media
Staggered-grid and rotated staggered-grid finite-difference discretization (4th-order space, 2nd-order time)
Coordinate rotation transformation of the 3D strain-rate tensor onto the local fiber-optic cable tangent
VTI介质中的一阶加速度-应变率弹性动力学偏微分方程构建
交错网格与旋转交错网格有限差分离散（空间四阶、时间二阶精度）
三维应变率张量向光纤局部切向坐标系的旋转变换
de: 2D two-layer VTI model (2 km x 2 km, 5 m grid) with a 20 Hz vertical point source
2D resampled elastic Marmousi model (5 m grid) with a 10 Hz vertical Ricker wavelet source
2D双层VTI模型（2 km × 2 km，5 m网格），采用20 Hz垂直点源激发
2D重采样Marmousi弹性模型（5 m网格），采用10 Hz主频垂直雷克子波激发
li: Numerical demonstrations are restricted to 2D synthetic geometries without gauge-length averaging or field DAS data.
Naive acoustic reduction by only setting S-wave velocity to zero still propagates non-physical shear strains unless explicitly removed.
数值算例仅限于二维合成模型，未考虑标距长度平均效应或实际DAS野外观测数据。
仅将横波速度置零的简单声波近似仍会传播非物理剪切应变，必须显式剔除相关方程。

tm.why: The paper develops a governing elastic wave equation in terms of acceleration and strain-rate specifically to simulate Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) recordings without data conversion.
It derives a first-order coupled PDE system for elastic and acoustic wave propagation and solves it using staggered-grid finite-difference methods.

ev.notes: Full 19-page manuscript PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Section 2, Appendix A, and 10 figures across Sections 2 and 3.

sum: Passive acoustic monitoring of whales traditionally requires vocalizations, leaving silent whales undetectable. This study demonstrates that submarine distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) can detect non-vocalizing whales by recording low-frequency (0.008–0.22 Hz) seafloor strain variations induced by translating hydrodynamic pressure and particle velocity fields from water displacement. Using DAS data from a 260 km Arctic telecom cable in Svalbard and AIS ship tracks as proxies, the authors develop a fluid-mechanical model based on Rayleigh cavity collapse to link strain amplitudes, zero-crossing widths, and dominant frequencies to object speed, depth, and length. They prove that hydrodynamic strain signals decay as inverse distance cubed (1/r³), allowing detection of large cruise ships up to 550 m away and silent diving blue whales within ~40 m of the cable. Combining acoustic calls, Scholte waves, and hydrodynamic signatures enables continuous tracking of marine mammals across shallow and deep dives.
传统被动声学监测依赖鲸鱼发声，无法探测静默鲸鱼。本研究利用斯瓦尔巴群岛海底通信光缆的分布式声学传感（DAS）数据，首次通过记录水体排开产生的低频（0.008–0.22 Hz）平移流体动力压力与质点速度场来探测静默蓝鲸。作者以已知AIS轨迹的船只作为校准代理，建立基于Rayleigh空腔坍缩理论的流体……

t: Models low-frequency DAS axial strain from moving ships and whales by superposing incompressible radial velocity fields based on Rayleigh's cavity-collapse formulation and relating dominant frequency, amplitude, and zero-crossing width to object speed, depth, and length.
基于Rayleigh空腔坍缩公式叠加不可压缩径向速度场模拟低频DAS轴向应变，由主频、振幅和过零宽度反演目标速度、深度与…

Submarine DAS strain recordings on a ~260 km buried and unburied telecom cable in Svalbard (8.16 m gauge length, 4.08 m spatial sampling), calibrated with AIS tracks of four vessels and applied to blue whale passages.
斯瓦尔巴群岛260公里海底光缆DAS应变数据（标距8.16米，道间距4.08米），结合4艘船AIS轨迹校准并用于蓝鲸监测…

Hydrodynamic strain signals decay as 1/r³, enabling detection of a 150 m cruise ship up to 550 m away (413 m depth) and 13 silent blue whale signatures within 40 m of the cable swimming at 2.4–5.3 m/s.
流体动力应变按1/r³衰减，可在550米内探测150米长游轮，并在光缆40米范围内探测到13个游速2.4–5.3 m/s…
Detection range is limited to ~30–40 m for blue whales due to 1/r³ decay, and simplified radial symmetry yields occasional unrealistic whale length estimates (<14 m or >30 m).
受1/r³衰减限制蓝鲸探测距离仅30–40米，且球对称简化模型导致部分鲸鱼体长估计失真。

First demonstration of detecting and characterizing silent, non-vocalizing whales using submarine DAS by sensing the translating low-frequency hydrodynamic pressure and velocity field generated by water displacement.
首次利用海底DAS感知水体排开产生的低频平移流体动力压力与速度场，实现对不发声静默鲸鱼的探测与特征反演。

kc: Discovery and physical interpretation of low-frequency (0.008–0.22 Hz) non-dispersive DAS strain signatures caused by translating hydrodynamic pressure fields of moving ships and silent whales.
Formulation of a first-order analytical fluid-flow model based on Rayleigh's cavity collapse theory showing that hydrodynamic strain signals decay as 1/r³.
Methodology to estimate moving object swimming/sailing speed, depth above the fiber, and characteristic length from DAS dominant frequency, amplitude, and spatial zero-crossing width.
Joint tracking of blue whales in Svalbard by combining shallow-water acoustic downsweeps (20–60 Hz), seafloor Scholte waves, and deep-water hydrodynamic pressure field signatures.
发现并解释了由移动船只和静默鲸鱼平移流体动力压力场引起的低频（0.008–0.22 Hz）非频散DAS应变信号。
基于Rayleigh空腔坍缩理论建立了一阶流体流动解析模型，证明流体动力应变信号按距离的立方反比（1/r³）衰减。
提出了利用DAS主频、最大振幅和空间过零点宽度估算移动目标的速度、距光缆深度及特征长度的反演方法。
结合浅水声学降频叫声（20–60 Hz）、海底Scholte波和深水流体动力压力场信号，实现了斯瓦尔巴群岛蓝鲸的联合追踪。
me: Low-frequency DAS preprocessing (conversion to strain, 0.007–0.22 Hz Butterworth bandpass filtering, and median common-mode noise subtraction).
Frequency-wavenumber (f–k) analysis to separate linear translating hydrodynamic pressure fields from dispersive ocean surface gravity waves (OSGW) and Kelvin wakes.
Analytical time-domain hydrodynamic modeling superposing incompressible radial flow fields (Rayleigh formulation) along source trajectories and converting inline particle velocity to axial strain.
Ship-calibrated parameter estimation and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation for object speed (V = 2Lf), depth above fiber, and body length.
低频DAS数据预处理（相位转应变、0.007–0.22 Hz Butterworth带通滤波及中值共模噪声去除）。
频率-波数（f–k）域分析，将线性平移流体动力压力场与频散海面重力波（OSGW）及Kelvin尾流分离。
基于Rayleigh不可压缩径向流公式的时域流体力学解析建模，沿轨迹叠加局部速度场并将轴向质点速度转换为光纤轴向应变。
利用已知船只参数校准并结合蒙特卡洛误差传播，反演目标移动速度（V = 2Lf）、水深及体长。
de: Submarine DAS dataset recorded on two ~260 km telecom cables between Longyearbyen and Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard (2022–2025), using 8.16 m gauge length and 4.08 m channel spacing.
AIS vessel tracking records and DAS recordings of four reference ships of varying lengths (45 m Kvitungen, 64 m Helmer Hanssen, 108 m ODEN, 150 m Le Commandant Charcot) at 70–413 m water depths.
Blue whale dataset from 24 August 2022 in Adventfjorden (~76 m water depth) containing 20–60 Hz vocalization downsweeps, Scholte interface waves, and 13 low-frequency hydrodynamic signatures.
斯瓦尔巴群岛朗伊尔城至新奥尔松两条约260公里海底通信光缆的DAS数据集（2022–2025年），标距8.16米，道间距4.08米。
四艘不同尺寸参考船只（45米Kvitungen、64米Helmer Hanssen、108米ODEN、150米LCC）在70–413米水深处的AIS轨迹与DAS记录。
2022年8月24日Adventfjorden（水深约76米）的蓝鲸数据集，包含20–60 Hz降频叫声、海底Scholte界面波及13个低频流体动力信号。
li: Small detection range due to rapid 1/r³ amplitude decay (~40 m from the fiber for blue whales and ~550 m for a 150 m cruise ship).
No independent visual, satellite, or tag verification was available to directly confirm the silent blue whale tracks and exact individual count.
The simplified spherical radial-flow model ignores directional non-spherical hydrodynamic effects and contraction phases, leading to some unrealistic whale length estimates (<14 m or >30 m).
受1/r³快速衰减限制，探测距离较短（蓝鲸距光缆约40米以内，150米大型游轮约550米以内）。
缺乏独立的目视、卫星或生物标签观测数据来直接验证静默蓝鲸轨迹及确切个体数量。
简化的球对称径向流模型忽略了非球形方向性效应和尾流收缩阶段，导致部分鲸鱼体长估计不够准确（<14米或>30米）。

tm.why: The study uses submarine fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) to record low-frequency strain variations induced by hydrodynamic pressure fields.
The work applies seabed fiber-optic sensing to environmental and marine biological monitoring by detecting and tracking silent blue whales and vessels in the Arctic.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PNAS article PDF analyzed, including equations, figures, Table 1, and methods.

sum: This study investigates embedded periodic signals within otherwise aperiodic abyssal hill bathymetry across paleo-half-spreading rates from 1 to 9 cm/yr. Using an empirical pre-whitening (EPW) spectral analysis method—which masks the central decaying peak of the autocovariance function to isolate periodic components in the coda—the author analyzes 315 archival trackline and multibeam bathymetric profiles from the North and South Atlantic, Pacific-Antarctic Ridge, and East Pacific Rise. Well-resolved periodicities (>3.2 sigma) are detected in most profiles, spanning 0.02 to 5 Myr without clustering at Milankovitch frequencies. Crucially, detected periods negatively correlate with spreading rates up to ~4 cm/yr (r = -0.20, >99.9% confidence) and remain flat at faster rates, mirroring trends in aperiodic abyssal hill parameters and axial valley-to-high transitions. This global synthesis demonstrates that abyssal hill periodicities are autogenic (likely driven by volcanic construction styles) while faulting governs the dominant aperiodic morphology.
本研究利用经验预白化（EPW）谱分析方法，通过掩蔽自协方差函数的中心衰减主峰以提取尾波中的周期成分，分析了大西洋、太平洋-南极洋脊及东太平洋海隆的315条历史测线与多波束水深剖面（古半扩张速率1-9 cm/yr）。结果显示大多数剖面存在显著周期信号（0.02至5 Myr），但未在米兰科维奇周期处聚集……

t: Empirical pre-whitening (EPW) masks the central decaying peak of the bathymetric autocovariance function and transforms the remaining coda via FFT, normalized by von Kármán model confidence levels, to detect discrete spectral peaks above 3.2 sigma.
利用经验预白化掩蔽水深自协方差中心衰减峰，对尾波做FFT并用von Kármán模型归一化以检测>3.2σ谱峰。

Archival MGD77 trackline and multibeam bathymetric profiles converted to crustal age: 177 North Atlantic, 88 South Atlantic, 42 Pacific-Antarctic Ridge, and 8 Northern East Pacific Rise segments, plus 12 Southern East Pacific Rise profiles.
转换为年龄的MGD77测线与多波束剖面：北大西洋177条、南大西洋88条、PAR 42条、NEPR 8条及SEPR 12…

Periodicities occur in 66% of Atlantic profiles (median 0.72 Myr in NATL, 0.36 Myr in SATL) and negatively correlate with half-spreading rates up to 3.3-4 cm/yr (r = -0.20, >99.9% confidence), remaining flat (~0.04-0.06 Myr) at higher rates.
66%大西洋剖面存在周期性，在半扩张速率<4 cm/yr时与速率显著负相关（r=-0.20），更高速率下趋于平缓。
Periodicity uncertainties (estimated at 10%-30%, increasing at older crustal ages) cannot be formally quantified due to unquantifiable uncertainties in plate reconstruction age models.
受板块重建模型不确定性限制，周期测量误差（约10%-30%）无法严格定量。

First global analysis of abyssal hill periodicities across slow-to-superfast spreading rates (1-9 cm/yr) using normalized empirical pre-whitening, discovering a negative spreading-rate dependence below 4 cm/yr that supports intrinsic volcanic origin.
首次在全球1-9 cm/yr扩张速率范围应用归一化EPW，发现慢-中速扩张下的周期-速率负相关及内源火山成因。

kc: Applied normalized empirical pre-whitening (EPW) to 315 bathymetric profiles spanning paleo-half-spreading rates of 1 to 9 cm/yr.
Demonstrated that embedded abyssal hill periodicities are ubiquitous (66%-88% of profiles) but widely scattered (0.02 to 5 Myr) without clustering at Milankovitch cycles.
Discovered a statistically significant negative correlation between periodicity and half-spreading rate up to ~4 cm/yr, transitioning to a flat trend at faster rates.
Proposed a dual-process hypothesis where intrinsic volcanic construction drives periodic signals while tectonic faulting controls aperiodic morphology.
将归一化经验预白化（EPW）方法应用于古半扩张速率在1至9 cm/yr之间的315条水深剖面。
证明深海丘陵内嵌周期信号普遍存在（占剖面的66%-88%），但分布极其分散（0.02至5 Myr），未在米兰科维奇周期处聚集。
发现在半扩张速率低于~4 cm/yr时周期与扩张速率呈显著负相关，而在更快扩张速率下趋势平缓。
提出双过程假说：内源火山建造控制周期性信号，而构造断层作用控制非周期性地形。
me: Converted bathymetric profiles from geographic coordinates to crustal age and depth using the Müller et al. (2016) global age grid, followed by linear resampling and 6th-order polynomial detrending.
Applied empirical pre-whitening (EPW) by masking the decaying central peak of the profile autocovariance function and applying FFT to the remaining coda.
Fitted a 3-parameter von Kármán statistical model to the autocovariance via weighted least-squares inversion to establish frequency-dependent standard deviation (sigma) confidence thresholds.
Normalized the EPW spectrum by dividing by sigma(f) and identified robust periodicities using a 3.2-sigma minimum threshold and an RMS amplitude ratio criterion (R >= 0.1).
利用Müller等（2016）全球地壳年龄网格将水深剖面转换为年龄-深度序列，并进行线性重采样和六阶多项式去趋势。
采用经验预白化（EPW）技术，掩蔽自协方差函数的中心衰减峰，对剩余尾波进行快速傅里叶变换（FFT）。
通过加权最小二乘反演将三参数von Kármán统计模型拟合至自协方差函数，以建立频率相关的标准差（sigma）置信度阈值。
用sigma(f)对EPW谱进行归一化，并以3.2 sigma及均方根振幅比（R >= 0.1）作为判据识别显著周期成分。
de: 177 North Atlantic (NATL) and 88 South Atlantic (SATL) flowline-oriented bathymetric profiles (~10-30 Myr length) from MGD77 tracklines and multibeam grids.

42 multibeam profiles from the Pacific-Antarctic Ridge (PAR, ~3.5-11 Myr length) and 8 from the Northern East Pacific Rise (NEPR, ~2.5-4.5 Myr length), combined with 12 Southern East Pacific Rise (SEPR) profiles.
来自MGD77测线和多波束网格的177条北大西洋（NATL）和88条南大西洋（SATL）平行流线方向水深剖面（长约10-30 Myr）。
来自太平洋-南极洋脊（PAR，长约3.5-11 Myr）的42条多波束剖面、北东太平洋海隆（NEPR，长约2.5-4.5 Myr）的8条剖面，以及结合前人研究的12条南东太平洋海隆（SEPR）剖面。
li: Uncertainties in plate reconstruction age models (estimated at 10%-30%, increasing with crustal age) cannot be formally quantified.
Strong intrinsic scatter in detected periodicities obscures geographical patterns and yields a modest correlation coefficient (r = -0.20).
板块重建年龄模型的不确定性（估计为10%-30%，随地壳年龄增加）无法进行严格的形式化定量。
检测到的周期信号存在强烈内源离散性，掩盖了地理空间分布模式，导致相关系数绝对值较低（r = -0.20）。

tm.why: The study investigates the tectonic and volcanic processes governing mid-ocean ridge crustal accretion and abyssal hill morphology across global spreading rates.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations, and all 4 main figures.

sum: Coexisting fundamental and higher modes in seismic data complicate dispersion curve picking in Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) and two-station surface-wave methods. This paper introduces a dispersion-guided, physics-aware unsupervised deep-learning framework that acts as a deep inverse operator to separate surface-wave modes directly in the time-space domain. Using a two-head U-Net architecture, the method applies a differentiable phase-shift transform to map predictions into the frequency-phase-velocity (f-v) domain. An adaptive Gaussian mask centered on the picked fundamental-mode dispersion curve enforces physical constraints in the loss function by maximizing in-mask energy preservation and suppressing out-of-mask leakage. Evaluated on finite-difference synthetic data and hammer-source field data from Sweden's Alum Shale Formation, the approach cleanly separates fundamental and higher modes within ~30 seconds per gather without labeled training data, significantly improving two-station dispersion spectra coherence and providing mask-perturbation uncertainty estimates.
针对面波多道分析（MASW）和双台法中基阶与高阶模态混叠导致频散曲线拾取困难的问题，本文提出一种频散引导的物理感知无监督深度学习面波模态分离框架。该方法采用双头U-Net作为深度反演算子，在时空域直接分离基阶和高阶面波。通过在频率-相速度（f-v）域构建自适应高斯掩码，将物理约束嵌入损失函数，最大化……

t: A two-head U-Net trained unsupervisedly separates fundamental and higher surface-wave modes in the space-time domain by optimizing a physics-aware loss using differentiable f-v transforms and an adaptive Gaussian mask.
通过结合可微f-v变换与自适应高斯掩码的物理感知损失，无监督训练双头U-Net在时空域分离基阶和高阶面波。
Tested on 2D elastic finite-difference synthetic gathers (18 and 25 Hz) and an August 2025 hammer-source field dataset from Sweden's Alum Shale Formation using 98 nodal receivers and 317 shots.
采用18和25 Hz二维弹性有限差分合成数据，以及瑞典明矾页岩组98个节点检波器和317炮的锤击实测数据。

Optimizing for 2,000 epochs (~30 s on an RTX 4090 GPU) cleanly isolates fundamental-mode dispersion ridges, unmasks weaker higher-mode branches, and improves two-station dispersion spectrum continuity.
在RTX 4090上迭代2000轮（约30秒）即可清晰分离基阶频散脊并凸显高阶能量，显著改善双台频散谱连续性。
Automatic dispersion curve picking fails when modes overlap in the same frequency band, necessitating manual picks and parameter tuning for field data.
同频带模态重叠时自动频散拾取易失效，实测数据需人工拾取并微调掩码宽度等参数。
Formulates surface-wave mode separation as a purely unsupervised deep inverse operator driven by f-v domain adaptive Gaussian mask constraints, eliminating labeled data requirements.
将面波模态分离构建为纯无监督f-v域物理约束驱动的深度反演算子，无需任何标签训练数据。

kc: Developed an unsupervised two-head U-Net acting as a deep inverse operator to separate fundamental and higher surface-wave modes in the space-time domain without labeled data.
Formulated a physics-aware loss function in the f-v domain using a differentiable phase-shift transform and an adaptive Gaussian mask to enforce modal energy concentration and mixture consistency.
Demonstrated improved coherence of two-station phase-velocity dispersion spectra and introduced mask-perturbation uncertainty quantification on synthetic and Swedish Alum Shale field datasets.
开发了一种无监督双头U-Net深度反演算子，无需标签数据即可在时空域分离基阶和高阶面波模态。
利用可微相移变换和自适应高斯掩码在f-v域构建了物理感知损失函数，强制实现模态能量集中与混合一致性。
在合成数据和瑞典明矾页岩实测数据上验证了双台法频散谱相干性的提升，并引入了掩码扰动不确定性量化。
me: Two-head U-Net encoder-decoder architecture with sigmoid-based mixture consistency guaranteeing that separated fundamental and residual modes sum to the input gather.
Differentiable phase-shift f-v transform and adaptive Gaussian masking centered on fundamental-mode dispersion curves.
Multi-term unsupervised physics-aware loss combining time-domain reconstruction, residual in-mask suppression, fundamental in-mask preservation, and out-of-mask/broadband stop-band suppression.
Mask-perturbation uncertainty quantification to evaluate waveform and dispersion sensitivity to the assumed Gaussian mask.
采用具有Sigmoid混合一致性约束的双头U-Net编码器-解码器架构，确保分离出的基阶与残差模态之和等于输入道集。
应用可微相移f-v变换以及以基阶频散曲线为中心的自适应高斯掩码。
结合时域重构、残差掩码内抑制、基阶掩码内保持以及掩码外/宽带阻带抑制的多项无监督物理感知损失函数。
采用掩码扰动不确定性量化方法，评估分离波形和频散图像对假定高斯掩码的敏感性。
de: 2D isotropic elastic finite-difference synthetic shot gathers (18 Hz and 25 Hz Ricker wavelets, 8 surface sources) on a 1D layered model validated against Haskell-Thomson theoretical dispersion curves.

Active-source hammer seismic field survey from the Alum Shale Formation near Norråker, central Sweden (August 2025), consisting of 98 3-component nodal receivers (10 m spacing) and 317 shot points (3.33 m spacing).
Two-station dispersion spectrum comparisons on selected field receiver pairs (S10-S38 and S20-S58) before and after mode separation.
基于一维层状模型的二维各向同性弹性有限差分合成炮集（18 Hz和25 Hz雷克子波，8个地表震源），并与Haskell-Thomson理论频散曲线进行验证。
2025年8月在瑞典中部Norråker附近明矾页岩组采集的锤击主动源地震实测数据，包含98个三分量节点检波器（间距10 m）和317个炮点（间距3.33 m）。
模态分离前后实测数据选定双台检波器对（S10-S38和S20-S58）的双台频散谱对比实验。
li: Automatic dispersion-curve maxima picking can fail when modal components overlap in the same frequency range, requiring manual dispersion curve picking for complex field data.
Hyperparameters such as Gaussian mask width, cutoff frequency bands, and loss weights require manual tuning according to the input dispersion energy distribution.
当不同模态在同一频率范围内重叠时，自动频散曲线极大值拾取可能失效，复杂实测数据仍需人工拾取频散曲线。
高斯掩码宽度、截止频带和损失权重等超参数需要根据输入频散能量分布进行人工微调。

tm.why: The paper proposes a physics-aware unsupervised deep-learning framework using a two-head U-Net to separate surface-wave modes.
The method separates fundamental and higher surface-wave modes to improve dispersion curve picking for MASW and two-station surface-wave tomography.
The neural network is formulated as an unsupervised deep inverse operator guided by frequency-phase-velocity domain physical constraints.

ev.notes: Full 15-page preprint PDF including theory, equations, hyperparameter table, synthetic finite-difference tests, Swedish Alum Shale field applications, two-station dispersion comparisons, and uncertainty quantification was analyzed.

sum: This Nature Geoscience Q&A features insights from Ana Ferreira, Valerie Finlayson, and Jennifer Georgen on volcanism within oceanic tectonic plates. It specifically explores the geodynamic, geochemical, and geophysical factors behind the extreme intensity of intraplate volcanic activity during the Cretaceous period, synthesizing current understanding and outstanding questions in mantle plume dynamics and lithospheric interactions.
这篇《自然-地球科学》访谈记录了与Ana Ferreira、Valerie Finlayson和Jennifer Georgen的对话，探讨了洋内板块内部的火山作用。文章重点讨论了白垩纪时期板块内火山活动异常剧烈的地球动力学、地球化学和地球物理学机制，总结了目前对地幔柱动力学与岩石圈相互作用的认识及……

t: Expert Q&A and interdisciplinary synthesis of geophysical, geochemical, and geodynamic perspectives on oceanic intraplate volcanism.
通过专家问答形式，对洋内板块火山作用的地球物理、地球化学和地球动力学观点进行多学科综合。
Synthesized literature data and observations regarding Cretaceous oceanic plateaus, seamount chains, and mantle plume dynamics.
综合了关于白垩纪洋底高原、海山链及地幔柱动力学的文献数据与观测资料。
Provides a comprehensive overview of the theories explaining the extreme intensity of Cretaceous intraplate magmatism and lithospheric interactions.
全面概述了阐释白垩纪板内岩浆活动极端强度及岩石圈相互作用的理论假说。
Does not present new primary datasets, numerical simulations, or quantitative inversions.
未提出新的原始数据集、数值模拟或定量反演。
Brings together leading geophysical and geochemical experts to address the long-standing enigma of Cretaceous super-plumes and intraplate volcanism.
汇集了地球物理与地球化学领域的顶尖专家，共同探讨白垩纪超级地幔柱与板内火山作用的长期谜题。

The paper directly addresses the intensity and processes of volcanism within oceanic tectonic plates.

sum: This study investigates the source process of the April 20, 2026, Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate earthquake in northeastern Japan using a joint inversion of strong-motion and geodetic data. The estimated slip distribution reveals large slips at depths of 20–35 km, overlapping with the rupture areas of the 1960, 1989, and 2011 off-Iwate events. This indicates the repeated rupture of a common interplate asperity. The study suggests that postseismic deformation from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake accelerated stress accumulation on this recurrent asperity, shortening its recurrence interval and enhancing coseismic slip in 2026.
本研究通过强震动和大地测量数据的联合反演，分析了2026年4月20日日本东北岩手县外海Mw 7.5地震的震源过程。结果显示，在震中下倾方向20-35公里深度存在大滑移区，该破裂区与1960年、1989年和2011年岩手外海地震的破裂区高度重合，表明同一板块间凹凸体发生了重复破裂。研究表明，2011年……

t: Joint inversion of strong-motion and geodetic data to estimate the spatial and temporal slip distribution on the fault plane.
联合反演强震动和大地测量数据，以估算断层面上的空间和时间滑移分布。
Strong-motion waveforms and geodetic data from the April 20, 2026, Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate Prefecture earthquake.
2026年4月20日岩手县外海Mw 7.5地震的强震动波形和大地测量数据。
Large slips were identified at depths of 20–35 km, overlapping with the 1960, 1989, and 2011 rupture zones.
在20-35公里深度发现大滑移区，与1960、1989和2011年的破裂区重合。
The analysis relies on the simplified assumption of a planar fault geometry and standard 1D velocity structures for green's functions.
分析依赖于简化的平直断层几何假设以及用于格林函数的标准一维速度结构。
Demonstrates that postseismic deformation from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake accelerated the recurrence of a M7-class interplate asperity.
证实了2011年东北大地震的震后变形加速了板块间M7级重复凹凸体的复发。

kc: Determined the source process of the 2026 Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate earthquake using joint inversion of strong-motion and geodetic data.
Identified that the 2026 rupture area overlaps with the 1960, 1989, and 2011 events, confirming it as a recurrent interplate asperity.
Proposed that postseismic deformation from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake accelerated stress accumulation and shortened the recurrence interval of this asperity.
利用强震和大地测量数据联合反演，确定了2026年岩手县外海Mw 7.5地震的震源破裂过程。
识别出2026年的破裂区与1960年、1989年和2011年地震重合，证实其为重复发生破裂的板块间凹凸体。
提出2011年东北大地震后的余震后变形加速了该凹凸体的应力积累并缩短了其复发周期。
me: Joint inversion of strong-motion waveforms and geodetic (GNSS) data to estimate slip distribution.
联合反演强震动波形和大地测量（GNSS）数据以估算滑移量分布。
de: Strong-motion seismograms and geodetic data recording the 2026 Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate earthquake.
Historical seismic catalog data from the 1960, 1989, and 2011 off-Iwate events.
记录2026年岩手县外海Mw 7.5地震的强震动波形和大地测量数据。
1960年、1989年和2011年岩手外海地震的历史地震目录数据。
li: The resolution of slip distribution at deeper or shallower extensions may be limited by station coverage.
由于台站覆盖范围的限制，更深或更浅延伸处的滑移分布分辨率可能有限。

tm.why: The paper estimates the source process and fault rupture characteristics of the 2026 Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate earthquake.
It discusses stress accumulation and postseismic deformation following the 2011 Tohoku earthquake on a recurrent interplate asperity.

sum: This paper investigates the competition between atmospheric escape and replenishment via outgassing during the magma ocean crystallization phase of young rocky exoplanets. The authors extend a coupled interior-atmosphere model by incorporating an energy-limited atmospheric escape module, comparing radiative-convective and prescribed-convective atmospheres. They find that atmospheric escape shortens magma ocean lifetimes by weakening greenhouse insulation. Additionally, volatile dissolution into the magma ocean interacts with escape to chemically fractionate the planetary volatile budget over time, retaining more soluble species. The mantle redox state remains a primary control on the retained atmospheric composition, with high oxygen fugacity yielding H2O- and CO2-rich atmospheres, and low oxygen fugacity producing H2- or CO-dominated atmospheres.
本文研究了年轻岩石外行星岩浆洋结晶过程中，大气逃逸与排气补给之间的竞争机制。作者通过引入能量限制的大气逃逸模块，扩展了耦合的内部-大气模型，并对比了辐射-对流和规定对流大气。研究表明，大气逃逸通过减弱温室保温效应缩短了岩浆洋的寿命。此外，挥发分在岩浆洋中的溶解与逃逸相互作用，通过保留更易溶的组分，随……

t: Coupled interior-atmosphere numerical modeling incorporating an energy-limited atmospheric escape module to simulate magma ocean crystallization and atmospheric replenishment.
耦合内部-大气的数值模拟，并结合能量限制的大气逃逸模块，模拟岩浆洋结晶与大气补给。
Synthetic parameter sweeps exploring orbital separations, escape efficiencies, mantle oxidation states, and initial volatile inventories for Earth-mass planets.
针对地球质量行星，对轨道距离、逃逸效率、地幔氧化态和初始挥发分进行合成参数扫描。
Atmospheric escape shortens magma ocean lifetimes by weakening greenhouse insulation, and volatile dissolution chemically fractionates the planetary volatile budget over time.
大气逃逸通过减弱温室保温缩短了岩浆洋寿命，且挥发分溶解随时间对行星挥发分进行化学分馏。
The model relies on simplified energy-limited escape parameterizations and convective approximations for atmospheric energy transport.
模型依赖于简化的能量限制逃逸参数化以及大气能量传输的对流近似。
First coupling of energy-limited escape with magma ocean outgassing and dissolution to track chemical fractionation of volatiles during planetary solidification.
首次将能量限制逃逸与岩浆洋排气及溶解耦合，追踪行星固化过程中挥发分的化学分馏。

kc: Developed an extended coupled interior-atmosphere model incorporating an energy-limited atmospheric escape module for magma ocean planets.
Demonstrated that atmospheric escape shortens magma ocean lifetimes by reducing greenhouse insulation.
Quantified how volatile dissolution and escape interact to chemically fractionate planetary volatile budgets over time.
开发了一个扩展的耦合内部-大气模型，首次为岩浆洋行星引入了能量限制的大气逃逸模块。
证明了大气逃逸通过减弱温室保温效应，缩短了岩浆洋的维持寿命。
定量分析了挥发分溶解与逃逸的相互作用如何随时间对行星挥发分总量进行化学分馏。
me: Coupled interior-atmosphere numerical modeling.
Energy-limited atmospheric escape parameterization.
Radiative-convective equilibrium atmospheric modeling.
耦合内部-大气数值模拟。
能量限制的大气逃逸参数化方法。
辐射-对流平衡大气模型。

Comparative analysis of radiative-convective versus purely convective atmospheric structures.
数值模拟实验，探索了广泛的轨道距离、逃逸效率、地幔氧化状态和初始挥发分储量。
辐射-对流与纯对流大气结构的对比分析。

sum: This study introduces the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) to explain far-field earthquake triggering across different spatial and temporal scales. It categorizes remote triggering into three distinct mechanisms: Antipodal Resonance (~20,000 km, days to months, driven by PKP-wave focusing and free oscillations); Plate-Margin Symmetric-End Stress Transfer (>1,000 km, 1–3 years, mediated by slow slip events and relay transfer); and Conventional Plate-Margin Compressional Transfer. By establishing these frameworks, the paper challenges traditional views that confine significant triggering to the near field, offering a new spatiotemporal correlation test for cross-scale remote triggering.
本研究提出了“三部式时空触发假说”（TSTH），用以解释不同空间和时间尺度上的远场地震触发。该假说将远程触发分为三种机制：①对跖共振（约20,000公里，数天至数月，由PKP波焦散聚焦和自由振荡介导）；②板块边缘对称端应力传递（>1,000公里，1-3年，由慢滑移和中继传递介导）；③常规板块边缘挤压……

t: Proposes the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) to classify and test remote earthquake triggering mechanisms across different spatial and temporal scales.
提出三部式时空触发假说（TSTH），对不同时空尺度下的远程地震触发机制进行分类和检验。
Uses global earthquake catalog data to perform spatiotemporal correlation tests of remote triggering.
利用全球地震目录数据对远程触发进行时空相关性检验。
Defines three remote triggering mechanisms: Antipodal Resonance (~20,000 km), Plate-Margin Symmetric-End Stress Transfer (>1,000 km), and Conventional Plate-Margin Compressional Transfer.
定义了三种远程触发机制：对跖共振（~2万公里）、板块边缘对称端应力传递（>1千公里）和常规挤压传递。
The statistical correlation of remote triggering over long time lags (years) is difficult to distinguish from background seismicity rates.
长达数年的远程触发在统计相关性上较难与背景地震活动率完全区分。
Introduces a cross-scale framework linking antipodal PKP-wave focusing, free oscillations, and slow slip events to remote earthquake triggering.
引入了将对跖PKP波聚焦、自由振荡和慢滑移事件与远程地震触发相联系的跨尺度框架。

kc: Proposed the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) for remote earthquake triggering.
Classified far-field triggering into three distinct physical mechanisms based on spatial scale and time lag.
Introduced the concepts of antipodal resonance via PKP-wave focusing and plate-margin symmetric-end stress transfer.
提出了用于远程地震触发的“三部式时空触发假说”（TSTH）。
根据空间尺度和时间滞后将远场触发划分为三种不同的物理机制。
引入了通过PKP波聚焦引起的对跖共振以及板块边缘对称端应力传递的概念。
me: Spatiotemporal correlation testing of global earthquake catalogs.
Theoretical modeling of PKP-wave caustic focusing and Earth's free oscillations.
Analysis of slow slip events and plate-margin relay transfer mechanisms.
全球地震目录的时空相关性检验。
PKP波焦散聚焦和地球自由振荡的理论建模。
慢滑移事件和板块边缘中继传递机制的分析。
de: Analysis of global historical earthquake catalogs to test the spatiotemporal correlation of remote triggering.
分析全球历史地震目录，以检验远程触发的时空相关性。
li: The hypothesis relies on statistical correlations that require further physical validation and high-resolution seismic observations.
该假说依赖于统计相关性，需要进一步的物理验证和高分辨率地震观测支持。

tm.why: The paper proposes and tests a hypothesis for cross-scale remote earthquake triggering mechanisms over various spatial and temporal scales.
It incorporates slow slip events and plate-margin relay transfer as mechanisms for long-term stress transfer and remote triggering.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive.

sum: This study performs linear system identification (SID) of the iconic UC San Diego Geisel Library using 30-channel acceleration records from six low-intensity earthquakes (PGA < 1.47%g). Five state-of-the-art SID methods—two input-output (DSI, OKID-ERA) and three output-only (SSI-cov, SSI-data, MNExT-ERA)—were employed to cross-validate results, evaluate 3-DOF versus 6-DOF rigid-base excitations, and assess soil-structure interaction (SSI). Thirteen vibration modes were identified across all methods and events. Comparisons with a prior 486-day ambient vibration study show slight decreases in natural frequencies and increases in damping ratios during earthquakes due to micro-crack activation and amplitude dependence, with no significant SSI effects. Excluding inferred rotational base inputs reduced mean response prediction RRMS errors from 79.06% to 61.20% due to rank-deficient rotational estimation errors. Finally, an uncalibrated 3D OpenSees finite element model sensitivity analysis showed concrete Young's modulus and nonstructural stiffness dominate model discrepancies.
本研究利用6次低强度地震（PGA<1.47%g）的30通道加速度记录，对加州大学圣地亚哥分校Geisel图书馆进行了线性系统识别（SID）。采用2种输入-输出法（DSI、OKID-ERA）和3种仅输出法（SSI-cov、SSI-data、MNExT-ERA）交叉验证，评估了3自由度与6自由度刚性基底……

t: Five state-space system identification methods—two input-output (DSI, OKID-ERA) and three output-only (SSI-cov, SSI-data, MNExT-ERA)—were applied with stabilization diagrams up to model order 80 to extract modal frequencies, damping ratios, and complex mode shapes.
应用2种输入-输出和3种仅输出状态空间系统识别方法及稳定图技术提取结构模态参数。

Thirty-channel acceleration data sampled at 200 Hz from ten Kinemetrics Etna2 tri-axial accelerometers in the 8-story UCSD Geisel Library recorded during six low-intensity earthquakes (M4.2–M5.3) between June 2021 and January 2024.
Geisel图书馆10台三分量加速度计在2021至2024年记录的6次弱震（M4.2–5.3）30通道200Hz数据。

Thirteen vibration modes were identified; natural frequencies agreed closely across methods (mean c.o.v. 1.25%), whereas damping ratios varied widely (mean c.o.v. 58.1%). Excluding noisy rotational base inputs reduced mean prediction RRMS error from 79.06% to 61.20%.
识别出13个模态，频率变异系数均值1.25%；剔除旋转输入使响应预测误差从79.06%降至61.20%。

The 6x6 transformation matrix linking two first-floor accelerometers to 6-DOF rigid-base motion is rank-one deficient, introducing estimation errors in rotational input components and limiting 6-DOF prediction accuracy.
仅由两个基底传感器构成的6×6转换矩阵秩一亏损，导致基底旋转激励估计存在误差。

Comprehensive cross-validation of five input-output and output-only SID methods on a complex landmark building under multiple earthquakes, quantifying rotational base input effects, amplitude dependence vs ambient noise, and FE model sensitivities.
在复杂地标建筑上交叉验证5种识别方法，量化基底旋转输入、幅值效应及有限元参数敏感性。

kc: Identified 13 vibration modes of the complex Brutalist UCSD Geisel Library across six low-intensity earthquakes using five input-output and output-only state-space SID methods.
Demonstrated slight natural frequency reduction and damping ratio increase from ambient vibration to low-intensity seismic excitation, with negligible soil-structure interaction.

Evaluated 6-DOF versus 3-DOF rigid-base seismic input, showing that rank-one deficiency in two-station base estimation introduces rotational errors that increase forward prediction RRMS error from 61.20% to 79.06%.

Developed a detailed 158,646-DOF OpenSees-STKO finite element model and quantified parameter sensitivities (concrete modulus, reinforcement, nonstructural components, live loads) as a baseline for Bayesian updating.
利用5种输入-输出和仅输出状态空间系统识别方法，从6次弱震数据中识别出复杂建筑UCSD Geisel图书馆的13个振动模态。
证实了从环境振动到弱震激励下自振频率轻微降低、阻尼比增大，且土-结相互作用（SSI）可忽略不计。
对比了6自由度与3自由度刚性基底输入，发现双台站基底估计的秩一亏损会引入旋转分量误差，使正演预测平均RRMS误差从61.20%升至79.06%。
建立了包含158,646个自由度的OpenSees-STKO详细有限元模型，量化了混凝土模量、钢筋、非结构构件和活载的敏感性，为贝叶斯模型修正提供基准。
me: Deterministic-Stochastic Subspace Identification (DSI) and Observer/Kalman Filter Identification with Eigensystem Realization Algorithm (OKID-ERA) for input-output state-space modeling.
Covariance-Driven SSI (SSI-cov), Data-Driven SSI (SSI-data), and Multi-Reference Natural Excitation Technique with ERA (MNExT-ERA) for output-only modal identification.
Least-squares pseudo-inverse estimation of 6-DOF (3 translational, 3 rotational) rigid-base motion from two tri-axial base accelerometers.
3D linear finite element modeling in OpenSees-STKO with 24,497 beam-column and 75,731 shell elements and parameter sensitivity analysis.
采用确定性-随机子空间识别（DSI）和观测器/卡尔曼滤波结合特征系统实现算法（OKID-ERA）进行输入-输出状态空间建模。
采用协方差驱动子空间识别（SSI-cov）、数据驱动子空间识别（SSI-data）和多参考自然激励技术结合ERA（MNExT-ERA）进行仅输出模态识别。
利用基底两个三分量加速度计，通过最小二乘伪逆估计6自由度（3平动、3转动）刚性基底地震输入。
在OpenSees-STKO中建立包含24,497个梁柱单元和75,731个壳单元的三维线性有限元模型并进行参数敏感性分析。
de: 30-channel acceleration records (200 Hz sampling rate, PTP synchronized) from 10 Kinemetrics Etna2 tri-axial accelerometers deployed across five levels of the 8-story Geisel Library.
Six low-intensity Southern California/Baja California earthquakes between June 2021 and January 2024 (M4.2 to M5.3, epicentral distances 63.5–165.3 km, base PGA 0.03%g–1.47%g).
Comparison against a previously published 486-day ambient vibration dataset and rooftop Vaisala WXT536 meteorological records.
部署在8层Geisel图书馆5个不同高度的10台Kinemetrics Etna2三分量加速度计记录的30通道加速度数据（200 Hz采样，PTP亚微秒同步）。
2021年6月至2024年1月期间记录的6次南加州/下加利福尼亚弱震事件（震级M4.2–5.3，震中距63.5–165.3 km，基底PGA为0.03%g–1.47%g）。
与前期发表的486天环境振动数据集以及屋顶Vaisala WXT536气象站记录进行对比。
li: Rank-one deficiency in the 6x6 geometric transformation matrix from only two first-floor tri-axial accelerometers causes non-unique estimation errors in rotational base excitations.
Spatial sparsity of the sensor array (24 response DOFs above the first floor) causes projection-induced spurious cross-correlations (MAC 0.4–0.5) between some distinct 3D modes.
High variability in identified modal damping ratios (c.o.v. averaging 58.1%, including one nonphysical negative damping estimate) due to low SNR and linear viscous damping model-form errors.
仅由首层两个三分量加速度计构成的6×6几何转换矩阵存在秩一亏损，导致基底旋转激励分量的非唯一估计误差。
传感器阵列空间稀疏（首层以上仅24个响应自由度）导致部分不同三维模态之间出现投影诱导的虚假互相关（MAC达0.4–0.5）。
受低信噪比及线性粘滞阻尼模型形式误差影响，识别出的模态阻尼比变异性很大（变异系数平均58.1%，且出现一次非物理负阻尼）。

tm.why: The study analyzes the structural dynamic response and modal properties of a complex building under six recorded earthquake excitations and compares them with ambient vibrations and finite element modeling.
The study relies on a high-precision building array of ten tri-axial force-balance accelerometers synchronized with sub-microsecond accuracy via GPS/GNSS-disciplined PTP.

The paper applies output-only system identification methods including cross-correlation-based natural excitation techniques (MNExT-ERA) and compares earthquake-derived modes against ambient vibration baselines.

ev.notes: Full 28-page PDF (including Appendices A, B, and C) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: Friction-induced thermal pressurization is a key earthquake fault-weakening mechanism, yet the resulting internal slip-zone microstructures remain poorly understood. This study examines the 5–25 mm thick principal slip zone of a major thrust in the Hota Group (Boso accretionary wedge, Japan), which experienced coseismic thermal pressurization without frictional melting. Using optical/scanning electron microscopy, particle size/shape analysis, and wavelength-dispersive X-ray spectrometry, the authors identify 20 sharp-bounded microlayers classified into planar-laminated, turbulent-flow-like, breccia, and massive layers. Planar-laminated layers exhibit particle size, circularity, and chemical variations indicative of shear-induced granular segregation, whereas turbulent-flow-like layers display vortical structures formed by subsequent fluidization. Modeling the turbulent-flow-like layers via 2D Couette–Poiseuille hydrodynamics yields an ultralow coseismic viscosity of 1.2 × 10^-4 to 2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s (comparable to liquid water). This ultralow-viscosity fluidized flow acts as an intense lubricant, enabling large shallow coseismic slip and tsunami generation.
本研究针对日本房总增生楔保田群古俯冲主逆冲断层的主滑移带开展显微构造、颗粒粒度与圆度统计及X射线波谱元素面扫描分析。研究识别出20个具清晰边界的微层，分为平行纹层、类湍流层、角砾层和块状层。平行纹层记录了流化颗粒流中的颗粒分选，而类湍流层中的涡旋构造源于进一步流化变形。基于二维Couette–Poi……

t: Combined optical/SEM microscopy, ImageJ particle size/circularity analysis, and WDS elemental mapping with 2D Couette–Poiseuille hydrodynamic modeling using a critical Reynolds number (Re = 1400) to estimate coseismic fluidized fault gouge viscosity.
结合显微观测、粒度圆度统计、元素面扫描与二维Couette–Poiseuille流体动力学模型估算粘度。
Thin sections of fault rock from a 5–25 mm thick principal slip zone in a major thrust of the Hota Group (Emi Group), Boso accretionary wedge, Japan, buried at 1–4 km depth.
日本房总增生楔保田群主逆冲断层5–25 mm厚黑色主滑移带薄片样品（埋深1–4 km）。

Identified 20 microlayers showing particle segregation and vortical flow structures (68–233 µm thick); hydrodynamic modeling yields an ultralow coseismic viscosity of 1.2 × 10^-4 to 2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s for slip velocities of 1.0–6.0 m/s.
识别出20个微层及68–233 µm厚涡旋构造，算得同震流化粘度低至1.2×10^-4至2.3×10^-3 Pa s。
The viscosity estimate relies heuristically on a critical Reynolds number (Re = 1400) for pure water, and multiple layers might form within a single long-slip event.
临界雷诺数（1400）基于纯水启发式假设，且多层构造或可在单次长滑移事件中形成。
First quantitative estimation of ultralow dynamic viscosity in natural turbulent-flow-like fault gouge layers induced by coseismic thermal pressurization in a shallow subduction thrust.
首次定量估算天然浅部俯冲逆冲断层中由热增压诱发的类湍流断层泥超低同震粘度。

kc: Identified a 20-layer microstructure within a shallow subduction-related principal slip zone, categorized into planar-laminated, turbulent-flow-like, breccia, and massive layers.
Demonstrated that planar-laminated sublayers formed via particle segregation (by size, circularity, and density/mineralogy) during fluidized granular flow.
Estimated an ultralow coseismic dynamic viscosity of 1.2 × 10^-4 to 2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s for turbulent-flow-like fault gouge using a Couette–Poiseuille hydrodynamic model.
在浅部俯冲相关主滑移带中识别出20层显微构造，划分为平行纹层、类湍流层、角砾层和块状层。
证实平行纹层亚层是由流化颗粒流过程中的颗粒粒度、圆度及密度/矿物成分分选形成的。
利用Couette–Poiseuille流体动力学模型，估算类湍流断层泥的同震动态粘度低至1.2 × 10^-4至2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s。
me: Polarized optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) of thin sections cut perpendicular to the fault plane and parallel to slip.
ImageJ-based particle size (equivalent circular diameter, span) and circularity analysis across 18 sublayers of a planar-laminated layer.
Wavelength-dispersive X-ray spectrometry (WDS) elemental mapping of eight major elements (Si, Na, Al, Mg, K, Fe, Ca, Ti).
Two-dimensional Couette–Poiseuille hydrodynamic modeling using Reynolds number transition criteria (Re = 1400) and observed vortex thicknesses.
对垂直断层面且平行滑动方向的薄片进行偏光光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观测。
基于ImageJ软件对平行纹层的18个亚层进行颗粒粒径（等效圆直径、跨度）和圆度统计分析。
利用波长色散X射线光谱仪（WDS）对8种主量元素（Si、Na、Al、Mg、K、Fe、Ca、Ti）进行元素面扫描。
结合雷诺数层流-湍流转变准则（Re = 1400）和观测到的涡旋厚度，开展二维Couette–Poiseuille流体动力学建模。
de: Fault rock specimens from a 5–25 mm thick glossy black principal slip zone in the Hota Group (Emi Group), Boso Peninsula, Japan (burial depth 1–4 km).
Particle size and circularity dataset across 18 sublayers (SL1–SL18) in Layer 2.
High-resolution WDS elemental maps across the 20 recognized slip-zone layers.
采自日本房总半岛保田群（江见群）厚5–25 mm黑色光泽主滑移带的断层岩样品（古埋深1–4 km）。
第2层内18个亚层（SL1–SL18）的颗粒粒径分布与圆度统计数据集。
横跨滑移带20个微层的高分辨率WDS主量元素分布图。
li: Layered structures might depend on total slip distance during a single event rather than strictly one layer per earthquake, as seen in high-velocity friction experiments.
Viscosity estimation relies heuristically on a critical Reynolds number (Re = 1400) derived for pure liquid water rather than dense granular-fluid mixtures.
Exact microscale geochemical signatures of high-temperature fluid within individual sublayers remain unverified.
微层结构可能不仅取决于滑动事件次数，还受单次事件滑动距离影响（如高速摩擦实验所示）。
粘度估算依赖纯水层流-湍流转变临界雷诺数（Re = 1400）的启发式假设，而非颗粒-流体混合物的严格准则。
微米级单层或亚层内部直接指示高温流体与热增压的精确地球化学标志物尚待进一步证实。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault weakening mechanisms, specifically thermal pressurization, granular fluidization, and ultralow viscosity within a principal slip zone.
The findings directly relate coseismic ultralow dynamic viscosity of fluidized fault material to intense fault lubrication, large stress drop, and shallow subduction rupture propagation.

ev.notes: Full 17-page article-in-press PDF provided and analyzed, including text, references, and figure captions on pages 16–17.

sum: This paper presents MUSIC (multisite integrated chronologies), an open-source probabilistic toolbox designed to integrate paleoseismic event-age probability density functions (PDFs) from multiple trench sites into a single, unified earthquake chronology. The framework utilizes the Bhattacharyya coefficient to quantify the overlap of contemporaneous event PDFs, enabling systematic correlation of ruptures across sites. It then applies a weighted-mean method to combine these overlapping PDFs, yielding narrower age uncertainties than conventional averaging. Applying MUSIC to the central-eastern Altyn Tagh Fault (ATF), the authors reconstruct earthquake recurrence intervals using Monte Carlo simulations. They identify a regular increase in earthquake frequency during clustering periods. Given an elapsed time of ~370 years, the results suggest an elevated probability of an Mw 7.0+ earthquake on the central-eastern ATF in the coming decades, highlighting the tool's value for seismic hazard assessment.
本文介绍了开源工具包 MUSIC，用于将多个探槽场地的古地震事件年龄概率密度函数（PDF）整合为统一的地震活动年表。该框架利用巴氏系数定量评估不同场地地震PDF的重叠度，并采用加权平均法合并重叠的PDF，从而比传统方法获得更窄的年龄不确定性。作者将该方法应用于阿尔金断裂带中东段，通过蒙特卡洛模拟计算……

t: A probabilistic framework (MUSIC) using the Bhattacharyya coefficient to quantify PDF overlap and a weighted-mean method to combine multisite paleoseismic event-age distributions.
基于巴氏系数定量评估PDF重叠度并采用加权平均法合并多场地古地震年龄分布的概率框架（MUSIC）。
Multisite paleoseismic event-age probability density functions (PDFs) from trench sites along the central-eastern sections of the Altyn Tagh Fault.
来自阿尔金断裂带中东段多个探槽场地的多场地古地震事件年龄概率密度函数（PDF）。

The weighted-mean method reduces age uncertainties, and Monte Carlo simulations reveal regular earthquake frequency increases during clusters, indicating high Mw 7.0+ probability on the ATF within decades.
加权平均法降低了年龄不确定性，蒙特卡洛模拟显示丛集期地震频率规律性增加，表明阿尔金断裂带未来几十年发生Mw 7.0+级地…
Relies on the quality and availability of paleoseismic trench PDFs and assumes specific rupture correlation models across sites.
依赖于古地震探槽PDF的质量和可用性，并假设了跨场地的特定破裂关联模型。
First framework to use the Bhattacharyya coefficient and weighted-mean combination for multisite paleoseismic correlation, implemented in an open-source toolbox (MUSIC).
首次将巴氏系数和加权平均法用于多场地古地震关联，并实现了开源工具包（MUSIC）。

kc: Developed MUSIC, an open-source toolbox for integrating multisite paleoseismic data.
Introduced the Bhattacharyya coefficient to quantify event-age PDF overlap.
Demonstrated accelerated strain release and high seismic hazard along the Altyn Tagh Fault.
开发了用于整合多场地古地震数据的开源工具包 MUSIC。
引入巴氏系数来定量评估事件年龄 PDF 的重叠度。
证实了阿尔金断裂带的加速应变释放和高地震危险性。
me: Bhattacharyya coefficient for PDF overlap quantification.
Weighted-mean method for combining overlapping PDFs.
Monte Carlo approach for earthquake recurrence interval calculation.
用于定量评估 PDF 重叠度的巴氏系数方法。
用于合并重叠 PDF 的加权平均法。
用于计算地震复发间隔的蒙特卡洛方法。
de: Synthesized and integrated paleoseismic trench datasets from the central-eastern Altyn Tagh Fault.
综合并集成了来自阿尔金断裂带中东段的古地震探槽数据集。

该方法的性能严重依赖于单个探槽事件年龄 PDF 的准确性。

tm.why: The paper introduces a framework to improve seismic hazard assessments and applies it to estimate earthquake probabilities along the Altyn Tagh fault.
It presents a probabilistic framework using PDFs, Bhattacharyya coefficients, and Monte Carlo simulations to handle event-age uncertainties.

sum: This study investigates temporal variations in shallow subsurface seismic velocity ($dv/v$) and relative attenuation ($dQ^{-1}$) in the Taklimakan Desert from 2017 to 2019 using three broadband seismographs. Velocity changes are estimated via Rayleigh wave ellipticity (H/V) analysis, while attenuation variations are derived from road traffic-generated seismic signals. The results show clear seasonal fluctuations, with velocity changing by up to 4% and attenuation by up to 10%. These variations strongly correlate with temperature fluctuations with negligible time delay, indicating that thermoelastic strain governs long-term changes. Additionally, transient wetting events cause sharp drops in both velocity and Q, consistent with reduced frame stiffness and increased attenuation from wave-induced fluid flow. This highlights the dominant role of environmental forcing on desert subsurface properties.
本研究利用2017-2019年塔克拉玛干沙漠的宽频带地震数据，通过瑞利波椭圆率分析和交通噪声研究了浅表波速与衰减的季节性变化。结果表明，波速和衰减变化分别达4%和10%，且与温度波动高度相关，表明热弹性应变主导了长期变化。此外，降雨事件导致波速和Q值急剧下降，反映了水分引起的骨架刚度降低和流体流动衰……

t: Rayleigh wave ellipticity analysis is used to estimate velocity changes, while road traffic-generated seismic signals are analyzed to derive relative attenuation variations.
利用瑞利波椭圆率分析估算波速变化，并利用交通噪声推导相对衰减变化。
Continuous seismic data recorded by three broadband seismographs in the Taklimakan Desert from July 2017 to October 2019.
2017至2019年间塔克拉玛干沙漠三个宽频带地震台站记录的连续地震数据。
Velocity changed by up to 4% and attenuation by up to 10%, showing strong correlation with temperature fluctuations and sharp drops during wetting events.
波速和衰减变化分别达4%和10%，与温度高度相关，且在降雨时急剧下降。
The study is limited by the sparse spatial coverage of only three seismographs and potential source variability of traffic noise.
受限于仅有三个台站的稀疏空间覆盖以及交通噪声源潜在的随时间变化。
First joint observation of seasonal velocity and attenuation variations in a desert environment, linking them to thermoelastic strain and fluid-induced frame softening.
首次在沙漠环境中联合观测季节性波速与衰减变化并揭示其环境控制机制。

kc: Quantified seasonal variations in seismic velocity (up to 4%) and attenuation (up to 10%) in the Taklimakan Desert.
Demonstrated that thermoelastic strain is the primary driver of long-term seismic property variations in this desert environment.
Identified the impact of transient wetting events (rainfall) on reducing frame stiffness and increasing attenuation.
量化了塔克拉玛干沙漠地震波速（达4%）和衰减（达10%）的季节性变化。
证明了热弹性应变是该沙漠环境中长期地震性质变化的主要驱动力。
确定了瞬态降雨事件对降低骨架刚度和增加衰减的影响。
me: Rayleigh wave ellipticity (H/V ratio) analysis to estimate temporal velocity changes.
Analysis of road traffic-generated seismic signals to derive relative Q-value (attenuation) changes.
利用瑞利波椭圆率（H/V比）分析来估算波速随时间的变化。
分析道路交通产生的地震信号以推导相对Q值（衰减）的变化。
de: Continuous seismic data recorded by three broadband seismographs in the Taklimakan Desert from July 2017 to October 2019.
Meteorological data (temperature, precipitation) to correlate with seismic variations.
2017年7月至2019年10月期间由塔克拉玛干沙漠三个宽频带地震仪记录的连续地震数据。
气象数据（温度、降水）用于与地震变化进行关联分析。

Traffic noise source variability might introduce uncertainties in attenuation measurements.
由于仅使用了三个宽频带地震仪，空间覆盖范围有限。

The paper investigates relative Q-value changes associated with attenuation variations in the shallow subsurface.
