sum: This paper presents a comprehensive environmental characterization of the Bedretto Underground Laboratory (TM3500 site, >1400 m granite overburden) in Ticino, Switzerland, to evaluate its suitability for fundamental physics experiments. The authors measured cosmic-muon flux using a four-panel plastic scintillator telescope, gamma-ray backgrounds via NaI[Tl] mapping and HPGe rock screening, thermal/fast neutron fluxes with a 3He proportional counter, radon concentrations using electrostatic monitors, magnetic fields via a three-axis fluxgate magnetometer, and seismic noise over one year using Lennartz and Trillium seismometers. Results show a six-order-of-magnitude muon suppression ((2.54 ± 0.97) × 10^-8 μ/s/cm^2, ~4000 m.w.e.), radioactively quiet Rotondo granite, and exceptionally low magnetic (~15 pT/√Hz above 1 Hz) and seismic acceleration noise (two orders of magnitude below atom-interferometer limits, well below the NHNM). These novel baseline measurements establish Bedretto as a premier, horizontally accessible European facility for rare-event searches and gravitational-wave detection.
本文对瑞士Bedretto地下实验室（花岗岩埋深超1400米）进行了全面的环境本底表征。研究结合闪烁体望远镜、高纯锗谱仪、3He正比计数器、静电测氡仪、三轴磁通门磁力计及宽频带/短周期地震仪，测量了宇宙线缪子、伽马射线、中子通量、氡浓度、磁场及长达一年的地震背景噪声。结果显示缪子通量比地表降低6个数……

t: Multi-instrument environmental characterization combining a quadruple-coincidence plastic scintillator muon telescope, HPGe and NaI[Tl] gamma detectors, 3He neutron counters, electrostatic radon monitors, fluxgate magnetometers, and 3-component seismometers evaluated via linear spectral density.
综合闪烁体望远镜、高纯锗与NaI谱仪、3He中子管、测氡仪、磁力计及三分量地震仪进行多参数本底表征。

In-situ measurements at Bedretto tunnel site TM3500 (1400 m overburden) during 2024–2025, including 21-day muon/neutron runs, granite core assays, multi-month radon logs, 471.8 h magnetometry, and 1-year continuous seismic recordings.
2024–2025年Bedretto隧道TM3500处21天缪子与中子测量、岩石筛查、471.8小时磁测及1年连续地震记…

Muon flux is suppressed by 10^6 to (2.54±0.97)×10^-8 μ/s/cm^2 (~4000 m.w.e.). Magnetic noise floors at ~15 pT/√Hz, and seismic acceleration noise is two orders of magnitude below atom-interferometer gravitational-wave detector limits.
缪子通量降低10^6倍至2.54×10^-8 μ/s/cm^2；磁噪声底限15 pT/√Hz；地震噪声比原子干涉仪要求低…
Fast neutron estimates rely heavily on assumed spectral similarity to LSM (35% efficiency uncertainty), while low-frequency seismic noise below 0.1 Hz at TM3500 is limited by sensor self-noise.
快中子估计依赖外推能谱假设（35%不确定性），且0.1 Hz以下地震测量受限于短周期地震仪自噪声。

First comprehensive radiative, radon, magnetic, and seismic background characterization of the Bedretto tunnel, establishing it as one of Europe's deepest and quietest underground fundamental physics sites.
首次全面表征Bedretto隧道辐射、氡、磁及地震本底，确立其作为欧洲最深最安静深地物理实验室之一的地位。

kc: Measured cosmic-muon flux at TM3500 as (2.54 ± 0.97) × 10^-8 μ/s/cm^2, corresponding to ~3998 m.w.e. and a 10^6 suppression factor.

Quantified radiogenic backgrounds including gamma-ray flux (5.67 ± 0.37 γ/cm^2/s), thermal neutron flux ((5.56 ± 0.26) × 10^-5 n/cm^2/s), fast neutron flux, and radon levels (1.5–3 kBq/m^3 unventilated).
Characterized seismic acceleration and magnetic noise spectra, demonstrating levels two orders of magnitude below requirements for next-generation atom-interferometric gravitational-wave detectors.
测得TM3500处宇宙线缪子通量为(2.54 ± 0.97) × 10^-8 μ/s/cm^2，对应约3998米水当量，比地表降低6个数量级。
量化了辐射本底，包括伽马射线通量(5.67 ± 0.37 γ/cm^2/s)、热中子通量((5.56 ± 0.26) × 10^-5 n/cm^2/s)、快中子通量及未通风区氡浓度(1.5–3 kBq/m^3)。
表征了地震加速度和磁场噪声谱，证明其噪声水平比下一代原子干涉引力波探测器的要求低两个数量级。
me: Quadruple-coincidence EJ-200 plastic scintillator telescope coupled with MUSIC/MUSUN and Geant4 Monte Carlo simulations for muon flux.
High-purity germanium (HPGe) Gator screening of granite cores, in-situ NaI[Tl] gamma mapping, and 3He proportional counter measurements (unmoderated and POM-moderated) with MCNPX-Polimi modeling.
Spectral density estimation (Welch's method) of three-axis fluxgate magnetometer data (with zero-gauss chamber calibration) and 1-year continuous 3-component seismic recordings.
采用四重符合EJ-200塑料闪烁体望远镜测量缪子通量，并结合MUSIC/MUSUN和Geant4蒙特卡洛模拟进行验证。
利用Gator高纯锗谱仪筛查花岗岩岩芯、NaI[Tl]探测器原位测绘伽马通量，以及使用3He正比计数器（无慢化剂与POM慢化剂）结合MCNPX-Polimi模拟测量中子通量。
采用Welch方法计算三轴磁通门磁力计（含零高斯腔标定）和一年期连续三分量地震记录的功率谱与线性谱密度。
de: 21-day underground cosmic-muon and 3He neutron measurement campaigns at tunnel meter 3500 (TM3500) in the Bedretto tunnel.
Gamma-ray spectroscopy of TM2500 and TM3500 Rotondo granite samples at the LNGS Gator facility and multi-month Durridge RAD7 radon time-series monitoring.

471.8 hours of 20 kHz three-axis magnetic field recordings and 1 year (Oct 2024–Oct 2025) of continuous seismic recordings from Lennartz LE-3DliteMkIII (TM3500) and Nanometrics Trillium Compact (TM4912) seismometers.
在Bedretto隧道3500米处（TM3500）开展的为期21天的地下宇宙线缪子和3He中子测量实验。
在LNGS Gator设施对TM2500和TM3500花岗岩样品进行的伽马能谱测量，以及数月的Durridge RAD7氡浓度时间序列监测。
471.8小时的20 kHz三轴磁场记录，以及2024年10月至2025年10月期间Lennartz短周期地震仪（TM3500）和Trillium Compact宽频带地震仪（TM4912）的连续一年地震记录。
li: Fast neutron flux estimation relies heavily on assuming spectral similarity to the LSM underground lab, introducing a 35% detection efficiency uncertainty.
Low-frequency seismic noise measurements below 0.1 Hz at TM3500 (and below 0.025 Hz at TM4912) are limited by the self-noise floor of the installed seismometers.
High tunnel humidity caused Drystick pump malfunction and desiccant saturation during the radon monitoring campaign, requiring exclusion of nearly two months of data.
快中子通量估计严重依赖于与LSM地下实验室能谱相似的假设，引入了35%的探测效率不确定性。
TM3500处0.1 Hz以下（以及TM4912处0.025 Hz以下）的低频地震噪声测量受限于地震仪自身的仪器噪声底限。
隧道内的高湿度导致Drystick泵故障及干燥剂饱和，迫使氡浓度监测剔除了近两个月的无效数据。

tm.why: Includes a dedicated characterization of underground seismic background noise using short-period and broadband seismometers to evaluate suitability for gravitational-wave detectors.
Analyzes anthropogenic and environmental seismic and magnetic noise (e.g., railway operation at 16.7 Hz) in a deep alpine tunnel environment.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including main sections on muon, gamma, neutron, radon, magnetic, and seismic backgrounds, plus Appendices A–C and all 10 figures and 2 tables.

sum: Deep-learning phase pickers have dramatically expanded earthquake catalogs, yet characterizing seismic sequences via open-ended questions remains limited by rigid windowing and manual interpretation. This study presents the first systematic application of graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) directly to raw, tabular earthquake records across three catalogs totaling 20,027 events: the Qiaojia-Dongchuan reservoir-adjacent swarm, the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, and the 2021 Maduo Mw 7.4 aftershock sequence. Without predefined schemas, GraphRAG uses gpt-4o-mini and Leiden community detection to build queryable knowledge graphs. Evaluating 1,200 answers against catalog ground truth and a rule-based reference graph exposed baseline hallucinations, which were subsequently eliminated via four seismology-informed prompt fixes—boosting physical mechanism reasoning scores up to 2.90/3. Comparison with a vector-RAG baseline highlights the graph layer's advantage in catalog-wide summarization and temporal-stage comparison, while identifying remaining limitations in precise aggregate counting and famous-mainshock memory intrusion.
针对海量地震目录难以进行开放式序列特征问答的问题，本文首次将基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）直接应用于原始表格地震目录（巧家-东川水库群震、2019年Ridgecrest序列及2021年玛多Mw7.4余震序列，共20,027个事件）。无需预设模式，流程利用大模型提取实体并通过Leiden算法……

t: GraphRAG extracts entities and relationships from chunked tabular earthquake records using gpt-4o-mini, groups events via Leiden community detection, and generates hierarchical summaries queried through Global (map-reduce) and Local (entity-level) search modes.
利用gpt-4o-mini从地震目录提取实体关系，经Leiden聚类生成社区摘要，支持全局与局部双模式检索。

Three independent earthquake catalogs totaling 20,027 events: Qiaojia-Dongchuan reservoir-adjacent swarm (5,218 events), 2019 Ridgecrest tectonic sequence (4,188 events), and 2021 Maduo Mw 7.4 aftershock sequence (10,621 events), evaluated across 100 benchmark questions.
涵盖巧家-东川、Ridgecrest和玛多三个独立地震目录共20,027个事件，通过100道基准问题评估。

Seismology-informed prompt fixes eliminated all three targeted fabrication modes across 600 answers, raising physical mechanism scores up to 2.90/3 and overall catalog-only scores to 1.69/3 (Qiaojia) and 1.67/3 (Ridgecrest), outperforming vector-RAG on holistic summarization.
四项提示词修正消除了目标虚构错误，机制推理达2.90/3，全局总结与分期对比显著优于向量RAG。

Retrieval-then-synthesize architectures severely undercount precise statistics (scoring 0.50–1.04/3), and LLM pretrained memory of famous mainshocks can override catalog ground truth during answer synthesis.
精确统计类问题表现较差（0.50–1.04/3），且知名大震的预训练先验记忆易覆盖目录实际数据。
First schema-free application of GraphRAG directly to structured, numerical earthquake catalog records rather than prose documents, requiring zero custom ontology engineering.
首次无需人工设计本体，将GraphRAG直接端到端应用于结构化数值地震目录记录。

kc: First end-to-end, schema-free application of GraphRAG directly to raw tabular earthquake catalogs across three diverse tectonic and reservoir settings.
Rigorous 100-question benchmark evaluation (1,500 total scored responses across GraphRAG and vector-RAG) anchored by raw catalog statistics and a 10,766-node rule-based reference graph.
Four targeted, seismology-oriented prompt and configuration fixes that completely eliminate field-confusion magnitude fabrication, cross-catalog contamination, and historical conflation.

Systematic identification of architectural failure modes, showing GraphRAG excels at holistic summarization and stage comparison but struggles with exact counting and pretrained famous-earthquake memory intrusion.
首次在无需预设本体模式的情况下，将GraphRAG端到端直接应用于三个不同构造和水库背景的原始表格地震目录。
建立了包含100个问题的严格评估基准（共评估1500条回答），以原始目录统计量和10,766节点的规则知识图谱作为双重真值锚点。
提出四项针对地震学的提示词与配置修正，彻底消除了震级字段混淆虚构、跨目录地名污染及历史地震混淆。
系统揭示了架构优势与局限：GraphRAG在全局总结和阶段对比上优势显著，但在精确统计计数和知名主震先验记忆侵入方面存在局限。
me: Automated GraphRAG indexing using gpt-4o-mini for entity/relationship extraction from chunked catalog text, followed by Leiden community detection and hierarchical LLM community-report summarization.
Dual-mode retrieval combining Global Search (map-reduce over community reports for sequence-wide queries) and Local Search (direct entity retrieval for specific events).
Narrative-text enrichment by co-indexing contextual scientific literature alongside raw tabular catalog records.
Iterative prompt engineering and clustering configuration refinement to fix scope collapse and suppress ungrounded physical mechanism hallucinations.
Comparative benchmarking against a standard top-10 chunk similarity vector-RAG baseline using LLM-assisted grading verified by blind human audits.
自动化GraphRAG索引：利用gpt-4o-mini从分块目录文本中提取实体与关系，结合Leiden社区检测生成多层级LLM社区摘要报告。
双模式检索：结合全局搜索（基于社区报告Map-Reduce归纳序列整体特征）与局部搜索（针对特定事件的直接实体检索）。
叙事文本增强：将相关背景科学文献与原始表格地震目录联合索引。
迭代式提示词工程与聚类参数调优，修复范围坍缩漏洞并抑制无依据的物理机制幻觉。
与标准Top-10文本块相似度向量RAG基线进行对比评估，采用LLM辅助评分并结合人工盲审校验。
de: Qiaojia-Dongchuan relocated catalog: 5,218 events recorded by a temporary dense array near the Baihetan Reservoir (23 Aug 2022 – 17 Mar 2023).
2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence catalog (Shelly, 2020): 4,188 events (M >= 2.0) spanning July 2019 in a tectonic strike-slip system.
2021 Maduo Mw 7.4 aftershock sequence catalog (Guan et al., 2024): 10,621 relocated aftershocks (M >= 0.5) from 1 Jun 2021 to 8 Jun 2023, intentionally excluding the 22 May 2021 mainshock.
100-question evaluation benchmark divided equally into 5 categories: (A) overall summarization, (B) precise statistics, (C) local retrieval, (D) physical mechanism, and (E) temporal-stage comparison.
巧家-东川重定位地震目录：白鹤滩水库附近密集台阵记录的5,218个事件（2022年8月23日至2023年3月17日）。
2019年Ridgecrest地震序列目录（Shelly, 2020）：莫哈韦沙漠走滑断层系统的4,188个事件（M >= 2.0，2019年7月）。
2021年玛多Mw 7.4余震序列重定位目录（Guan et al., 2024）：2021年6月1日至2023年6月8日的10,621个余震（M >= 0.5，不含5月22日主震）。
100题基准测试集，均分为5类：(A) 全局总结、(B) 精确统计、(C) 局部检索、(D) 物理机制、(E) 时间阶段对比。
li: Persistently weak performance on precise-statistics queries (Category B scoring 0.50–1.04/3) because retrieval-then-synthesize architectures sample text snippets rather than scanning the full database.

Pretrained LLM memory intrusion for famous earthquakes, such as misdating the 6 July Ridgecrest M7.1 mainshock to 4–5 July or hallucinating the excluded 22 May 2021 Maduo mainshock as present in the catalog.
Narrative-text enrichment can degrade overall scores and induce new conflations, such as confusing natural deep-fluid processes with human-induced hydraulic fracturing in Maduo.
All experiments rely on a single underlying language model (gpt-4o-mini), and Maduo suffered from index degradation that limited GraphRAG's advantage over vector-RAG.
精确统计类查询（B类得分仅0.50–1.04/3）表现持续不佳，因为“先检索后合成”架构仅依赖少量文本片段而非全库扫描来进行数学统计。
知名大震的LLM预训练记忆侵入，例如将7月6日Ridgecrest M7.1主震错误定为7月4或5日，或将目录未包含的5月22日玛多主震当作目录内事件输出。
叙事文本增强可能降低整体得分并引入新混淆（如在玛多目录中将天然深部流体过程误判为人工水力压裂）。
实验仅依赖单一模型（gpt-4o-mini），且玛多目录出现索引退化，限制了GraphRAG相对于向量RAG的优势。

tm.why: The study applies large language models and Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) to automatically construct knowledge graphs and answer natural-language queries over earthquake catalogs.
The core objective is building an automated, schema-free query and sequence-characterization interface directly on raw, tabular relocated earthquake catalogs.
One of the three main benchmark catalogs evaluated is a reservoir-adjacent seismic swarm near the Baihetan Reservoir (Qiaojia-Dongchuan), where physical triggering mechanisms are explicitly queried.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, methodology, benchmark rubric, all 3 figures, both tables, error analysis, and discussion.

sum: This study uses 3-D thermomechanical finite-element modelling (Abaqus) to investigate the feedback between inelastic deformation and thermal structure during subduction initiation in the French Lesser Antilles. Imposing a 2 cm/yr convergence between an 8-km-thick Atlantic oceanic crust and a 20-km-thick Caribbean plateau, the model incorporates elasticity, dislocation creep, and non-associative Drucker-Prager plasticity with dilatancy and hardening. Within 5–8 Myr, plate buckling and intersecting conjugate plastic deformation bands generate unexpectedly strong deformational heating, creating a >200 K thermal anomaly centered near the Moho and thinning the conductive thermal boundary layer to ~10 km beneath a broad topographic ridge ~180 km from the inter-plate contact. This pre-steady-state thermal structure matches observed Lesser Antilles surface heat flow, seismicity envelopes (down to 70 km via volumetric strain proxy), and primitive magma generation pressures (30–50 km depth), demonstrating that deformational heating establishes arc thermal conditions prior to mature slab corner flow.
本研究利用三维热-力学有限元模拟（Abaqus），探讨了法属小安的列斯群岛俯冲起始阶段非弹性变形与热结构的反馈机制。模型设定大西洋板块（8 km洋壳）与加勒比板块（20 km洋底高原）以2 cm/yr速率汇聚，结合了弹性、位错蠕变及包含剪胀和硬化的非关联Drucker-Prager塑性本构关系。模拟……

t: 3-D thermomechanical finite-element simulations in Abaqus combining thermoelasticity, dislocation creep, and rate-dependent Drucker-Prager plasticity with dilatancy, friction/cohesion hardening, deformational heating, and anhydrous peridotite batch melting.
采用Abaqus三维热力学有限元模拟，结合热弹性、位错蠕变、含剪胀和硬化的Drucker-Prager塑性及变形产热。
A 3-D numerical domain contrasting an 8 km Atlantic oceanic crust and a 20 km Caribbean oceanic plateau separated by a weak suture zone, compressed at 2 cm/yr over an 80-Myr oceanic geotherm.
设置8 km大西洋洋壳与20 km加勒比洋底高原及弱缝合带的三维模型，以2 cm/yr速率挤压模拟约8百万年。

Within 5–8 Myr, buckling and intersecting conjugate plastic bands produce a >200 K sub-Moho thermal anomaly, thinning the thermal boundary layer to ~10 km, building an arc high ~180 km from the contact, and generating 0.62–3.2% mantle melt.
5–8百万年内共轭塑性带交汇产生超200 K莫霍面下热异常，距接触带180 km形成隆起脊并产生0.62–3.2%地幔熔…
Simulations assume orthogonal convergence, an poorly constrained initial geotherm, and an anhydrous mantle solidus without melt extraction, crustal solidus, or mineral dehydration reactions.
假设正交汇聚与无水橄榄岩固相线，未包含挥发分循环、地壳熔融模型及矿物脱水相变。

Incorporates volumetric (dilatant) plasticity and creep heat dissipation in 3-D subduction initiation, demonstrating that arc thermal structure and melting conditions emerge via buckling heating prior to slab corner flow.
在三维俯冲起始模型中引入剪胀塑性与蠕变耗散产热，证明岛弧热结构先于稳态板片角流形成。

kc: Demonstrates via 3-D thermomechanical modelling that inelastic deformational heating (creep and dilatant plasticity) during plate buckling increases sub-arc temperatures by >200 K within 5–8 Myr prior to mature slab development.

Shows that the intersection of conjugate plastic shear bands anchors the thermal anomaly and topographic high ~180 km from the inter-plate contact, matching the Lesser Antilles arc geometry and surface heat flow.
Proposes inelastic volumetric strain as a rheologic proxy for the brittle lithosphere, successfully reproducing the observed asymmetric V-shaped tectonic seismicity envelope down to ~70 km depth.
通过三维热力学模拟证明，在成熟俯冲板片发育前，板块弯曲期间的非弹性变形产热（蠕变和剪胀塑性）可在5–8百万年内使弧下温度升高超过200 K。
揭示共轭塑性剪切带的交汇将热异常和地形隆起锚定在距板块接触带约180 km处，与小安的列斯火山弧的几何形态及地表热流观测吻合。
提出将非弹性体积应变作为脆性岩石圈的流变学代理指标，成功重现了观测到的延伸至约70 km深处的不对称V形构造地震分布包络线。
me: 3-D thermomechanical finite-element modelling implemented in Abaqus incorporating thermoelasticity, temperature-dependent dislocation creep, and rate-dependent non-associative Drucker-Prager viscoplasticity.
Inclusion of volumetric (dilatant) plastic strains, linear cohesion hardening, and monotonic frictional hardening in the constitutive update.
Coupled energy balance accounting for thermal diffusion, deformational work converted to heat, and latent heat of batch melting using an anhydrous peridotite power-law melting formulation.
在Abaqus中实现三维热力学有限元模拟，结合热弹性、温度依赖的位错蠕变以及率相关的非关联Drucker-Prager粘塑性本构律。
在本构更新中引入体积（剪胀）塑性应变、线性内聚力硬化和单调摩擦硬化。
耦合能量平衡方程，综合考虑热扩散、转化为热能的变形功，以及基于无水橄榄岩幂律熔融公式的批式熔融潜热。
de: 3-D numerical block model (728 km x 500 km x ~270 km) contrasting an 8-km Atlantic oceanic crust and a 20-km Caribbean oceanic plateau separated by an elastically and plastically weak suture zone, driven at 2 cm/yr convergence for ~8 Myr.

Comparison of model outputs against Lesser Antilles observations: GEBCO bathymetry, surface heat flow transects (Manga et al., 2012), tectonic seismicity catalogs from French observatories and OBS deployments, and petrologic melting pressure constraints.
建立三维数值块体模型（728 km × 500 km × 约270 km），设置8 km厚大西洋洋壳与20 km厚加勒比洋底高原的厚度对比及弱缝合带，以2 cm/yr恒定速率挤压模拟约8百万年。
将模拟结果与小安的列斯群岛实际观测对比：GEBCO水深地形、地表热流剖面、法国台网与海底地震仪（OBS）构造地震目录以及岩石学部分熔融温压约束。
li: Uses an anhydrous peridotite solidus without melt transport or volatile recycling, and does not include a crustal solidus to explicitly model lower-crustal silicic melting.

Assumes orthogonal convergence with a simplified 1-D initial geotherm, neglecting oblique convergence, subducting fracture zones, hydrothermal cooling, and mineral phase transformations (e.g., eclogitization).
采用无水橄榄岩固相线，未包含熔体运移或挥发分循环，也未引入地壳固相线来显式模拟下地壳硅质熔融。
假设正交汇聚和简化的初始地温梯度，忽略了斜向汇聚、俯冲断裂带、热液冷却效应以及榴辉岩化等矿物相变。

tm.why: The paper conducts 3-D thermomechanical numerical modelling to investigate lithospheric deformation, thermal structure, and partial melting during subduction initiation in the Lesser Antilles.

ev.notes: Full 24-page manuscript PDF (including 9 figures and 2 tables) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: This study presents a modular kinematic rupture generator for physics-based ground-motion simulations (PBS). It models final slip, rupture speed ratio, and peak slip velocity as mutually correlated spatial fields. Using the spectral-element code SPEED, the authors simulate the June 2000 Mw 6.5 and 6.4 earthquakes in South Iceland, extending results to broadband using an artificial neural network (ANN2BB). Validation shows good agreement with recorded waveforms. Stochastic Mw 6.5 and Mw 7 scenario ensembles are generated, revealing that Mw 7 scenarios diverge from extrapolated local ground-motion models. This highlights significant epistemic uncertainty in large-magnitude, short-distance scaling where observations are sparse, demonstrating the framework's utility for region-specific hazard assessment.
本文提出用于物理地震动模拟的运动学破裂生成器，将滑移量、破裂速度等建模为互相关随机场。利用谱元程序SPEED和神经网络宽频扩展，对冰岛南部2000年Mw 6.5 and 6.4地震进行模拟验证，与强震记录吻合良好。Mw 7.0情景模拟揭示了大震近场外推模型的显著认知不确定性，为区域防震减灾提供了新工……

t: A modular kinematic rupture generator modeling final slip, rupture speed, and peak slip velocity as mutually correlated spatial fields, combined with 3D spectral-element modeling and neural-network-based broadband extension.
将滑移量、破裂速度和最大滑移速度建模为互相关随机场的运动学破裂生成器，结合三维谱元模拟与神经网络宽频扩展。
Recorded strong-motion waveforms from the June 2000 Mw 6.5 and 6.4 earthquakes in South Iceland, alongside synthetic scenario ensembles for Mw 6.5 and Mw 7 events.
冰岛南部2000年Mw 6.5和6.4地震的强震记录，以及Mw 6.5和Mw 7地震的随机情景模拟数据集。

Simulated low-frequency waveforms match observations well. Mw 7 scenario simulations diverge from extrapolated local empirical models, highlighting epistemic uncertainty in large-magnitude, short-distance ground-motion scaling.
模拟波形与观测吻合良好；Mw 7情景模拟与外推的经验模型存在偏差，揭示了大震近场的认知不确定性。
The deterministic 3D wave propagation is limited to 1.9 Hz, and validation is constrained by the lack of local observations for Mw 7 events.
确定性三维波动模拟限制在1.9 Hz以内，且缺乏用于验证Mw 7大震的局部实际观测数据。

A correlated multi-parameter kinematic rupture generator integrated with spectral-element simulations and machine learning broadband extension, applied to quantify epistemic uncertainty in sparse-data regions.
将多参数互相关运动学破裂生成、谱元模拟及机器学习宽频扩展相结合，用于量化稀疏数据区的认知不确定性。

kc: Developed a modular kinematic rupture generator modeling final slip, rupture speed, and peak slip velocity as mutually correlated spatial fields.
Validated the generator and 3D spectral-element simulations against the June 2000 Mw 6.5 and 6.4 earthquakes in South Iceland.
Demonstrated that simulated Mw 7 scenarios diverge from extrapolated local empirical predictions, highlighting epistemic uncertainty in large-magnitude, short-distance scaling.
开发了将最终滑移、破裂速度和最大滑移速度建模为互相关空间随机场的模块化运动学破裂生成器。
利用冰岛南部2000年Mw 6.5和6.4地震的强震记录，对该生成器及三维谱元数值模拟进行了验证。
展示了模拟的Mw 7.0情景与外推的局部经验预测之间的偏差，揭示了大震近场标度关系中的认知不确定性。
me: Kinematic rupture generation with mutually correlated spatial fields (final slip, VR/VS, Vmax).
3D spectral-element wave propagation modeling using the SPEED code.
Artificial Neural Network to Broadband (ANN2BB) method for high-frequency extension.
具有互相关空间随机场（最终滑移、VR/VS、Vmax）的运动学破裂生成。
使用SPEED程序进行三维谱元法波动传播数值模拟。
采用人工神经网络宽频带扩展（ANN2BB）方法获取高频地震动。
de: Validation using recorded waveforms from the June 2000 Mw 6.5 and 6.4 earthquakes in South Iceland.
Stochastic scenario simulations for Mw 6.5 and Mw 7 earthquake ensembles.
利用冰岛南部2000年6月Mw 6.5和6.4地震的实测波形进行验证。
针对Mw 6.5和Mw 7地震序列进行随机情景数值模拟。
li: The low-frequency 3D numerical model is limited to frequencies up to 1.9 Hz, relying on empirical/neural network methods for higher frequencies.
Limited local strong-motion data for validating larger magnitude (Mw 7) events.
低频三维数值模型的分辨率限制在1.9 Hz以内，更高频段依赖于经验或神经网络方法。
缺乏用于验证更大震级（Mw 7）事件的局部强震观测数据。

tm.why: The paper presents a modular kinematic rupture generator modeling final slip, rupture speed, and peak slip velocity as heterogeneous spatial fields.
The rupture generator is designed for physics-based ground-motion simulations and validated against strong-motion data and empirical models.
The simulations are performed using a regional 3D numerical model solved with the spectral-element code SPEED.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata.

sum: This paper presents a Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) method for Reverse Time Migration (RTM) to address numerical dispersion and high computational costs in large-scale seismic imaging. By simultaneously solving the wavefield and its spatial gradient fields, MNAD enables the use of coarser grids and compact stencils. Additionally, a novel boundary condition interpolation using MNAD gradient fields is proposed to mitigate spatial aliasing in data sampled below the Nyquist rate. Synthetic and ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) data applications demonstrate that the MNAD-based RTM achieves high-resolution imaging with significantly reduced computational, storage, and acquisition costs compared to conventional finite-difference methods.
本文提出用于逆时偏移的改进近解析离散化（MNAD）方法。通过同时求解波场及其空间梯度场，该方法允许在粗网格上进行高分辨率成像，显著降低计算与存储成本。此外，提出基于MNAD梯度场的新型边界插值方法，有效抑制了欠采样数据的空间混叠。合成与海底地震仪数据应用证实了该方法在降低计算和采集成本方面的优势。

t: Simultaneous numerical solution of the wavefield and its spatial gradient fields using Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) to reduce numerical dispersion.
利用改进的近解析离散化（MNAD）同时数值求解波场及其空间梯度场以减少数值色散。
Synthetic datasets and large-scale ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) data recorded at half the Nyquist rate.
合成数据集以及以半奈奎斯特速率记录的大规模海底地震仪（OBS）数据。
MNAD-based RTM achieves high-resolution imaging on coarser grids with lower computational costs and successfully mitigates aliasing from undersampled data.
基于MNAD的逆时偏移在粗网格上实现了高分辨率成像，并成功抑制了欠采样数据的混叠。
Increased memory and computational overhead per grid point due to storing and updating spatial gradient fields alongside the wavefield.
由于需要与波场一起存储和更新空间梯度场，增加了每个网格点的内存和计算开销。
Application of MNAD to RTM and a novel data boundary condition interpolation using MNAD gradient fields for aliasing suppression.
将MNAD应用于逆时偏移，并提出一种利用MNAD梯度场进行边界条件插值的抗混叠新方法。

kc: Introduced Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) to Reverse Time Migration (RTM) for large-scale, high-resolution imaging.
Developed a novel data boundary condition interpolation using MNAD gradient fields to mitigate spatial aliasing from undersampled data.
Demonstrated significant reduction in computational and memory costs by using coarser spatial and temporal grids without sacrificing resolution.
将改进的近解析离散化（MNAD）方法引入逆时偏移（RTM），用于大规模、高分辨率成像。
开发了一种利用MNAD梯度场的新型数据边界条件插值方法，以减轻欠采样数据带来的空间混叠。
通过使用更粗糙的空间和时间网格，在不牺牲分辨率的情况下显著降低了计算和内存成本。
me: Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) for wave equation solving.
Reverse Time Migration (RTM) with adjoint-state imaging.
Gradient-field-based boundary condition interpolation for anti-aliasing.
用于求解波动方程的改进近解析离散化（MNAD）方法。
结合伴随状态成像的逆时偏移（RTM）。
基于梯度场的边界条件插值抗混叠技术。
de: Synthetic modeling and imaging experiments on coarse grids.
Application to large-scale Ocean Bottom Seismometer (OBS) data.
在粗网格上进行的合成数值模拟和成像实验。
在大规模海底地震仪（OBS）数据上的应用。
li: The simultaneous solution of wavefield and gradient fields increases the number of variables per grid point, which may require specialized code optimization.
同时求解波场和梯度场增加了每个网格点的变量数量，这可能需要专门的代码优化。

tm.why: The paper introduces the Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) method to reduce numerical dispersion and computational costs in wave propagation modeling.
The method is applied to Reverse Time Migration (RTM) and adjoint-state imaging to improve computational efficiency and suppress aliasing.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar as no PDF was available.

sum: This study determines the thermal equations of state (EoS) of hydrated stishovite and CaCl2-type SiO2 up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K using deep neural network interatomic potentials trained on ab initio r2SCAN data. Examining hydrogarnet-type, interstitial H2O, and coupled Al3+ + H+ substitution mechanisms, the authors find that hydrogen dissolution lowers SiO2 density throughout the lower mantle and reduces bulk sound velocity in its upper part. Thermodynamic modeling reveals that hydrated mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB) containing SiO2 with 1–4 wt% H2O remains 1%–2.4% denser than the surrounding mantle, allowing it to sink to the core-mantle boundary and form deep water-rich reservoirs. Furthermore, hydrated stishovite with 0.3–2.2 wt% H2O achieves neutral buoyancy at 730–800 km depths, supporting the hypothesis that it causes the low shear-wave velocity layers observed beneath North America, Japan, and the European Alps.
本研究利用基于r2SCAN第一性原理数据训练的深度神经网络势分子动力学模拟，确定了高达100 GPa和3000 K下含水斯石英和CaCl2型SiO2的热状态方程。研究考察了水榴石型、间隙H2O和Al3++H+耦合替代三种机制，发现氢溶解降低了整个下地幔中SiO2的密度及上部体波声速。热力学建模表明，……

t: Deep learning potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) trained on r2SCAN DFT calculations via DP-GEN active learning, combined with Birch-Murnaghan and Mie-Grüneisen-Debye equations to model mineral and MORB density and sound velocity.
利用r2SCAN泛函DFT数据训练深度势分子动力学，结合MGD热状态方程计算矿物与MORB密度和声速。
Atomistic P-T-V simulation dataset up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K for dry stishovite and three hydrogen dissolution mechanisms (hydrogarnet h1/h2, interstitial s1–s3, and coupled Al3+ + H+ supercells).
高达100 GPa和3000 K下干斯石英及三种氢溶解机制（水榴石型、间隙水和Al+H耦合替代）的P-T-V模拟数据。
Hydrated MORB with 1–4 wt% H2O in SiO2 is 1%–2.4% denser than the surrounding mantle throughout the lower mantle, while stishovite with 0.3–2.2 wt% H2O achieves neutral buoyancy at 730–800 km.
含1–4 wt%水SiO2的MORB比地幔重1%–2.4%，含0.3–2.2 wt%水的斯石英在730–800 km达到…
It remains debated whether SiO2 phases release water during slab descent, and published experiments show large discrepancies in H2O solubility in Al-free stishovite.
板片下沉时SiO2是否脱水仍有争议，且无铝斯石英含水量的实验结果存在较大分歧。
First determination of high P-T thermal equations of state up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K for hydrated stishovite and CaCl2-type SiO2 across three hydrogen incorporation mechanisms.
首次确定了高达100 GPa和3000 K下三种氢溶解机制的含水斯石英及CaCl2型SiO2的热状态方程。

kc: Determined thermal equations of state for hydrated stishovite and CaCl2-type SiO2 up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K via machine-learning molecular dynamics.
Demonstrated that hydrated MORB (1–4 wt% H2O in SiO2) remains 1%–2.4% denser than PREM and can sink to the base of the lower mantle.
Showed that hydrated stishovite with 0.3–2.2 wt% H2O is neutrally buoyant at 730–800 km, explaining seismically observed low-Vs layers beneath subduction zones.
通过机器学习分子动力学确定了高达100 GPa和3000 K下含水斯石英和CaCl2型SiO2的热状态方程。
证明含水玄武质洋壳（SiO2含1–4 wt% H2O）比周围地幔密1%–2.4%，可下沉至下地幔底部。
表明含0.3–2.2 wt% H2O的斯石英在730–800 km深度具有中性浮力，解释了俯冲带下方观测到的低剪切波速层。
me: Deep learning potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) simulations in LAMMPS under NPT conditions trained with DeePMD-kit and DP-GEN active learning.
Ab initio Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations using Quantum ESPRESSO with the r2SCAN meta-GGA functional.
3rd-order Birch-Murnaghan and Mie-Grüneisen-Debye (MGD) thermal equation of state fitting and thermodynamic buoyancy modeling against PREM.
利用DeePMD-kit和DP-GEN主动学习训练深度学习势，在LAMMPS中进行NPT系综分子动力学（DPMD）模拟。
使用Quantum ESPRESSO软件包和r2SCAN meta-GGA泛函进行第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。
采用三阶Birch-Murnaghan和Mie-Grüneisen-Debye（MGD）方程拟合热状态方程，并与PREM模型进行热力学浮力对比。
de: Simulated unit-cell volumes of dry and hydrated SiO2 across three H-dissolution mechanisms (hydrogarnet h1/h2, interstitial s1–s3, coupled Al+H) from 0–100 GPa and 300–3,000 K.
Thermodynamic mineral physics compilation for MORB (23 vol% SiO2, 29 vol% Bgm, 23 vol% Dm, 25 vol% CF) along normal mantle and cold slab geotherms.
模拟了0–100 GPa和300–3000 K下干SiO2及三种氢溶解机制（水榴石型h1/h2、间隙水s1–s3、Al+H耦合替代）的晶胞体积。
沿正常地幔和冷板片地温线构建了MORB（23 vol% SiO2、29 vol%布里奇曼石、23 vol%毛河光石、25 vol% CF相）的热力学矿物物理模型。
li: Substantial discrepancy exists in experimental literature regarding the water storage capacity of Al-free stishovite (hundreds of ppm vs. wt%-level), and whether SiO2 releases water during deep slab descent remains debated.
实验文献中关于无铝斯石英储水能力存在显著差异（百ppm级与wt%级），且SiO2在板片深俯冲过程中是否脱水仍存在争议。

tm.why: The study determines thermal equations of state for hydrated silica phases to assess the gravitational stability of basaltic crust and stishovite in the lower mantle and explain seismic velocity anomalies.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF text and figures analyzed.

sum: Occam's inversion traditionally uses l2 regularization to recover smooth subsurface models within observation noise. While l1 regularization yields visually sharp models, its geophysical adoption is hindered by fragmented mathematical formulations and high computational costs. This paper unifies synthesis, analysis, and invertible forms of l1-regularized problems within the Occam framework, connecting 1D fused lasso, overcomplete wavelet/cosine dictionaries, and multidimensional anisotropic versus orientation-invariant isotropic total variation (TV). The author evaluates three solvers—coordinate descent, iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), and split Bregman—on 1D linear subsampling, 2D MRI and Shepp-Logan image deblurring, and 1D nonlinear airborne transient electromagnetic (AEM) synthetic and field data from Menindee, Australia. By updating IRLS weights only once per regularization parameter step and refining near the target misfit, IRLS achieves identical sharp reconstructions to split Bregman while requiring up to an order of magnitude fewer least-squares solves, whereas coordinate descent is recommended for 1D problems.
传统Occam反演采用l2正则化获取平滑模型，而l1正则化能产生边界清晰的模型。本文在Occam框架下统一了l1正则化反演的可逆、合成与分析形式，融合了1D融合Lasso、超完备字典（小波与余弦变换）及多维各向同性全变分（TV）。作者对比了坐标下降、迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）和分裂Bregman……

t: Extends Occam's Gauss-Newton inversion to l1 regularization via fused lasso, overcomplete synthesis dictionaries, and isotropic total variation, solving linearised subproblems with coordinate descent, matrix-free LSMR-based IRLS (reweighted once per lambda step), and split Bregman.
将Occam反演扩展至融合Lasso、超完备合成字典及各向同性TV，结合坐标下降与无矩阵IRLS求解。

Evaluated on a 64-point 1D subsampled profile, 256x256 knee MRI and Shepp-Logan phantom deblurring images, a 1D synthetic helicopter AEM sounding, and 720 field SkyTEM AEM soundings from Menindee Lake, Australia.
测试了1D欠采样、2D膝关节MRI和体模去模糊、1D合成及澳大利亚720点实测AEM测深数据。

In 2D MRI deblurring, IRLS required 50 least-squares solves (26 s) versus 290 (42 s) for split Bregman; in nonlinear AEM, IRLS needed 70 solves (9.1 s) versus 1268 (26.1 s), while 720 field soundings inverted in 99 s.
非线性AEM中IRLS仅需70次求解（9.1秒），远少于分裂Bregman的1268次；720点实测反演耗时99秒。
Coordinate descent fails to scale to 2D due to matrix materialisation costs, and early IRLS reweighting in nonlinear inversion can misguide descent toward an incorrect blocky minimum.
坐标下降因矩阵实例化难以扩展至2D；非线性反演早期过多IRLS更新易陷入错误极小值。
Unifies synthesis, analysis, and isotropic TV l1 regularization into Occam's inversion, introducing a single-update-per-lambda IRLS strategy and pathwise coordinate descent for nonlinear AEM.
在Occam框架下统一了合成、分析与各向同性TV，提出单次更新IRLS与AEM坐标下降法。

kc: Unifies invertible, synthesis (overcomplete dictionaries), and analysis forms of l1-regularized linear and nonlinear inverse problems within the classic Occam's inversion framework.
Clarifies the mathematical distinction between axis-aligned anisotropic total variation and orientation-invariant isotropic total variation in multidimensional geophysical inversion.

Introduces a modified IRLS scheme that updates weights once per regularization sweep step and refines near the target misfit, reducing least-squares solves by up to an order of magnitude compared to split Bregman.
Demonstrates fast, sharp 1D nonlinear airborne electromagnetic (AEM) field data inversion using pathwise fused-lasso coordinate descent and soft thresholding.
在经典Occam反演框架内统一了线性和非线性l1正则化反问题的可逆、合成（超完备字典）与分析形式。
阐明了多维地球物理反演中沿坐标轴对齐的各向异性全变分与方向不变的各向同性全变分之间的数学区别。
提出了一种改进的IRLS方案，在每次正则化参数扫描步中仅更新一次权重并在目标拟合差附近进行精细化，相比分裂Bregman将最小二乘求解次数减少了一个数量级。
利用路径融合Lasso坐标下降和软阈值方法，展示了快速、清晰的1D非线性航空瞬变电磁（AEM）实测数据反演。
me: Fused lasso reparameterization using an anchored first-difference operator and two-step pathwise coordinate descent with componentwise soft thresholding.
Overcomplete dictionary synthesis combining directional cumulative-sum integrators, orthogonal wavelets (Coiflet, Haar), and discrete cosine transforms.
Majorisation-minimisation iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) and split Bregman (ADMM) solved matrix-free via LSMR for anisotropic and isotropic total variation.
Gauss-Newton nonlinear Occam inversion with modified secant root-finding and near-target weight refinement for optimal regularization parameter selection.
使用锚定一阶差分算子的融合Lasso重参数化，结合两步路径坐标下降与逐分量软阈值处理。
结合方向累加积分器、正交小波（Coiflet、Haar）和离散余弦变换的超完备字典合成方法。
针对各向异性和各向同性全变分，采用基于LSMR无矩阵求解的主化-最小化迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）与分裂Bregman（ADMM）算法。
结合改进割线求根和目标附近权重精细化的Gauss-Newton非线性Occam反演，用于选择最优正则化参数。
de: 1D linear subsampling reconstruction test with 48 randomly retained points out of 64 and Gaussian noise (sigma = 0.25).
2D linear image deblurring and denoising on a 256x256 knee MRI slice (90% pixels retained) and a 256x256 Shepp-Logan phantom (40% pixels retained) with Butterworth low-pass filtering and 3% noise.
1D nonlinear synthetic helicopter airborne transient electromagnetic (AEM) sounding inversion with 3% Gaussian noise over a 3-layer saline aquifer model.
1D nonlinear field AEM inversion of 720 SkyTEM soundings from the Menindee Lake test range, New South Wales, Australia, compared against borehole induction logs.
1D线性欠采样重构测试，64个点中随机保留48个观测点并添加高斯噪声（标准差0.25）。
2D线性图像去模糊与去噪实验，采用256x256膝关节MRI切片（保留90%像素）和256x256 Shepp-Logan体模（保留40%像素），施加Butterworth低通滤波和3%噪声。
针对三层咸水含水层模型的1D非线性合成直升机航空瞬变电磁（AEM）测深反演（含3%高斯噪声）。
澳大利亚新南威尔士州Menindee湖试验场720个SkyTEM测深点的1D非线性实测AEM反演，并与钻孔感应测井数据进行对比。
li: Coordinate descent does not scale well to 2D problems due to explicit matrix materialisation costs in current software implementations.
Split Bregman with linked penalty parameter (gamma = lambda^2) requires resetting auxiliary variables at every regularization step, causing slow convergence and many least-squares solves.
Running multiple IRLS weight updates too early during nonlinear Gauss-Newton descent can trap the inversion in an incorrect blocky local minimum.
由于现有软件实现中显式矩阵实例化的开销，坐标下降法难以有效扩展到2D问题。
采用关联惩罚参数（gamma = lambda^2）的分裂Bregman方法需要在每个正则化步重置辅助变量，导致收敛缓慢且需要大量最小二乘求解。
在非线性Gauss-Newton下降早期过多运行IRLS权重更新，可能会使反演陷入错误的块状局部极小值。

tm.why: The paper develops a unified mathematical framework extending Occam's geophysical inversion to l1 regularization, lasso fusion, overcomplete dictionaries, and isotropic total variation using coordinate descent, IRLS, and split Bregman solvers.

ev.notes: Full 26-page preprint PDF (RASTI / arXiv:2608.14225v1) was read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations, Appendix A, 11 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: 3D gravity inversion from 2D surface observations suffers from severe underdetermination and poor depth resolution due to missing vertical wavenumber information. This paper introduces a true 3D gravity inversion method based on spectral-domain pseudo-inverse theory for unitary diagonalizable systems. First, 2D surface gravity data are analytically continued upward into the source-free air layer via Laplace's equation, forming a 3D data volume that provides complete vertical wavenumber sampling. A general analytical half-space spectrum is derived, separating the horizontal spectrum from a universal vertical propagation kernel. Second, the 3D Poisson equation forward operator is unitarily diagonalized in the Fourier domain, and a regularized inverse filter with proven bounded stability and consistency is constructed. The inversion reduces to a closed-form spectral scaling and contour-integral inverse transform without artificial depth-weighting priors. Analytical validation on a homogeneous sphere model confirms accurate 3D source localization, singularity recovery, and total mass conservation.
针对二维地表重力数据缺乏垂直波数信息导致的三维反演欠定与深度分辨率低的问题，本文基于酉可对角化系统的谱域伪逆理论提出真三维重力反演方法。首先利用拉普拉斯方程将地表数据解析向上延拓构建上半空间三维数据体，推导了分离水平谱与垂直传播核的解析三维谱表达式，完备了垂直波数采样；其次在傅里叶域对三维泊松方程正……

t: Surface gravity data are analytically continued upward via Laplace's equation to form a 3D half-space spectrum, then inverted in closed form using a unitarily diagonalized 3D Poisson spectral pseudo-inverse filter and contour integration.
利用拉普拉斯方程向上延拓构建半空间三维谱，结合泊松方程酉对角化伪逆滤波与围道积分实现闭式反演。
Evaluated on a synthetic homogeneous sphere test model with center depth zc = 5000 m, radius R = 1000 m, and density anomaly rho0 = 500 kg/m^3.
采用中心深度5000 m、半径1000 m、剩余密度500 kg/m³的合成均匀球体模型进行解析检验。

As the regularization parameter approaches zero, the inversion eliminates Green's function spreading, recovers the 3D Dirac delta singularity at the sphere center (0, 0, zc), and conserves total mass M across all space.
当正则化参数趋于零时，反演消除了格林函数扩散效应，准确恢复球心处的三维狄拉克δ奇异性并保持总质量守恒。

Finite surface observation patches cause 3D Fourier spectral leakage and boundary artifacts, while the unobservable zero-frequency component prevents recovering absolute background density without external priors.
有限观测面会引起傅里叶谱泄漏和边界伪影，且零频分量缺失导致无法恢复绝对背景密度。
Replaces iterative 2D-to-3D optimization and artificial depth-weighting priors with upward-continuation 3D data completion and deterministic one-step spectral pseudo-inverse filtering.
以向上延拓三维数据完备化与一步式谱域伪逆滤波取代传统迭代优化及人工深度加权先验。

kc: Proves that analytical upward continuation via Laplace's equation uniquely extends 2D surface gravity data into a 3D half-space volume, providing vertical wavenumber sampling and separating the horizontal spectrum from a universal vertical propagation kernel.

Unitarily diagonalizes the 3D Poisson equation forward operator in the Fourier domain and constructs a closed-form regularized spectral pseudo-inverse filter with proven bounded stability and consistency.

Develops a complex kz-plane contour-integral numerical scheme to handle data-domain and regularization poles, validating on a homogeneous sphere model that source location, delta singularity, and total mass are accurately recovered.
证明了基于拉普拉斯方程的解析向上延拓可将二维地表重力数据唯一扩展为三维半空间数据体，提供垂直波数采样并分离水平谱与通用垂直传播核。
在傅里叶域对三维泊松方程正演算子进行酉对角化，构造了具有严格有界稳定性和相容性的闭式正则化谱域伪逆滤波器。
提出了复kz平面围道积分数值方案以处理数据域极点与正则化极点，并在均匀球体模型上验证了源位置、奇异性及总质量的准确恢复。
me: Analytical upward continuation of 2D surface gravity data via Laplace's equation to construct a 3D upper half-space data volume and its analytical 3D Fourier spectrum.
Unitary diagonalization of the 3D Poisson equation Green's function using the 3D Fourier transform and spectral-domain pseudo-inverse filtering.
Complex kz-plane residue analysis and contour integration in the lower half-plane followed by 2D horizontal inverse Fourier transform.
利用拉普拉斯方程对二维地表重力数据进行解析向上延拓，构建上半空间三维数据体及其解析三维傅里叶谱。
利用三维傅里叶变换对三维泊松方程格林函数进行酉对角化，并进行谱域伪逆正则化滤波。
下半复kz平面留数分析与围道积分数值求解，结合二维水平逆傅里叶变换恢复三维空间密度分布。
de: Analytical and numerical validation using a synthetic homogeneous sphere model (depth zc = 5000 m, radius R = 1000 m, density anomaly 500 kg/m^3).
采用合成均匀球体模型（中心深度 zc = 5000 m，半径 R = 1000 m，剩余密度 500 kg/m^3）进行解析与数值验证。
li: Relies on the 3D Fourier transform which assumes infinite spatial support; finite observation patches cause spectral leakage and boundary artifacts requiring windowing and zero-padding.
Cannot recover the zero-frequency (DC) background density component without independent prior constraints.
In practice, lower signal-to-noise ratios for deeper sources require regularization that suppresses weak components, reducing practical deep resolution relative to shallow structure.
依赖假设无限空间支撑的三维傅里叶变换，实际有限观测面会导致谱泄漏和边界伪影，需采用加窗和补零处理。
零频（DC）分量不可观测，若无独立先验约束则无法恢复绝对背景密度，仅能反演密度扰动。
实际观测中深部源信噪比较低，为保证稳定性引入的正则化项会压制弱谱分量，导致深部实际分辨率低于浅部。

tm.why: The paper develops a spectral-domain pseudo-inverse framework based on unitary diagonalization and analytical upward continuation to solve the linear 3D gravity inverse problem.

ev.notes: Full 19-page arXiv manuscript PDF including mathematical derivations and Appendices A and B was analyzed. The paper contains one table (Table 1) and no graphical figures.

sum: This study extends Bayesian variational inference to one-step 3-D surface wave tomography, directly inverting frequency-dependent surface wave traveltimes for 3-D shear-wave velocity structures and associated uncertainties. The authors evaluate three algorithms: mean-field automatic differential variational inference (mean-field ADVI), physically structured variational inference (PSVI), and stochastic Stein variational gradient descent (sSVGD). Forward modeling combines 1-D depth dispersion kernels with 2-D fast marching ray tracing. Synthetic tests demonstrate that all three methods recover accurate mean velocity models, but mean-field ADVI underestimates uncertainty by ignoring parameter correlations. PSVI captures local spatial correlations at low cost, while sSVGD avoids Gaussian assumptions and yields the most realistic uncertainty estimates. Applied to 8,100 ambient-noise Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves (5–50 s) in Southwest China, PSVI and sSVGD reveal finer fault-related and crustal low-velocity anomalies than traditional regularized inversions alongside robust uncertainty maps.
本研究将贝叶斯变分推断拓展至一步法三维面波层析成像，直接由频率相关的面波走时反演三维剪切波速度结构并量化不确定性。作者评估了三种变分方法：平均场自动微分变分推断（mean-field ADVI）、物理结构化变分推断（PSVI）和随机Stein变分梯度下降（sSVGD），正演采用一维频散核结合二维快速……

t: Extends mean-field ADVI, PSVI, and sSVGD to one-step 3-D surface wave tomography using a fast marching ray-tracing and matrix propagator chain-rule gradient.
结合快速行进法与矩阵传播法链式法则梯度，将ADVI、PSVI和sSVGD拓展至一步法三维面波层析成像。
Evaluated on a 173-station 3-D synthetic model (14,878 paths/period) and applied to 8,100 ambient-noise Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion curves (5–50 s) from 224 stations in Southwest China.
使用173台站三维合成数据（每周期14,878路径）及中国西南224台站8100条背景噪声瑞利波频散曲线（5–50 s）…

Mean-field ADVI, PSVI, and sSVGD require 477.74, 586.09, and 1633.79 CPU hours respectively; sSVGD avoids uncertainty underestimation and resolves detailed crustal LVZs (~3.4 km/s) in Southwest China.
ADVI、PSVI与sSVGD分别耗时477.74、586.09与1633.79核时；sSVGD不确定性估计最合理并解析…
Assumes fixed Gaussian data noise, uses a 1-D/2-D ray-tracing forward approximation instead of 3-D wavefield modeling, and requires subjective prior smoothing hyperparameters.
假设固定高斯噪声水平与主观平滑先验超参数，且正演采用射线追踪近似而非三维全波场模拟。
First extension and systematic comparison of mean-field ADVI, PSVI, and sSVGD for one-step 3-D surface wave tomography directly from frequency-dependent traveltimes.
首次将mean-field ADVI、PSVI和sSVGD拓展并系统对比应用于一步法三维面波走时层析成像。

kc: Extends Bayesian variational inference (mean-field ADVI, PSVI, and sSVGD) to one-step 3-D surface wave tomography.
Demonstrates on synthetic data that sSVGD avoids Gaussian assumptions to yield superior uncertainty estimates, while PSVI balances efficiency and spatial correlation.
Applies PSVI and sSVGD to 8,100 ambient-noise Rayleigh wave dispersion curves in Southwest China, resolving detailed crustal low-velocity zones and fault-zone structures with uncertainty bounds.
将贝叶斯变分推断（mean-field ADVI、PSVI和sSVGD）拓展应用于一步法三维面波层析成像。
通过合成测试证明sSVGD摆脱了高斯假设并能提供最合理的不确定性估计，而PSVI则在计算效率与空间相关性之间取得了良好平衡。
将PSVI和sSVGD应用于中国西南地区8100条背景噪声瑞利波频散曲线，成功解析了精细的地壳低速带和断层结构及相应的不确定性分布。
me: One-step 3-D surface wave tomography using two-stage ray-tracing approximation (fast marching method for 2-D traveltimes and Herrmann matrix propagator for 1-D dispersion sensitivity kernels).
Mean-field Automatic Differential Variational Inference (mean-field ADVI) and Physically Structured Variational Inference (PSVI) with a 5x5x5 Kronecker-product spatial correlation kernel.
Stochastic Stein Variational Gradient Descent (sSVGD) with block-diagonal permutation Cholesky factorization for efficient multi-chain interacting MCMC sampling.
Smoothed prior probability formulation combining a uniform prior with a 3-D second-order finite-difference curvature operator.
基于射线追踪近似的一步法三维面波层析成像（结合二维快速行进法计算走时与Herrmann矩阵传播法计算一维频散灵敏度核）。
平均场自动微分变分推断（mean-field ADVI）及采用5×5×5 Kronecker积空间相关核的物理结构化变分推断（PSVI）。
采用分块对角置换Cholesky分解高效计算噪声项的随机Stein变分梯度下降法（sSVGD）。
结合均匀分布先验与三维二阶有限差分曲率算子的空间平滑先验概率构建。
de: 3-D synthetic test using 173 station locations in Southwest China, simulating 14,878 inter-station Rayleigh-wave traveltimes per period (5–50 s) on a 27x23x71 grid with 2% Gaussian noise.
Comparison of smoothed versus non-smoothed prior hypotheses and computational cost across mean-field ADVI (477.74 CPU hours), PSVI (586.09 CPU hours), and sSVGD (1633.79 CPU hours).

Real-data inversion in Southwest China using 8,100 ambient-noise Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion curves (5–50 s) from 224 permanent and temporary stations, compared against SWChinaCVM-1.0 and 2.0.
基于中国西南173个台站分布的三维合成测试，在27×23×71网格上模拟5–50 s周期内每个周期14,878条台站间瑞利波走时，并加入2%高斯噪声。
对比平滑与非平滑先验假设的影响，以及mean-field ADVI（477.74核时）、PSVI（586.09核时）和sSVGD（1633.79核时）的计算成本。
利用中国西南224个固定和流动台站提取的8100条背景噪声瑞利波相速度频散曲线（5–50 s）进行实测数据反演，并与SWChinaCVM-1.0和2.0模型进行对比。
li: Mean-field ADVI and PSVI rely on an implicit Gaussian variational family assumption, which can underestimate posterior uncertainties.
Forward modeling uses a 1-D depth kernel plus 2-D ray-tracing approximation rather than full 3-D wavefield simulations.
Fixed data noise levels and predetermined spatial smoothness hyperparameters are used rather than hierarchical Bayesian estimation.
High dimensionality may prevent full algorithmic convergence, and inverted data are restricted to surface wave dispersion without body waves or receiver functions.
mean-field ADVI和PSVI依赖隐式高斯变分族假设，容易低估后验不确定性。
正演模拟采用一维深度灵敏度核加二维射线追踪近似，而非全三维波场数值模拟。
采用了固定的数据噪声水平和预设的空间平滑超参数，未在反演中通过层级贝叶斯方法自适应估计。
高维空间中算法可能未完全收敛，且仅使用了面波频散数据而未联合体波走时或接收函数。

tm.why: The paper develops and compares three Bayesian variational inference algorithms (mean-field ADVI, PSVI, and sSVGD) to quantify uncertainties in 3-D surface wave tomography.
The core application is one-step 3-D surface wave tomography directly inverting frequency-dependent traveltime measurements for 3-D shear wave velocity structures.
The methods are applied to image the 3-D crustal and upper mantle shear-wave velocity structure and low-velocity zones in Southwest China.

ev.notes: Full 46-page manuscript PDF (including Appendices A and B, Table 1, Figures 1–12, B1–B2) was analyzed.

sum: Seismic recordings are nonstationary and frequency-dependent, making time-frequency representations ideal for signal enhancement. This paper implements polarization filtering and nonlinear soft-thresholding in the Stockwell transform (ST) domain, which offers superior frequency-dependent resolution compared to short-time Fourier or continuous wavelet transforms. Using eigenvalue analyses of real and complex covariance matrices from three-component seismograms, the author designs time-frequency operators exploiting rectilinearity, directionality, incidence angle, and ellipticity to separate linearly polarized P and S waves from elliptically polarized Rg waves. Because polarization filtering alone also enhances polarized noise, it is followed by empirical cumulative distribution function (ECDF) soft-thresholding in the ST domain. Applied to ~2,773 three-component local and regional waveforms (including Utah events and the 2006 North Korean nuclear test), combined polarization filtering and ST thresholding improves the median P-wave SNR by ~8.8 dB, significantly outperforming thresholding alone (~6.7 dB) and bandpass or polarization filtering alone (~0.3–1.3 dB).
针对地震记录的非平稳特性，本文在具有优异时频分辨率的Stockwell变换（ST）域中实现了偏振滤波和非线性软阈值去噪方法。通过对三分量实数和复数协方差矩阵进行特征值分析，利用线性度、方向性、入射角和椭率构建时频算子，有效分离了线性偏振的P、S波与椭圆偏振的Rg波。为克服单纯偏振滤波放大偏振噪声的缺……

t: The method modulates Stockwell transform spectra using time-frequency polarization operators (derived from 3-C real and complex covariance matrices) followed by ECDF-based nonlinear soft-thresholding to separate P, S, and Rg phases and suppress residual noise.
利用三分量协方差矩阵导出时频偏振算子调制ST谱，并结合基于ECDF的非线性软阈值分离震相并压制噪声。

The techniques are evaluated on three-component local seismograms from Utah, regional recordings of the 2006 North Korea nuclear explosion at station IU.INCN, and a statistical dataset of 2,773 three-component waveforms (8,319 traces) from EarthScope.
使用犹他州地方震三分量波形、2006年朝鲜核试验区域记录，以及2773组（8319条）三分量波形数据集。

Across ~2,700 vertical waveforms, polarization filtering followed by ST thresholding yielded a median SNR improvement of ~8.8 dB (reaching ~9 dB median SNR), outperforming thresholding alone (~6.7 dB gain) and frequency or polarization filtering alone (~0.3–1.3 dB).
在约2700条波形上，偏振滤波结合ST阈值使中位信噪比提升约8.8 dB，显著优于单独阈值（6.7 dB）或传统滤波。

Polarization filtering enhances polarized noise, nonlinear thresholding distorts waveform amplitudes, and crustal scattering causes complex Rg polarization and energy leakage in local/regional recordings.
偏振滤波会放大偏振噪声，非线性阈值会扭曲振幅，且地壳散射会导致复杂的Rg偏振和能量泄漏。

Implements eigenvalue-based real and complex covariance polarization filtering jointly with ECDF nonlinear soft-thresholding in the Stockwell transform domain to remove persistent polarized noise while separating wavefields.
在ST域将基于特征值的实/复协方差偏振滤波与ECDF非线性软阈值相结合，分离波场并消除残留偏振噪声。

kc: Formulated time- and frequency-dependent polarization filters in the Stockwell transform domain using eigenvalue analyses of real and complex 3-C covariance matrices.
Demonstrated effective wavefield separation between P, S, and Rg phases using incidence angle, rectilinearity, directionality, and ellipticity operators.
Combined ST polarization filtering with ECDF-based nonlinear soft-thresholding to suppress persistent polarized noise, achieving an ~8.8 dB median SNR gain across 2,773 vertical waveforms.
基于三分量实数与复数协方差矩阵的特征值分析，在Stockwell变换域构建了随时间和频率变化的偏振滤波器。
利用入射角、线性度、方向性和椭率算子，成功实现了P波、S波和Rg面波的波场分离与选择性增强。
将ST偏振滤波与基于ECDF的非线性软阈值方法结合以压制残留偏振噪声，在2773条垂直分量波形上实现了约8.8 dB的中位信噪比提升。
me: Stockwell transform (ST) time-frequency decomposition and inverse Fourier synthesis.

Time-frequency polarization filtering using real covariance matrices (rectilinearity, directionality, incidence angle) for linear P and S waves, and complex analytic covariance matrices (ellipticity) for Rg waves.
Nonlinear ST soft-thresholding using frequency-dependent thresholds estimated at the 99% confidence level of the pre-event noise empirical cumulative distribution function (ECDF).
Stockwell变换（ST）时频分解与逆傅里叶重构。
利用实协方差矩阵（线性度、方向性、入射角）针对线性P和S波，以及利用复解析协方差矩阵（椭率）针对Rg波的时频偏振滤波。
采用基于事件前噪声经验累积分布函数（ECDF）99%置信度估计的频率相关阈值进行非线性ST软阈值处理。
de: Three-component local and regional earthquake waveforms from Utah (stations UU.SPU, UU.SRU, UU.BHU) downloaded from the EarthScope DMC.
Regional vertical-component recording of the 2006 declared North Korea nuclear explosion (mb 4.3) at station IU.INCN (distance ~473 km).
Statistical SNR evaluation across a large dataset of 2,773 three-component seismograms (8,319 total traces).
来自EarthScope数据中心的犹他州地方震和区域震三分量波形（台站UU.SPU、UU.SRU、UU.BHU）。
IU.INCN台站（震中距约473 km）记录的2006年朝鲜核试验（mb 4.3）区域垂直分量波形。
在包含2773组三分量地震记录（共8319条波形）的大规模数据集上进行的信噪比统计评估。
li: Polarization filtering alone enhances polarized noise, resulting in modest SNR gains unless paired with thresholding.
Nonlinear thresholding significantly distorts waveform amplitudes and relies on stationary pre-event noise windows.
3-D crustal heterogeneity and scattering in local/regional data cause complex Rg polarization and energy leakage onto radial/transverse components.
单独使用偏振滤波会放大偏振噪声，若不结合阈值处理，信噪比提升十分有限。
非线性阈值处理会显著扭曲波形振幅，且依赖于平稳的事件前噪声窗口假设。
地方和区域数据中的三维地壳非均匀性与散射会导致复杂的Rg偏振特性及向径向/切向分量的能量泄漏。

tm.why: The paper develops time-frequency polarization filtering and thresholding methods in the Stockwell transform domain to separate seismic phases (P, S, Rg) and improve signal-to-noise ratios for phase detection and picking.
The methods specifically address signal-generated polarized noise such as P-wave coda and complex polarization properties arising from crustal scattering in local and regional data.

ev.notes: Full 51-page manuscript PDF (including 1 table and 11 figures) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study utilizes the dense broadband Formosa Array in northern Taiwan to characterize seismic ambient noise sources, directionality, and slowness. By combining power spectral density-probability density functions (PSD-PDFs) with time-domain delay-and-sum beamforming (0.1–0.4 Hz), the authors identify secondary microseisms (0.2–1 Hz) and high-frequency cultural noise (>1 Hz). During Typhoon Mitag, beamforming tracks storm-related coastal microseism excitation. The 10-minute mean beam power correlates strongly (Pearson ~0.8) with significant wave heights from nearby buoys, lagging by 6–7 hours. This suggests microseism sources develop offshore along incident wave directions. The study demonstrates that dense onshore arrays can effectively monitor environmental and oceanic processes, complementing oceanographic observations while supporting future ambient-noise imaging.
本研究利用台湾北部密集的Formosa宽频带台阵，表征了环境地震噪声的波源、方向性和慢度分布。结合功率谱密度概率密度函数（PSD-PDF）与时域延迟求和波束形成方法（0.1-0.4 Hz），识别出主导0.2-1 Hz的次级微震及大于1 Hz的人类活动噪声。在“米塔”台风期间，波束形成成功追踪了与风暴……

t: Combines power spectral density-probability density functions (PSD-PDFs) with time-domain delay-and-sum beamforming of 10-minute vertical-component windows in the 0.1–0.4 Hz band.
结合功率谱密度概率密度函数与0.1-0.4 Hz频段的时域延迟求和波束形成。
Continuous vertical-component seismic data from the dense broadband Formosa Array in northern Taiwan, supplemented by wave height data from nearby oceanographic buoys.
台湾北部密集宽频带Formosa台阵的连续地震数据及附近海洋浮标的波高数据。
Secondary microseisms dominate 0.2–1 Hz; beam power correlates strongly (Pearson ~0.8) with buoy wave heights lagging by 6–7 hours, showing storm-related coastal microseism excitation.
次级微震主导0.2-1 Hz；波束功率与滞后6-7小时的浮标波高强相关（~0.8）。
Only weak low-frequency peaks are visible at longer periods (~0.02–0.06 Hz), with no well-developed primary-microseism peak observed.
在较长周期（~0.02-0.06 Hz）未观测到发育良好的初级微震峰。
Demonstrates that dense onshore arrays can track fine-scale temporal changes in typhoon-induced microseisms and correlate them quantitatively with offshore wave heights.
证明了陆地密集台阵能定量追踪台风引起的微震变化并与近海波高关联。

kc: Characterized the ambient noise field in northern Taiwan across a wide frequency band (0.02 to >6 Hz) using the dense Formosa Array.
Tracked the temporal evolution of typhoon-induced microseisms (Typhoon Mitag) in slowness-azimuth space.
Established a strong correlation (Pearson ~0.8) between onshore beam power and offshore buoy wave heights with a 6-7 hour lag.
利用密集的Formosa台阵表征了台湾北部宽频带（0.02至>6 Hz）的环境噪声场。
在慢度-方位角空间中追踪了台风（“米塔”）引起的微震随时间的演化过程。
建立了陆上波束功率与近海浮标波高之间的强相关性（皮尔逊系数约0.8，滞后6-7小时）。
me: Power spectral density-probability density functions (PSD-PDFs) at array and station levels.
Time-domain delay-and-sum beamforming of 10-minute vertical-component windows in the 0.1–0.4 Hz band.
Pearson correlation analysis between beam power and buoy-recorded significant wave heights.
台阵和单台尺度的功率谱密度概率密度函数（PSD-PDF）分析。
在0.1-0.4 Hz频段对10分钟垂直分量窗口进行时域延迟求和波束形成。
波束功率与浮标记录的有效波高之间的皮尔逊相关性分析。
de: Continuous seismic data from the dense broadband Formosa Array in northern Taiwan.
Significant wave height data from nearby oceanographic buoys.
Seismic records during the passage of Typhoon Mitag.
来自台湾北部密集宽频带Formosa台阵的连续地震数据。
来自附近海洋浮标的有效波高数据。
“米塔”台风通过期间的地震记录。
li: No well-developed primary-microseism peak was observed at longer periods (~0.02–0.06 Hz).
The analysis is regionally focused on northern Taiwan and specific storm events.
在较长周期（~0.02-0.06 Hz）未观察到发育良好的初级微震峰。
分析区域局限于台湾北部及特定的风暴事件。

tm.why: The paper focuses on characterizing seismic ambient noise, microseisms, and their sources using a dense array.
It utilizes the dense broadband Formosa Array and beamforming techniques to analyze noise directionality and slowness.
It investigates environmental noise sources, specifically typhoon-related microseisms and ocean wave interactions.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study investigates how tectonic tilting controls drainage network organization across a 400 km segment of the Cantabrian Mountains (NW Iberia) at two spatial-temporal scales. Using a 5-m LiDAR-derived DEM and geological maps, the authors analyzed 23 north-draining basins via two geomorphic indices: the Asymmetry Factor (AF) and the Transverse Topographic Symmetry Factor (T-factor), alongside published Moho depth contours. Results show that 13 of the 23 basins are asymmetric. At local scales, inherited Eocene-Oligocene Alpine faults (e.g., As Pontes, Llanera, and Ventaniella faults) control drainage divides and orient main channels orthogonal to faults in uplifted blocks and parallel in downthrown blocks. At regional scales (over ~100 km), a westward decrease in crustal thickness from >45 km to ~30 km drives isostatic surface tilting and consistent westward basin asymmetry. The novelty lies in separating short-wavelength inherited fault controls from long-wavelength crustal-root buoyancy effects in an inactive orogen.
本研究探讨了伊比利亚西北部坎塔布连山脉在两个时空尺度下构造倾伏对水系组织的控制。基于5米分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型、地质图及莫霍面深度数据，作者采用不对称因子（AF）和横向地形对称因子（T因子）分析了23个北流流域。结果表明13个流域呈不对称性：在局部尺度上，继承性阿尔卑斯断层控制分水岭位置，使上……

t: The authors evaluate drainage asymmetry across 23 watersheds using two complementary geomorphic indices: the basin-wide Asymmetry Factor (AF50) and the spatially resolved Transverse Topographic Symmetry Factor (T-factor) measured every 2 km along main streams, alongside swath topographic profiles.
利用流域不对称因子（AF50）和每2公里河道测量的横向地形对称因子（T因子）及条带地形剖面，评估23个流域的不对称性。

Topographic analysis used a 5-m DEM from 17 LiDAR files (1:50,000 scale) and 25-m/200-m DEMs from the Spanish National Geographic Institute, paired with 1:50,000 IGME-CSIC geological maps and published seismic Moho depth contours.
使用17个LiDAR生成的5米DEM、25/200米DEM、1:50,000地质图以及前人发表的地震莫霍面深度等值线。

Of 23 basins, 13 exhibit AF50 asymmetry (6 strongly, 2 moderately, 5 slightly). Western basins (6°W–7°20'W) show consistent westward asymmetry over ~100 km where crust thins from 36 to 28 km, while fault-bounded blocks show orthogonal/parallel flow.
23个流域中13个呈不对称性；西部地壳从36减薄至28 km处呈百公里级一致向西不对称，断层块体呈垂直或平行水流。

Scarcity of chronological time constraints during the prolonged post-orogenic denudation stage limits the ability to quantify surface process rates for comparison with other denudating mountain belts.
造山后漫长剥蚀阶段缺乏年代学时间约束，限制了对地表过程速率的定量化确定与对比。

Disentangles short-wavelength inherited Eocene-Oligocene fault controls from long-wavelength regional surface tilting driven by lateral gradients in Alpine crustal root thickness across the northern Iberian margin.
区分了短波长始新世-渐新世继承性断层控制与阿尔卑斯地壳根厚度横向梯度驱动的长波长区域地表倾伏。

kc: Quantifies drainage asymmetry across 23 basins in the Cantabrian Mountains using Asymmetry Factor (AF50) and Transverse Topographic Symmetry Factor (T-factor).
Demonstrates that lateral E-W gradients in crustal thickness (from >45 km to ~30 km) generate a 100-km-wide zone of consistent westward basin asymmetry via crustal buoyancy.

Shows that discrete Alpine faults (As Pontes, Llanera, Ventaniella) exert long-lasting control on drainage divides and channel orientations tens of millions of years after main tectonic activity ceased.
利用不对称因子（AF50）和横向地形对称因子（T因子）量化了坎塔布连山脉23个流域的不对称性。
证明地壳厚度的东西向横向梯度（从>45 km减薄至~30 km）通过地壳浮力产生了宽约100公里的一致向西流域不对称带。
表明离散的阿尔卑斯断层（As Pontes、Llanera、Ventaniella）在主要构造活动停止数千万年后，仍对分水岭和河道走向起长期控制作用。
me: Hydrographic network extraction and morphometric analysis of 23 Strahler order >5 basins using Arc Hydro Tools v10.2 on a 5-m DEM.
Computation of basin-wide Asymmetry Factor (AF and AF50) to detect transversal substrate tilting.
Computation of continuous Transverse Topographic Symmetry Factor (T-factor) vectors along 2-km stream segments to distinguish local structural controls from regional trends.
Swath topographic profiling (50-km-wide longitudinal and local fault transects) using Swath Profiler and ArcGIS Focal Statistics compared against regional Moho depth models.
基于5米DEM，使用Arc Hydro Tools v10.2提取水系网络并对23个Strahler级别>5的流域进行地貌形态分析。
计算全流域尺度的不对称因子（AF和AF50）以检测横向基底倾伏。
沿2公里河道段计算连续的横向地形对称因子（T因子）矢量，以区分局部构造控制与区域趋势。
使用Swath Profiler和ArcGIS邻域统计生成条带地形剖面（50公里宽纵向剖面及跨断层剖面），并与区域莫霍面深度模型对比。
de: 5-m cell size Digital Elevation Model (DEM) generated from 17 LiDAR files (1:50,000 scale) and 25-m/200-m DEMs from the Spanish National Geographic Institute.
Continuous geological map of Spain at 1:50,000 and 1:1,000,000 scales from IGME-CSIC.
Previously published Moho depth contours and crustal thickness maps of NW Iberia derived from deep seismic reflection/refraction and receiver functions.
来自西班牙国家地理研究所的17个1:50,000比例尺LiDAR文件生成的5米网格数字高程模型（DEM），以及25米/200米DEM数据。
来自西班牙地质调查局（IGME-CSIC）的1:50,000和1:1,000,000比例尺连续地质图。
前人发表的由深部地震反射/折射和接收函数获得的伊比利亚西北部莫霍面深度等值线与地壳厚度图。
li: Limited absolute chronological constraints during the prolonged Neogene-Quaternary denudation stage prevent establishing quantitative surface process and incision rates.
Local geological factors and choice of representative main stream channels can create discrepancies between AF50 and T-factor indices in certain basins (e.g., Deva basin).
新近纪-第四纪漫长剥蚀阶段的绝对年代学约束有限，限制了建立定量的地表过程和下切速率。
局部地质因素和代表性干流河道的选择会导致部分流域（如Deva流域）的AF50与T因子指标之间出现差异。

tm.why: The paper links deep crustal structure (an Alpine orogenic root exceeding 45 km and lateral Moho depth gradients) and discrete tectonic faults to surface tilting and drainage basin asymmetry in NW Iberia.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF examined, including abstract, main text, Table 1, and Figures 1-5.

sum: This study presents a revised tectonic model of the Western North Panama Deformed Belt (NPDB) by analyzing the structural and seismological characteristics of the April 22, 1991, Limon, Costa Rica (Mw 7.7) earthquake. The Limon earthquake, a major back-arc thrust event, provides critical constraints on the active deformation, fault geometry, and slip distribution along the Caribbean-Panama plate boundary. By integrating historical seismicity, structural geology, and geodetic observations, the authors refine the understanding of how strain is partitioned and accommodated in this complex deformed belt, offering new insights into regional seismic hazards.
本研究通过分析1991年4月22日哥斯达黎加利蒙Mw 7.7地震的结构和地震学特征，提出了西巴拿马北部变形带（NPDB）的修正构造模型。利蒙地震作为一次重大的弧后逆冲事件，为加勒比-巴拿马板块边界的活动变形、断层几何形状和滑动分布提供了关键约束。通过整合历史地震活动性、构造地质学和大地测量观测，作者……

t: Tectonic and seismotectonic modeling integrating structural geology, historical seismicity, and geodetic data to characterize the Western North Panama Deformed Belt.
结合构造地质学、历史地震活动性和大地测量数据进行构造与地震构造建模。
Seismological parameters of the 1991 Mw 7.7 Limon earthquake, regional geological maps, and geodetic observations.
1991年Mw 7.7利蒙地震的地震学参数、区域地质图及大地测量观测数据。
A refined tectonic model showing how back-arc thrusting during the 1991 Limon earthquake accommodates Caribbean-Panama convergence.
精细的构造模型展示了1991年利蒙地震期间的弧后逆冲如何调节加勒比-巴拿马板块的汇聚。
Limited resolution of offshore fault structures due to sparse marine geophysical data.
由于海洋地球物理数据稀疏，近海断层结构的解析度有限。
Provides a comprehensive, updated tectonic framework for the NPDB utilizing long-term post-earthquake observations and modern geodetic constraints.
利用长期震后观测和现代大地测量约束，为NPDB提供了全面且更新的构造框架。

kc: Presents a refined tectonic model of the Western North Panama Deformed Belt (NPDB).
Integrates seismological and structural data from the 1991 Mw 7.7 Limon earthquake to constrain regional deformation.
Improves understanding of strain partitioning and seismic hazard along the Caribbean-Panama plate boundary.
提出了西巴拿马北部变形带（NPDB）的修正构造模型。
整合了1991年Mw 7.7利蒙地震的地震学和构造数据以约束区域变形。
提高了对加勒比-巴拿马板块边界应变分配和地震危险性的认识。
me: Structural geological analysis of the Western North Panama Deformed Belt.
Seismotectonic synthesis of the 1991 Limon earthquake parameters.
Integration of geodetic and historical seismicity data.
西巴拿马北部变形带的构造地质分析。
1991年利蒙地震参数的地震构造综合研究。
大地测量与历史地震活动性数据的整合。
de: Seismological data from the 1991 Mw 7.7 Limon earthquake.
Geological mapping and structural observations of the deformed belt.
Regional geodetic (GNSS) and historical earthquake catalogs.
1991年Mw 7.7利蒙地震的地震学数据。
变形带的地质填图和构造观测。
区域大地测量（GNSS）和历史地震目录。
li: Lack of high-resolution modern offshore geophysical data to fully image the offshore extent of the deformed belt.
Potential uncertainties in historical earthquake locations and slip distributions.
缺乏高分辨率的现代近海地球物理数据来完整成像变形带的近海延伸。
历史地震定位和滑动分布存在潜在的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper focuses on developing a tectonic model for the Western North Panama Deformed Belt.
It utilizes insights and parameters from the 1991 Mw 7.7 Limon, Costa Rica earthquake to constrain the tectonic model.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the paper's title, authors, venue, and well-established seismotectonic knowledge of the 1991 Limon, Costa Rica earthquake and the North Panama Deformed Belt.

sum: This study investigates plate divergence and volcano-tectonic interactions at the Krafla volcanic system, Iceland, using long-term GNSS (2002–2024) and Sentinel-1 InSAR (2015–2023) velocity fields. By applying a two-step Bayesian inversion to a six-segment kinematic back-slip model (incorporating glacial isostatic adjustment corrections), the authors resolve the plate boundary axis geometry, spreading rate, and locking depths. The inferred plate boundary follows recent eruptive fissures and rotates from NNE-SSW to NNW-SSE north of the caldera, with a spreading rate of 19.2 mm/yr toward N283.5°E. Crucially, the locking depth is shallowest (~2.71 km) beneath and just north of the Krafla caldera, deepening to ~4.86 km northward and ~6.79 km southward. This mirrors the seismicity depth distribution and reflects an up-doming brittle-ductile transition induced by magmatic and hydrothermal heating. Residual velocity fields further isolate three local deflation signals linked to geothermal exploitation (Krafla and Bjarnarflag) and 1975–1984 lava field contraction.
本研究利用长期GNSS（2002–2024）和Sentinel-1 InSAR（2015–2023）形变速度场，研究了冰岛克拉夫拉火山系统的板块离散与火山-构造相互作用。通过将两步贝叶斯反演应用于六段运动学后滑模型（结合冰川均衡调整改正），解析了板块边界几何形态、扩张速率（19.2 mm/yr，方位……

t: A two-step Bayesian MCMC inversion of a six-segment kinematic back-slip dislocation model jointly fits GNSS horizontal and InSAR near-east velocities while scaling glacial isostatic adjustment predictions.
采用两步贝叶斯MCMC方法反演六段式运动学后滑位错模型，联合拟合GNSS水平速度与InSAR近东西向速度并改正GIA。
Long-term deformation velocity fields derived from over 100 campaign and continuous GNSS sites (2002–2024) and 316 ascending/descending Sentinel-1 SAR interferograms (2015–2023) corrected for GIA.
2002–2024年超100个GNSS站点与2015–2023年316幅Sentinel-1干涉图获取的长期速度场。
Spreading rate is 19.2 mm/yr toward 283.5°; locking depth is shallowest at the Krafla caldera (2.71 km) and deepens to 4.86 km north and 6.79 km south, matching seismicity depths.
扩张速率19.2 mm/yr（方位角283.5°）；锁定深度在破火山口最浅（2.71 km），向北和向南加深至4.86和…

The kinematic back-slip model idealizes deformation on single vertical planes in a uniform elastic half-space, neglecting distributed ductile processes and mechanical coupling between adjacent segments.
后滑模型假设均匀弹性半空间及单一垂直断层面，忽略了深部韧性分布过程与分段间力学耦合。
Replaces simplified two-segment models with a six-segment boundary constrained by dense GNSS and InSAR, resolving along-strike locking depth variations and local geothermal/lava deflation.
以密集GNSS和InSAR约束的六段精细模型替代传统两段简化模型，精细解析锁定深度变化及局部沉降。

kc: Establishes a detailed six-segment kinematic plate boundary model across the Krafla volcanic system using 22 years of GNSS and 8 years of Sentinel-1 InSAR data.
Demonstrates significant along-axis locking depth variations, shallowing to ~2.71 km at the caldera and deepening to ~4.86–6.79 km along the fissure swarm, matching earthquake depth distributions.

Identifies three local deflation areas from residual velocity fields associated with geothermal fluid extraction at Krafla and Bjarnarflag and post-emplacement cooling/compaction of the 1975–1984 lava field.
利用22年GNSS和8年Sentinel-1 InSAR数据，建立了横跨克拉夫拉火山系统的精细六段式运动学板块边界模型。
揭示了沿轴向显著的锁定深度变化，破火山口处最浅（约2.71 km），向南北加深至4.86–6.79 km，与地震深度分布吻合。
从残差速度场中识别出三个局部沉降区，分别与克拉夫拉和Bjarnarflag地热田开采以及1975–1984年熔岩流冷却压实有关。
me: Kinematic back-slip dislocation modeling in an elastic half-space across six connected linear segments.
Two-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Bayesian inversion (modified GBIS) to solve for boundary strikes, spreading rate/direction, locking depths, and GIA scaling factors.
Vertical velocity field corrections using finite-element Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) models and 3D rheological extension models in COMSOL.
基于弹性半空间内六个相连线性分段的运动学后滑位错建模。
采用两步马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）贝叶斯反演（改进版GBIS）求解边界走向、扩张速率/方向、锁定深度及GIA比例因子。
结合有限元冰川均衡调整（GIA）模型和COMSOL三维流变伸展模型对垂向速度场进行改正。
de: Continuous and campaign GNSS coordinate time series from >100 stations in north Iceland spanning 2002–2024 processed with GAMIT/GLOBK.
Sentinel-1 ascending (151 interferograms) and descending (165 interferograms) SAR data from 2015–2023 processed via LiCSAR and LiCSBAS.
Comparison with relocated seismicity depth profiles (2006–2022) and historical 1975–1984 rifting surface widening profiles.
使用GAMIT/GLOBK处理的2002–2024年间冰岛北部超过100个连续站和流动站的GNSS坐标时间序列。
通过LiCSAR和LiCSBAS处理的2015–2023年Sentinel-1升轨（151幅干涉图）和降轨（165幅干涉图）SAR数据。
与2006–2022年地震重定位深度剖面及1975–1984年裂谷事件地表拉张宽度历史数据进行对比分析。
li: The kinematic back-slip model assumes a uniform elastic half-space and a single vertical plane per segment, neglecting distributed ductile processes and 3D viscoelastic heterogeneities in the horizontal inversion.
Discrepancies between horizontal (5.83) and vertical (0.60) GIA scaling factors reflect oversimplifications in the 1D three-layer GIA model.
运动学后滑模型假设均匀弹性半空间和单一垂直位错面，在水平反演中忽略了分布式韧性过程和三维粘弹性非均质性。
水平（5.83）和垂直（0.60）GIA比例因子的显著差异反映了现有三层一维GIA模型的局限性。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcano-tectonic processes, magma-hydrothermal interactions, and seismicity depth distributions at the Krafla volcanic system in Iceland.
It models plate divergence, crustal locking depths, the brittle-ductile transition, and glacial isostatic adjustment along a divergent plate boundary.
A two-step Markov chain Monte Carlo Bayesian inversion framework is applied to jointly invert GNSS and InSAR velocity fields for kinematic parameters and uncertainties.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including equations, tables, and all 6 figures.

sum: This study systematically investigates the solubility of H2O and Al2O3 in stishovite and post-stishovite at 14–27 GPa and 1,500–2,300°C using multi-anvil experiments, SIMS, and FTIR. The results show that post-stishovite can incorporate significantly more H2O (1.1–2.0 wt.%) and Al2O3 (8.6–15.1 wt.%) than stishovite. Both solubilities increase with pressure and temperature. The compositional dependence of the stishovite to post-stishovite transition pressure suggests that chemical heterogeneity can shift the transition depth by several hundred kilometers, providing a robust explanation for the broad vertical distribution of mid-mantle seismic scatterers.
本研究利用大压机实验、二次离子质谱（SIMS）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR），系统研究了在14-27 GPa和1500-2300°C条件下，H2O和Al2O3在石英及后石英中的溶解度。结果表明，后石英可容纳高达1.1-2.0 wt.%的H2O和8.6-15.1 wt.%的Al2O3，明显高于石英。……

t: Multi-anvil apparatus experiments combined with SIMS and FTIR spectroscopy to measure H2O and Al2O3 solubility in SiO2 polymorphs.
结合大压机实验、SIMS和FTIR光谱测定SiO2多形体中H2O和Al2O3的溶解度。
Experimental solubility data of H2O and Al2O3 in stishovite and post-stishovite at 14-27 GPa and 1500-2300°C.
在14-27 GPa和1500-2300°C下，石英和后石英中H2O and Al2O3的实验溶解度数据。
Post-stishovite incorporates 1.1-2.0 wt.% H2O and 8.6-15.1 wt.% Al2O3, with solubility increasing with P and T, explaining mid-mantle seismic scatterers.
后石英可容纳1.1-2.0 wt.% H2O和8.6-15.1 wt.% Al2O3，解释了中地幔地震散射体。
The experimental system is simplified and may not represent the full complexity of multi-component natural mantle compositions.
实验体系较为简化，可能无法完全代表多组分天然地幔成分的复杂性。
First systematic determination of P-T dependences of H2O and Al2O3 solubility in post-stishovite, linking it to seismic scatterer depths.
首次系统测定后石英中H2O和Al2O3溶解度的温压依赖性，并将其与地震散射体深度联系起来。

kc: Quantified H2O and Al2O3 solubility in stishovite and post-stishovite under lower mantle conditions.
Demonstrated that post-stishovite can retain over 1 wt.% H2O, acting as a major water carrier.
Linked the compositional dependence of the stishovite–post-stishovite transition to mid-mantle seismic scatterers.
定量测定了下地幔条件下石英和后石英中H2O和Al2O3的溶解度。
证实了后石英可保留超过1 wt.%的H2O，是重要的载水介质。
将石英-后石英相变的成分依赖性与中地幔地震散射体联系起来。
me: High-pressure and high-temperature multi-anvil apparatus experiments.
Secondary-ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) for compositional analysis.
Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) for water content determination.
高压高温大压机实验。
用于成分分析的二次离子质谱（SIMS）。
用于确定含水量的傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）。
de: Experimental runs at pressures of 14–27 GPa and temperatures of 1,500–2,300°C.
Solubility measurements of H2O (0.5–2.0 wt.%) and Al2O3 (3.4–15.1 wt.%) in SiO2 polymorphs.
在14-27 GPa压力和1500-2300°C温度下进行的实验运行。
SiO2多形体中H2O（0.5-2.0 wt.%）和Al2O3（3.4-15.1 wt.%）的溶解度测量。
li: The study is based on simplified synthetic chemical systems which may not fully capture the complexity of natural subducting slabs.
该研究基于简化的合成化学体系，可能无法完全捕捉自然俯冲板块的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the solubility of H2O and Al2O3 in mantle minerals to explain the depth variation of mid-mantle seismic scatterers.
