sum: Seismic velocities depend on both density and elastic moduli, creating trade-off uncertainties when estimating reservoir gas saturation and geomechanical properties. This study proposes a joint measurement approach integrating cosmic-ray muon detection with seismic exploration to independently resolve P- and S-wave velocities into bulk density, bulk modulus, and shear modulus. Using Gassmann fluid substitution modeling, the authors first show that bulk density decreases linearly with gas saturation, overcoming the insensitivity of P-wave velocity at moderate-to-high gas saturations. They then validate the concept at the laboratory scale using a three-scintillator muon detector and 1 MHz ultrasonic transducers on acrylic and aluminum blocks. By calibrating muon flux against water depth to account for building structure effects, they estimate target densities and combine them with ultrasonic traveltime slopes to accurately recover the bulk and shear moduli of both materials.
本研究提出将宇宙射线缪子探测与地震勘探相结合的新方法，以克服地震波速中密度与弹性常数的耦合不确定性。首先利用Gassmann流体替换模型证明体密度随含气饱和度线性下降，有助于定量预测孔隙流体。随后在实验室尺度构建了三闪烁体缪子测量原型系统，结合1 MHz超声波换能器，对亚克力和铝块进行了联合测量。通……

t: The method integrates cosmic-ray muon transmission counts (calibrated via water depths to obtain density) with ultrasonic P- and S-wave traveltime slopes to independently calculate density, bulk modulus, and shear modulus.
结合经水深标定的宇宙射线缪子透射计数与超声波P、S波走时斜率，独立计算密度及体积、剪切模量。
Muon counts over 24-hour periods and 1 MHz ultrasonic waveforms across 15 receiver locations were collected on 20 cm cubic acrylic and aluminum blocks, alongside water tank calibration data.
在20厘米立方的亚克力和铝块上采集了24小时缪子计数及15个接收点的1 MHz超声波数据。

Estimated densities were 1.27±0.29 g/cm³ for acrylic (true 1.2) and 2.58±0.12 g/cm³ for aluminum (true 2.7), yielding bulk and shear moduli of 6.18 and 2.39 GPa for acrylic, and 65.99 and 24.29 GPa for aluminum.
估算亚克力和铝的密度分别为1.27和2.58 g/cm³，体积模量分别为6.18和65.99 GPa，剪切模量为2.39…
Muon counts fluctuate with barometric pressure and temperature, and the flux-to-density calibration must be recalculated if the detector position or building load changes.
缪子计数受气象因素波动影响，且标定关系随探测器位置或建筑负荷变化需重新计算。

First laboratory-scale experimental demonstration combining cosmic-ray muon radiography and ultrasonic wave measurements on the same target to decompose seismic velocities into density and elastic moduli.
首次在实验室尺度对同一目标联合开展宇宙射线缪子与超声波测量以解耦密度和弹性模量。

kc: Demonstrated via Gassmann fluid substitution modeling that decomposing seismic velocities into density and elastic moduli improves gas saturation estimation.
Developed a laboratory-scale prototype cosmic-ray muon measurement system calibrated using variable water depths and GEANT4 particle simulations.
Successfully separated P- and S-wave ultrasonic velocities into density, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for acrylic and aluminum blocks.
通过Gassmann流体替换建模证明将地震波速分解为密度和弹性模量有助于提高含气饱和度估算精度。
开发了实验室尺度的宇宙射线缪子探测原型系统，并利用不同水深和GEANT4粒子模拟进行了标定。
在亚克力块和铝块实验中成功将超声波P波和S波速度独立分解为密度、体积模量和剪切模量。
me: Gassmann's fluid substitution modeling for porous sandstone with varying gas saturation.
Cosmic-ray muon transmission counting using a three-fold coincidence plastic scintillator detector and linear water-depth calibration.
GEANT4 Monte Carlo particle transport simulation through a seven-story concrete building.
1 MHz ultrasonic pulse transmission measurements at 45-degree incident/oscillation angles to simultaneously record P and S waves.
针对不同含气饱和度多孔砂岩的Gassmann流体替换数值建模。
利用三重符合塑料闪烁体探测器进行宇宙射线缪子透射计数及水深线性标定。
利用GEANT4对穿过七层混凝土建筑的缪子进行蒙特卡洛粒子输运模拟。
采用45度入射和振动角的1 MHz超声波脉冲透射测量，同时记录P波和S波。
de: Numerical fluid substitution experiments for consolidated sandstone at porosities of 0.2 and 0.3 across gas saturations from 0.0 to 0.9.
Three 24-hour muon flux calibration sessions at five water depths (0 to 40 cm in 10 cm increments) on the 4th floor of a 7-story building.
Laboratory muon transmission and 1 MHz ultrasonic waveform measurements on 20 cm × 20 cm × 20 cm acrylic and aluminum blocks.
孔隙度为0.2和0.3、含气饱和度0.0至0.9的固结砂岩数值流体替换实验。

The empirical calibration between muon counts and density length is specific to the detector geometry, building structure, and upper-floor furniture layout.

缪子通量测量受气压和温度变化等气象因素影响而产生时间波动。

The method is motivated by reservoir monitoring, CO2 sequestration, and estimating gas saturation and geomechanical parameters in porous rocks.

sum: Deep learning models mapping seismic shot gathers to velocity models suffer from acquisition fragility and overconfident uncertainty under distribution shift. This study introduces a laptop-scale, physics-encoded deep residual FWI and uncertainty-calibration pipeline. Instead of raw gathers, a six-member heterogeneous neural ensemble receives a ten-channel Geometry-Invariant Physics Encoding (GIPE) comprising the starting model, an ADMM-regularized classical FWI prior, two misfit gradients, and six fast-marching illumination/wavenumber maps. Predictive intervals are calibrated via physics-conditioned Mondrian conformal prediction on synthetics and recalibrated out-of-distribution without labels using a held-out-shot wave-equation audit. Tested on 1000 synthetic models across six acquisition families, the ensemble reduces RMSE by 38% relative to the classical prior and transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries. On the 17 km Marmousi-2 marine benchmark, it lowers RMSE from 354 to 304 m/s while the audit restores collapsed conformal coverage from 0.42 to ~0.90 and flags elastic and wavelet physics mismatches.
针对直接映射炮集至速度模型的深度学习方法对观测系统脆弱且分布偏移下不确定性不可靠的问题，本文提出一种可在笔记本上运行的物理编码深度残差全波形反演（FWI）与校准框架。六成员异构集成网络输入10通道几何不变物理编码（含初始模型、ADMM正则化FWI先验、梯度及快速行进照明度图），输出速度残差与像素级方……

t: Variable survey layouts are mapped into a ten-channel model-space tensor via classical FWI/ADMM and eikonal operators. A six-member deep ensemble predicts velocity residuals and pixel-wise variances, calibrated by Mondrian conformal prediction and a label-free held-out-shot wave-equation audit.
通过FWI/ADMM和程函算子构建10通道物理编码，利用六成员深度集成预测残差与方差，并结合保形预测与留出炮波动审计校准…

Evaluated on a synthetic corpus of 1000 2D models (128x256 cells, 10 m spacing) across six acquisition families, plus zero-shot testing on the 17 km Marmousi-2 marine benchmark (20 m grid, 32 shots, 5 Hz Ricker wavelet).
采用涵盖6类观测系统的1000个二维合成模型数据集，以及17 km Marmousi-2海洋基准模型开展零样本测试。

On synthetic tests, the ensemble reduces RMSE by 38% (from 205 to 128 m/s) and transfers across unseen geometries. Zero-shot on Marmousi-2, it lowers RMSE from 354 to 304 m/s while the audit restores coverage from 0.415 to 0.888.
合成测试集RMSE降低38%（205降至128 m/s）；Marmousi-2零样本测试RMSE由354降至304 m/…
The audit requires propagation paths above ~2 km for perturbed wavefields to decorrelate, residual gains are capped where the classical prior is uninformative, and experiments are 2D acoustic.
短偏移距下审计缺乏敏感性，残差增益受限于先验模型深度，且实验仅限于二维声波合成数据。

Combines geometry-invariant physics encoding for zero-shot acquisition transfer with conformal synthetic calibration and a label-free held-out-shot wave-equation audit that restores out-of-distribution coverage and flags physics mismatch.
首次将几何不变物理编码与保形校准及无标签留出炮波动方程审计结合，实现跨观测系统迁移与分布外不确定性恢复。

Combines a six-member heterogeneous deep ensemble with physics-conditioned Mondrian conformal prediction stratified on illumination and depth.
Proposes a label-free held-out-shot physics audit that simulates predictive samples through unused shots to recalibrate interval widths and diagnose physics mismatch.

Demonstrates superior zero-shot geometry transfer and robustness compared to budget-matched gather-based baselines (InversionNet and source-conditioned Fourier-DeepONet variants) in ~90 hours on a consumer laptop.
提出几何不变物理编码（GIPE），通过经典波动与程函算子将可变观测系统映射为固定尺寸的10通道模型空间张量。

提出无需标签的留出炮物理审计方法，利用未参与反演的炮集开展前向模拟，在部署阶段重校准置信区间宽度并诊断物理失配。
在消费级笔记本上仅用约90小时完成全部实验，展示了优于同等预算炮集基准模型（InversionNet和源条件算子网络）的零样本几何迁移与鲁棒性。
me: Multiscale frequency-continuation acoustic FWI with water-column masking, illumination compensation, and reweighted-L1/total-variation ADMM refinement.
Ten-channel Geometry-Invariant Physics Encoding (GIPE) using adjoint-state misfit gradients and fast-marching eikonal wavenumber coverage maps.
Heterogeneous six-member deep residual ensemble (U-Net, residual CNN, attention U-Net) trained with heteroscedastic Gaussian negative log-likelihood.

基于异方差高斯负对数似然训练的六成员异构深度残差集成网络（U-Net、残差CNN、注意力U-Net）。

Zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluation on the full 17 km Marmousi-2 marine model (20 m grid, 32 surface shots, free-surface multiples).
Robustness sweeps across 11 full-line conditions and 36 crop-scale (4x2 km) conditions covering SNR (2 to 32), wavelet frequency/phase errors, shot decimation, and elastic-acoustic physics mismatch.
Ablation studies on coverage channels and acquisition augmentation, plus comparisons against two 35M-parameter gather-based baseline networks.

The residual formulation inherits the reach of the classical prior, capping accuracy gains in deep or unilluminated sections where the prior carries no information.

A heterogeneous six-member deep neural network ensemble predicts velocity residuals and pixel-wise log-variance from model-space physics encodings.

sum: Existing earthquake detection methods like STA/LTA or deep learning often require extensive parameter tuning, waveform templates, or large labeled training datasets. This study develops a parameter-light, training-free detection framework based on Benford's Law (BL), which governs the logarithmic distribution of leading digits in natural datasets. Using a sliding-window approach and adaptive noise normalization metrics, the authors analyze continuous vertical-component waveforms from two contrasting Indian subcontinent datasets: 275 intraplate events in the Deccan Volcanic Province (DVP) and 250 Gorkha aftershocks in the Himalayas (NAMASTE network). Results show that seismic energy onsets consistently conform to BL (~90% of waveforms exceed normalized threshold criteria), whereas pre-event noise does not. In the DVP dataset, the method achieves a 97.5% detection rate with zero false positives, and anomalies align closely with theoretical P-wave arrivals. The novelty lies in introducing normalized, threshold-free BL metrics scalable for continuous multi-station monitoring and ML pre-filtering.
针对传统地震检测需繁琐调参或大量训练数据的问题，本文提出了一种基于本福特定律（BL，自然数据首位数对数分布规律）的免训练、少参数地方震检测框架。研究采用滑动窗口与自适应噪声归一化指标，分析了印度次大陆两个不同构造区的连续垂直分量波形：德干火山省（DVP，275个事件）和喜马拉雅地区（NAMASTE台……

t: Sliding windows extract leading digits of bandpass-filtered vertical velocity amplitudes to compute chi-square Goodness-of-Fit (phi) to Benford's Law, normalized into baseline-adjusted (Delta_phi_N) and gradient-based (Delta_phi'_N) metrics for multi-criteria onset detection.
滑动窗口提取带通滤波垂直速度振幅首位数字，计算本福特定律卡方拟合优度及归一化指标以检测初至。

Continuous vertical-component broadband waveforms resampled at 25 Hz and filtered at 1-10 Hz from 20 stations in the Deccan Volcanic Province (275 events, 2403 traces) and 31 NAMASTE stations in Nepal (250 events, 6265 traces).
德干火山省20个台站（275个事件）和尼泊尔NAMASTE台网31个台站（250个事件）的1-10 Hz垂直分量波形。

Over 90.7% of DVP and 89.2% of NAMASTE waveforms exhibit strong BL conformity ((Delta_phi_N)_max > 0.5) at seismic onset, achieving a 97.5% detection rate (268/275 events) with zero false positives on DVP.
90.7%的DVP和89.2%的NAMASTE波形在初至处显著符合BL，DVP事件检出率达97.5%且零误报。
Temporal precision is constrained by the finite sliding-window length, creating a precision-stability trade-off, and detection sensitivity degrades for low-SNR or emergent arrivals.
时间精度受限于有限滑动窗口长度，且对低信噪比或缓变初至信号的检测性能有所下降。

Introduces adaptive, normalized Benford's Law statistical metrics (Delta_phi_N and threshold-free Delta_phi'_N) and validates scalable P-wave onset detection across multi-year, multi-station continuous arrays in contrasting tectonic environments.
提出自适应归一化及免阈值本福特定律统计指标，并在不同构造区多年多台站数据中验证了P波初至检测。

kc: Developed normalized Benford's Law (BL) goodness-of-fit deviation metrics (Delta_phi_N and Delta_phi'_N) that suppress baseline noise variability without requiring explicit amplitude thresholds.

Demonstrated universal BL conformity at seismic onset across two contrasting tectonic settings: the intraplate Deccan Volcanic Province (90.7% conformity) and the active Himalayan region (89.2% conformity).
Achieved a 97.5% event detection rate (268/275 events) with zero false positives on the Deccan dataset, outperforming untuned STA/LTA in stability.
Characterized the trade-off between statistical stability and timing precision controlled by sliding-window length, showing optimal window length scales with epicentral distance.
提出了归一化的本福特定律（BL）拟合优度偏差指标（Delta_phi_N和Delta_phi'_N），无需显式振幅阈值即可抑制基线噪声变化。
证实了板内德干火山省（90.7%符合）和活动喜马拉雅地区（89.2%符合）两种截然不同构造环境下地震初至均普遍遵循本福特定律。
在德干数据集上实现了97.5%的事件检出率（268/275）且零误报，稳定性优于未调参的STA/LTA方法。
揭示了滑动窗口长度对统计稳定性和时间精度的权衡控制，表明最优窗口长度随震中距增加而增大。
me: Sliding-window extraction of first significant digits from 1-10 Hz bandpass-filtered vertical ground velocity traces (step size 1 s, window length ~1/10 of trace duration).
Chi-square misfit calculation between observed leading-digit frequencies and theoretical Benford's Law logarithmic distribution, converted to a Goodness of Fit (GoF, phi) percentage.
Adaptive normalization using the 95th percentile of pre-event noise GoF (Delta_phi_N) and a gradient-emphasizing threshold-free metric (Delta_phi'_N).
Combined criteria-based P-wave onset detection requiring simultaneous satisfaction of phi(t) > 90%, Delta_phi_N(t) > 0.5, and Delta_phi'_N(t) > 0.5.
对1-10 Hz带通滤波的垂直分量地面速度记录采用滑动窗口（步长1秒，窗长约为记录总长的十分之一）提取首有效数字。
计算观测首位数字频率与理论本福特定律对数分布之间的卡方误差，并转换为拟合优度（GoF, phi）百分比。
利用震前噪声GoF的第95百分位数进行自适应归一化（Delta_phi_N），并构建强调梯度且无需显式噪声阈值的修正指标（Delta_phi'_N）。
采用联合判据进行P波初至检测，要求同时满足phi(t) > 90%、Delta_phi_N(t) > 0.5和Delta_phi'_N(t) > 0.5。
de: Deccan Volcanic Province (DVP) dataset: 20 broadband stations along a ~430 km W-E profile in western India (Jan 2020 - Dec 2023), comprising 2403 vertical waveforms from 275 ISC catalog events (<9 degrees epicentral distance).
Himalayan NAMASTE dataset: 31 broadband stations in Nepal (2015-2016), comprising 6265 vertical waveforms from 250 relocated Gorkha aftershocks with ML > 3.
Theoretical P-wave arrival time benchmarking using the TauP Toolkit with the AK135 global velocity model and sensitivity tests across sliding window lengths (40 s to 150 s).
德干火山省（DVP）数据集：印度西部约430公里东西向剖面的20个宽频带台站（2020年1月至2023年12月），包含ISC目录中275个事件（震中距<9度）的2403条垂直分量波形。
喜马拉雅NAMASTE数据集：尼泊尔31个宽频带台站（2015-2016年），包含250个重定位Gorkha余震（ML > 3）的6265条垂直分量波形。
使用TauP工具包和AK135全球速度模型进行理论P波到时基准对比，并在40秒至150秒的不同滑动窗口长度下进行敏感性测试。
li: Not a high-resolution sample-level phase picker, as seismic onset is identified as a statistical transition over a finite time window.
Requires choosing a sliding-window length, which introduces a trade-off between timing precision and statistical stability.
Reduced detection performance for low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) waveforms or highly emergent signals where the transition from noise is gradual.
并非高分辨率采样级震相拾取器，因为它是基于有限时间窗口内的统计转变来识别地震初至的。
需要选择滑动窗口长度，这在时间精度和统计稳定性之间引入了折衷。
对于低信噪比（SNR）波形或初至缓慢的微弱信号，从噪声到信号的统计转变不明显，检测性能会下降。

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates a statistical framework based on Benford's Law for local earthquake detection and P-wave onset identification in continuous seismic data.

sum: This study develops a discrete-event modeling framework to explain how geophysical systems progress toward catastrophic failure via sequences of distinct damage events. By modeling interevent intervals as shrinking geometrically and event magnitudes as constant, growing, or random, the authors demonstrate how logarithmic and power-law finite-time singularities naturally emerge. Extending the deterministic formulation to stochastic regimes via Kesten multiplicative processes captures intrinsic natural variability in critical failure times and precursory trajectories. Additionally, a mean-field damage model under constant or linearly varying stress links the power-law exponents of strain rate, event rate, and energy release rate to the evolving macroscopic stiffness of the system. Validated against numerical simulations and illustrated with field observations from landslides, glaciers, and volcanoes, this unified event-based perspective provides an intuitive physical foundation for interpreting precursory acceleration and improving geohazard early warning.
本研究开发了一个离散事件建模框架，通过几何收缩的事件间隔与恒定、几何增长或随机分布的事件幅值，揭示对数型和幂律型有限时间奇异性如何从加速重现的损伤事件中自然涌现。作者利用Kesten乘性过程将模型推广至随机系统，刻画了临界破裂时间和前兆轨迹的内在随机波动。此外，基于平均场损伤模型，在恒定或线性变化应……

t: Represents geophysical evolution toward failure as discrete damage events with geometrically shrinking waiting times and constant, geometrically scaling, or stochastic amplitude increments.
将灾变演化表征为等待时间几何收缩、幅值恒定或几何/随机变化的离散损伤事件序列。
Nine field datasets from landslides, glaciers, and volcanoes (displacement, tilt, rift length, earthquake count) alongside ensemble numerical simulations of stochastic recurrence equations.
滑坡、冰川和火山的9组前兆时间序列数据，以及随机重现方程的系综数值模拟。

Critical exponent m = -ln(ρ)/ln(λ) links time contraction λ and amplitude growth ρ; mean-field damage links strain rate (p_ε), energy (p_W), and event count (p_N) exponents via p_ε + p_N ≈ 2 or p_ε ≈ p_N.
导出临界指数m=-ln(ρ)/ln(λ)，并证明应变率与事件率幂律指数满足p_ε+p_N≈2或p_ε≈p_N。
Exponent relationships assume strain rate is primarily controlled by damage rate rather than stress rate, requiring caution when external stress evolves with strong nonlinearity.
指数关系假设应变率主要由损伤率控制，外加应力强非线性演化时需谨慎使用。
Provides a discrete quantum-like event-based framework and mean-field stiffness derivation that unify logarithmic and power-law finite-time singularities across deterministic and stochastic regimes.
提出离散事件框架与平均场刚度推导，在确定性和随机状态下统一了对数与幂律奇异性。

Generalized the event-based recurrence framework to stochastic time contraction and random amplitude growth using Kesten multiplicative processes.
Developed a mean-field damage model linking power-law exponents of strain rate, event rate, and energy release rate to macroscopic stiffness degradation.
建立了离散事件模型，证明对数和幂律有限时间奇异性源于几何缩短的事件间隔和演化的事件幅值。
利用Kesten乘性过程将基于事件的重现框架推广至随机时间收缩和随机幅值增长。
开发了平均场损伤模型，将应变率、事件率和能量释放率的幂律指数与宏观刚度退化联系起来。
me: Discrete-event recurrence modeling with geometrical contraction of interevent waiting times and geometrical or random event magnitude increments.
Stochastic analysis using Kesten multiplicative processes, Central Limit Theorem, and Levenberg-Marquardt calibration against ensemble numerical simulations.
Mean-field effective modulus damage mechanics under constant and linearly increasing stress conditions.
基于事件等待时间几何收缩及事件幅值几何或随机增量的离散事件重现建模。
利用Kesten乘性过程、中心极限定理及针对系综数值模拟的Levenberg-Marquardt标定进行随机分析。

de: Compilation of 9 observational time series of precursory acceleration across landslides (Brienz/Brinzauls, Preonzo, Abbotsford), glaciers (Grandes Jorasses, Weissmies, Amery), and volcanoes (Sierra Negra, St Helens, Merapi).
Synthetic numerical simulations (50 random realizations per stochastic setup) testing Gaussian, uniform, lognormal, and truncated power-law parameter distributions.
汇编了9个滑坡（Brienz/Brinzauls、Preonzo、Abbotsford）、冰川（Grandes Jorasses、Weissmies、Amery）和火山（Sierra Negra、St Helens、Merapi）灾变前兆加速观测时间序列。
测试高斯分布、均匀分布、对数正态分布和截断幂律分布参数的合成数值模拟（每个随机设置50次随机实现）。
li: Mean-field exponent relationships assume damage rate dominates over stress rate and may not hold when applied stress evolves with strong nonlinearity.
The present reduced-form models focus on general power-law trends and do not explicitly model log-periodic oscillations or dragon-king deviations near failure.
平均场指数关系假设损伤率占主导地位，当外加应力呈强非线性演化时可能不再适用。
当前的简化模型侧重于整体幂律加速趋势，未显式模拟临近破裂时的对数周期振荡或“龙王”事件偏差。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies finite-time singularity models to precursory acceleration observations from landslides, glacier breakoffs, and volcanic eruptions.
The paper models progressive damage accumulation, microcracking, and the transition from quasi-static deformation to elasto-dynamic runaway rupture.
The modeling framework aims to strengthen the physical foundations of early warning and time-to-failure forecasting for catastrophic geohazard events.

sum: This study investigates the effects of asymmetric fault-adjacent topography on supershear rupture and fault branch intersections using 3D dynamic rupture simulations. By comparing a branch fault system with a flat free surface to one with topography under uniform traction, the authors demonstrate that topography causes free surface-induced supershear to propagate more slowly and asymmetrically. Depending on initial shear stress, normal stress perturbations from topography can completely suppress the daughter crack in the slower direction, resulting in unilateral supershear rupture. Additionally, topography can facilitate throughgoing rupture onto secondary segments at intersections. These findings provide a physical mechanism explaining why some strike-slip earthquakes lack supershear rupture.
本研究利用三维动态破裂模拟，探讨了非对称断层相邻地形对超剪切破裂的影响。对比平坦表面发现，地形会导致自由表面诱导的超剪切破裂变慢且不对称。在特定初始应力下，地形引起的法向应力扰动可完全抑制单向子裂纹，导致单向超剪切破裂。此外，地形能促进破裂向次级断层传播，解释了部分走滑地震未发生超剪切破裂的机制。

t: 3D dynamic rupture simulations comparing strike-slip branch fault systems with flat versus asymmetric fault-adjacent topography under simplified uniform traction.
在简化均匀牵引力下，对比平坦与非对称相邻地形走滑分支断层系统的三维动态破裂模拟。
Synthetic numerical models of a right-lateral strike-slip branch fault system with simplified uniform on-fault traction and asymmetric topography.
具有简化均匀断层牵引力和非对称地形的右旋走滑分支断层系统合成数值模型。

Topography slows supershear propagation, causes asymmetry, can fully suppress daughter cracks in one direction (leading to unilateral supershear), and facilitates throughgoing rupture at intersections.
地形减缓了超剪切传播并导致非对称性，可完全抑制单向子裂纹，并促进交汇处的贯穿破裂。
Simplified uniform traction and idealized topography models may not fully represent the complexity of natural fault systems.
简化的均匀牵引力和理想化地形模型可能无法完全代表自然断层系统的复杂性。
First systematic exploration of how asymmetric fault-adjacent topography affects supershear rupture propagation and branch fault intersection behavior.
首次系统探讨了非对称断层相邻地形如何影响超剪切破裂传播及分支断层交汇处的行为。

kc: Demonstrated that fault-adjacent topography slows down and introduces asymmetry to free surface-induced supershear rupture.
Showed that normal stress perturbations from topography can suppress daughter crack formation, leading to unilateral supershear.
Revealed that topography can facilitate throughgoing rupture onto secondary fault segments at intersections.
证明了断层相邻地形会减缓自由表面诱导的超剪切破裂并引入非对称性。
表明地形引起的法向应力扰动可抑制子裂纹形成，导致单向超剪切破裂。
揭示了地形可以促进破裂在交汇处向次级断层段贯穿传播。

Implementation of simplified uniform on-fault traction to isolate topographic effects.
Comparison between flat free surface and asymmetric fault-adjacent topography models.
走滑分支断层系统的三维动态破裂模拟。

模拟具有非对称地形的右旋走滑断层系统的合成数值实验。

该研究采用了简化的均匀断层牵引力和理想化地形，可能无法完全捕获真实断层带的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D dynamic rupture simulations to investigate supershear rupture behavior and propagation along strike-slip branch fault systems.
It models rupture behavior at fault intersections and branch fault systems under the influence of topography-induced stress perturbations.

sum: Accurate traveltime calculation in 3D vertical transverse isotropic (VTI) media is hindered by point-source singularities and directional propagation errors. While a six-tetrahedron pyramidal finite-difference stencil yields second-order local accuracy with simple quadratic updates in unfactored form, introducing multiplicative factorization to remove the source singularity converts the local update into a complex quartic equation and complicates oblique-face updates. This study develops a 3D VTI fast sweeping solver that integrates both techniques. The authors solve the interior tetrahedral quartic equations analytically via Ferrari's method with causality root selection. For oblique stencil faces, horizontally constrained faces reduce to quartic equations by exploiting the VTI Hamiltonian structure, whereas mixed horizontal-vertical constrained faces are solved using a guaranteed monotonic bisection algorithm. Synthetic tests on a 3D homogeneous VTI model and the heterogeneous 3D Overthrust VTI model demonstrate a 37-fold reduction in average traveltime error compared to direct finite-difference methods.
本研究提出了结合乘性分解与六四面体金字塔模板的三维VTI介质程函方程快速扫描（FSM）求解器。乘性分解用于消除点源奇异性，而六四面体模板用于提高局部差分精度。针对分解后局部更新由二次方程变为四次方程及倾斜面更新复杂化的问题，本文在四面体内部及水平约束倾斜面采用Ferrari方法解析求解四次方程并施加……

t: Combines multiplicative traveltime factorization with a six-tetrahedron pyramidal stencil in a 3D fast sweeping framework, solving interior and horizontally constrained updates via Ferrari's quartic solver and mixed oblique face updates via bisection.
将走时乘性分解与六四面体金字塔模板结合，利用Ferrari法求解四次方程并用二分法求解混合约束倾斜面。
Evaluated on two 3D synthetic VTI velocity models: a 101x101x51 homogeneous model (100 m spacing) and a 321x321x161 smoothed 3D Overthrust VTI model (25 m spacing).
采用101×101×51的三维均匀VTI模型和321×321×161的三维Overthrust VTI模型进行合成测试。
In the 3D homogeneous VTI test, factorization reduces average absolute traveltime error from 0.014873 s (direct FD) to 0.000447 s (0.000393 s in text), with runtime increasing from 26.8 s to 36.7 s.
相比直接有限差分，平均绝对走时误差从0.014873秒降至0.000447秒，计算耗时从26.8秒增至36.7秒。
Factorization turns simple quadratic local updates into quartic equations and nonlinear face systems, causing a moderate increase in runtime (36.7 s vs 26.8 s).
乘性分解将原本的二次方程变为四次方程及非线性系统，增加了约37%的计算成本，且仅限VTI介质。

First integration of multiplicative source factorization with the six-tetrahedron pyramidal stencil for 3D VTI media, providing complete analytical quartic and iterative bisection solutions for all oblique stencil faces.
首次在3D VTI介质中融合乘性分解与六四面体模板，并推导出全部倾斜面的完整求解方案。

kc: Combines multiplicative factorization with a six-tetrahedron pyramidal finite-difference stencil in a 3D VTI fast sweeping eikonal solver.
Derives exact quartic update equations solved via Ferrari's method for tetrahedral interiors and horizontally constrained oblique faces.
Designs a monotonic bisection iterative scheme with proven existence and uniqueness for mixed horizontal-vertical constrained oblique faces.
Releases open-source code and validates accuracy on 3D homogeneous and complex Overthrust VTI models.
在三维VTI快速扫描程函方程求解器中结合了乘性分解与六四面体金字塔有限差分模板。
推导了四面体内部及水平约束倾斜面的精确四次更新方程，并结合Ferrari方法与因果性准则求解。
针对混合水平-垂直约束倾斜面设计了二分迭代求解策略，并证明了解的存在性与唯一性。
开源了算法代码，并在三维均匀VTI模型与三维Overthrust复杂模型上验证了高精度。
me: Multiplicative factorization of traveltime field (T = T0 * tau) using an analytical homogeneous VTI reference solution at the source.
Six-tetrahedron per octant pyramidal finite-difference discretization with eight-direction Gauss-Seidel fast sweeping iterations.
Ferrari's closed-form quartic solver coupled with backward characteristic ray-tracing causality checks.
Bisection root-finding on vertical or horizontal slowness components for mixed-constraint inclined tetrahedral faces.
基于震源处均匀VTI解析参考场的走时场乘性分解（T = T0 * tau）。
每个卦限六四面体金字塔有限差分离散化与八方向Gauss-Seidel快速扫描迭代。
结合反向特征射线追踪因果性检验的Ferrari四次方程闭式求解器。
针对混合约束倾斜四面体面的慢度分量二分求根算法。
de: 3D homogeneous VTI model (101 x 101 x 51 grid, 100 m spacing, Vnmo = 2500 m/s, V0 = 2000 m/s, eta = 0.2) benchmarked against a shooting method reference.
Smoothed 3D Overthrust VTI model (321 x 321 x 161 grid, 25 m spacing) validated against pseudo-acoustic wavefield snapshots.
三维均匀VTI模型（网格101×101×51，间距100 m，Vnmo=2500 m/s，V0=2000 m/s，eta=0.2），以打靶法参考解为基准进行误差对比。
平滑的三维Overthrust VTI模型（网格321×321×161，间距25 m），通过伪声波波场快照进行走时等值线验证。
li: Formulation relies on the acoustic VTI approximation and does not handle tilted transverse isotropy (TTI) where symmetry axis tilt breaks horizontal linear proportionality.
Solving quartic equations and bisection updates increases computational runtime by about 37% compared to the unfactored quadratic solver.
公式基于声学VTI近似并利用了水平慢度线性比例关系，尚未扩展至倾斜横向各向同性（TTI）介质。
求解四次方程和二分法更新使计算耗时相比未分解的二次方程直接差分法增加了约37%。

tm.why: The paper develops a finite-difference fast sweeping numerical solver for the 3D anisotropic eikonal equation.
The eikonal solver is specifically formulated and derived for 3D vertical transverse isotropic (VTI) media.
Accurate first-arrival traveltime computation via eikonal solvers forms the forward-modeling engine for traveltime tomography and seismic migration.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF read and analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Section 2, Algorithm 1, numerical experiments in Section 3, Table 1, and Figures 1-11.

sum: This study investigates the phase stability and thermoelastic properties of (Fe,Al)OOH solid solutions under lower-mantle conditions using first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations. By modeling the ε-to-pyrite (Py) phase transition along cold slab geotherms, the authors demonstrate that aluminum incorporation significantly shifts the transition to higher pressures and broadens the transition interval (up to 20–30 GPa for 40–70% Al). Fe-rich compositions drastically reduce seismic velocities and increase density, whereas Al-rich compositions exhibit elastic properties similar to the ambient mantle. These contrasting seismic signatures suggest that compositional variations in slab-derived (Fe,Al)OOH can explain observed seismic heterogeneities near the core-mantle boundary (CMB). The novelty lies in quantifying the continuous solid-solution effects of Al on the ε-to-Py transition and its direct seismic expression.
本研究利用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，探讨了下地幔条件下(Fe,Al)OOH固溶体的相稳定性和热弹性性质。通过模拟冷俯冲带地温梯度下的ε到黄铁矿型（Py）相变，研究发现铝的引入显著将相变推向更高压力并拓宽了相变区间（40-70% Al时达20-30 GPa）。富铁组分显著降低地震波速并增加……

t: First-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations combined with an ideal two-phase solid-solution model of FeOOH and AlOOH end-members.
结合FeOOH和AlOOH端元理想两相固溶体模型的第一性原理密度泛函理论计算。
Simulated thermoelastic properties and phase stability data of (Fe,Al)OOH solid solutions along representative very cold slab geotherms.
沿代表性极冷俯冲带地温梯度的(Fe,Al)OOH固溶体模拟热弹性性质和相变数据。
Al incorporation shifts the ε-to-Py transition to higher pressures, broadening the transition interval to 20-30 GPa for 40-70% Al, with Fe-rich compositions reducing seismic velocities.
铝的引入将相变推向高压并拓宽区间，富铁组分降低波速，富铝组分接近常态地幔。
The study assumes an ideal solid-solution model, which may simplify real-world non-ideal mixing and defect behaviors under lower-mantle conditions.
采用理想固溶体模型，忽略了非理想混合及缺陷行为。
First systematic quantification of the continuous compositional effects of Al on the ε-to-Py transition and its resulting seismic signatures near the CMB.
定量化了铝对该相变及核幔边界地震学响应的连续固溶体效应。

kc: Quantified the phase stability and thermoelastic properties of (Fe,Al)OOH solid solutions using DFT.
Demonstrated that Al incorporation shifts the ε-to-pyrite transition to higher pressures and broadens the transition interval.
Linked compositional variations in (Fe,Al)OOH to seismic velocity and density heterogeneities near the core-mantle boundary.
利用DFT定量研究了(Fe,Al)OOH固溶体的相稳定性和热弹性性质。
证明了铝的引入将ε到黄铁矿型相变推向更高压力并拓宽了相变区间。
将(Fe,Al)OOH的成分变化与核幔边界附近的地震波速和密度不均匀性联系起来。
me: First-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations.
Ideal two-phase solid-solution modeling using end-members (ε-FeOOH, Py-FeOOH, δ-AlOOH, Py-AlOOH).
第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。
使用端元（ε-FeOOH、Py-FeOOH、δ-AlOOH、Py-AlOOH）构建的理想两相固溶体模型。
de: Theoretical simulations of phase transitions and elastic properties along representative very cold slab geotherms.
沿代表性极冷俯冲带地温梯度的相变和弹性性质的理论模拟。
li: Relies on an ideal solid-solution model which may neglect non-ideal mixing behaviors or complex defect chemistry.
依赖于理想固溶体模型，可能忽略了非理想混合行为或复杂的缺陷化学。

tm.why: The paper models the phase stability and seismic expression of (Fe,Al)OOH solid solutions to explain seismic heterogeneities near the core-mantle boundary.

sum: Relay zones along faults act as barriers to earthquake propagation, constraining rupture sizes. Because observational biases complicate deterministic modeling of fault geometries, this study introduces a stochastic modeling strategy coupled with an iterative kinematic rupture algorithm. Fault traces are generated using power-law relay zone separation distributions (controlled by frequency constant Fc) and fault maturity thresholds (minimum separation Smin derived from cumulative displacement), while rupture jumping depends on the aggregate rupture-length-to-separation ratio (Jr). Sensitivity analysis of 1,110,000 realizations on a 10 km fault shows that lower segmentation and higher maturity promote rupture cascading, increasing maximum magnitudes and altering Gutenberg-Richter b-values (0.4–2.8). Applications to the Yushu-Ganzi-Xianshuihe fault, North Anatolian fault, and hydraulic fracturing in Ohio replicate observed magnitude-frequency distributions and recurrence intervals, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale structural controls improves seismic hazard assessment.
断层沿线的中继带可阻碍地震破裂传播，但观测偏差限制了确定性建模。本研究提出一种耦合随机断层几何生成与运动学破裂迭代算法的统计建模方法。该方法结合中继带幂律分布、断层成熟度（最小间距阈值）及破裂跳跃比，对10公里断层进行了111万次敏感性模拟，并应用于玉树-甘孜-鲜水河断裂、北安纳托利亚断裂及俄亥俄州……

t: Couples stochastic generation of segmented fault traces (using power-law relay zone separations and displacement-derived maturity limits) with an iterative kinematic rupture algorithm governed by a rupture-length-to-separation jumping ratio.
将基于幂律中继带间距和位移成熟度下限的随机断层生成与受跳跃比控制的运动学破裂迭代算法相耦合。
Evaluates 111 sensitivity configurations (1,110,000 ruptures) on a 10 km fault, plus three case studies: Yushu-Ganzi-Xianshuihe fault, North Anatolian fault, and Ohio hydraulic fracturing seismicity.
在10公里断层上进行111组配置（111万次破裂）敏感性测试，并分析鲜水河、北安纳托利亚及俄亥俄州三个案例。

Modeled b-values range from 0.4 to 2.8 depending on segmentation and maturity; case studies indicate M8.0 and M8.4 saturation with ~3 ky and ~20–30 ky return times for YGX and NAF, and 3% full-rupture (M4.2) in Ohio basement.
模拟b值在0.4至2.8之间；YGX和NAF最大震级达M8.0和M8.4（复发周期约3千年和2-3万年），俄亥俄基底达M…

Ignores stress transfer, aftershocks, aseismic slip, dynamic friction/fluid physics, stepping direction, and 3D depth-varying fault linkage, capturing only first-order geometric controls on mainshock rupture lengths.
忽略应力传递、余震、无震滑移、动态摩擦与流体物理及三维深部结构连接，仅捕捉一阶几何控制。

Integrates quantitative multiscale fractal fault segmentation and displacement-driven relay zone maturity into a stochastic kinematic framework, avoiding observational censorship of sub-resolution fault steps.
将定量多尺度分形断层分段和受位移控制的成熟度纳入随机运动学框架，克服了次分辨率阶区的观测截断偏差。

kc: Developed a stochastic kinematic rupture model integrating multiscale fractal fault segmentation and cumulative displacement maturity.
Conducted a sensitivity analysis of 1,110,000 realizations quantifying how relay zone frequency, jumping ratio, and minimum separation govern rupture cascading and b-values.
Validated the framework across three diverse tectonic and induced seismicity settings: Yushu-Ganzi-Xianshuihe fault, North Anatolian fault, and Ohio hydraulic fracturing.
开发了结合多尺度分形断层分段特征与累积位移成熟度的随机运动学破裂模型。
通过111万次模拟的敏感性分析，量化了中继带频率、跳跃比和最小间距对破裂级联和b值的控制。
在玉树-甘孜-鲜水河断裂、北安纳托利亚断裂和俄亥俄州水力压裂三个构造与诱发地震区验证了模型。
me: Power-law stochastic generation of 1D segmented fault traces bounded by minimum (maturity-controlled) and maximum relay zone separations.
Iterative kinematic rupture propagation algorithm where a rupture jumps a bounding relay zone if the aggregate rupture length to separation ratio exceeds a threshold (R/S > Jr).
Conversion of simulated rupture lengths to moment magnitudes via empirical and theoretical scaling laws to evaluate b-values and calibrated return periods.
基于受成熟度控制的最小和最大中继带间距边界，采用幂律分布随机生成一维分段断层迹线。
迭代运动学破裂传播算法：当累积破裂长度与中继带间距之比超过跳跃比阈值（R/S > Jr）时，破裂跨越障碍。
利用经验和理论标度律将模拟破裂长度转换为矩震级，以评估b值和标定后的复发周期。
de: Sensitivity analysis on a synthetic 10 km fault across 111 parameter configurations (10,000 realizations each, totaling 1,110,000 simulated ruptures).
Case studies comparing simulated seismicity against historical catalogs for the 1,000 km Yushu-Ganzi-Xianshuihe fault and 1,200 km North Anatolian fault.
Case study of hydraulic fracturing induced seismicity in Harrison County, Ohio, comparing 2 km reactivated basement and sedimentary cover faults.
针对10公里合成断层在111种参数配置下进行敏感性分析（每种配置10,000次实现，共111万次模拟破裂）。
对比1000公里玉树-甘孜-鲜水河断裂和1200公里北安纳托利亚断裂的历史地震目录与模拟结果。
俄亥俄州Harrison县水力压裂诱发地震案例研究，对比2公里长的基底和沉积盖层活化断层。
li: Omits stress transfer, aseismic deformation, slow slip, aftershocks, and off-fault seismicity, causing left-hand truncation at small magnitudes.
Excludes dynamic rupture physics such as frictional heterogeneities, dynamic weakening, regional stress fields, and pore fluid pressure.
Uses a simplified 2D kinematic representation that ignores 3D segment merging at depth, stepping direction (releasing vs. restraining), and segment overlap.
忽略了应力传递、无震形变、慢滑移、余震和断层外地震，导致小震级端出现明显的左截断。
未包含摩擦非均质性、动态弱化、区域应力场和孔隙流体压力等动力学破裂物理机制。
采用简化的二维运动学表征，忽略了深部三维断层段合并、阶区方向（张性或压性）及断层段重叠。

tm.why: The paper models earthquake rupture propagation, cascading across fault segments, and termination at relay zones.
The core focus is on internal fault zone geometry, relay zone breaching, fault maturity, and structural controls on rupture arrest.
The study evaluates maximum earthquake magnitudes, recurrence intervals, and b-values to improve seismic risk and hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 28-page PDF used, including all equations, sensitivity analysis tables/figures, and three case studies.

sum: This study applies the Seis-PickNet deep-learning model to build an expanded Pn-wave travel-time database for the southwestern United States. Using these high-quality picks, the authors perform Pn-wave travel-time tomography to construct a high-resolution velocity and anisotropy model of the uppermost mantle. The results reveal a strong correlation between active tectonic units, low-velocity anomalies, and strong anisotropy. Specifically, the model identifies independent thermal upwelling conduits beneath volcanic fields along the Colorado Plateau margins (e.g., Black Rock Desert, Uinkaret, and San Francisco volcanic fields) and supports the presence of ancient Farallon slab remnants beneath the central Great Basin. This work demonstrates how deep-learning-driven phase picking can significantly enhance the resolution of regional seismic tomography to image fine-scale mantle dynamics.
本研究利用深度学习模型 Seis-PickNet 自动拾取震相，构建了美国西南部更大规模的 Pn 波旅行时数据库。基于此，研究重建了该地区上地幔顶部高分辨率 Pn 波速度与各向异性结构。结果表明，活动构造单元与显著的低速异常及强各向异性密切相关。研究揭示了科罗拉多高原边缘火山区下方的独立热上涌通道，……

t: Deep-learning-based phase picking using Seis-PickNet combined with Pn-wave travel-time tomography to invert for velocity and anisotropy.
结合 Seis-PickNet 深度学习震相拾取与 Pn 波旅行时层析成像，反演速度与各向异性结构。
Regional seismic waveform data from dense networks in the southwestern United States, used to build an expanded Pn-wave travel-time database.
美国西南部密集台网的区域地震波形数据，用于构建扩展的 Pn 波旅行时数据库。
High-resolution uppermost mantle velocity and anisotropy models revealing independent thermal upwelling conduits beneath volcanic fields and Farallon slab remnants.
高分辨率上地幔顶部速度与各向异性模型，揭示了火山区下方的独立热上涌通道及法拉隆残留体。
Pn-wave tomography is restricted to the uppermost mantle and lacks vertical resolution to image deeper mantle structures.
Pn 波层析成像局限于最上地幔，缺乏对更深部地幔结构的垂直分辨率。
Integrating deep-learning phase picking (Seis-PickNet) with Pn-wave tomography to significantly expand the dataset and resolve fine-scale uppermost mantle structures.
将深度学习震相拾取与 Pn 波层析成像结合，显著扩大了数据集并解析出精细的上地幔顶部结构。

kc: Expanded the Pn-wave travel-time database for the southwestern United States using the deep-learning-based Seis-PickNet model.
Constructed a high-resolution velocity and anisotropy model of the uppermost mantle beneath the southwestern US.
Identified independent thermal upwelling conduits beneath volcanic fields along the margins of the Colorado Plateau.
Provided seismic evidence supporting the existence of ancient Farallon slab subduction remnants beneath the central Great Basin.
利用基于深度学习的 Seis-PickNet 模型扩展了美国西南部的 Pn 波旅行时数据库。
构建了美国西南部上地幔顶部高分辨率的速度与各向异性结构模型。
识别出科罗拉多高原边缘火山区下方独立的深部热上涌通道。

sum: Previous marsquake magnitude estimates rely on 1D velocity models, neglecting intense 3D crustal scattering that redistributes ballistic wave energy into prolonged coda waves. This study performs the first 3D spectral-element waveform simulations (using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE) for the largest recorded marsquake, S1222a, incorporating surface topography, Moho undulations, and 3D von Kármán random crustal heterogeneities. By fitting three-component waveform envelopes in the 0.04–0.08 Hz band against InSight SEIS recordings, the authors show that crustal heterogeneities with 20–50 km correlation lengths and 30%–40% maximum velocity perturbations are required to reproduce the multi-hour coda. Accounting for 3D scattering revises S1222a's moment magnitude to Mw 4.7–4.9, resolving discrepancies between 1D waveform inversions (Mw 4.2–4.3) and normal mode observations. Neglecting 3D scattering systematically underestimates marsquake and impact magnitudes by 0.2–0.3, significantly impacting estimates of Martian global seismic moment rate and impact crater scaling.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) using simultaneous-source (SML) encoding accelerates computation compared to sequential-source (SQ) workflows, but hybrid-domain discrete-frequency encoding introduces severe wavenumber discontinuity artifacts. Furthermore, automatic differentiation-based deep learning (DL) FWI struggles with high memory overhead and lacks wavefield decoupling for multi-source inversion. This paper proposes a unified adjoint-state-gradient coupled long short-term memory (LSTM) reparameterized FWI framework supporting both SQ and SML strategies. The LSTM network maps random feature inputs to velocity perturbations, regularizing updates by capturing long-range dependencies and mitigating high-wavenumber discontinuities, while phase-sensitive detection (PSD) achieves crosstalk-free multi-source gradients without heavy memory storage. Tested on the Marmousi II, Overthrust, and Canadian Foothills synthetic benchmarks and a 2D land seismic dataset, the LSTM reparameterization outperforms conventional and CNN-parameterized FWI. Specifically, DL-SML FWI delivers imaging accuracy comparable to DL-SQ FWI while achieving a 2.37x to 3.03x computational speedup.

sum: This paper proposes a 'pulsating Earth' geodynamic model to resolve 31 systemic contradictions in plate tectonics. The model is driven by coupled thermoelectric, electrochemical, and thermodynamic feedback loops operating within Large Low Shear Velocity Provinces (LLSVPs) and Ultra-Low Velocity Zones (ULSVPs) at the core-mantle boundary. Thermal gradients generate thermoelectric voltages (Seebeck effect), augmented by phase transitions and iron redox reactions. These voltages drive electric currents, causing Peltier heating, adiabatic compression, and conductivity increases. The resulting self-sustaining thermal cycles drive periodic radial expansion (generating extensional tectonics) and contraction (generating compressional tectonics). Quantitative validation shows the system generates a magnetic flux of 1.916e25 lines and a radial expansion of 324.4 km over 20 million years, matching expected physical constraints.
本文提出了一种“脉动地球”地球动力学模型，旨在解决板块构造学说中的31个系统性矛盾。该模型由核幔边界大型低剪切波速省（LLSVPs）和超低速带（ULSVPs）内的热电、电化学和热力学耦合反馈机制驱动。温差通过塞贝克效应产生热电势，并因相变和铁氧化还原反应而增强。这些电压产生电流，引起珀尔帖加热、绝热……

sum: The authors perform a nonparametric generalized inversion of horizontal S-wave Fourier acceleration spectra from 7,452 aftershocks of the 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule earthquake to separate source, path, and site terms. By analyzing 101,566 records, they find stable site responses and highly variable effective attenuation (Q0 approx. 30-160), with crustal events showing lower Q0 and stronger frequency dependence than slab events. Fitting source spectra with an omega-squared model reveals self-similar scaling above Mw 3.5, with median stress drops of 0.95 MPa (crustal) and 0.78 MPa (slab). Notably, a deep slab-related seismicity band (42.5–52.5 km) exhibits systematically higher stress drops (median 1.75 MPa). This highlights the importance of accounting for 3D path heterogeneity to accurately resolve source properties.
本文对2010年智利茂莱地震的7452个余震进行非参数广义谱反演，分离了震源、路径和台站项。结果表明，介质衰减（Q0约30-160）空间变化显著，地壳地震衰减更强。在42.5-52.5 km深度的俯冲板块内存在一个显著的高应力降异常带（中位数1.75 MPa）。该研究强调了精细刻画路径非均匀性对解析……

First application of spatially coherent event clustering in a nonparametric inversion to resolve 3D path heterogeneity and isolate localized deep stress-drop anomalies in the Maule sequence.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the data and source code associated with a study establishing a unified quadratic scaling relation between seismic potency and local earthquake magnitude (ML) across a wide range (-1.8 <= ML <= 7.5). The work addresses the long-standing issue of scaling discrepancies between small and large events by introducing a single quadratic formulation, bridging microearthquakes and major earthquakes.
该Zenodo仓库提供了用于建立-1.8至7.5级地震震源效能（potency）与地方震级（ML）之间统一二次定标关系的数据和源代码。该研究通过引入单一的二次公式，解决了小震和大震之间定标关系的差异问题，实现了微震与大地震之间的平滑过渡与统一表征。

t: Empirical quadratic regression analysis to relate seismic potency with local earthquake magnitude.
采用经验二次回归分析方法，建立地震震源效能与地方震级之间的关系。
A comprehensive dataset of earthquake potencies and local magnitudes spanning -1.8 to 7.5.

A unified quadratic scaling relation that successfully fits both microearthquakes and large events.

Potential regional dependence of the scaling parameters due to ML calibration differences.

A single, continuous quadratic relation spanning an unprecedentedly wide magnitude range.

sum: Twenty years after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, this study evaluates future tsunami hazards, coastal building exposure growth, and pedestrian evacuation efficiency along Thailand's Andaman coast. Using the Slab2 geometry, Okada dislocation model, and TUNAMI-N2 finite-difference shallow-water solver, the authors simulate 3,044 earthquake scenarios (Mw 7.8–9.4) along the northern Sunda Subduction Zone (Arakan, Andaman, and North Sumatra segments). Results show an Mw 9.0 Andaman segment rupture poses the severest hazard, producing wave heights up to 27 m at the Similan Islands and 19 m median heights at Khao Lak with arrival times under 90 minutes. Meanwhile, buildings in inundation zones nearly doubled between 2003 and 2024 due to tourism expansion. A novel GIS network analysis comparing official signage-guided routes against shortest road-network paths reveals that 82% of signage-based routes are longer (averaging 528 m extra distance), highlighting critical gaps in shelter capacity and last-mile signage.
本研究在2004年印度洋海啸二十周年之际，评估了泰国安达曼海岸未来的海啸风险、建筑暴露增长及疏散路线效率。基于Slab2模型、Okada位错理论与TUNAMI-N2有限差分浅水方程模型，作者模拟了巽他俯冲带北段3,044个Mw 7.8–9.4级地震情景。结果表明，安达曼段Mw 9.0级地震威胁最大，……

t: Simulates 3,044 subduction earthquake scenarios (Mw 7.8–9.4) using Slab2 geometry, Okada dislocation, and the TUNAMI-N2 finite-difference shallow-water model across nested grids down to 15 m, paired with ArcGIS Network Analyst evacuation routing.
结合Slab2、Okada模型与TUNAMI-N2模拟3,044个地震海啸情景，并用ArcGIS评估疏散路线。

Uses NOAA/NCEI historical tsunami records, 765 Slab2 subfaults, 5-m topographic DEMs, Royal Thai Navy bathymetry, 2003–2024 building inventories, and field-mapped signage networks in Khao Lak and Patong.
采用历史海啸记录、765个Slab2子断层、5米DEM、海军水深、建筑清单及实地疏散指示牌路网。
An Mw 9.0 Andaman rupture yields wave heights up to 27 m (Similan Islands) and 19 m median height at Khao Lak; 82% of signage evacuation routes exceed shortest paths by 528 m on average.
安达曼9.0级地震可在斯米兰产生27米波高；82%的指示牌疏散路线比最短路径平均多走528米。
Worst-case inundation modeling relies on a simplified uniform-slip source that may underestimate localized run-up, and static GIS route analysis omits road capacity and crowd congestion dynamics.
淹没模拟采用简化均匀滑动源可能低估局部爬高，静态GIS路网分析未考虑拥堵动力学。
Combines a 3,044-scenario northern Sunda tsunami hazard database with 20-year building exposure tracking and a novel GIS diagnostic framework comparing official signage routes against shortest paths.
将3,044情景海啸库、20年建筑暴露演变与对比指示牌和最短路径的GIS诊断框架相结合。

kc: Constructed a multi-scenario tsunami hazard database of 3,044 synthetic megathrust ruptures (Mw 7.8–9.4) along the northern Sunda Subduction Zone and performed 15-m nested-grid inundation modeling for worst-case Mw 9.0 scenarios across 12 coastal Areas of Interest.

Developed a transferable GIS network diagnostic framework comparing step-by-step signage-guided pedestrian evacuation routes against shortest road-network paths, finding that 82% of signage routes require an average of 528 m extra travel distance.

Quantified 20-year building exposure growth (2003–2024) in Khao Lak and Patong inundation zones, demonstrating a nearly two-fold increase dominated by hotels and commercial structures that severely exceeds government vertical shelter capacity.
构建了巽他俯冲带北段3,044个合成逆冲地震情景（Mw 7.8–9.4）的海啸危险性数据库，并对12个重点海岸区域的Mw 9.0最坏情景进行了15米高分辨率嵌套网格淹没模拟。
开发了可推广的GIS路网诊断框架，将基于指示牌的步行疏散路线与路网最短路径进行对比，发现82%的指示牌路线平均需多走528米。
量化了考拉和巴东海啸淹没区20年间（2003–2024）的建筑暴露增长，揭示了由酒店和商业建筑主导的近两倍增长严重超出了政府垂直避难所的容量。
me: Subduction fault discretization into 765 subfaults using the Slab2 geometry model, with rupture dimensions scaled via Wells & Coppersmith (1994) empirical relations and seafloor deformation computed via the Okada (1985) analytical model.

Numerical tsunami propagation and run-up simulation using the TUNAMI-N2 model solving depth-integrated nonlinear shallow-water equations with an explicit staggered leap-frog finite-difference scheme across nine nested grids (1,215 m down to 15 m).

GIS pedestrian network analysis in ArcGIS Pro (ArcPy Network Analyst Closest Facility tool) comparing sequential signage-traced routes against shortest road-network paths and classifying distance deviations into three efficiency tiers.
基于Slab2几何模型将俯冲带划分为765个子断层，利用Wells & Coppersmith (1994)经验关系计算破裂尺度，并通过Okada (1985)解析模型计算海底静态形变。
采用TUNAMI-N2模型求解深度积分非线性浅水方程，利用显式交错蛙跳有限差分格式在9层嵌套网格（从1,215米至15米）中模拟海啸传播与爬高。
在ArcGIS Pro中利用ArcPy网络分析工具对比按指示牌序列追踪的路线与路网最短路径，并将距离偏差划分为三个效率等级。
de: Global Historical Tsunami Database (NOAA/NCEI) records from 2100 BC to October 2025 and published paleotsunami/geodetic constraints along the Sunda, Andaman, and Arakan trenches.
3,044 synthetic earthquake scenarios (Mw 7.8 to 9.4 in 0.2 increments), including 162 Mw 9.0 scenarios across four segments (Arakan, Andaman–Arakan, Andaman, North Sumatra).

5-m topographic Digital Elevation Models (Land Development Department), Royal Thai Navy hydrographic bathymetry, field-mapped tsunami evacuation signage sequences, and 2003 vs. 2024 building footprint inventories in Khao Lak and Patong.
全球历史海啸数据库（NOAA/NCEI，公元前2100年至2025年10月）记录，以及巽他、安达曼和若开海沟已发表的古海啸与大地测量约束数据。
3,044个合成地震情景（Mw 7.8至9.4，间隔0.2），包含四个断层段（若开、安达曼-若开、安达曼、北苏门答腊）的162个Mw 9.0级情景。
泰国土地发展局5米地形数字高程模型（DEM）、泰国皇家海军水深数据、实地测绘的海啸疏散指示牌序列，以及2003年与2024年考拉和巴东的建筑分布数据。
li: High-resolution inundation modeling for the worst-case Mw 9.0 scenarios assumed a simplified uniform-slip distribution, which can underestimate localized peak wave heights and onshore run-up compared to heterogeneous slip models with shallow asperities.

The GIS evacuation route evaluation is a static geometric road-network analysis that does not account for road capacity, pedestrian crowd dynamics, or traffic congestion bottlenecks during peak tourist seasons.
针对Mw 9.0最坏情景的高分辨率淹没模拟采用了简化的均匀滑动模型，相比包含浅部凹凸体的非均匀滑动模型，可能会低估局部最大波高和陆上爬高。
GIS疏散路线评估属于静态几何路网分析，未考虑道路通行能力、行人群体动力学或旅游旺季的交通拥堵瓶颈。

tm.why: The paper evaluates regional tsunami hazards along Thailand's Andaman coast arising from potential Mw 7.8–9.4 megathrust earthquakes on the Sunda Subduction Zone, alongside coastal exposure and evacuation preparedness.

The study simulates regional tsunami propagation and coastal inundation across 3,044 earthquake scenarios by solving depth-integrated shallow water equations via an explicit staggered leap-frog finite-difference scheme (TUNAMI-N2).

ev.notes: Full text PDF (16 pages, Scientific Reports accepted manuscript) including abstract, main text, 8 figures, 2 tables, and methods was read and analyzed.

sum: Traditional analytical volcano deformation models assume an inflating cavity in an elastic halfspace, neglecting crustal visco-elasticity, magma transport, and magma compressibility. This study uses 3D thermomechanical finite-difference models (LaMEM) incorporating a spherical reservoir and a cylindrical feeding channel to self-consistently simulate magma injection, overpressure evolution, and surface uplift. Results show two opposing effects in thermally weakened visco-elastic crust: the same overpressure causes up to 5-fold more deformation, while the same injected volume produces up to 5-fold less overpressure. These largely cancel, yielding a net uplift reduction of ~15% in mature systems. Including magma compressibility (2e-10 Pa^-1) further slows overpressure buildup, reducing total surface uplift by up to 80% compared to elastic assumptions. Consequently, elastic inversions overestimate overpressure in thermally mature systems and underestimate intruded volumes by up to a factor of 5 in young/cold systems. First-order correction factors for the Mogi model are derived.
传统火山形变解析模型假设弹性半空间中的空腔膨胀，忽略了地壳粘弹性、岩浆运移及可压缩性。本研究利用三维热力学有限差分模型（LaMEM），结合球形岩浆房与圆柱形补给通道，自洽模拟了岩浆注入、超压演化及地表隆升。结果表明，热弱化粘弹性地壳存在两种相反效应：相同超压引起的形变增加达5倍，但相同注入体积产生的……

t: The authors use the 3D staggered-grid finite-difference marker-in-cell code LaMEM to solve conservation of momentum, mass, and energy with Maxwell visco-elastic rheology and dislocation creep for magma injection through a cylindrical conduit into a spherical chamber.
使用三维交错网格有限差分代码LaMEM，结合麦克斯韦粘弹性与位错蠕变流变学，模拟岩浆经圆柱通道注入球形储层的热力学过程。

Synthetic 3D numerical experiments testing 27 elastic benchmark setups, thermal maturities from 0 to 1,000 kyr, four crustal creep rheologies (quartzite, wet quartzite, granite, plagioclase), and magma compressibilities of 2e-14 and 2e-10 Pa^-1.
开展三维数值实验，包含27组弹性基准测试、0-1000 kyr热成熟度、4种地壳流变律及可压缩与不可压缩岩浆对比。

Thermal weakening changes uplift-to-overpressure and overpressure-to-volume ratios by up to 5-fold in opposite directions, yielding a net ~15% uplift decrease. Adding magma compressibility slows overpressure growth by ~70% and underestimates intruded volume by up to 5-fold.
热弱化使隆升/超压比与超压/体积比反向变化达5倍，净隆升减少15%；计入岩浆可压缩性使超压增长减慢70%，体积低估达5倍…
The model omits dike propagation, poro-(visco)-elasticity in magmatic mushes, complex multiphase volatile behavior, topography, and crustal faults.
未包含岩脉扩展机制、晶粥多孔粘弹性、复杂多相挥发分动力学、地表地形及地壳断层。

Models self-consistent overpressure evolution via a physical magma feeding channel rather than internal cavity boundary conditions, and derives first-order analytical corrections to Mogi equations for thermally weakened crust.
引入物理补给通道自洽模拟超压演化而非设定内边界条件，并推导了考虑地壳热弱化的Mogi模型一阶解析修正因子。

kc: Developed 3D compressible, nonlinear visco-elastic thermomechanical models of magma ascent through a feeding pipe into a spherical reservoir.
Quantified the competing effects of crustal thermal weakening: enhanced surface compliance vs. reduced reservoir overpressure, resulting in a net ~15% uplift reduction.
Demonstrated that magma compressibility reduces surface uplift by up to 80% relative to incompressible elastic models, causing up to 5-fold underestimation of intrusion volumes.
Derived first-order analytical modification factors for the Mogi equations using an effective visco-elastic shell thickness based on the 50-year Maxwell relaxation contour.
建立了岩浆经补给管道上升至球形储层的三维可压缩非线性粘弹性热力学数值模型。
量化了地壳热弱化的竞争效应：地表柔度增加与储层超压降低相互抵消，导致净隆升减少约15%。
证明岩浆可压缩性可使地表隆升相比不可压缩弹性模型减少达80%，导致侵入体积被低估达5倍。
基于50年麦克斯韦弛豫时间等值线定义了有效粘弹性壳层厚度，推导了Mogi方程的一阶解析修正因子。
me: 3D staggered-grid finite-difference marker-in-cell thermomechanical modeling using LaMEM.
Maxwell visco-elastic rheology with temperature- and strain-rate-dependent dislocation creep flow laws (quartzite, wet quartzite, granite, plagioclase).
Dynamic magma injection simulated via a prescribed parabolic vertical velocity profile in a basal cylindrical feeding conduit.
Benchmarking against Mogi (1958), McTigue (1987), and visco-elastic shell analytical solutions (Dragoni & Magnanensi, 1989).
使用LaMEM代码进行三维交错网格有限差分质点网格法（marker-in-cell）热力学数值模拟。
采用麦克斯韦粘弹性流变学，结合依赖温度和应变率的位错蠕变流动律（石英岩、湿石英岩、花岗岩、斜长石）。
通过在底部圆柱形补给通道施加抛物线型垂直速度剖面，动态模拟岩浆注入过程。
与Mogi (1958)、McTigue (1987)及粘弹性壳层解析解（Dragoni & Magnanensi, 1989）进行基准对比验证。
de: 27 elastic benchmark simulations varying crustal shear modulus (2, 10, 50 GPa), reservoir depth (3, 5, 7 km), and inflow velocity (1, 5, 10 m/yr).
Visco-elastic simulations across thermal maturity stages from 0 to 1,000 kyr of thermal diffusion prior to mechanical injection.
Comparative simulations testing four host-rock lithologies and compressible (2e-10 Pa^-1) versus nearly incompressible (2e-14 Pa^-1) magma.
开展27组弹性基准模拟，系统改变地壳剪切模量（2、10、50 GPa）、储层深度（3、5、7 km）和流入速度（1、5、10 m/yr）。
对经历0至1000 kyr热扩散预处理的不同热成熟度阶段进行粘弹性模拟。
对比测试四种围岩岩性，以及可压缩（2e-10 Pa^-1）与近不可压缩（2e-14 Pa^-1）岩浆的响应差异。
li: Does not model dike propagation mechanisms; limited to magma injection into pre-existing reservoirs via a wide cylindrical conduit.
Neglects poro-visco-elasticity of crystal mushes and complex multiphase volatile exsolution dynamics beyond bulk compressibility.
Omits surface topography, pre-existing crustal faults, and multi-intrusion thermal histories.
未模拟岩脉扩展机制，仅限于岩浆通过较宽圆柱形通道注入已存在的储层。
忽略了晶粥的多孔粘弹性以及除体积可压缩性之外的复杂多相挥发分出溶动力学。
未考虑地表地形、先存地壳断层以及多次侵入的复杂热历史。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D thermomechanical continuum modeling (LaMEM) to simulate magma transport, reservoir overpressure, and crustal visco-elastic deformation.
The study directly addresses volcano monitoring by quantifying how crustal thermal weakening and magma compressibility alter volcanic surface deformation.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, 9 figures, 1 table, and discussion sections.

sum: This study investigates focal mechanism variations along oceanic transform faults to understand the mechanical controls on fault segmentation. By analyzing earthquake source parameters, the authors demonstrate how variations in fault slip behavior, thermal structure, and pore fluid pressure influence the spatial segmentation of transform faults. The findings provide key insights into the partitioning of seismic and aseismic slip and the mechanical factors governing large earthquake ruptures in marine environments.
本研究通过分析洋中脊转换断层的震源机制解变化，探讨了控制断层分段的力学机制。研究表明，断层滑动行为、热结构及孔隙流体压力的空间差异显著影响了转换断层的分段特征。这些发现为理解海洋环境中地震与无震滑动的分配以及控制大震破裂的力学因素提供了重要启示。

t: Analysis of focal mechanism variations and centroid-moment tensors to characterize fault slip and stress state.

sum: Understanding microscale deformation mechanisms across the crustal brittle-plastic transition is crucial for modeling fault strength and earthquake nucleation. This study presents general shear deformation experiments on room-dry, 1:1 powdered quartz-albite mixtures using a Griggs-type solid-medium apparatus. Simulated depth conditions spanned 7–30 km (210–900°C, 185–870 MPa) with strain rates stepped between 1.4×10^-3/s and 1.4×10^-4/s. At shallower depths (≤18 km), samples exhibited strain hardening, friction coefficients matching Byerlee's law (0.7–0.8), and cataclastic grain comminution. At greater depths (24 and 30 km), samples underwent substantial strain weakening (friction dropping to 0.58 and 0.23, respectively). Post-mortem SEM, TEM, and autocorrelation function (ACF) analyses revealed interconnected nanocrystalline domains (grains down to 20–40 nm) without amorphous material at ≥24 km, alongside polygonal recrystallized quartz grains (200–900 nm) with triple-junction pores at 30 km. These findings provide unprecedented microphysical evidence that nanogranular grain boundary sliding and dynamic recrystallization concurrently reduce strength at the base of the seismogenic...

t: General shear experiments on 1:1 quartz-albite powders in a Griggs-type apparatus across simulated depths of 7–30 km with strain-rate stepping, integrated with SEM/TEM imaging and Weka-segmented Autocorrelation Function (ACF) fabric analysis.
利用Griggs装置对1:1石英-钠长石开展7–30 km模拟深度阶跃剪切实验，结合SEM/TEM与ACF组构分析。

Eight laboratory experiments (Z7–Z30 and hydrostatic Z10H) on ~0.1 g room-dry quartz-albite mixtures at 210–900°C and 185–870 MPa, sheared to strains of 3.4–5.6 at strain rates switched between 1.4×10^-3/s and 1.4×10^-4/s.

Samples Z7–Z18 strain-hardened with friction converging to 0.7–0.8, whereas Z24 and Z30 strain-weakened to μ=0.58 and 0.23, forming 20–40 nm crystalline nanograins at ≥24 km and 200–900 nm polygonal quartz grains at 30 km.
Z7–Z18应变硬化（μ=0.7–0.8），Z24和Z30应变弱化至μ=0.58和0.23，形成20–40 nm纳米晶及…

Electron beam damage in TEM prevented measuring crystallographic preferred orientations (CPOs) in nanograins, and piston grooves may have induced local stress concentrations affecting recrystallization estimates.
TEM电子束损伤阻碍了CPO测量，且活塞凹槽可能引起局部应力集中，影响重结晶估算。

First experimental series spanning the complete brittle-plastic transition up to 900°C and 870 MPa for quartz-albite aggregates, demonstrating fully crystalline nanogranular slip and dynamic recrystallization.
首次实现石英-钠长石跨越完整脆塑性转换带（达900°C、870 MPa）实验，揭示纯纳米晶滑移与动态重结晶机制。

kc: Conducted shear deformation experiments on 1:1 quartz-albite mixtures spanning the entire brittle-plastic transition (7–30 km simulated depths, up to 900°C and 870 MPa).
Demonstrated via TEM that localized slip zones at 24–30 km depths consist of fully crystalline nanograins (down to 20 nm) rather than amorphous material, driving weakening via grain boundary sliding.

Identified concurrent nanogranular slip, dynamic recrystallization of polygonal quartz grains, and creep cavitation at 30 km depth, constructing an updated experimental crustal strength-depth profile.
对1:1石英-钠长石混合物进行了跨越整个脆塑性转换带（模拟深度7–30 km，高达900°C和870 MPa）的剪切变形实验。
通过TEM证实24–30 km深度的局部滑移带由完全结晶的纳米晶粒（小至20 nm）而非非晶质组成，通过晶界滑移导致弱化。
发现在30 km深度处纳米晶滑移、多边形石英动态重结晶与蠕变空化同时发生，构建了新的实验地壳强度-深度剖面。
me: High-pressure, high-temperature general shear experiments using a Griggs-type solid salt assembly with alumina pistons cut at 45° and velocity stepping.
Multiscale post-mortem microstructural characterization using optical microscopy, FE-SEM, EDS elemental mapping, and FIB-TEM.
Machine-learning phase segmentation (Trainable Weka Segmentation in Fiji) combined with Autocorrelation Function (ACF) fabric analysis to quantify phase elongation and orientation.
使用配备45°氧化铝活塞和固体盐组件的Griggs型装置进行高温高压一般剪切实验及速率阶跃测试。
利用光学显微镜、FE-SEM、EDS元素面扫描和FIB-TEM进行多尺度变形后显微构造表征。
结合Fiji中的机器学习相分割（Trainable Weka Segmentation）与自相关函数（ACF）组构分析，量化矿物相伸长率与定向。

Mechanical stress-strain and friction coefficient time series at stepped shear strain rates of 1.4×10^-3/s and 1.4×10^-4/s up to shear strains of 3.4–5.6.
Microstructural images (stitched BSE, cross-polarized light, TEM bright-field/HAADF, SAED diffraction patterns) and ACF ellipse aspect-ratio datasets.

在1.4×10^-3/s和1.4×10^-4/s阶跃剪切应变率下达到3.4–5.6剪切应变的力学应力-应变及摩擦系数数据。

sum: This paper describes a new broadband ocean-bottom seismic (OBS) dataset collected offshore New Zealand's North Island as part of an amphibious experiment investigating the Auckland volcanic field. From August 2023 to September 2024, 20 OBS instruments were deployed at depths of 1200–2700 m, with 15 successfully recovered. The authors present comprehensive quality control metrics, including instrument orientations determined via Rayleigh-wave polarization (uncertainties < 7.5°), tilt characteristics (< 2.5°), and clock drift corrections (0.1 s precision) using ambient noise cross-correlation. The dataset shows excellent signal fidelity in the 2–20 s microseismic band. This dataset provides critical offshore coverage to complement land-based networks for studying intraplate volcanism and subduction zone dynamics.
本文介绍了新西兰北岛近海的宽频带海底地震（OBS）数据集，旨在研究奥克兰火山区。在深海部署20台OBS并成功回收15台。研究提供了全面的质控指标，包括利用瑞利波极化确定方位角（误差<7.5°）及利用背景噪声互相关进行钟差校正（精度0.1秒）。该高质量数据集为板内火山和俯冲带研究提供了关键的近海观测数……

sum: This study addresses the challenge of using distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) for earthquake early warning (EEW) by establishing a direct empirical scaling relation between DAS-derived peak strain rate (from the first 3 seconds of P-waves) and peak ground acceleration (PGA). Using long-term downhole fiber observations in Taiwan, the authors find a high correlation (0.93) between these parameters. They validate the relation using DAS experiments in a building basement and at Sakurajima Volcano, Japan, showing that the scaling relation is transferable across different cable settings and tectonic regions after a simple amplitude calibration. This calibration requires only five to six events to constrain a single correction term, demonstrating the high potential of urban telecom cables to augment on-site EEW systems.
本研究针对分布式声学传感（DAS）在地震预警（EEW）中的应用难题，建立了P波前3秒内DAS峰值应变率与共址地震仪记录的峰值地表加速度（PGA）之间的直接经验标度关系。利用台湾米仑断层钻井的长期下井光纤观测，该关系展现出0.93的高相关性。通过在日本樱岛火山和建筑物地下室的验证，证明该标度关系在振幅……

利用经验回归建立P波前3秒内DAS峰值应变率与共址PGA的直接标度关系，并用自助法进行校正。
Long-term downhole fiber observations in Taiwan (Milun fault), validated with DAS experiments in a building basement and at Sakurajima Volcano, Japan.

A strong correlation (0.93) between peak strain rate and PGA, with successful transferability demonstrated using a single correction term constrained by only 5-6 events.

Requires amplitude calibration using a few local events to account for site amplification, cable orientation, and coupling biases.
需要利用少量本地事件进行振幅校正，以消除场地放大、光缆走向及耦合偏差的影响。

sum: Strong seismic scattering in heterogeneous volcanic environments typically obscures deep magmatic plumbing in conventional seismic images. This study applies passive seismic matrix imaging with iterative wavefield aberration correction to publicly available 1–10 Hz vertical-component cross-correlation functions from the 2018 Lipari dense nodal array (46 stations). By redatuming the reflection matrix and compensating for scattering-induced phase distortions, the authors image relative reflectivity down to ~10 km depth, far exceeding the ~2.5 km limit of prior ambient noise tomography. The 3D reflectivity volume reveals steep reflectors (3–10 km depth) aligned with the Tindari–Letojanni fault, interpreted as a damage-zone corridor guiding vertical magma and fluid ascent. Beneath the San Calogero hydrothermal field, a continuous reflector at 1–2 km depth marks a candidate boundary between an altered clay-rich cap and a competent intrusion complex, providing a clear structural framework and monitoring targets for volcanic hazards.
火山区的强散射往往掩盖深部岩浆通道。本研究将被动源地震矩阵成像与迭代波场像差校正应用于2018年利帕里岛密集节点台阵（46个台站）公开的1–10 Hz垂向互相关函数。通过反射矩阵重定位和散射相位畸变补偿，成功反演了深达约10公里的相对反射率结构，远超此前背景噪声层析成像约2.5公里的深度限制。结果显……

t: 1–10 Hz ambient-noise cross-correlations are assembled into a reflection matrix, redatumed using a 1D P-wave model, and focused via iterative phase-screen aberration correction to extract confocal relative reflectivity.
将1–10 Hz互相关组装为反射矩阵，利用1D模型重定位，并通过迭代相位屏像差校正提取共焦相对反射率。

Publicly available vertical-component inter-station cross-correlation functions from 46 seismic nodes recorded over ~30 days during the 2018 Lipari Island experiment, band-pass filtered between 1 and 10 Hz.
2018年利帕里岛密集台阵46个节点约30天记录的公开垂向互相关函数，经1–10 Hz带通滤波。
Resolved reflectivity to ~10 km depth, revealing steep reflectors (3–10 km) along the Tindari–Letojanni fault and a continuous shallow reflector (1–2 km) beneath the San Calogero hydrothermal field.
揭示了深达10公里的反射结构，包括沿TLf断层的3–10公里陡立反射带和San Calogero下方1–2公里浅部连续反…

Seismic reflectivity represents relative impedance contrasts and cannot uniquely distinguish among aqueous fluids, cooled intrusions, or melt, while public data lack continuous waveforms for earthquake relocation.
相对反射率无法唯一区分流体、冷却侵入体或熔体，且公开数据缺乏用于地震重定位的连续波形。
First application of passive seismic matrix imaging with aberration correction to Lipari Island, extending structural resolution from ~2.5 km to ~10 km depth despite strong volcanic scattering.
首次将含像差校正的被动源矩阵成像应用于利帕里火山，克服强散射将成像深度从2.5公里拓展至10公里。

kc: Imaged the relative-reflectivity structure beneath Lipari Island to ~10 km depth using passive seismic matrix imaging, overcoming strong volcanic scattering.
Identified steep, deep reflectors (3–10 km) aligned with the Tindari–Letojanni fault that act as structural corridors for vertical magma and fluid transfer.
Resolved a prominent shallow reflector (1–2 km depth) beneath the San Calogero hydrothermal field, interpreted as a cap–intrusion boundary.
Proposed a tectono-magmatic model linking fault-guided vertical ascent to laterally partitioned shallow storage and identified priority hazard monitoring targets.
利用被动源地震矩阵成像克服火山强散射，揭示了利帕里岛下方深达约10公里的相对反射率结构。
识别出与Tindari–Letojanni断层一致的3–10公里深部陡立反射带，作为岩浆与流体垂向运移的构造通道。
在San Calogero热液区下方1–2公里处分辨出明显的浅部反射界面，解释为热液盖层与侵入体的接触边界。
提出了连接断层引导垂向运移与浅部侧向分隔存储的构造-岩浆模型，并确定了优先灾害监测目标。
me: Assembly of 1–10 Hz band-pass filtered inter-station cross-correlation functions into a frequency-domain reflection matrix.
Wavefield redatuming to a 3D subsurface focal grid using a 1D P-wave reference velocity model incorporating station elevations.
Closed-loop iterative wavefield aberration correction using dominant coherent modes in the wavenumber-difference domain to compensate for scattering.
Resolution and sensitivity verification using reflection point-spread functions (RPSFs), noisy synthetic tests in Gaussian random media, and reference velocity perturbations.

sum: This work presents the first operational Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) system developed for high-speed railways in Italy, specifically deployed on the Naples-Rome line. Utilizing a dedicated seismic network, the system detects earthquakes in real time, rapidly estimates expected ground shaking, and automatically issues alerts to the railway traffic control system within seconds. Its key innovation lies in its segment-specific alerting capability, which identifies and warns only the railway segments exposed to potentially damaging shaking. This allows for targeted mitigation measures (e.g., train deceleration or emergency braking) while minimizing unnecessary service disruptions across the network, demonstrating high reliability and operational efficiency.

sum: This paper introduces a community model aimed at facilitating integrated, multi-disciplinary studies of trans-crustal magmatic systems. Developed by an interdisciplinary team of seismologists, petrologists, and geophysicists, the model provides a standardized framework to combine seismic tomography, magnetotellurics, petrological constraints, and geochemical data. By integrating these diverse datasets, the model helps resolve the spatial distribution of melt, mush zones, and pathways within the crust, advancing our understanding of volcanic plumbing systems and hazard assessment.

sum: This study monitors the rapid geomorphic response of the Hakka River to a 3.5-meter coseismic coastal uplift caused by the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake in Japan. Using uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) surveys, the authors documented a maximum vertical riverbed lowering of 2 meters and an upstream knickpoint migration of 770 meters within the first year. These rapid changes were primarily driven by major post-earthquake floods. The findings show that fluvial terraces can form in less than a year following coseismic uplift. However, riverbed armoring from sediment sorting currently prevents the river from reaching a new graded state, suggesting that geomorphic adjustments will continue over the next decade.

sum: This paper introduces Neural-BEM, a novel computational framework that accelerates 3D earthquake sequence simulations with evolving elastic heterogeneities. Traditional boundary element methods (BEM) struggle with the computational cost of incorporating off-fault elastic heterogeneities. Neural-BEM addresses this by using a trained Neural Operator to emulate on-fault elastic stress transfer, mapping slip distributions and elastic heterogeneities to elasto-static traction changes. The fault slip equation, coupled with rate-and-state friction, is solved using a standard fourth-order Runge-Kutta method. The authors demonstrate that Neural-BEM matches the accuracy of traditional BEM while enabling the inclusion of static and evolving heterogeneities at a fraction of the computational cost. Simulations reveal that spatial variations in fault rock rigidity can induce interseismic locking and creeping behavior even under uniform rate-and-state parameters, highlighting the physical insights enabled by this accelerated modeling approach.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the simulated data and analyzed swarm sequences associated with the study 'Frictional Heterogeneities can induce Earthquake Swarms with Diffusive Migration Patterns'. The dataset includes numerical simulations of earthquake swarms under heterogeneous frictional conditions, alongside an Excel spreadsheet detailing the analyzed swarm sequences. It serves as a benchmark for understanding the physical mechanisms, such as fluid-like diffusion patterns, that govern swarm migration without requiring actual fluid injection, highlighting the role of fault-zone frictional properties.

sum: This paper presents a continuous distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) dataset capturing the 2 April 2024 Mw 7.4 Hualien, Taiwan, earthquake sequence. Recorded by the Milun fault Drilling and All-inclusive Sensing (MiDAS) project, the dataset spans 7 days before and 30 days after the mainshock, capturing 5,944 seismic events ($M_L \ge 0.0$). Although the mainshock and large aftershocks suffer from instrumental signal saturation, the dataset provides high spatial and temporal resolution recordings of small-to-moderate events. The data is openly shared in MiniSEED format with DAS channels represented as virtual stations, offering a valuable resource for studying fault-zone processes and earthquake sequence evolution.
