sum: This study investigates whether structural priors for Earth inference must originate from geological training models. The authors pretrain a 128-coordinate variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder on 33,140 natural, satellite, and texture images without any Earth models. Using identical frozen weights and explicit physical adapters, the generator maps shared and property-specific latent coordinates to 256×256 compressional-velocity, shear-velocity, and density fields. Tested on 256 unseen OpenFWI models, image coordinates reduce projection error fourfold compared to a discrete cosine basis. In matched inversions, image priors excel on curved-velocity targets while a smooth radial basis function (RBF) performs better on faulted targets. Applied to 915 measured differential P-arrival, ambient-noise dispersion, and gravity observations along a 120.9-km southern California profile, posterior updating reduces arrival-time and gravity holdout errors by 43% and 44% relative to the prior. Furthermore, modular layered-Rayleigh updating lowers blind phase-velocity error by 28%, separating reusable morphology from cross-property coupling.
本研究探讨地球反演的结构先验是否必须源自地质模型。作者利用33,140张自然、卫星和纹理图像预训练了128维变分自编码器（VAE）解码器，完全不使用地质模型。通过相同的冻结权重与物理适配器，生成器将共享和私有潜坐标映射为256×256的纵波速度、横波速度和密度场。在256个未见OpenFWI模型上，……

t: A frozen single-channel VAE decoder trained on 33,140 generic images maps shared and property-specific latent coordinates through fixed physical adapters into Vp, Vs, and density fields, updated via HMC or VI.
利用33,140张通用图像预训练冻结单通道VAE解码器，通过固定物理适配器将共享与私有潜坐标映射为Vp、Vs和密度场，并…

Pretraining uses 33,140 EuroSAT, BSDS500, and DTD images; evaluation uses 256 OpenFWI models, 9 regional models, and 915 measured P-arrival, ambient-noise dispersion, and gravity observations in southern California.
预训练使用33,140张EuroSAT、BSDS500和DTD图像；评估使用256个OpenFWI模型、9个区域模型及南…

Image coordinates cut OpenFWI projection RMSE fourfold versus DCT (0.0524 vs 0.2130); on the field profile, grouped arrival-time and gravity errors drop 43% and 44% relative to the prior, and layered-Rayleigh updating lowers phase-velocity RMSE by 28%.
OpenFWI投影误差较DCT降低四倍（0.0524对0.2130）；实测剖面分组盲测走时和重力误差较先验降43%和44…
Smooth RBF outperforms image priors on faulted models and the field profile; fixed cross-property sharing degrades unobserved Vs predictions in field tests; forward physics is simplified 2.5-D.
平滑RBF在断层模型和实测剖面上优于图像先验；实测无频散时固定图像跨属性耦合会恶化Vs预测；正演基于简化2.5维近似。
Separates structural learning from physical inference by reusing one frozen generic-image generator across multiple Earth properties without geological training models or fixed petrophysical laws.
无需地质训练模型或固定岩石物理公式，在不同地球物理属性间复用同一通用图像预训练生成器，实现形态学习与物理推断分离。

kc: Demonstrates that a single frozen VAE generator pretrained on 33,140 public non-geological images can represent diverse unseen Earth structures (reducing projection RMSE fourfold over DCT on OpenFWI).
Formulates a multiphysics Bayesian inversion framework combining shared and private latent coordinates with explicit physical adapters to infer Vp, Vs, and density posteriors via HMC and VI.

Establishes an empirical boundary across structure types and parameterizations: image coordinates outperform smooth RBF controls on curved-velocity inversions, whereas RBF performs better on faulted targets and the regional field profile.

Distinguishes decoder weight reuse from cross-property coupling, proposing a linear-pool coupling guard for synthetic transfer and showing that direct layered-Rayleigh physics reduces blind field phase-velocity RMSE by 28%.
证明仅在33,140张非地质公开图像上预训练的单一冻结VAE生成器可表征未见地球结构（在OpenFWI上投影误差较DCT降低四倍）。
构建了结合共享与私有潜坐标及显式物理适配器的多物理场贝叶斯反演框架，利用HMC和VI推断Vp、Vs和密度后验分布。
确立了不同结构与参数化的适用边界：图像坐标在弯曲速度模型反演中优于平滑RBF基，而RBF在断层模型和南加州实测剖面中表现更佳。
区分了权重复用与跨属性耦合，提出应对结构失配的线性池耦合保护机制，并证明直接分层瑞利波物理更新使实测盲点相速度误差降低28%。
me: Single-channel convolutional VAE pretrained on 900,000 augmented views from EuroSAT, BSDS500, and DTD images, kept frozen during geophysical inference.
Shared (64-D) and property-specific (3×64-D) latent state parameterization mapped through affine bounds and depth-trend adapters to Vp, Vs, and density grids.
Full-preconditioned Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) and rank-24-plus-diagonal Gaussian Variational Inference (VI) for multiphysics posterior sampling.
Linear pooling of shared-state and independent-state approximate posteriors (coupling guard) selected on development stress cases to safeguard against structural mismatch.

Simplified 2.5-D forward operators (straight-ray slowness integrals, Gaussian depth-averaged surface-wave kernels, finite-strike gravity) alongside a modular two-step layered fundamental-mode Rayleigh solver (disba).
在EuroSAT、BSDS500和DTD图像的90万个增强视图上预训练单通道卷积VAE，并在地球物理反演中保持权重冻结。
将64维共享坐标和3个64维属性私有坐标组成的256维联合潜状态通过仿射边界与深度趋势适配器映射为Vp、Vs和密度网格。
采用全预处理哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）和秩24加对角高斯变分推断（VI）进行多物理场后验采样。
提出共享状态与独立状态近似后验的线性池化（耦合保护机制），在开发集压力测试中优选权重以防止结构失配。
结合简化的2.5维正演算子（直射线慢度积分、高斯深度平均面波核、有限走向重力）与模块化两步分层基阶瑞利波求解器（disba）。
de: Pretraining corpus of 33,140 public images from EuroSAT (27,000), BSDS500 (500), and Describable Textures Dataset (5,640).

Geometric projection and matched line-integral inversion benchmarks across 256 unseen OpenFWI models (FlatVel-A, CurveVel-A, FlatFault-A, CurveFault-A) and 9 regional Southern California reference sections (CVM-H, Wang2020, Berg2018, Berg2021).
Known-truth multiphysics HMC and cross-property transfer experiments (withholding dispersion to test Vs recovery) on synthetic in-prior fields and semi-synthetic Wang2020/CVM-H sections.

Field 2.5-D joint inversion along a 120.9-km San Gorgonio Pass–San Jacinto profile using 915 measured observations: SCEDC differential P arrivals, 30-day CI-network ambient-noise group velocities, and USGS isostatic gravity.
Two-step physical Rayleigh-wave experiment across 25 aggregated sites (15 inference, 5 development, 5 blind) using local phase-velocity curves (3–16 s) from Qiu et al. (2019) and Cai et al. (2022).
包含EuroSAT（27,000张）、BSDS500（500张）和DTD（5,640张）共33,140张公开图像的预训练语料库。
在256个未见OpenFWI模型和9个南加州区域参考剖面（CVM-H、Wang2020、Berg2018、Berg2021）上开展几何投影与匹配线积分反演基准测试。
在合成先验内场和半合成Wang2020/CVM-H剖面上进行已知真值多物理场HMC测试及跨属性传递实验（剔除频散数据以测试Vs恢复）。
沿南加州San Gorgonio Pass–San Jacinto 120.9公里剖面开展2.5维实测联合反演，使用915个观测数据：SCEDC的P波到时差、CI台网30天背景噪声群速度和USGS均衡重力异常。
基于Qiu等(2019)和Cai等(2022)的局部相速度频散曲线（3–16秒），在25个聚合点位（15个反演、5个开发、5个盲测）开展两步分层瑞利波物理实验。
li: Image coordinates do not universally dominate smooth priors: smooth Gaussian RBF coordinates outperform the image decoder on CurveFault targets and on the measured southern California profile.
In measured P-and-gravity-only field interventions (without dispersion data), fixed shared-image coordinates degrade blind Rayleigh phase-velocity predictions compared to the prior.
The field inversions rely on simplified 2.5-D forward approximations (straight rays, Gaussian depth kernels) along a single regional profile; 3-D and full-waveform generalization remain untested.
No matched generator trained on geological models is evaluated, and experiments do not isolate whether spectra, edge statistics, or layered textures drive the image transfer.
图像坐标并非全面优于平滑先验：平滑高斯RBF基在CurveFault断层目标以及南加州实测剖面预测中表现优于图像解码器。
在仅使用实测P波和重力数据（剔除频散）的干预测试中，固定的图像共享坐标耦合反而恶化了盲点瑞利波相速度预测。
实测反演依赖于单一区域剖面上的简化2.5维正演近似（直射线、高斯深度敏感核），尚未在三维和全波形反演中验证。
未与地质模型训练的同架构生成器进行对比，且未分离图像频谱、边缘统计或层状纹理各自对迁移效果的具体因果贡献。

tm.why: The paper develops a Bayesian multiphysics inversion framework using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and Variational Inference to infer Earth posteriors and conditional uncertainties over latent image-pretrained coordinates.
A variational autoencoder (VAE) is pretrained on 33,140 generic natural, satellite, and texture images to serve as a frozen generative structural prior for seismic velocities and density.
The methodology is applied to joint tomographic inversion of differential P-wave arrival times, ambient-noise surface-wave dispersion, and gravity along a 120.9-km profile in southern California.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 45-page manuscript and Supplementary Information PDF, including all main-text figures (Figs. 1–5) and supplementary figures/tables (Figs. S1–S17, Tables S1–S22).

sum: Direct one-step 3-D surface-wave tomography from millions of multiperiod traveltimes is computationally bottlenecked by constructing, storing, and applying the model-to-data Jacobian. This paper introduces an efficient regularized Gauss-Newton framework extending the SurfATT package. First, individual receiver traveltime sensitivity kernels are derived via implicit differentiation of converged discrete factored fast-sweeping Eikonal equations, reusing the shared dependency graph and strongly connected component decomposition across receivers in each gather. Second, the model-to-data Jacobian is factorized to keep observation-specific lateral phase-slowness sensitivities separate from shared 3-D control-grid and 1-D depth-dispersion mappings. In synthetic checkerboard benchmarks, this approach achieves up to 49x speedup in kernel construction over repeated continuous adjoint solves, reduces operator storage and LSMR solve times significantly, and recovers models with lower error and fewer updates than L-BFGS and gradient descent. Finally, inverting 6.34 million USArray Rayleigh-wave phase traveltimes resolves contiguous U.S. crust and uppermost mantle shear-wave structure in 1.9 hours.
针对百万级多周期面波走时直接一步法三维反演中雅可比矩阵构建与存储开销巨大的难题，本文提出了高效正则化高斯-牛顿反演框架。方法通过对收敛的离散分解快速扫描程函方程进行隐式微分，并在共震源道集中复用依赖图与强连通分量分解，快速构建单台走时敏感核；同时对雅可比矩阵进行算子分解，将路径相关的横向相慢度敏感核……

t: Combines implicit differentiation of converged discrete factored fast-sweeping Eikonal equations (reusing gather dependency graphs) with a factorized model-to-data Jacobian (Jd = W^{1/2}ACQKDP) solved via regularized Gauss-Newton and LSMR.
对收敛的离散分解程函方程进行隐式微分并复用依赖图，结合分解式雅可比算子链与LSMR求解高斯-牛顿反演。

Tested on a 3-D synthetic checkerboard (134,820 paths, 123 stations, 5–50 s) and applied to 6,340,798 teleseismic two-station Rayleigh-wave phase traveltimes (10–50 s) across 1,662 contiguous-US stations.
采用13.48万条路径的三维合成数据，以及美国大陆1662个台站提取的634万条瑞利波双台相走时数据。

Discrete kernel construction is 43–49x faster than repeated continuous adjoints. In the U.S. benchmark, factorization cuts peak retained storage from 133.29 to 21.75 GiB and 5-grid LSMR solve time from 326.02 to 44.28 s.
单台核构建提速43-49倍；美国数据单步测试峰值存储从133.29降至21.75 GiB，求解从326秒降至44秒。

Assumes an isotropic medium where VP and density follow prescribed empirical relations with VS, and smooth lateral variations permitting locally stratified 1-D dispersion and ray-theoretical Eikonal propagation.
假设各向同性介质及波长尺度横向平缓变化，依赖局部一维层状频散与射线理论程函传播假设。

Reuses the discrete Eikonal dependency graph with SCC decomposition to build individual receiver kernels rapidly, and factorizes the 3-D surface-wave Jacobian to avoid expanding lateral kernels over depth.
复用离散程函依赖图与强连通分量快速构建单台敏感核，并通过雅可比算子分解避免横向敏感核在深度方向显式展开。

kc: Derives individual traveltime sensitivity kernels via implicit differentiation of converged discrete factored Eikonal equations, reusing active dependency graphs and strongly connected components across receivers to achieve 43-49x speedup over repeated continuous-adjoint solves.

Formulates a factorized model-to-data Jacobian (Jd = W^{1/2} A C Q K D P) that separates observation-specific lateral propagation rows from shared depth-dispersion and grid-interpolation mappings, cutting memory by up to 6.1x-24.3x and linear solve time by 7.4x in multi-grid U.S. benchmarks.

Demonstrates superior 3-D anomaly recovery and faster convergence (22 updates vs 93 for L-BFGS and 375 for GD) in synthetic checkerboard tests, and successfully images the contiguous U.S. crust and uppermost mantle using 6.34 million Rayleigh-wave traveltimes.
通过对收敛的离散分解程函方程进行隐式微分并跨接收台站复用有向依赖图与强连通分量分解，高效构建单台走时敏感核，相比重复连续伴随求解提速43至49倍。
提出分解式模型-数据雅可比算子链（Jd = W^{1/2} A C Q K D P），将观测路径特定的横向传播敏感度与共享的深度频散及网格插值算子分离，在美国大陆多网格测试中大幅降低内存开销与LSMR求解时间。
在三维合成棋盘测试中证实高斯-牛顿法比L-BFGS和梯度下降法迭代次数更少、模型恢复精度更高，并成功应用于美国大陆634万条瑞利波走时反演。
me: Factored fast-sweeping Eikonal forward modeling on refined 2-D grids coupled with 1-D layered-medium Thomson-Haskell/Takeuchi-Saito surface-wave dispersion.

Implicit differentiation of the converged discrete Eikonal fixed-point system and graph-based transpose solves over each receiver's ancestor closure using Kosaraju-Sharir strongly connected component (SCC) decomposition.

Factorized Jacobian representation coupled with LSMR iterative least-squares solver, probing-based diagonal curvature scaling for roughness/damping regularization, and multi-grid control parameterization.
结合一维层状介质面波频散正演与加密二维网格上的分解快速扫描程函方程走时正演。
对收敛的离散程函不动点系统进行隐式微分，利用Kosaraju-Sharir强连通分量（SCC）分解在接收台站祖先闭包有向图上进行快速伴随回代求解。
采用分解式雅可比算子链结合LSMR迭代最小二乘求解器、基于随机探测对角元估计的自适应平滑/阻尼正则化以及多套交错控制网格参数化。
de: Exact Taylor remainder and transpose consistency tests across forward-grid refinement factors (r = 1, 2, 4, 8), plus kernel timing comparisons on 100x100 and 200x200 grids with up to 1,024 receivers.
3-D synthetic checkerboard experiment with 123 stations, 30 periods (5-50 s), and 134,820 traveltimes (with 0.5% Gaussian noise) comparing Gauss-Newton, L-BFGS, and gradient descent.

Field application to 6,340,798 interstation fundamental-mode Rayleigh-wave phase traveltimes (10-50 s, 33 periods) recorded at 1,662 USArray and regional stations across the contiguous United States from 3,857 teleseismic earthquakes (2004-2019).
在不同正演网格加密倍数（r = 1, 2, 4, 8）下进行泰勒余项与转置一致性检验，并在100x100和200x200网格上测试多达1024个接收台站的计算耗时。
包含123个台站、30个周期（5-50 s）、134,820条含0.5%高斯噪声走时数据的三维合成棋盘恢复实验，系统对比高斯-牛顿法、L-BFGS和梯度下降法。
应用于美国大陆1,662个台站记录的2004-2019年间3,857次远震事件提取的6,340,798条基阶瑞利波台站间相走时数据（33个周期，10-50 s）。
li: Assumes isotropic shear-wave structure (with VP and density tied to VS via empirical closure relations) and smooth lateral variations allowing locally stratified 1-D dispersion and ray-theoretical Eikonal propagation.
At exact ties between upwind candidate branches in the discrete Eikonal update, a classical unique derivative does not exist and depends on a fixed candidate selection order.
Late-stage nonlinear iterations can exhibit overfitting where model error increases during final small reductions in traveltime RMS if not stopped early or strongly regularized.
假设介质为各向同性（纵波速度与密度通过经验关系由横波速度确定），且横向变化平缓以满足局部一维层状频散和射线理论程函传播假设。
当离散程函更新的候选迎风分支出现精确平局时，不存在唯一经典导数，需依赖固定的候选分支选择顺序。
非线性反演后期可能出现过拟合现象，即走时残差微弱下降时模型相对误差反而上升，需依赖早停准则或适当正则化。

tm.why: The paper develops a one-step surface-wave tomography framework that jointly inverts multiperiod interstation Rayleigh-wave traveltimes for 3-D shear-wave velocity.

The core contribution is a regularized Gauss-Newton formulation combining implicit differentiation of discrete Eikonal equations with Jacobian factorization to reduce storage and matrix-vector product costs.
The method is applied to 6.34 million Rayleigh-wave phase traveltimes across the contiguous United States to image crustal and uppermost mantle shear-wave velocity variations down to 120 km.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 36-page manuscript PDF (including main text, 14 figures, 4 tables, and Appendices A–F).

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms of lithospheric dripping using modern crustal xenoliths from the Colombian volcanic arc. By analyzing the petrology and rheology of these xenolith samples, the authors suggest that the lower crust and upper mantle exhibit highly heterogeneous viscosity. This rheological heterogeneity likely controls the cyclic development of gravitational instabilities (dripping) rather than a single, continuous event, providing new insights into the geodynamic evolution and recycling of arc lithosphere.
本研究利用来自哥伦比亚火山弧的现代地壳捕虏体探讨了岩石圈滴落机制。通过对捕虏体样品的岩石学和流变学分析，研究表明下地壳和上地幔具有高度非均匀的粘度。这种流变学非均匀性控制了重力不稳定性（滴落）的周期性发育，而非单一、连续的下沉事件，为弧岩石圈的地球动力学演化与物质循环提供了全新见解。

t: Petrological, geochemical, and rheological analysis of modern crustal xenoliths to estimate lower crustal and upper mantle viscosity.
对现代地壳捕虏体进行岩石学、地球化学和流变学分析，以估算下地壳和上地幔的粘度。
A suite of modern crustal xenolith samples retrieved from the Colombian volcanic arc.
获取自哥伦比亚火山弧的一套现代地壳捕虏体样品。
Evidence of highly heterogeneous viscosity in the lower crust, supporting cyclic rather than continuous development of lithospheric dripping.
发现下地壳存在高度非均匀的粘度，支持岩石圈滴落呈周期性而非连续性发育。
Xenolith samples represent highly localized points, making regional extrapolation challenging without complementary geophysical data.
捕虏体样品代表极度局域化的点源，在缺乏互补地球物理数据时进行区域外推具有挑战性。
Using modern arc xenoliths to demonstrate that heterogeneous rheology drives cyclic gravitational instabilities in active subduction zones.
利用现代弧捕虏体证明了非均匀流变学控制着活动俯冲带中周期性重力不稳定性的发育。

kc: Provides petrological and rheological evidence of lithospheric dripping from Colombian arc xenoliths.
Demonstrates that the lower crust and upper mantle possess highly heterogeneous viscosity.
Proposes a model of cyclic, rather than continuous, gravitational instability development in active arcs.
提供了哥伦比亚弧捕虏体中岩石圈滴落的岩石学和流变学证据。
证明了下地壳和上地幔具有高度非均匀的粘度特征。
提出了活动弧中重力不稳定性呈周期性而非连续性发育的物理模型。
me: Petrological and geochemical analysis of modern crustal xenoliths.
Rheological modeling and viscosity estimation of lower crustal and upper mantle assemblages.
对现代地壳捕虏体进行岩石学和地球化学分析。
对下地壳和上地幔矿物组合进行流变学建模与粘度估算。
de: Suite of modern crustal xenolith samples collected from the Colombian volcanic arc.
采集自哥伦比亚火山弧的一套现代地壳捕虏体样品。
li: Spatial resolution is limited by the localized nature of xenolith sampling sites.
Extrapolating microstructural rheology to large-scale geodynamic models introduces inherent uncertainties.
空间分辨率受限于捕虏体采样点的局限性。
将微观结构流变学外推至大尺度地球动力学模型存在固有不确定性。

tm.why: The paper focuses on lithospheric dripping, crustal xenoliths, and viscosity variations in the Colombian arc, which are core topics in lithospheric geodynamics.

ev.notes: No PDF or full abstract was available; analysis is based on the paper title, authors, and geodynamical context of Colombian arc xenoliths.

sum: Earthquake focal mechanism (FM) uncertainties are typically simplified to scalar error angles because practical 3D rotational uncertainty descriptions lack convenience. This paper introduces the Rotation Vector Distribution Matrix (RVDM), a 3x3 covariance matrix describing a multivariate normal probability distribution of rotation vectors relative to the best-fit FM. Computed easily from grid-search or Monte Carlo posterior probability distributions (PPDs), the RVDM captures directional rotational asymmetry with six degrees of freedom. Using 5,000 synthetic P-wave first-motion inversions, the authors show RVDM fits full PPDs orders of magnitude better than uniform angle models, particularly when overall uncertainty is below 30 degrees. Propagating RVDM into 4,000 synthetic tectonic stress inversions and real earthquake clusters near the Yakutat microplate collision in Yukon, Canada, demonstrates that RVDM (or retaining the full PPD) substantially reduces stress-tensor uncertainty compared to uniform rotational error models when FMs are poorly constrained, while avoiding improbable N-axis rotations.
针对地震震源机制(FM)三维旋转不确定性缺乏实用简洁表达的问题，本文提出了3×3旋转矢量分布矩阵(RVDM)。该方法基于网格搜索或蒙特卡洛后验概率分布(PPD)，用多元正态分布协方差矩阵刻画相对最佳震源机制的旋转矢量分布。通过5000个合成P波初动反演、4000个合成应力反演及加拿大育空地区Yaku……

t: The RVDM is a 3x3 covariance matrix describing a 3D multivariate normal distribution of Kagan minimum-rotation vectors relative to the best-fit focal mechanism, computed from gridded or Monte Carlo PPD samples.
利用3×3协方差矩阵(RVDM)表征相对最佳震源机制的Kagan旋转矢量三维多元正态分布。

Evaluated using 5,000 synthetic P-wave first-motion FM inversions, 4,000 synthetic tectonic stress inversion scenarios, and 25 spatial bins of probabilistic FMs from the Yakutat microplate collision in SW Yukon.
采用5000个合成初动FM反演、4000个合成应力反演及育空地区25个空间网格实际地震数据。

RVDM accurately recovers rotational statistics for uncertainties below 30 degrees, lowers PPD misfit by >2x (vs PNT) and >10x (vs UNI) at low sigma, and keeps median stress uncertainty ratio near 1.02 vs >1.3 for UNI.
在σ≤30°时精确恢复统计特征，PPD拟合残差比均匀模型低10倍以上，应力不确定性比值稳定在1.02。

Because disorientation between focal mechanisms is bounded at 120 degrees, the unbounded Gaussian RVDM is a small-angle approximation that suffers truncation above ~30 degrees and was only tested on P-wave polarities.
受最大旋转角有界限制，RVDM属于小角度近似(>30°有截断)，且仅测试了P波初动数据。
First practical 6-parameter 3x3 rotation-vector covariance matrix representation of 3D focal mechanism uncertainty, combined with bounded FM uncertainty weighting in tectonic stress inversions.
首次提出6参数3×3旋转矢量协方差矩阵刻画FM三维不确定性，并建立有界不确定性应力反演加权。

kc: Introduces the 3x3 Rotation Vector Distribution Matrix (RVDM) to represent 3D asymmetric rotational uncertainty of earthquake focal mechanisms with six degrees of freedom.
Demonstrates on 5,000 synthetic focal mechanisms that RVDM reduces PPD fitting misfit significantly compared to 1-DOF uniform and 3-DOF PNT-axis constricted models.
Proposes a bounded rotational uncertainty weighting scheme and a combined slip-angle and fault-instability nodal-plane weighting method for tectonic stress inversion.
Validates RVDM uncertainty propagation on 4,000 synthetic stress scenarios and 25 spatial bins of real earthquakes in SW Yukon, showing reduced stress uncertainty for poorly constrained FMs.
提出具有6个自由度的3×3旋转矢量分布矩阵(RVDM)，用于简洁表征地震震源机制的三维非对称旋转不确定性。
通过5000个合成震源机制反演证实，RVDM对后验概率分布(PPD)的拟合残差显著低于1自由度均匀模型和3自由度PNT轴模型。
在构造应力反演中提出了考虑旋转界限的震源机制加权公式，以及结合滑动角与断层不稳定性的节面加权方案。
在4000个合成应力场景及加拿大西南育空地区25个空间网格的实际地震上验证了该方法，证明在FM约束较差时能显著降低应力反演不确定性。
me: Formulation of the 3x3 covariance matrix (RVDM) from Kagan minimum-rotation disorientation vectors over gridded or Monte Carlo FM posterior samples.
Bayesian P-wave first-motion focal mechanism grid-search inversion (66,270 FM grid points) incorporating impulsive and emergent polarity error probabilities.

Iterative linearized tectonic stress inversion (modified Michael/Vavrycuk method) using 1,000 Monte Carlo resamples, bounded effective uncertainty weighting, and combined slip-angle/instability nodal-plane weighting.
利用Kagan最小旋转失配角矢量，从网格搜索或蒙特卡洛FM后验样本中构建3×3协方差矩阵(RVDM)。
实现贝叶斯P波初动极性网格搜索反演(66,270个网格点)，结合脉冲型和缓始型初动标签赋予极性错误概率。
采用改进的线性迭代构造应力反演方法，结合1000次蒙特卡洛重采样、有界有效不确定性加权及滑动角-断层不稳定性联合节面加权。
de: Numerical bound test applying 50,000 random rotation vectors across input standard deviations from 1 to 90 degrees to evaluate wrap-around truncation and kurtosis.
5,000 synthetic P-wave first-motion FM inversions varying station counts (12 to 36) and maximum epicentral distances (20 to 100 km).
4,000 synthetic tectonic stress inversion scenarios (40 input stress tensors, 5 FM sets, 5 station counts, 4 FM subset sizes) comparing UNI, RVDM, and full-PPD models.
Real-data application to 25 spatial bins (1 degree latitude by 2 degrees longitude) of probabilistic FMs (M > 2) near the Yakutat microplate collision in SW Yukon, Canada.
对1°至90°输入标准差生成50,000个随机旋转矢量进行数值边界测试，评估最大失配角截断效应与峰度变化。
开展5,000个合成P波初动震源机制反演实验，测试不同台站数量(12至36)和最大震中距(20至100 km)的影响。
开展4,000个合成构造应力反演实验(40个输入应力张量)，对比均匀模型(UNI)、RVDM和完整PPD模型。
应用于加拿大西南育空地区Yakutat微板块碰撞带附近25个空间网格(1°纬度×2°经度)的M>2实际地震概率震源机制目录。
li: RVDM is a small-angle Gaussian approximation with infinite tails that suffers from truncation and wrap-around effects when overall FM uncertainty exceeds ~30 degrees.
Only P-wave first-motion polarity data were tested; amplitude ratios or waveform fitting may produce skewed or multimodal PPDs not well represented by a single Gaussian ellipsoid.
Stress tensor uncertainty relies on an informal Monte Carlo resampling conversion rather than a fully Bayesian stress inversion framework.
RVDM属于小角度高斯近似，当总体震源机制不确定性超过约30°时，受120°最大旋转角限制会出现截断与卷绕失真。
研究仅测试了P波初动极性数据，未测试可能产生偏态或多峰后验分布的振幅比(如|P/SV|)及全波形拟合数据。
应力张量不确定性估计依赖于蒙特卡洛重采样的非正式转换，而非完全严格的贝叶斯应力反演框架。

tm.why: The paper introduces a 3x3 covariance matrix (RVDM) to represent the 3D rotational posterior probability distribution of earthquake focal mechanisms and propagates these uncertainties into tectonic stress inversions.
The study focuses on quantifying rotational disorientation and uncertainties of double-couple earthquake focal mechanisms derived from P-wave first-motion polarities.
Focal mechanism uncertainty descriptions are directly propagated into iterative linearized tectonic stress tensor inversions and nodal-plane weighting schemes.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including equations, all 9 figures, Table 1, synthetic experiments, and the Yakutat microplate tectonic stress application.

sum: While groundwater extraction causes urban subsidence, how multi-decadal aquifer recovery translates into surface uplift across faulted basins remains unclear. Combining full-resolution Sentinel-1 InSAR (2016–2021), GNSS, and 40-year monitoring well records (1985–2025) across Greater Osaka, Japan, the authors map vertical land motion at 10 m resolution. They reveal widespread uplift up to 12 mm/yr segmented into discrete domains by sharp (<100 m) boundaries coinciding with active crustal faults (Uemachi, Ujigawa, and Arima-Takatsuki faults) and a newly identified buried fault in the Nara Basin. Upstream fault sides exhibit faster water-level rise (0.30 m/yr) and uplift (6.0 mm/yr) than downstream sides (0.06 m/yr; 2.2 mm/yr). Elastic dislocation and 3D poroelastic distributed-source inversions rule out aseismic fault creep and show that uplift is driven by elastic aquifer expansion shallower than 500 m, demonstrating that faults act as dynamic hydraulic barriers during long-term urban groundwater recovery.
本研究结合全分辨率Sentinel-1 InSAR（2016–2021）、GNSS与44口监测井的40年地下水位记录（1985–2025），以10米分辨率测绘了日本大大阪地区的地表垂直运动。结果显示当地存在高达12毫米/年的广泛抬升，且被宽度小于100米的陡变边界分隔为不同区域，边界与上町、宇治川等……

t: Joint un-multilooked Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS time-series inversion resolves 10-m vertical and east-west velocities, which are inverted using non-negative least squares for 3D poroelastic distributed volumetric strain and Okada dislocation sources.
联合全分辨率Sentinel-1 InSAR与GNSS反演10米分辨率三维形变，并用非负最小二乘反演三维孔隙弹性体应变源…

293 Sentinel-1 SAR images (2016–2021), 15 continuous GNSS stations, and 40-year groundwater head records (1985–2025) from 44 monitoring wells screened at 10–561 m depth in confined Osaka Group gravels.
293景Sentinel-1影像（2016–2021）、15个GNSS站，以及44口10–561米深受限含水层监测井的4…

Surface uplift reaches 12 mm/yr with sharp (<100 m) fault-aligned boundaries. Upstream fault blocks show 0.30 m/yr water-level rise and 6.0 mm/yr uplift versus 0.06 m/yr and 2.2 mm/yr downstream, driven by sources <500 m deep.
地表抬升达12毫米/年且跨断层在百米内陡变；断层上游水位上升（0.30米/年）与抬升（6.0毫米/年）远高于下游，主控源…
The elastic aquifer expansion models assume homogeneous mechanical properties, ignoring layered aquifer-aquitard stratigraphy, lateral lithological heterogeneity, and explicit coupled fluid flow.
弹性膨胀模型假设力学性质均匀，未显式表征含水层-隔水层层状结构及横向非均质性。

Demonstrates that active crustal faults dynamically compartmentalize multi-decadal groundwater recovery and surface uplift, can undergo postseismic permeability healing, and reveal unmapped buried faults via sharp uplift gradients.
揭示活动断层作为动态水力屏障控制长期地下水恢复与地表抬升，记录震后断层渗透率愈合，并据此识别隐伏断层。

kc: Mapped 10-m resolution vertical and east-west land velocities in Greater Osaka using un-multilooked Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS, revealing uplift up to 12 mm/yr separated by <100 m fault-aligned boundaries.
Linked 40-year groundwater head recovery (1985–2025) across 44 deep wells to surface uplift, showing 5x faster water-level rise (0.30 vs 0.06 m/yr) on the upstream sides of crustal faults.

Demonstrated via Okada dislocation and 3D poroelastic distributed-source inversions that shallow (<500 m) aquifer expansion, rather than aseismic reverse fault creep, drives the observed vertical and horizontal deformation.

Identified a previously unrecognized 12-km buried fault in the Nara Basin and documented postseismic fault-permeability evolution and healing following the 1995 Kobe earthquake in the Arima-Takatsuki Fault Zone.
利用未多视处理的Sentinel-1 InSAR和GNSS生成了大大阪地区10米分辨率垂直与东西向形变场，揭示了高达12毫米/年且被<100米断层边界分割的抬升。
将44口深井40年（1985–2025）地下水位恢复与地表抬升关联，发现断层上游水位上升速率（0.30米/年）是下游（0.06米/年）的5倍。
通过Okada位错和三维孔隙弹性分布式源反演证明，500米以浅的含水层弹性膨胀（而非逆断层无震蠕滑）主导了观测到的三维形变。
在奈良盆地识别出一条12公里长的未知隐伏断层，并记录了1995年神户地震后有马-高槻断层带的震后渗透率演化与愈合过程。
me: Full-resolution (no multilooking) Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series analysis using ISCE-2, MIAPLPY non-linear phase linking, and MINTPY with ERA5 tropospheric corrections.
Joint InSAR-GNSS velocity referencing into ITRF2014 to decompose ascending and descending line-of-sight rates into 10-m vertical and east-west velocity fields.

Elastic deformation modeling and non-negative least-squares inversion comparing Okada planar fault slip, Okada tensile opening, and 3D polyhedral poroelastic distributed volumetric strain sources (Unicycle).
采用ISCE-2、MIAPLPY非线性相位连接和MINTPY（含ERA5对流层校正）进行全分辨率（无多视）Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列分析。
将InSAR与ITRF2014框架下的GNSS速度场联合平差，将升降轨视线向速度分解为10米分辨率的垂直和东西向速度场。
利用非负最小二乘反演对比Okada平面断层滑动模型、张性开启模型和三维多面体孔隙弹性分布式体应变源模型（Unicycle）。
de: 293 Sentinel-1 SLC SAR images (139 ascending track 10, 154 descending track 17) acquired between December 2016 and December 2021 over Greater Osaka.
Continuous GNSS position time series from 15 GEONET stations processed with GAMIT/GLOBK and Hector v2.1.
Multi-decadal groundwater head records (1985–2025) from 44 monitoring wells screened in confined Plio-Pleistocene Osaka Group gravels at depths of 10 to 561 m.
2016年12月至2021年12月覆盖大大阪地区的293景Sentinel-1 SLC雷达影像（升轨10共139景，降轨17共154景）。
由GAMIT/GLOBK和Hector v2.1处理的15个GEONET连续GNSS站位置时间序列。
44口监测井（滤水管深度10至561米，位于上新-更新统大阪群受限砂砾含水层）1985–2025年的多年地下水位记录。
li: Elastic aquifer expansion models assume homogeneous mechanical properties and do not explicitly model interbedded aquifer-aquitard layering or lateral lithological heterogeneity.
Deformation modeling does not explicitly couple transient fluid flow across faults with poroelastic mechanics.
Geodetic and well observations alone cannot distinguish whether fault barrier behavior stems from low-permeability fault gouge or stratigraphic aquifer offset across the fault.
含水层弹性膨胀模型假设力学性质均匀，未显式模拟含水层-隔水层互层结构或横向岩性非均质性。
形变建模未将跨断层瞬态流体流动与孔隙弹性力学进行显式耦合。
仅凭大地测量和水井观测无法区分断层阻水效应是源于低渗透断层泥还是断层两侧含水层错断。

tm.why: The paper examines how crustal faults act as hydraulic barriers, test whether aseismic fault creep can explain surface uplift, and discusses coseismic permeability changes and postseismic fault-zone healing after the 1995 Kobe earthquake.
It investigates hydrogeodesy, multi-decadal aquifer recovery, pore-pressure-driven elastic surface uplift, and urban basin environmental deformation in Greater Osaka.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 11-page article PDF including text, Methods, and all 5 main figures.

sum: For 50 years, two candidate seismic signals recorded on Mars by Viking 2 (sols 53 and 80) remained enigmatic due to instrument limitations, data compression, and lack of planetary context. Here, the authors reconstruct the original Viking 2 digital sampling workflow in Python, simulating how modern InSight marsquakes would appear through Viking's 3-Hz-peaked response and amplitude/zero-crossing compression scheme. They demonstrate that Viking was effectively blind to low-frequency (<1 Hz) tectonic marsquakes. Re-evaluating the high-SNR sol 80 nighttime event reveals three plausible origins: a local (~110 km) seasonal high-frequency marsquake in the northern plains, a distant (39°–85°) tectonic broadband marsquake (Mw 4.6–5.1) if the first arrival is a crustal Sp conversion, or a hundred-meter-scale meteorite impact. Additionally, the sol 80 signal decays 20 times faster than typical InSight events, indicating spatial heterogeneity in Martian crustal attenuation.
海盗2号记录的两个候选火星地震信号（sol 53和80）因仪器限制与数据压缩困扰学界近50年。本研究用Python重建了海盗2号的数字采样、仪器响应与振幅/过零点压缩重建流程，并将洞察号火星震波形转换为海盗号模拟记录。结果表明海盗号对低于1 Hz的构造火星震几乎不敏感。重新评估高信噪比的sol 80……

t: The authors rewrote the legacy Fortran Viking 2 workflow in Python, convolving displacement waveforms with the recovered instrument response, extracting 1-Hz smoothed amplitudes and zero-crossings, and reconstructing waveforms assuming sinusoidal signals.
用Python重写海盗2号流程，将波形与仪器响应卷积，提取1 Hz振幅与过零点并基于正弦假设重建波形。
They analyzed the 560-sol University of Texas Institute for Geophysics (UTIG) Viking 2 three-mode seismic archive alongside PDS meteorological data and InSight SEIS marsquake waveforms.
分析了涵盖560个火星日的UTIG海盗2号三模式地震数据集、PDS气象数据以及洞察号火星震波形。

The sol 80 event either locates ~110 km away in the northern-plains seasonal marsquake region, represents a distant (39°–85°) Mw 4.6–5.1 tectonic marsquake, or reflects an impact, while decaying 20 times faster than InSight events.
sol 80事件可能为北方平原近震、Mw 4.6–5.1远距离构造震或撞击，且其衰减比洞察号事件快20倍。

In the absence of site-characterization constraints at the Viking 2 landing site, magnitude estimates assuming bedrock must be treated as upper bounds, and sparse detections prevent seismicity rate comparisons.
缺乏海盗2号着陆点场地效应约束，震级估计仅为上限，且探测稀少无法对比活动率。
First comprehensive digital reconstruction of the Viking 2 sampling workflow and re-evaluation of the 50-year-old candidate signals using modern InSight waveform and structural context.
首次全面数字化重建海盗2号采样流程，并利用洞察号现代观测背景重新评估50年前的候选信号。

kc: Reconstructed and archived the 1970s Viking 2 seismic simulation and sinusoidal waveform reconstruction workflow in modern Python code.
Demonstrated that Viking 2's 3-Hz peak sensitivity and zero-crossing compression rendered it blind to low-frequency (<1 Hz) tectonic marsquakes.
Linked the Viking sol 80 event to InSight's northern-plains seasonal marsquake source region, or alternatively to a distant Mw 4.6–5.1 tectonic event or meteorite impact.
Revealed a 20-times faster signal decay in Utopia Planitia compared to InSight, implying lateral heterogeneity in Martian crustal attenuation.
使用现代Python代码重建并归档了海盗2号地震模拟及正弦波形重建工作流程。
证明海盗2号3 Hz的峰值灵敏度和过零点压缩策略使其无法探测低频（<1 Hz）构造火星震。
将sol 80事件与洞察号推断的北方平原季节性震源区关联，或解释为Mw 4.6–5.1远震及陨石撞击。
发现乌托邦平原的信号衰减速度比洞察号快20倍，表明火星地壳衰减结构存在横向异质性。
me: Digital end-to-end simulation of the Viking 2 seismometer response (peaked at 3 Hz), smoothing, and Event-mode (1.01 Hz) amplitude and zero-crossing extraction.
Sinusoidal waveform reconstruction from compressed 120-point segment amplitude and zero-crossing values via linear amplitude interpolation and phase control.
Forward conversion of InSight marsquake displacement waveforms into simulated Viking Digital Unit (DU) records corrected for source-receiver distance.
Moment magnitude estimation via waveform amplitude scaling against distant broadband InSight event S1102a.
海盗2号地震仪响应（峰值3 Hz）、平滑处理及事件模式（1.01 Hz）振幅和过零点提取的端到端数字模拟。
通过线性振幅插值和相位控制，从压缩的120点片段振幅和过零点数值进行正弦波形重建。
考虑震中距校正，将洞察号火星震位移波形正向转换为海盗号数字单位（DU）模拟记录。
利用洞察号远距离宽频带事件S1102a进行波形振幅缩放，估算矩震级。
de: Viking 2 three-component seismometer dataset (UTIG archive) covering sols 0–560 across High-data-rate (20.2 Hz), Event (1.01 Hz), and Normal (0.067 Hz) modes.
Viking 2 candidate seismic event records on sol 53 and sol 80, plus Planetary Data System (PDS) meteorological wind and temperature data.
InSight SEIS waveform data and Marsquake Service catalog events (LF, BB, HF, 2.4-Hz, and VF families) used for forward Viking simulation.
涵盖sol 0–560的UTIG海盗2号三分量地震数据集，包含高速率（20.2 Hz）、事件（1.01 Hz）和正常（0.067 Hz）三种模式。
海盗2号sol 53和sol 80候选地震事件记录，以及PDS行星数据系统的风速与温度气象数据。
用于正向模拟海盗号记录的洞察号SEIS波形数据与火星震目录事件（涵盖LF、BB、HF、2.4-Hz和VF事件族）。
li: Incomplete recovery of original spectral shapes from zero-crossing compression prevents standard spectral fitting for magnitude estimation.
Lack of local site-amplification constraints at the Viking 2 landing site means bedrock-assumed magnitude estimates represent upper bounds.
Sparse detections (1–2 events) and partial Event-mode temporal coverage (~1/3 of mission) preclude definitive seismicity rate comparisons between missions.
过零点压缩无法完整恢复原始频谱形状，导致无法应用标准频谱拟合法估算震级。
海盗2号着陆点缺乏局部场地放大效应约束，基于基岩假设的震级估计仅为上限值。
极少的探测数量（1–2个事件）和有限的事件模式覆盖率（约占任务期1/3）限制了两任务间地震活动率的确定性对比。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the legacy Viking 2 Martian seismic dataset and reinterprets candidate marsquakes using modern InSight mission observations.
The rapid decay of the Viking sol 80 signal compared to InSight marsquakes is analyzed to infer lateral heterogeneity in Martian subsurface attenuation.
The authors reconstruct the 1970s Viking 2 seismometer instrument response, sampling strategy, and digital compression workflow.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF analyzed, including all 4 figures, methodology for Viking simulation/reconstruction, and reinterpretation of the sol 53 and sol 80 candidate events.

sum: Standard deep learning operations designed for Euclidean domains introduce distortions or singularities when applied to spherical geometry, hindering scalable machine learning in geophysics, planetary science, and atmospheric physics. This paper presents torch-harmonics, an open-source PyTorch library for differentiable signal processing and geometric machine learning on the two-dimensional sphere. The library implements forward and inverse scalar and vector spherical harmonic transforms (SHT/VSHT), spectral and discrete-continuous (DISCO) convolutions, quadrature rules, and global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms. To overcome computational bottlenecks at high spatial resolutions, torch-harmonics integrates stride-1 memory layout optimizations, custom CUDA kernels for sparse graph aggregations and tensor transpositions, and 2D distributed-memory parallelism using pencil decomposition and halo exchanges. It serves as the foundation for state-of-the-art architectures like Spherical Fourier Neural Operators (SFNO), Local Spherical Neural Operators, Spherical Transformers, and hybrid differentiable spectral PDE solvers.
针对欧几里得空间设计的标准深度学习操作应用于球面几何时会引入畸变或奇点。本文提出了开源PyTorch库torch-harmonics，用于二维球面上的可微信号处理与几何机器学习。该库实现了标量与矢量球谐变换（SHT/VSHT）、谱卷积、离散-连续（DISCO）卷积以及全局和邻域球面注意力机制。为突破……

t: Implements differentiable scalar/vector spherical harmonic transforms, isotropic spectral convolutions, anisotropic discrete-continuous (DISCO) convolutions, and quadrature-weighted spherical attention in PyTorch using custom CUDA kernels and 2D pencil-decomposed distributed parallelism.
基于自定义CUDA内核与二维分布式并行，在PyTorch中实现可微标/矢量球谐变换、谱卷积、DISCO卷积及球面注意力。

Demonstrated on synthetic rotating shallow water PDE simulations, 360-degree omnidirectional image depth estimation and segmentation, and GPU kernel benchmarks (~2.0 GB tensor workloads on NVIDIA GB200 GPUs).
在旋转球面浅水波PDE合成数据、360度全景图像深度估计与分割，以及GB200 GPU基准测试上进行了验证。
Custom CUDA transpose kernels achieve ~6.2 TB/s memory throughput on a GB200 GPU (vs. 0.5 TB/s for standard PyTorch permute), and CSR row presorting yields up to 20% runtime improvement.
自定义CUDA转置内核在GB200上达6.2 TB/s吞吐量（标准算子仅0.5 TB/s），CSR预排序带来20%运行加…

Currently supports only equiangular, Legendre-Gauss, and Gauss-Lobatto grids, and irregular neighbor counts in CSR structures cause load imbalances spanning three orders of magnitude if left unsorted.
目前仅支持等角、Legendre-Gauss和Gauss-Lobatto三种网格，且邻域注意力需额外进行张量内存布局转换…

Provides the first unified, GPU-accelerated, and distributed-memory PyTorch library combining differentiable vector spherical harmonics, DISCO convolutions, and spherical attention to scale geometric deep learning to high resolutions.
首个统一集成可微矢量球谐变换、DISCO卷积与球面注意力的GPU加速分布式PyTorch库。

kc: Introduces torch-harmonics, a differentiable PyTorch library implementing scalar and vector spherical harmonic transforms, quadrature, and spectral resampling on equiangular and Gaussian grids.
Provides building blocks for spherical machine learning, including isotropic spectral convolutions (SFNO), anisotropic discrete-continuous (DISCO) convolutions, and spherical attention mechanisms.

Implements custom CUDA kernels and 2D distributed-memory parallelism (pencil decomposition and all-to-all collectives) achieving 6.2 TB/s transpose throughput and 20% load-balancing speedups on GB200 GPUs.
Demonstrates end-to-end capabilities including a differentiable spectral solver for the rotating shallow water equations on the sphere.
推出了torch-harmonics可微PyTorch库，在等角和ガウス网格上实现了标量与矢量球谐变换、求积及谱重采样。
提供了球面机器学习核心模块，包括各向同性谱卷积（SFNO）、各向异性离散-连续（DISCO）卷积和球面注意力机制。
实现了自定义CUDA内核与二维分布式并行（铅笔分解与全对全通信），在GB200 GPU上实现6.2 TB/s转置吞吐量与20%负载均衡加速。
展示了包括旋转球面浅水波方程可微谱求解器在内的端到端科学计算与混合建模能力。
me: Factorized Spherical Harmonic Transform (SHT) and Vector SHT combining real-valued FFTs in longitude with stride-1 batched GEMM Legendre transforms in latitude.
Discrete-Continuous (DISCO) convolutions parameterized by Morlet-like wavelets, Zernike polynomials, or piecewise linear B-splines for localized anisotropic filtering.
Continuous global and geodesic-masked neighborhood self-attention discretized with spherical quadrature weights to preserve approximate SO(3) equivariance.
2D domain decomposition across polar and azimuthal process groups using NCCL all-to-all collectives and custom CSR-based CUDA aggregation kernels.
因式分解的球谐变换（SHT）与矢量SHT，将经度方向的实数FFT与纬度方向步长为1的批量矩阵乘法勒让德变换相结合。
采用类Morlet小波、Zernike多项式或分段线性B样条参数化的离散-连续（DISCO）卷积，实现局部各向异性滤波。
结合球面求积权重离散化的连续全局与测地线掩码邻域自注意力机制，以保持近似SO(3)等变性。
利用NCCL全对全集合通信与基于CSR的自定义CUDA聚合内核，在极向和方位角进程组间实现二维区域分解。
de: Differentiable spectral shallow water equations solver on a rotating sphere using VSHT for spectral divergence and curl computations.
Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO) and Local Spherical Neural Operator (LSNO) training on synthetic PDE data generated by the shallow water solver.
Spherical image processing tasks including depth estimation and segmentation on 360-degree omnidirectional images using Spherical Transformers.
Kernel benchmarks on NVIDIA GB200 GPUs evaluating custom BCHW-to-BHWC transpose kernels and CSR row-presorting load balancing.
旋转球面上的可微谱浅水方程求解器，利用VSHT在谱空间高效计算散度与旋度。
在浅水求解器生成的合成PDE数据上训练球面傅里叶神经算子（SFNO）和局部球面神经算子（LSNO）。
使用球面Transformer在360度全景图像上进行深度估计和图像分割等球面图像处理实验。
在NVIDIA GB200 GPU上进行内核基准测试，评估自定义BCHW-BHWC转置内核及CSR行预排序负载均衡性能。
li: Currently supports only three grid types (equiangular, Legendre-Gauss, and Gauss-Lobatto), with other spherical grids left for future work.
DISCO convolutions and discretized spherical attention provide only approximate rotation equivariance due to finite grid discretization.
Neighborhood attention requires BCHW to BHWC memory layout permutations before and after kernel execution to ensure coalesced memory access.
目前仅支持三种球面网格类型（等角网格、Legendre-Gauss网格和Gauss-Lobatto网格），其他流行网格尚待支持。
受限于有限网格离散化，DISCO卷积和离散球面注意力机制仅能提供近似的旋转等变性。
邻域注意力机制在内核执行前后需要进行BCHW与BHWC内存布局转换，以保证全局内存合并访问。

tm.why: The library implements GPU-accelerated, distributed-memory spherical harmonic transforms, vector spherical harmonics, and a differentiable spectral shallow-water wave solver relevant to global geophysical modeling.
Provides foundational geometric deep learning layers (Spherical Fourier Neural Operators, DISCO convolutions, spherical transformers) designed for global geophysical and planetary spherical datasets.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 27-page arXiv preprint PDF, including the main text (Sections 1–5) and Appendices A and B containing mathematical formulations, code listings, distributed communication schemes, and CUDA kernel benchmarks.

sum: Ultrahigh-pressure (UHP) metamorphism is widely considered evidence of cold, steady-state subduction based on peak metamorphic conditions (<330 °C/GPa). However, direct constraints on the prograde evolution are scarce. This study reports a young (~4.4 Ma) coesite-bearing UHP eclogite from Goodenough Island, eastern Papua New Guinea. Using Raman spectroscopy of mineral and melt inclusions, piston-cylinder re-homogenization experiments, Zr-in-rutile thermometry, SIMS U-Pb zircon dating, and Perple_X thermodynamic modeling, the authors reconstruct the rock's pressure-temperature-time path. They find that garnet cores formed under warm conditions (700 ± 20 °C, 1.5 ± 0.2 GPa; ~470 °C/GPa) up to ~45 km depth, before shifting to a cold regime in the garnet mantle (800 ± 25 °C, >2.9 GPa; ~280 °C/GPa) with vertical subduction rates >60 mm/yr between 5.1 and 4.4 Ma. This thermal switch reflects shear heating and/or transient early-stage subduction, challenging the reliance on peak UHP conditions to infer subduction thermal structure.
超高压变质作用通常基于峰期条件被视为冷俯冲的证据，但缺乏进变质演化的直接约束。本研究报道了巴布亚新几内亚Goodenough岛新发现的年轻（约4.4 Ma）含柯石英超高压榴辉岩。通过包裹体拉曼光谱、熔体包裹体均一化实验、金红石Zr温度计、锆石U-Pb定年及热力学模拟，重建了其P-T-t轨迹。结果表明……

t: The authors combine Raman spectroscopy of mineral/melt inclusions, piston-cylinder melt re-homogenization experiments, Zr-in-rutile thermometry, Perple_X thermodynamic modeling, and SIMS U-Pb dating of zircon inclusions to constrain the prograde P-T-t path.
结合拉曼光谱、活塞圆筒熔体包裹体均一化实验、金红石Zr温度计、热力学模拟和锆石SIMS定年重建P-T-t轨迹。

A partially retrogressed mafic eclogite lens (sample 03118b) hosted in felsic gneiss from Goodenough Island, eastern Papua New Guinea, containing zoned garnets with coesite, rutile, zircon, and nanogranitoid melt inclusions.
采自巴布亚新几内亚Goodenough岛的退变质榴辉岩（03118b），石榴石含柯石英、金红石、锆石和熔体包裹体。

Garnet cores formed at 1.5 ± 0.2 GPa and 700 ± 20 °C (~470 °C/GPa), whereas coesite-bearing garnet mantles formed at >2.9 GPa and 800 ± 25 °C (~280 °C/GPa) between 5.1 and 4.4 Ma, implying vertical subduction >60 mm/yr.
石榴石核部形成于1.5 GPa、700 °C，含柯石英幔部于5.1–4.4 Ma形成于>2.9 GPa、800 °C，垂…
Garnet compositional isopleths are insensitive above 1.8 GPa, and quantifying the relative contributions of shear heating versus young subduction thermal transience is beyond the study's scope.
石榴石等值线在>1.8 GPa时不敏感，且未能定量区分剪切生热与非稳态俯冲的相对贡献。

Provides direct prograde petrological evidence that UHP rocks can experience an initially warm geothermal gradient before transitioning into rapid cold subduction, challenging steady-state cold subduction assumptions.
首次直接证明超高压岩石在进入深部快速冷俯冲前可经历浅部温暖进变质演化，挑战稳态冷俯冲假设。

kc: Discovery of coesite inclusions in eclogite from Goodenough Island, dated at ~4.4 Ma, among Earth's youngest UHP eclogites.
Reconstruction of a two-stage prograde P-T-t path showing a shift from warm shallow subduction (~470 °C/GPa) to cold deep subduction (~280 °C/GPa) at vertical rates >60 mm/yr.
Demonstration that peak metamorphic conditions of UHP rocks do not uniquely indicate cold, steady-state subduction throughout the entire prograde history.
在Goodenough岛榴辉岩中发现约4.4 Ma的柯石英包裹体，为地球上最年轻的超高压榴辉岩之一。
重建了两阶段进变质P-T-t轨迹，揭示了从浅部温暖俯冲（~470 °C/GPa）向深部超快（垂向速率>60 mm/yr）冷俯冲（~280 °C/GPa）的转变。
证明超高压岩石的峰期变质条件并不能唯一指示整个进变质历史均为冷且稳态的俯冲热结构。
me: Raman spectroscopy (2D and 3D mapping) of coesite and polyphase nanogranitoid melt inclusions in garnet.
Piston-cylinder melt inclusion re-homogenization experiments at 2.5 GPa and 750–900 °C.
Electron microprobe analysis (EPMA), Zr-in-rutile thermometry, and Perple_X thermodynamic phase equilibria modeling.
Large-geometry SIMS U-Pb geochronology and trace-element analysis of ~10 µm zircon inclusions extracted via bulk dissolution.
石榴石中柯石英及多相纳米花岗岩熔体包裹体的二维与三维拉曼光谱成像。
2.5 GPa和750–900 °C条件下的活塞圆筒熔体包裹体均一化实验。
电子探针矿物化学分析、金红石Zr温度计以及Perple_X热力学相平衡模拟。
全岩溶解提取~10 µm锆石包裹体并进行大型二次离子质谱（SIMS）U-Pb定年与微量元素分析。
de: Retrogressed eclogite sample 03118b collected from eastern Taleba Bay, southern Goodenough Island, Papua New Guinea.
High-pressure piston-cylinder re-homogenization experiments on crack-free nanogranitoid inclusions in garnet chips.
SIMS U-Pb ages and chondrite-normalized rare-earth-element profiles from 26 extracted zircon grains (17 filtered analyses).
采自巴布亚新几内亚Goodenough岛南部Taleba湾东部的退变质榴辉岩样品03118b。
针对石榴石碎片中无裂隙纳米花岗岩包裹体的高温高压活塞圆筒均一化实验。
26颗提取锆石颗粒（17个有效数据）的SIMS U-Pb年龄及球粒陨石标准化稀土元素配分数据。
li: Garnet compositional isopleths are insensitive to pressure changes above 1.8 GPa, preventing exact pressure determination for the garnet mantle and rim.
Relative contributions of shear heating versus non-steady-state early subduction thermal evolution are not quantitatively separated.
石榴石成分等值线在1.8 GPa以上对压力变化不敏感，无法精确限定石榴石幔部和边部的形成压力。
未定量区分板块界面剪切生热与年轻俯冲带非稳态热演化对早期高地温梯度的相对贡献。

tm.why: The paper investigates the thermal structure, geothermal gradients, and subduction rates of a subduction zone using petrological and geodynamic constraints from ultrahigh-pressure eclogite.

ev.notes: Full 13-page Nature Geoscience PDF (including Methods and Extended Data Figs. 1–4) was read and analyzed.

sum: This dataset presents microearthquake catalogs from the TDBnet temporary seismic experiment in northern Mongolia (August 2023 to December 2024), targeting the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction. The network comprised 15 stations (broadband and short-period) supplemented by 5 permanent stations. Earthquakes were automatically detected and picked using PhaseNet, associated with PyOcto, and located using NonLinLoc with a local 1-D velocity model. Relative relocations (HypoDD) and focal mechanisms (FMNEAR) are provided for subset events. The dataset contains two catalogs (broadband and short-period) in CSV format, serving as the foundation for analyzing fault structures and long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 Mw ≥ 8 earthquake sequence.
该数据集包含蒙古北部TDBnet临时地震台网（2023年8月至2024年12月）观测到的微震目录，旨在研究1905年Mw ≥ 8地震序列的长期余震及断裂构造。台网由15个临时台站和5个固定台站组成。研究采用PhaseNet进行自动检测与拾取，PyOcto进行关联，NonLinLoc进行绝对定位，并利……

t: Automated earthquake detection and phase picking using PhaseNet, event association with PyOcto, absolute location via NonLinLoc, and relative relocation using HypoDD.
采用PhaseNet进行自动检测与拾取，PyOcto进行关联，NonLinLoc进行绝对定位，并结合HypoDD进行重定…
Seismic waveforms from 15 temporary TDBnet stations (broadband and short-period) and 5 permanent stations in northern Mongolia from August 2023 to December 2024.
2023年8月至2024年12月期间蒙古北部15个TDBnet临时台站和5个固定台站记录的地震波形数据。
Two microearthquake catalogs (broadband and short-period) mapping seismicity around the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction, including relative relocations and focal mechanisms.
获得了蒙古北部断裂交汇区的高精度微震目录（包括宽频带和短周期），并提供了部分重定位和震源机制解。
The temporary network deployment was short-term (5 to 16 months), and advanced relocations/focal mechanisms are only available for a subset of events.
临时台网观测时间较短（5至16个月），且重定位和震源机制解仅覆盖部分地震事件。
First high-resolution microearthquake catalog targeting the long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake sequence using a dense temporary local network.
首次利用密集临时台网针对1905年Mw >= 8大地震序列的长期余震进行高分辨率微震目录构建。

kc: Provides high-resolution microearthquake catalogs for the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction in Mongolia.
Applies modern machine-learning-based workflows (PhaseNet, PyOcto) for robust automatic earthquake detection and phase picking.
Delivers relative relocations and focal mechanisms to help image fault structures at depth.
提供了蒙古Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen断裂交汇区的高分辨率微震目录。
应用了现代机器学习工作流（PhaseNet、PyOcto）进行鲁棒的地震自动检测与震相拾取。
提供了相对重定位和震源机制解，有助于精细刻画深部断裂构造。
me: Machine-learning-based phase picking using PhaseNet.
Event association using PyOcto.
Absolute earthquake location using NonLinLoc with a locally inverted 1-D velocity model.
Relative relocation using HypoDD and focal mechanism determination using FMNEAR.
基于PhaseNet的机器学习震相拾取。
使用PyOcto进行地震事件关联。
使用NonLinLoc和本地1D速度模型进行地震绝对定位。
使用HypoDD进行相对重定位，并使用FMNEAR确定震源机制解。
de: Seismic data from the TDBnet temporary experiment (15 three-component stations) deployed from August 2023 to December 2024.
Complementary data from 5 permanent Mongolian seismic stations.
Two distinct catalogs: a broadband (BB) catalog and a denser short-period (SP) catalog.
2023年8月至2024年12月部署的TDBnet临时地震台网（15个三分量台站）的地震数据。
来自5个蒙古固定地震台站的补充数据。
两个独立的目录：宽频带（BB）目录和更密集的短周期（SP）目录。
li: The temporary deployment was limited in duration (up to 16 months for broadband, 5 months for short-period).
Relative relocations and focal mechanisms are only available for a subset of the events in the short-period catalog.
临时台网部署时间有限（宽频带最长约16个月，短周期为5个月）。
相对重定位和震源机制解仅适用于短周期目录中的部分事件。

tm.why: The dataset contains microearthquake catalogs produced from a temporary seismic experiment in Mongolia using automated detection and relocation workflows.
The catalogs target the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction to investigate long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake sequence.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the Zenodo abstract and metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Neighboring faults occasionally rupture repeatedly in close succession, suggesting synchronization despite inherent earthquake irregularity. Casting adjacent fault segments as coupled oscillators, the authors propose that synchronization emerges when phase-dependent stress interaction (A) outweighs the natural frequency difference (Φ) from fault asymmetry (A/Φ > 1) and stochastic perturbations. This theoretical threshold is formulated using fault lengths and spacing, and validated using rate-and-state spring-slider and 1D boundary-integral fault simulations. Observational tests across vastly different scales confirm the theory: among 215 repeating microearthquake families on the central San Andreas Fault, synchronization decays rapidly over ~1 km, tracking static stress transfer decay. Across a 1000-year historical record of Japanese megathrust earthquakes, the parameter-free geometric threshold (requiring <10% length difference for adjacent segments) uniquely identifies the Nankai and Hokkaido segments as poised for synchronized M8+ ruptures, providing a mechanistic basis for compound earthquake hazard advisories.
本研究将相邻断层视为耦合振子，提出当相位相关的应力相互作用超过由断层不对称性引起的固有周期差异（A/Φ > 1）及外部扰动时，断层间会出现同步破裂。作者利用断层长度和间距推导出无量纲同步阈值，并通过速率-状态摩擦滑块模型和一维断层数值模拟进行了验证。跨尺度的观测检验支持了该理论：在圣安德烈亚斯断层2……

t: Neighboring faults are modeled as coupled oscillators where synchronization requires phase-dependent interaction strength A to exceed characteristic frequency mismatch Φ (A/Φ > 1), validated via rate-and-state slider blocks and 1D spectral boundary-integral fault simulations.
将邻近断层建模为耦合振子，导出同步条件A/Φ > 1，并通过速率-状态弹簧滑块和一维边界积分断层模拟验证。

Tested against a 36-year catalog of 215 repeating microearthquake families (M > 2.0) on the central San Andreas Fault and a 1000-year historical record of 11 neighboring megathrust segment pairs across Japan.
采用圣安德烈亚斯断层36年215个重复微震族目录，以及日本11对相邻俯冲带分段1000年历史大震目录。

San Andreas repeater synchronization decays over ~1 km, matching static stress transfer decay. For adjacent segments, synchronization requires length differences under 10%, correctly identifying 2 synchronized pairs (Nankai, Hokkaido) out of 11 Japanese megathrust pairs.
重复微震同步性在1公里内随应力传递衰减；相邻断层长度差需小于10%，准确识别出南海和北海道2对同步分段。
The geometric threshold assumes co-planar faults with shared loading rates and frictional properties, causing a false positive at the non-coplanar 90-degree Nankai-Sagami junction.
几何公式假设共面断层及相同加载速率，在近90度交汇的南海-相模海槽非共面处产生了假阳性。
Establishes a parameter-free, geometry-based mechanistic threshold (A/Φ > 1) that predicts earthquake synchronization across both microearthquake repeaters and M8+ megathrust segments.
提出无需调参的几何力学阈值（A/Φ > 1），统一解释了微震与M8+巨型逆冲地震的跨尺度罕见同步现象。

kc: Formulated a coupled-oscillator theoretical threshold (A/Φ > 1) relating fault geometry and spacing to earthquake cycle synchronization.
Validated the synchronization transition using rate-and-state spring-slider models and 1D spectral boundary-integral fault simulations.
Demonstrated that repeating microearthquakes on the central San Andreas Fault synchronize locally within ~1 km, tracking static stress transfer decay.
Identified Nankai and Hokkaido megathrust segments from a 1000-year historical catalog as uniquely geometrically poised for synchronized ruptures.
建立了耦合振子理论阈值（A/Φ > 1），将断层几何尺寸与间距同地震周期同步性联系起来。
利用速率-状态摩擦弹簧滑块模型和一维谱边界积分断层模拟验证了同步转变条件。
证明圣安德烈亚斯断层中段的重复微震在约1公里内呈现局部同步，与静态应力传递衰减规律一致。
基于千年历史地震目录，识别出日本南海海槽和北海道俯冲带分段具备发生同步巨型地震的独特几何条件。
me: Coupled oscillator analytical modeling of phase difference evolution between interacting fault segments
Spring-block slider numerical simulations with rate-and-state friction
Quasi-dynamic 1D spectral boundary-integral earthquake sequence simulations (Motorcycle code)
Phase coherence and normalized order parameter analysis on earthquake catalogs
相互作用断层段相位差演化的耦合振子解析建模
具有速率-状态摩擦律的弹簧-滑块数值模拟
准动态一维谱边界积分地震序列模拟（使用Motorcycle程序）
地震目录的相位相干性与归一化序参量统计分析
de: 36-year catalog of 215 repeating earthquake families (M > 2.0) in the creeping section of the central San Andreas Fault from NCSS
1000-year historical rupture catalog of 11 pairs of neighboring megathrust segments in Japan (Nankai, Sagami, Japan, and Kuril/Hokkaido trenches)
Suites of asymmetric 2-block slider simulations and 1D co-planar rate-weakening fault simulations separated by a velocity-strengthening barrier
北加州地震系统（NCSS）圣安德烈亚斯断层蠕滑段36年间的215个重复地震序列目录（M > 2.0）
日本11对相邻巨型逆冲断层分段（南海、相模、日本及千岛/北海道海沟）的1000年历史破裂目录
非对称双滑块模拟实验集，以及由速度强化障碍体分隔的一维共面速度弱化断层模拟实验集
li: Analytical geometric thresholds assume co-planar circular faults with uniform loading rates, normal stresses, and frictional properties.
Fails to account for non-coplanar geometries (e.g., the 90-degree junction between Nankai and Sagami troughs produced a false positive).
Does not directly apply to parallel faults experiencing stress shadowing or highly elongated ruptures without numerical re-derivation.
解析几何阈值假设断层为共面圆形裂纹，且具有相同的加载速率、正应力和摩擦性质。
未考虑非共面复杂几何结构（例如南海海槽与相模海槽呈近90度交汇处产生了一个假阳性预测）。
对于存在应力影区的平行断层或极度狭长的破裂，需重新推导或数值评估，无法直接套用公式。

tm.why: The paper develops a mechanistic coupled-oscillator and rate-and-state friction framework to explain fault-to-fault stress interaction and earthquake cycle synchronization.
It models full and partial rupture sequences on neighboring 1D fault segments and analyzes source dimensions and stress drops.
The study identifies neighboring megathrust segments in Nankai and Hokkaido poised for synchronized M8+ ruptures, supporting compound earthquake hazard advisories.

ev.notes: Full 10-page GRL article PDF examined, including equations, main text, and all 4 figures.

sum: This study investigates the temporal evolution of scaled energy (the ratio of radiated seismic energy to seismic moment in successive time windows) across more than 1,500 global earthquakes drawn from four independent moment-rate function (MRF) catalogs (SCARDEC, Ye16, YK23, and Tocheport07). Using a time-local incremental windowing approach, the authors find a universal energetic onset in the first 20%–30% of rupture duration, followed by a decay to a steady level 4–6 times lower. Shallow strike-slip events exhibit higher scaled energy than thrust events, and some shallow catalogs show a secondary rise at rupture arrest, whereas deep earthquakes (>100 km) consistently lack energetic arrest and show higher overall scaled energy. Dynamic rupture simulations using SBIEMLAB and nested-asperity models demonstrate that energetic onset requires high prestress near nucleation and cross-scale spatial correlation, while late-stage arrest peaks require abrupt stopping of self-healing pulses or large-scale crack barriers.
本研究利用四个独立震源时间函数目录（SCARDEC、Ye16、YK23和Tocheport07）中超过1500次全球地震，采用分段时窗增量法量化了地震破裂过程中标度能量（辐射能量与地震矩之比）的时间演化。结果显示各机制、震级和深度均存在一致规律：标度能量在破裂前20%–30%最高，随后衰减至4–6倍……

t: Divides preprocessed moment-rate functions into N (5, 8, or 10) equal time windows to incrementally compute radiated energy (via squared moment acceleration under point-source approximation) and seismic moment, yielding time-local scaled energy evolution e(t).
将预处理后的震源时间函数等分为5、8或10个时窗，基于点源近似增量计算辐射能量与地震矩之比e(t)。

Over 1,500 earthquake moment-rate functions from four catalogs: SCARDEC (537 shallow Mw >= 6.6 and deep events), Ye16 (120 M > 7 megathrust events), YK23 (969 M3.0–7.0 Japanese events), and Tocheport07 (129 deep events >= 100 km).
综合SCARDEC、Ye16、YK23和Tocheport07四个独立目录中超过1500次全球浅源与深源地震的震源时间函…

Scaled energy peaks in the first 20%–30% of rupture (~10^-5 to 10^-4) and decays 4–6 fold. Shallow strike-slip events exceed thrust events; deep earthquakes (>550 km) have 2–3x higher peak e(t) and lack energetic arrest.
标度能量在破裂前20%–30%达峰后衰减4–6倍；走滑高于逆冲，深震幅值更高且无显著终止能量回升。

Deconvolution side-lobes and MRF end-truncation cause dataset-dependent arrest peaks, while 2-D simulations neglect 3-D fault width, off-fault inelasticity, damage zones, and thermo-hydro-mechanical friction.
反褶积截断影响末端特征，且二维动态模拟忽略了三维发震层宽度、断层外非弹性变形与热流耦合本构。

Replaces cumulative energy metrics with an incremental time-window formulation across four independent MRF catalogs, resolving late-stage rupture arrest and linking e(t) directly to dynamic rupture heterogeneity.
提出局部增量分窗指标并联合多目录对比，首次精细分辨破裂终止阶段能量演化并约束动态破裂非均质性。

kc: Introduces a time-local, incremental windowing formulation of scaled energy that preserves temporal resolution throughout rupture propagation and arrest.
Establishes across 1,500+ events from four catalogs that scaled energy peaks in the first 20%–30% of duration and decays by a factor of 4–6.
Demonstrates that deep earthquakes (>100 km) exhibit a robust asymmetric evolution with energetic onset, gradual arrest, and a surge in peak scaled energy below 550 km.

Constrains fault rheology and heterogeneity via dynamic rupture simulations, showing that late-stage rises require abrupt arrest (e.g., self-healing pulses) and energetic onsets reflect cross-scale asperity nesting.
提出了一种局部时间窗口增量标度能量计算方法，在破裂传播和终止阶段均保持了均匀的时间分辨率。
基于四个目录1500余次地震证实标度能量在破裂前20%–30%达峰，随后衰减4–6倍。
揭示深源地震（>100 km）具有高能起始、平缓终止的非对称演化特征，且550 km以深峰值标度能量显著升高。
通过动态破裂模拟约束断层流变与非均质性，表明破裂末期能量回升需破裂突然停止（如自愈合脉冲），而高能起始反映了跨尺度凹凸体嵌套。
me: Incremental time-windowing (N = 5, 8, 10 windows) of preprocessed moment-rate functions (MRFs) to compute windowed seismic moment, radiated energy, and scaled energy e(t).
Point-source radiated energy integration from the squared time derivative of MRFs using AK135 velocity/density structure.

2-D spectral boundary integral element method (SBIEMLAB) dynamic rupture simulations exploring linear slip-weakening and frictional restrengthening across Dc, Hurst exponent H, and prestress closeness to failure.
Comparison of e(t) against 3-D hierarchical nested-asperity dynamic models, teleseismic back-projection, and kinematic finite-fault forward modeling (2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake).
对预处理后的震源时间函数（MRFs）进行等分时间窗口（N = 5, 8, 10）分析，计算各时窗内的地震矩、辐射能量及标度能量演化e(t)。
基于点源近似和AK135速度密度模型，对MRF时间导数的平方进行积分以估算辐射能量。
利用二维谱边界积分元法（SBIEMLAB）开展动态破裂模拟，系统测试线性滑移弱化与摩擦再强化模型中Dc、Hurst指数H及预应力临界度的影响。
将e(t)与三维层级嵌套凹凸体动态模型、远震反投影及2021年玛多Mw 7.4地震运动学有限断层正演模型进行对比验证。
de: SCARDEC global database: 537 shallow earthquakes (depth <= 40 km, Mw >= 6.6) and deep earthquakes using optimal teleseismic body-wave deconvolved MRFs.
Ye16 catalog: 120 shallow large (M > 7) global megathrust earthquakes from finite-fault inversions.
YK23 catalog: 969 Mw 3.0–7.0 regional earthquakes in Japan derived using empirical Green's functions.
Tocheport07 catalog: 129 intermediate and deep earthquakes (depth >= 100 km) derived from stacked aligned teleseismic P-waveforms.
Case study of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake combining MRF, multi-array teleseismic back-projection, and finite-fault kinematic slip models.
SCARDEC全球数据库：采用最优远震体波反褶积MRF的537次浅源地震（深度<=40 km，Mw>=6.6）及深源地震。
Ye16目录：由有限断层反演获得的全球120次大型浅源俯冲带逆冲地震（M>7）。
YK23目录：利用经验格林函数获得的日本地区969次Mw 3.0–7.0区域地震。
Tocheport07目录：通过对齐远震P波波形叠加获得的129次中深源和深源地震（深度>=100 km）。
2021年玛多Mw 7.4地震综合实例分析，结合了MRF、多台阵远震反投影和有限断层运动学滑动模型。
li: Point-source approximation ignores finite-source directivity and space-time travel-time smearing across the fault plane.
SCARDEC MRFs are filtered below 1 Hz due to Earth attenuation and suffer from lower SNR and amplified high-frequency noise for strike-slip nodal P waves.
Deconvolution side-lobes and end-of-rupture MRF truncation can artificially inflate late-stage arrest scaled energy in SCARDEC and YK23.
2-D dynamic rupture simulations omit 3-D finite seismogenic width, off-fault plasticity, fault-zone damage/bimaterial effects, and full hydrothermal constitutive physics.
点源近似忽略了有限震源的方向性效应以及断层面上的时空走时平滑效应。
SCARDEC的MRF受地球衰减限制仅能分辨1 Hz以下信号，且走滑地震节面附近P波信噪比低，辐射校正易放大高频噪声。
有限带宽反褶积旁瓣及MRF末端截断可能人为抬高SCARDEC和YK23在破裂终止阶段的标度能量。
二维动态破裂模拟未包含三维有限发震层宽度、断层外非弹性变形、损伤带/双材料效应以及完整的热-流体耦合本构物理过程。

tm.why: The paper analyzes the temporal evolution of scaled energy during earthquake ruptures using moment-rate functions and dynamic rupture simulations.
It links radiated energy evolution to fault heterogeneity, prestress closeness to failure, slip-weakening distance, and frictional restrengthening.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF analyzed, including all sections (§1–§5), equations (1–3), Table 1, and Figures 1–12.

sum: The timing of the Arabia-Eurasia collision remains debated due to uncertainties in continental subduction and cratonic underthrusting. This study presents FWME24, a high-resolution radially anisotropic seismic velocity model of the upper mantle beneath the Middle East developed using adjoint full-waveform inversion (SPECFEM3D_GLOBE) of 38 regional earthquakes (Mw 5.5–7.2) recorded at 1,957 stations. By employing a weighted normalized cross-correlation misfit function to fit body waves (15–100 s, including complex triplicated arrivals) and surface waves (25–130 s), the inversion achieves high resolution in the upper 500 km. FWME24 images ~250-km-thick cratonic Arabian lithosphere extending horizontally beneath Eurasia, fragmented fast anomalies in the mantle transition zone interpreted as subducted passive margin or delaminated lithosphere, and northward-channeled Afar plume material. Reconstructing the underthrusted Arabian lithosphere in a mantle reference frame constrains the initiation of hard collision to ~22 Ma, reconciling seismic structure with geological deformation records.
本研究利用38个区域地震（Mw 5.5–7.2）在1957个台站的波形记录，基于SPECFEM3D_GLOBE伴随全波形反演方法构建了中东上地幔径向各向异性速度模型FWME24。通过加权归一化互相关误差函数拟合体波（含三重震相）和面波，模型在上地幔500公里内具高分辨率。研究发现约250公里厚的阿拉……

t: Iterative adjoint full-waveform inversion using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE and a weighted normalized cross-correlation misfit function, alternating between earthquake source parameter updates and 3D radially anisotropic mantle velocity updates via preconditioned conjugate gradients.
采用SPECFEM3D_GLOBE与加权归一化互相关目标函数，交替进行震源与径向各向异性地幔结构的伴随全波形反演。
Waveforms from 38 regional earthquakes (Mw 5.5–7.2) recorded at 1,957 stations across the Middle East, windowed around body waves (15–100 s) and surface waves (25–100 s and 70–130 s).
中东周边38个区域地震在1957个台站的波形，分窗拟合15–100秒体波和25–130秒面波。

Model FWME24 reveals ~250-km-thick fast (+5% dVS) cratonic Arabian lithosphere extending northward beneath Eurasia; reconstructing the +1% dVS contour at 200 km depth constrains hard collision initiation to 22–15 Ma.
揭示250公里厚的阿拉伯克拉通向北俯冲于欧亚之下，200公里深度+1%等值线重建限定硬碰撞发生于22–15 Ma。
Sparse stations and sources in the north and south cause east-west smearing and poor lower-mantle resolution, while collision age estimates vary with chosen dVS contour thresholds and depth slices.
南北向台站稀缺导致东西向涂抹与下地幔低分辨率，且碰撞年龄受速度等值线阈值选择影响。
First regional full-waveform tomography of the Middle East fitting triplicated upper-mantle waves to directly quantify the extent of underthrusted Arabian craton and date hard collision initiation.
首次在中东利用拟合三重震相的全波形层析成像直接量化阿拉伯克拉通俯冲范围并限定硬碰撞时间。

kc: Developed FWME24, a new full-waveform radially anisotropic seismic tomography model of the upper mantle beneath the Middle East.
Imaged ~250 km thick cratonic Arabian lithosphere underthrusting northward beneath the Zagros mountains and central Iran.
Constrained the initiation of hard collision between cratonic Arabia and Eurasia to ~22 Ma (diachronously until 15 Ma) by integrating tomographic contours with plate reconstructions.
Identified fragmented high-velocity anomalies in the mantle transition zone linked to continental subduction and rift/plume-induced lithospheric delamination.
构建了中东地区上地幔全新的全波形径向各向异性地震层析成像模型（FWME24）。
揭示了约250公里厚的阿拉伯克拉通岩石圈向北水平俯冲至扎格罗斯山脉和伊朗中部之下。
通过将层析成像边界与板块重建结合，限定阿拉伯克拉通与欧亚大陆的硬碰撞始于约22 Ma（穿时持续至15 Ma）。
识别出地幔转换带内破碎的高速异常体，揭示了早期大陆俯冲及裂谷/地幔柱诱导的岩石圈拆沉过程。
me: Adjoint full-waveform inversion using the spectral-element code SPECFEM3D_GLOBE down to ~15 s period.
Weighted normalized cross-correlation misfit function to capture phase and relative amplitude of multi-path triplicated waves while mitigating absolute amplitude uncertainties.
Alternating inversions for earthquake source parameters (location, centroid time, half duration, moment tensor) and 3D radially anisotropic mantle structure (VP, VS, phi, xi, eta).
Preconditioned conjugate gradient optimization with random-probing approximate Hessian and multi-iteration point spread function resolution tests.
利用谱元法程序SPECFEM3D_GLOBE进行精确至约15秒周期的伴随全波形反演。
采用加权归一化互相关误差函数，拟合多路径三重震相的相位与相对振幅，同时消除绝对振幅不确定性。
交替反演地震震源参数（位置、时间、半持续时间、矩张量）与三维径向各向异性地幔结构参数。
采用基于随机微扰近似Hessian矩阵的预处理共轭梯度法，并开展多迭代点扩散函数分辨率测试。

Windowed body waves (P, S, PP, SS filtered at 15–100 s) and short/long-period surface waves (filtered at 25–100 s and 70–130 s).
Starting model combining S40RTS (VS), P12 (VP), and CRUST1.0 on a 60° × 38° spectral-element mesh.
Kinematic plate reconstruction back to 30 Ma using a mantle reference frame and upper-plate deformation restoration.
环绕阿拉伯-欧亚碰撞带的38个区域地震（Mw 5.5–7.2）在1957个宽频带台站记录的三分量波形。
分窗提取的体波（P、S、PP、SS，滤波15–100秒）以及短周期（25–100秒）和长周期（70–130秒）面波。

结合地幔参考系与上盘变形恢复的30 Ma以来板块运动学重建实验。

Poorer resolution in central/southern Arabia at 300–500 km depths and generally poor resolution in the lower mantle.

阿拉伯中南部在300–500公里深度分辨率较差，且模型在下地幔整体分辨率不足。
碰撞时间估计依赖于所选的速度异常等值线（+1% dVS）和深度切片（200公里），等值线每变化1%时间偏移约2 Myr。

The tomographic images are integrated with plate reconstructions to constrain the timing of Arabia-Eurasia collision (~22 Ma), cratonic underthrusting, continental subduction, and lithospheric delamination.

sum: This study evaluates the aleatory variability of response spectral amplitudes on competent rock sites in central and eastern North America (CENA). Competent rock is defined by near-surface shear-wave velocity >800 m/s and minimal site amplification (peaks < 3). The results show that at frequencies ≤5 Hz, the within-event aleatory variability for competent rock is approximately 0.4 ln units, which is substantially lower than the 0.5–0.6 ln units typically observed at soil sites. However, this variability increases at higher frequencies, surpassing soil site variability above 15 Hz. The single-station total aleatory variability ranges from 0.5 to 0.6 ln units between 1 and 10 Hz. These findings suggest that seismic hazard assessments for critical infrastructure on rock sites can benefit from reduced uncertainty models.
本研究评估了北美中东部（CENA）坚硬岩石场地响应谱振幅的偶然不确定性。坚硬岩石定义为近地表剪切波速度大于800 m/s且场地放大系数小于3的场地。结果表明，在频率≤5 Hz时，坚硬岩石的事件内偶然不确定性约为0.4对数单位，显著低于土层场地的0.5-0.6。然而，在高频（>15 Hz）下，岩石场地……

t: Empirical statistical analysis of response spectral amplitudes from ground-motion models, classifying competent rock sites using shear-wave velocity (Vs > 800 m/s) and site amplification limits.
对地震动模型响应谱振幅进行经验统计分析，利用剪切波速度和场地放大限制对坚硬岩石进行分类。
Ground-motion recordings from competent rock sites in central and eastern North America (CENA) with Vs > 800 m/s.
来自北美中东部（CENA）且剪切波速度大于800 m/s的坚硬岩石场地的地震动记录。

坚硬岩石在≤5 Hz时的事件内偶然不确定性约为0.4对数单位，但在高频（>15 Hz）下增加并超过土层。
Results are regionally constrained to CENA competent rock and show high variability at high frequencies (>15 Hz).

Demonstrates that competent rock sites have significantly lower low-frequency aleatory variability than commonly assumed soil-derived values.

Quantified the frequency-dependent behavior of aleatory variability on rock sites, showing it increases and exceeds soil variability at >15 Hz.
Provided single-station total aleatory variability estimates (~0.5–0.6 ln units) for competent rock.

sum: Deep learning-based seismic fault detection is often bottlenecked by scarce labeled field data and the unrealistic textures of synthetic training sets. This paper presents a two-stage framework using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) and Neural Style Transfer (NST). In Stage 1, an unconditional model (U-DDPM) is pretrained on standardized patches from three open-source 3D field surveys (F3, Kerry, Teapot Dome) to learn realistic seismic texture priors. In Stage 2, weights are transferred to a fault-conditioned model (FC-DDPM) fine-tuned with classifier-free guidance on NST-stylized FaultSeg3D synthetic data. The resulting FC-DDPM generates diverse, one-to-many seismic realizations honoring prescribed binary fault masks while preserving the frequency-wavenumber (F-K) bandwidth and amplitude statistics of field data. Augmenting 2,000 synthetic samples with 20,000 FC-DDPM-generated images significantly reduces overfitting and improves downstream U-Net fault detection continuity and precision on F3 and Kerry field surveys.
针对深度学习地震断层识别缺乏标注实际数据及合成数据纹理失真的瓶颈，本文提出结合去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）与神经风格迁移（NST）的两阶段生成框架。第一阶段利用F3、Kerry和Teapot三个开源实际三维地震数据集预训练无条件模型（U-DDPM）以学习真实地震纹理先验；第二阶段利用经NST风格化的……

t: A two-stage transfer learning framework pretrains an unconditional U-Net DDPM on unlabeled field seismic patches and fine-tunes a fault-conditioned DDPM using classifier-free guidance on neural style-transferred synthetic seismic-fault pairs.
采用两阶段迁移学习，先用无标签实际数据预训练U-DDPM，再用风格化合成断层对微调FC-DDPM。

Three open-source 3D field seismic surveys (F3, Kerry, Teapot Dome; 27,634 locally normalized 256x256 patches) for pretraining, plus 2,000 NST-stylized FaultSeg3D synthetic seismic-fault pairs for conditional fine-tuning.
F3、Kerry和Teapot三个开源三维实际数据（27,634个切片）及2,000对NST风格化FaultSeg3D合…

FC-DDPM lowers F-K spectral distance to field data from 1.79 to 1.48 and achieves 0.70 fault-adherence Dice. Augmenting with 20,000 generated images improves F3 field fault detection Dice from 0.134 to 0.173.

NST relies on an ImageNet-pretrained VGG-19 feature extractor, which does not encode geophysical reflector continuity and causes localized texture inconsistencies and abrupt amplitude-envelope variations.

Decouples seismic texture learning from structural fault conditioning via two-stage diffusion transfer learning, using neural style transfer as an intermediate domain-bridging step without needing paired field fault labels.
通过两阶段扩散模型迁移学习与神经风格迁移，在无配对实际标签下解耦纹理学习与断层结构控制。

Demonstrates one-to-many controllable seismic image generation using classifier-free guidance, boosting downstream U-Net fault detection performance on unseen field surveys.
提出两阶段迁移学习DDPM框架，将无条件实际地震纹理学习与结构断层条件控制解耦。

Per-patch high-quantile local amplitude normalization for multi-survey data standardization.
Neural Style Transfer (NST) using VGG-19 Gram matrices and content loss to bridge synthetic-to-field domain gaps.
Fault-conditioned DDPM (FC-DDPM) fine-tuning via zero-initialized input channel expansion and classifier-free guidance (CFG).

基于分位数局部振幅归一化的多工区地震数据标准化方法。
利用VGG-19 Gram矩阵和内容损失的神经风格迁移（NST）消除合成与实际数据间的域差异。

2,000 synthetic seismic patches and binary fault masks from FaultSeg3D stylized with F3 textures via NST for FC-DDPM fine-tuning.
Frequency-wavenumber (F-K) spectral analysis, Wasserstein amplitude distance, and sensitivity tests on CFG scale (s) and NST style weights.
Downstream U-Net fault segmentation experiments comparing baseline (2,000 synthetic) vs. augmented (20,000 FC-DDPM) training on F3 and Kerry 3D field data.

Full 1,000-step reverse diffusion sampling requires ~2.7 s per 128x128 patch (or ~5.8 s per 256x256 patch), though amortizable.

sum: This study adapts receiver-function (RF) analysis to regional intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes within the Ionian slab to image the crust beneath the Campi Flegrei volcanic caldera. By utilizing steep P-wave incidence from deep sources and correcting for finite-distance moveout, the authors overcome depth-resolution limits of local tomography. Using ray-theory simulations and global optimization, they identify a prominent low-velocity, high-Vp/Vs interface at 7.7±0.4 km depth, corresponding to the top of a magmatic sill, and a deeper discontinuity at 21.7±0.9 km representing the Moho. This novel application of regional deep-slab RFs provides high-resolution constraints on the deep magmatic plumbing system of a highly hazardous volcanic area.
本研究将接收函数分析方法应用于伊奥尼亚板块内的区域中深源地震，以成像坎皮佛莱格瑞（Campi Flegrei）火山区下方的地壳结构。利用深源地震提供的陡角P波入射，并进行有限距离动校正，结合射线理论模拟与全局优化，克服了局部地震断层成像在深部解析度不足的问题。结果表明，在7.7±0.4 km深度存在……

Regional waveforms of intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes within the Ionian slab beneath the Tyrrhenian Sea, recorded by the dense Campi Flegrei seismic network.

Identification of a prominent low-velocity interface at 7.7±0.4 km depth (magmatic sill top) and the Moho discontinuity at 21.7±0.9 km depth beneath Campi Flegrei.
