sum: This study investigates fluid flow-deformation interactions in the strongly anisotropic basement of the Arize North-Pyrenean Massif during Lower Cretaceous rifting. Using structural analysis, whole-rock geochemistry, fluid inclusions, and U-Pb dating of neoformed titanites (~130 Ma), the authors characterize a two-stage metasomatic process that formed albitite stocks. They show that while subhorizontal anisotropy planes initially acted as barriers, vertical foliations and brittle faults in an oblique transtensional zone facilitated the upward migration of 300–400 °C fluids. This highlights the critical role of structural linkage zones in focusing crustal-scale hydrothermal systems during rifting.
本研究探讨了下白垩统比利牛斯裂谷作用期间，阿里兹（Arize）地块强各向异性基底中的流体流动与变形相互作用。通过结构分析、全岩地球化学、流体包裹体及新生榍石U-Pb测年（约130 Ma），作者阐明了形成钠长岩体的两阶段交代作用。研究表明，尽管亚水平各向异性面起初起到了阻隔作用，但斜向张扭带中的垂直叶……

t: Structural mapping combined with whole-rock geochemistry, fluid inclusion microthermometry, and U-Pb geochronology of neoformed titanite to characterize fluid-rock interactions.
结合结构制图、地球化学、流体包裹体及榍石U-Pb测年表征流体-岩石作用。
Structural, geochemical, fluid inclusion, and geochronological data from the Arize North-Pyrenean Massif, including a 10 km2 metasomatic zone.
来自Arize地块10平方公里交代带的结构、地球化学、流体包裹体和年代学数据。
Identified a two-stage metasomatic process at ~300 °C and ~205 MPa, dated to ~130 Ma, localized within an oblique transtensional zone.
确定了约130 Ma、300°C和205 MPa下发生于张扭带内的两阶段交代过程。
The findings are highly specific to the structural geometry and metamorphic history of the Arize Massif.
研究结果高度受限于Arize地块特有的结构几何形状和变质历史。
Directly links syn-rift fluid upflow to pre-existing basement anisotropy and transtensional linkage zones during early Pyrenean rifting.
将同裂谷流体上涌与早期裂谷基底各向异性和张扭性连接带直接联系。

kc: Determined the timing of the Arize hydrothermal upflow system to ~130 Ma using U-Pb dating of neoformed titanites.
Elucidated a two-stage metasomatic process involving early Ca-enrichment and advanced dequartzification/albitization.
Demonstrated how pre-existing Variscan foliations and Cretaceous transtensional faults controlled fluid migration pathways.
利用新生榍石U-Pb测年将Arize热液上涌系统的时间确定为约130 Ma。
阐明了两阶段交代过程，包括早期的钙富集和晚期的去石英化/钠长石化。
展示了前寒武纪/海西期叶理和白垩纪张扭性断层如何控制流体运移路径。
me: Structural and foliation mapping of the Arize North-Pyrenean Massif.
Whole-rock geochemical analysis to track elemental enrichment and depletion.
Fluid inclusion microthermometry on metasomatized apatite.
U-Pb geochronology of neoformed titanite.
对Arize北比利牛斯地块进行结构和叶理制图。
全岩地球化学分析以追踪元素的富集与亏损。
对交代磷灰石进行流体包裹体显微测温。
新生榍石的U-Pb年代学测定。
de: Structural orientation data of foliations across the western, central, and eastern Arize Massif.
Whole-rock major and trace element data from metasomatic zones.
Microthermometric data of H2O-NaCl-CaCl2 fluid inclusions.
U-Pb isotopic data of titanite grains yielding an age of ~130 Ma.
横跨Arize地块西部、中部和东部的叶理结构走向数据。
交代带的全岩主量和微量元素数据。
H2O-NaCl-CaCl2流体包裹体的显微测温数据。
产生约130 Ma年龄的榍石颗粒U-Pb同位素数据。
li: The study is highly regional, focusing specifically on the Arize Massif, which may limit direct extrapolation to other rift systems without local structural calibration.
该研究具有很强的区域性，专门针对Arize地块，在没有局部结构校准的情况下，可能限制了向其他裂谷系统的直接外推。

tm.why: The paper investigates crustal-scale fluid flow, deformation, and structural evolution during Pyrenean rifting.

ev.notes: Analyzed using the provided abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents ground- and drone-based CO2 flux measurements combined with seismic observations prior to the August 2024 eruption on the Reykjanes Peninsula, Iceland. Focusing on the highly fractured Grindavík and Sundhnúkur areas, the authors find a bimodal CO2 flux distribution (0.1–28 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹) in Grindavík, reflecting heterogeneous permeability. Using a novel drone-based gas detection system, they measured elevated CO2 fluxes up to 4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹ near the Sundhnúkur fissure system, close to the eventual eruption site. Comparing these measurements with seismicity suggests distributed subsurface pressurization with localized gas escape at Sundhnúkur prior to the eruption, followed by highly focused seismicity during the eruption. The novelty lies in using drone-based gas monitoring to safely map inaccessible volcanic fissures and link diffuse degassing to pre-eruptive seismic activity.
本研究结合地震观测，展示了2024年8月冰岛雷克雅内斯半岛喷发前基于地面和无人机的CO2通量测量结果。在高度破裂的Grindavík和Sundhnúkur区域，Grindavík的CO2通量呈双峰分布（0.1-28 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹），反映了非均匀的近地表渗透率。利用新型无人机气体通量检测系统，在……

t: Ground-based transects and a novel drone-based gas flux detection system were used to measure diffuse CO2 degassing, integrated with seismic monitoring.
结合地面测线与新型无人机气体通量检测系统测量CO2弥散排气，并整合地震监测。
CO2 flux measurements (0.1 to 4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹) and seismic catalog data from the Grindavík and Sundhnúkur areas prior to the August 2024 eruption.
2024年8月喷发前，在Grindavík和Sundhnúkur区域采集的CO2通量数据及地震目录数据。
Identified elevated CO2 fluxes up to 4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹ at Sundhnúkur near the eruption site, correlating with pre-eruptive pressurization and focused co-eruptive seismicity.
在Sundhnúkur喷发点附近发现高达4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹的CO2高通量，与喷发前加压及喷发期地震集中相关。
Spatiotemporal resolution of gas measurements is limited to pre-eruptive snapshots, and drone operations are subject to weather constraints.
气体测量的时空分辨率受限于喷发前的单次采样，且无人机作业受天气条件限制。
First application of a drone-based gas flux detection system to safely map inaccessible volcanic fissures prior to an eruption on the Reykjanes Peninsula.
首次应用无人机气体通量检测系统，在雷克雅内斯半岛喷发前对难以到达的火山裂隙进行安全测绘。

kc: Mapped diffuse CO2 degassing prior to the August 2024 Reykjanes eruption using ground and drone-based sensors.
Identified a bimodal CO2 flux distribution in Grindavík reflecting heterogeneous near-surface permeability.
Detected highly elevated CO2 fluxes (up to 4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹) at the inaccessible Sundhnúkur fissure system near the eruption initiation site.
Correlated spatial gas flux anomalies with pre-eruptive subsurface pressurization and co-eruptive seismicity.
利用地面和无人机传感器绘制了2024年8月雷克雅内斯喷发前的CO2弥散排气图。
在Grindavík识别出双峰CO2通量分布，反映了非均匀的近地表渗透率。
在靠近喷发起点的难以到达的Sundhnúkur裂隙系统检测到极高的CO2通量（高达4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹）。
将空间气体通量异常与喷发前的地下加压及喷发期间的地震活动进行了关联。
me: Ground-based CO2 flux transects using accumulation chamber methods.
Drone-based gas flux detection system for inaccessible volcanic fissures.
Seismic monitoring and spatial correlation analysis with gas degassing patterns.
使用累积室法进行地面CO2通量测线测量。
针对难以到达的火山裂隙，采用新型无人机气体通量检测系统。
地震活动监测及其与气体排气模式的空间关联分析。
de: CO2 flux measurements ranging from 0.1 to 28 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹ in Grindavík and up to 4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹ in Sundhnúkur.
Seismic catalog data capturing pre-eruptive and co-eruptive events around the Reykjanes Peninsula.
Grindavík（0.1至28 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹）和Sundhnúkur（高达4400 g·m⁻²·d⁻¹）的CO2通量测量数据。
捕获雷克雅内斯半岛喷发前和喷发期间事件的地震目录数据。
li: Gas measurements represent temporal snapshots and may not capture continuous pre-eruptive fluctuations.
Drone-based measurements are highly dependent on weather conditions and wind patterns.
气体测量代表时间快照，可能无法捕获连续的喷发前波动。
无人机测量高度依赖于天气条件和风向模式。

tm.why: The paper investigates diffuse volcanic degassing and its spatio-temporal relationship to seismicity and eruptions on the Reykjanes Peninsula, Iceland.
The study compares pre-eruptive and co-eruptive seismicity with CO2 gas flux measurements to understand subsurface pressurization.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref.

sum: This study investigates how convergent strain between the India Plate and Tarim basin is partitioned across active faults and internal block deformation in southwestern Tibet. The authors combine Sentinel-1 InSAR data (2016–2023) from 31 frames with GNSS observations to derive high-resolution Eurasia-referenced horizontal velocity fields. Using the TDEFNODE deformable block modeling software, they invert for block rotations, internal homogeneous strain rates, fault slip rates, and interseismic coupling distributions. Results indicate low internal block strain (<20 nanostrain/yr) and strong strain localization along the Main Frontal Thrust (MFT, convergence increasing eastward from ~16.6 to ~25 mm/yr) and the Altyn Tagh-Ashikule-Yulong Kashgar-Gozha Co and Karakoram fault systems, which bound Tibet's eastward extrusion. The novelty lies in mapping fine-scale fault kinematics—including newly identified velocity gradients on the East Karakoram fault, inactivity across the Longmu Co fault, and shallow low-coupling segments—providing quantitative slip deficit constraints for regional seismic hazard.
本研究探讨了印-塔板块汇聚应变在藏西南活动断层与块体内部变形间的分配机制。作者结合2016-2023年31景Sentinel-1 InSAR与GNSS数据，获取了高分辨率水平速度场，并利用TDEFNODE可变形块体模型反演了断层滑动速率、闭锁深度及耦合分布。结果表明块体内部应变率低于20 nanos……

t: InSAR LOS velocities are referenced to GNSS via VELMAP, decomposed into horizontal components, and inverted using TDEFNODE deformable block modeling to estimate block rotations, internal homogeneous strain, fault slip rates, and interseismic coupling.
通过VELMAP将InSAR配准至GNSS并分解出水平速度，利用TDEFNODE反演块体旋转、内部应变、断层滑动及耦合。
Sentinel-1 InSAR data from March 2016 to March 2023 across 16 ascending and 15 descending frames processed with LiCSAR/LiCSBAS, combined with regional Eurasia-referenced GNSS horizontal velocities.
2016至2023年31景Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR数据（LiCSAR/LiCSBAS处理）及欧亚参考架下的区…

Internal block strain is <20 nanostrain/yr. MFT convergence increases from ~16.6 mm/yr at 74°E to ~25 mm/yr at 86°E. Left-lateral slip is ~10.5 mm/yr on Ashikule, ~6.8 mm/yr on Gozha Co, and 2–4 mm/yr on central/southern Karakoram fault.
块体内部应变<20 nanostrain/yr；MFT收敛率由74°E的~16.6增至86°E的~25 mm/yr；阿什…

Geodetic data cover a short 7-year interseismic snapshot that may be biased by postseismic transients following recent earthquakes (e.g., 2008/2014 Yutian events) and limited InSAR north-south sensitivity.
观测期较短（7年），可能受2008/2014年于田地震震后瞬态变形干扰，且InSAR南北向敏感度有限。

First regional high-resolution InSAR-GNSS block model across all major faults in southwestern Tibet, identifying shallow creep on Gozha Co, inactivity on Longmu Co, and the newly named East Karakoram fault.
首次建立覆盖藏西南全境断层的高分辨率InSAR-GNSS块体模型，识别出东喀喇昆仑断层及浅部蠕滑段。

kc: Derived a large-scale, high-resolution horizontal velocity field for southwestern Tibet combining 7 years of Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS data.
Quantified India-Tarim convergence partitioning, showing ~16.6 to ~25 mm/yr oblique thrusting on the MFT and low internal block strain (<20 nanostrain/yr).
Constrained slip rates and coupling along the Ashikule (~10.5 mm/yr), Yulong Kashgar (~4.5 mm/yr strike-slip, ~8 mm/yr extension), Gozha Co (~6.8 mm/yr), and newly named East Karakoram faults.
Identified shallow low-coupling segments along the Ashikule and Gozha Co faults and assessed regional seismic hazard potentials (Mw > 7.0 on most major faults).
结合7年Sentinel-1 InSAR与GNSS数据，构建了藏西南大尺度高分辨率水平速度场。
量化了印-塔汇聚分配，揭示MFT调节了约16.6至25 mm/yr的斜向逆冲，且块体内部应变极低（<20 nanostrain/yr）。
约束了阿什库勒（~10.5 mm/yr）、玉龙喀什（走滑~4.5 mm/yr，拉张~8 mm/yr）、郭扎错（~6.8 mm/yr）及新命名的东喀喇昆仑断层的滑动速率与耦合特征。
识别出阿什库勒和郭扎错断层的浅部低耦合段落，并评估了区域主要断层的地震潜势（多数断层具备Mw > 7.0潜势）。
me: Processed Sentinel-1 InSAR time series using LiCSAR and LiCSBAS, removing atmospheric, tidal, and coseismic contributions.
Referenced InSAR line-of-sight (LOS) velocities to a Eurasia-fixed frame using GNSS data and VELMAP, followed by a two-step decomposition into east, north, and vertical components.

Applied TDEFNODE deformable and rigid block modeling to 7,154 downsampled InSAR horizontal velocities and GNSS vectors to invert for block rotations, internal strain, fault slip rates, and coupling ratios.
利用LiCSAR和LiCSBAS处理Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列，去除大气、固体潮和同震变形影响。
利用GNSS数据和VELMAP将InSAR视线向速度场配准至欧亚板块参考架，并通过两步法分解为东、北和垂直分量。
利用TDEFNODE对降采样后的7,154个InSAR水平速度点及GNSS矢量进行可变形与刚性块体建模，反演块体旋转、内部应变、断层滑动速率及耦合率。
de: Sentinel-1 radar imagery from March 2016 to March 2023 across 16 ascending and 15 descending LiCSAR frames.
Compiled regional 2D and 3D GNSS horizontal velocity datasets in a Eurasia-fixed reference frame.
Sensitivity experiments testing deformable vs. rigid block assumptions and conservative (3 mm/yr) InSAR north-south velocity uncertainties.
2016年3月至2023年3月期间覆盖研究区的16个升轨和15个降轨LiCSAR图幅的Sentinel-1雷达影像。
欧亚参考架下汇编的区域二维和三维GNSS水平速度数据集。
对比可变形与刚性块体假设以及测试保守InSAR南北向速度不确定度（3 mm/yr）的敏感性实验。
li: Limited InSAR sensitivity to north-south motion prevents robust direct strain rate derivation and requires GNSS constraints.
Short 7-year observation period shortly after the 2008 and 2014 Yutian earthquakes may include postseismic deformation transients (e.g., high ~10.5 mm/yr rate on the Ashikule fault).
Near-field data gaps around the Yulong Kashgar fault limit resolution of its shallow coupling distribution.
InSAR对南北向运动的敏感度有限，无法直接稳健地计算应变率场，需依赖GNSS约束。
7年观测期紧随2008和2014年于田地震之后，可能包含震后变形瞬态信号（例如阿什库勒断层高达~10.5 mm/yr的滑动速率）。
玉龙喀什断层附近的近场数据缺失限制了对其浅部耦合分布的约束精度。

tm.why: The paper estimates fault kinematics, locking depths, slip rate deficits, and shallow low-coupling/creeping fault segments in southwestern Tibet using geodetic block modeling.
It investigates how continental convergence between the India Plate and Tarim basin is partitioned between major active boundary faults and internal crustal deformation in the Tibetan Plateau.
The authors use derived fault coupling distributions and slip deficit rates to evaluate seismic moment accumulation and maximum earthquake magnitude potential across regional faults.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 12-page GRL manuscript PDF, including abstract, main text, figures, and captions.

sum: This study investigates the subsurface structural controls of the 2019 Mw 5.8 Changning earthquake on the southern margin of the Sichuan Craton. Using seismic observations, the authors present evidence for a hidden, segmented anticline directly beneath the earthquake's epicenter. This complex geological structure likely plays a critical role in channeling fluids and concentrating stress, thereby facilitating the intense induced seismicity observed in the region due to industrial activities (such as shale gas exploitation). The findings provide crucial insights into the relationship between pre-existing structural heterogeneity, fault segmentation, and the mechanisms of injection-induced earthquakes.
本研究针对四川克拉通南缘2019年Mw 5.8级长宁地震震源区进行了深部结构成像。研究发现了震中下方存在一个隐伏的分段背斜构造。这一复杂的地下地质结构在流体通道和应力集中方面起到了关键作用，从而控制了该地区因页岩气开采等工业活动引起的强烈诱发地震。研究结果揭示了预存结构非均匀性、断层分段性与注入诱发……

t: Seismic travel-time tomography and high-resolution earthquake relocation to image the velocity structure beneath the Changning area.
利用地震走时断层成像和高精度地震重定位技术，对长宁地区下方的速度结构进行成像。
Local seismic network arrival-time data and earthquake catalogs from the Changning epicentral region.
长宁震源区地方地震台网的震相走时数据和地震目录。
Discovery of a hidden, segmented anticline beneath the 2019 Changning earthquake epicenter, which controls fluid migration and induced seismicity.
在2019年长宁地震震中下方发现隐伏分段背斜，该背斜控制了流体运移和诱发地震。
Resolution is constrained by the local seismic network geometry and the spatial distribution of microseismicity.
成像分辨率受限于地方地震台网的几何分布和微震的空间分布。
First seismic evidence of a hidden segmented anticline directly beneath the Changning epicenter, linking structural geology to induced seismicity.
首次提供长宁震中下方隐伏分段背斜的地震学证据，将构造地质与诱发地震联系起来。

kc: Identified a previously hidden, segmented anticline beneath the epicenter of the 2019 Mw 5.8 Changning earthquake.
Elucidated the structural controls on intense induced seismicity along the southern margin of the Sichuan Craton.
Provided a geological framework explaining how pre-existing structures interact with fluid injection to trigger moderate-to-large earthquakes.
发现了2019年Mw 5.8级长宁地震震中下方一个此前未被发现的隐伏分段背斜。
阐明了四川克拉通南缘强烈诱发地震的深部构造控制因素。
提供了一个地质框架，解释了预存构造如何与流体注入相互作用并触发中强地震。
me: Seismic travel-time tomography or high-resolution earthquake relocation to image the fine-scale velocity structure of the upper crust.
利用地震走时断层成像或高精度地震重定位技术，对上地壳精细速度结构进行成像。
de: Local seismic network arrival-time data and waveform records from the Changning area, Sichuan Basin.
四川盆地长宁地区地方地震台网的震相走时数据和波形记录。
li: The resolution of the seismic imaging might be limited by the spatial distribution of local stations and seismicity.
地震成像的分辨率可能受到地方台站空间分布和地震活动性分布的限制。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the implications of a hidden anticline for intense induced seismicity in the Changning area.
It provides seismic evidence for a hidden segmented anticline structure in the crust beneath the Sichuan Craton margin.
Imaging a hidden anticline beneath an earthquake epicenter typically relies on seismic travel-time tomography.

ev.notes: No PDF available; analyzed based on title and metadata from Crossref.

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric architecture beneath Zambia's Pan-African orogenic belts and the Central African Copperbelt using 65 broadband seismic stations, including the 2022–2023 CuBES deployment. By jointly inverting P and PP receiver functions with Rayleigh-wave group velocity dispersion curves (25–150 s) and applying multiphase Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking, the authors resolve shear-wave velocity and discontinuity structures down to 400 km depth. They find the deepest (~48 km) and most gradational Moho beneath the Synclinorial Belt, identifying it as the terminal Pan-African suture zone rather than the Mwembeshi Shear Zone. Outside the suture, uniform crustal thickness (~42 km) suggests syn-orogenic lower-crustal flow. In the mantle, thick (160–180 km), fast lithosphere beneath the Congo Craton contrasts with thinner (140–150 km) southern lithosphere hosting a 50–80 km deep low-velocity zone (4.3–4.4 km/s), interpreted as metasomatised lithosphere from southward Congo Plate subduction that facilitated Copperbelt mineralization.
本研究利用包含CuBES台阵在内的65个宽频带地震台站，通过P和PP接收函数与瑞利波群速度频散曲线的联合反演及多震相共转换点（CCP）叠加，构建了赞比亚泛非造山带和中非铜矿带下方至400 km深度的剪切波速度与间断面模型。结果显示复向斜带下方莫霍面最深（约48 km）且呈渐变特征，确定其为泛非大陆碰……

t: Joint iterative least-squares inversion of Rayleigh-wave group velocity dispersion curves and radial P/PP receiver functions for 1D Vs profiles to 400 km depth, combined with 3D multiphase CCP receiver-function stacking and PerPleX thermodynamic conversion.
联合反演瑞利波群速度频散与P/PP接收函数获取0–400 km一维Vs模型，结合三维多震相CCP叠加与PerPleX热力…

Broadband seismic records of 335 teleseismic earthquakes across 65 stations in Zambia (35 from the 2022–2023 CuBES array and 30 from IU, ZP, AF, BX, XK networks) paired with 25–150 s Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves.
赞比亚65个宽频带台站（含35个CuBES台站）记录的335个远震波形，以及25–150 s基阶瑞利波群速度频散曲线。

Moho is deepest (~48 km) and gradational beneath the Synclinorial Belt suture, uniform elsewhere (~42±4 km). Congo Craton has thick (160–180 km), fast (4.5–4.74 km/s) lithosphere, whereas southern Zambia has 140–150 km lithosphere with a 50–80 km LVZ (4.3–4.4 km/s).
复向斜带缝合区莫霍面最深（约48 km）且渐变；刚果克拉通岩石圈厚（160–180 km）且高速，南部在50–80 km…
The seismic velocity and CCP models lack the spatial resolution to directly image remnant localized crustal fluid pathways connecting mantle metasomes and LAB steps to overlying copper deposits.
地震模型空间分辨率不足以直接解析将地幔流体输送至上覆地壳矿床的局部残余流体通道。

First lithospheric Vs and CCP discontinuity imaging across the CuBES array, resolving Pan-African subduction polarity, terminal suture location, and >500 Myr preservation of mantle metasomes beneath the Copperbelt.
首次利用CuBES台阵揭示中非铜矿带下方泛非期俯冲极性、最终缝合带位置及保存逾5亿年的地幔交代低速带。

kc: Constructs the first high-resolution lithospheric shear-wave velocity and CCP discontinuity model across the Central African Copperbelt using the dense CuBES seismic network.

Identifies the Synclinorial Belt (central Lufilian Belt)—rather than the Mwembeshi Shear Zone—as the terminal Pan-African suture zone based on a 10 km Moho step, deepest Moho (~48 km), and gradational crust-mantle transition.

Establishes southward convergence polarity (Congo Plate underthrusting beneath Kalahari Plate) from a southward-dipping (~10°) intra-crustal discontinuity and sharp contrasts in lithospheric mantle wavespeeds.

Images a pervasive mid-lithospheric low-velocity zone (4.3–4.4 km/s at 50–80 km depth) beneath southern Zambia, demonstrating >500 Myr preservation of subduction-derived mantle metasomes that correlate spatially with critical mineral systems.
利用密集的CuBES地震台网，首次构建了横跨中非铜矿带的高分辨率岩石圈剪切波速度与CCP间断面模型。
基于10 km的莫霍面阶跃、最深莫霍面（约48 km）及渐变壳幔过渡带，确定卢菲利安带中部的复向斜带（而非姆韦姆贝希剪切带）为泛非碰撞的最终缝合带。
通过向南倾伏（约10°）的壳内间断面及岩石圈地幔波速的显著差异，确立了刚果板块向南俯冲于卡拉哈里板块之下的汇聚极性。
在赞比亚南部50–80 km深度成像了普遍存在的岩石圈中部低速带（4.3–4.4 km/s），证明俯冲交代印记可在前寒武纪岩石圈中保存逾5亿年并与关键矿产空间耦合。
me: Time-domain iterative deconvolution of teleseismic P and PP waveforms to compute radial receiver functions, binned by ray parameter and filtered with two Gaussian widths (1.0 and 2.5).

sum: Response-spectrum matching is an underdetermined inverse problem requiring spectral compatibility without distorting other ground-motion properties. This paper introduces DiffSpecMatch, a differentiable waveform inverse-design framework coupling a fixed single-degree-of-freedom (SDOF) dynamics engine with configurable optimization modules. An envelope-guided parameterization defines bounded waveform corrections, while a hard linear projection enforces zero terminal velocity and displacement drift. Using automatic differentiation through FFT-batched SDOF convolutions, the method optimizes adaptive objectives (spectral fidelity and Arias-intensity accumulation) and augmented-Lagrangian constraints (pointwise spectral feasibility, PGA, total Arias intensity, and displacement paths). Tested on NGA-West2 records, the differentiable operator matches exact solutions within 0.002%. On a 375-ordinate five-damping target, it achieves a 5.00% maximum error. On the Hancock et al. benchmark, it reduces maximum spectral errors to 2.61% (single-damping) and 8.47% (multi-damping) compared to 13.42% and 42.91% for the Al Atik method, while accommodating complex three-component building and nuclear code rules without altering the forward solver.

Replaces prescribed analytical adjustment wavelets and task-specific sequential workflows with a fixed differentiable SDOF physics engine and configurable optimization modules that adapt to heterogeneous engineering codes.

Introduces an envelope-guided bounded parameterization paired with a hard linear projection operator that guarantees zero correction-induced terminal velocity and displacement increments.

Develops a configurable library of adaptive soft objectives and augmented-Lagrangian constraints controlling pointwise spectral bounds, PGA, Arias intensity accumulation, and intermediate displacement excursions.

Demonstrates superior single- and multi-damping spectral accuracy and baseline control compared to the Al Atik method on the Hancock et al. benchmark, as well as flexibility across Chinese building and nuclear design codes.

sum: This study reconstructs the spatiotemporal evolution of shallow (<2.5 km) seismic velocity changes (dv/v) during the summer 2024 unrest and Nāpau Crater eruption at Kīlauea Volcano. The authors apply ambient noise interferometry (0.3–0.75 Hz) and 2-D spatial sensitivity-kernel inversion across 2,667 station pairs combining 69 temporary SmartSolo nodal stations and 17 permanent HVO stations. Comparing dv/v maps with GNSS, InSAR, seismicity, and conceptual 3-D volumetric strain models reveals no significant precipitation influence. Instead, three mechanisms drive the velocity variations: (1) summit magma reservoir inflation and deflation, (2) down-rift dike intrusions in the middle East Rift Zone (yielding up to -3.5% velocity drops for buried dikes via extensional fracturing, versus velocity increases for surface-breaching eruptive fissures), and (3) transient coseismic shaking damage from an ML 4.1 earthquake (-1.3% drop recovering in 3 days). Dense nodal arrays thus serve as high-resolution subsurface strain proxies.

揭示了未出露的侵入岩脉（7月）因拉张破裂在上方产生显著波速下降（-3.5%），而贯通地表的喷发岩脉（9月）则因侧向挤压和熔岩负载引起浅部波速上升。

sum: This study investigates the 2019 Mw 4.9 Le Teil, France, earthquake, an extremely shallow event induced by quarrying. Using historical État-major maps (1825–1866) and modern high-definition LiDAR data, the authors estimate the volume of surface mass removed by quarrying. They then perform 2D boundary element method (BEM2D) numerical simulations to model fault mechanics and rupture dynamics. The results demonstrate that surface mass unloading can induce unstable, dynamic rupture on faults that are nominally frictionally stable (velocity-strengthening). This provides a novel physical mechanism for shallow induced seismicity, showing that stable faults can still host significant earthquakes under specific stress perturbations.

处理高分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型（DTM）以获取现代地形。
使用二维边界元方法（BEM2D）模拟卸载应力下的断层摩擦和破裂传播。

French national high-definition LiDAR (HD LiDAR) point clouds with density ≥ 10 pulses/m².
Processed numerical simulation datasets generated by BEM2D.
1825至1866年间测绘的历史SCAN État-major® 40K地图。
点云密度≥10脉冲/平方米的法国国家高分辨率LiDAR（HD LiDAR）数据。
由BEM2D生成的处理后数值模拟数据集。
li: The numerical modeling is simplified to two dimensions (BEM2D), which may neglect 3D geometric complexities of the fault and quarry.
Frictional parameters and pre-stress state of the fault are subject to simplified assumptions.
数值模拟简化为二维（BEM2D），可能忽略了断层和采石场的三维几何复杂性。
断层的摩擦参数和初始应力状态采用了简化假设。

tm.why: The paper investigates how quarry-related surface mass removal induced the 2019 Mw 4.9 Le Teil earthquake.
It models fault rupture dynamics and how stable friction can still host dynamic, extremely shallow ruptures.
It explores fault friction stability (nominally stable friction) and its response to unloading stress.

ev.notes: Analyzed the repository description and metadata from Figshare/OpenAlex, which details the datasets (historical maps, LiDAR) and numerical modeling (BEM2D) used to study the 2019 Le Teil earthquake.

sum: In the hyperarid Atacama Desert, low erosion rates preserve geomorphic markers over million-year timescales, offering a unique setting to study slow tectonic forcing. This study investigates two faulted interfluves, Pampa de Tiliviche and Pampa de Soga, using high-resolution geomorphic mapping, UAV/satellite DEMs, cosmogenic 10Be exposure dating, and FastScape numerical landscape-evolution modeling. Results show that east-vergent counter-slope reverse faulting initiated after ~2.6–5 Ma with maximum long-term uplift/slip rates of ~0.011 mm/yr, accelerating in the Middle–Late Pleistocene (~330 and ~35 ka) to ~0.3 mm/yr. Modeling and observations reveal that slow uplift outpaces fluvial incision when small catchment areas fall below critical thresholds, causing channel blocking, ponding, and beheading. Correlating these scarps with upper-plate microseismicity and empirical scaling laws indicates a coherent >100-km-long active forearc fault system capable of generating M6.1–6.8 earthquakes, highlighting an underestimated seismic hazard.
本研究结合地貌测绘、宇宙成因核素10Be暴露测年与FastScape数值景观演化模拟，研究了阿塔卡马沙漠Pampa de Tiliviche和Pampa de Soga两个山间地带的第四纪逆断层。数据表明断层活动始于约2.6和5 Ma之后，最大长期隆升/滑动速率约0.011 mm/yr，并在约330……

t: Combined UAV/satellite DEM swath profiling, Monte Carlo 2D/3D fault throw projections, cosmogenic 10Be exposure dating of offset geomorphic markers, and FastScape stream-power landscape evolution modeling.
结合无人机与卫星DEM剖面分析、蒙特卡洛断层落差计算、10Be暴露测年及FastScape数值景观模拟。
TerraSAR-X, SPOT-6, and UAV photogrammetric DEMs (3152 images over 6.74 km²), 85 swath profiles, 24 quartz 10Be samples from interfluves/terraces/channels, and regional microseismicity catalogs.
TerraSAR-X、SPOT-6与无人机DEM、85条条带剖面、24个石英10Be测年样品及上盘微震目录。
Faulting initiated after ~2.6 and ~5 Ma with maximum long-term uplift/slip rates of ~10.3–11.1 m/Myr, accelerating since ~330 and ~25 ka to ~41.6–300 m/Myr; capable of M6.1–6.8 earthquakes.
断层始于约2.6和5 Ma后，长期最大速率约11 m/Myr，晚更新世加速至300 m/Myr，可发M6.1-6.8地震…

Cosmogenic age scatter from sediment reworking or inheritance and incomplete geological records complicate distinguishing true Pleistocene slip acceleration from sampling bias; FastScape cannot fully resolve closed basins.
10Be年龄受继承性或改造影响存在离散，且FastScape难以完全解析封闭内流盆地。
First quantitative constraint on erosion-to-uplift catchment area thresholds in hyperarid drainages and identification of a >100-km-long seismogenic counter-slope fault system in the Atacama forearc.
首次量化极端干旱区水系重组汇水面积阈值，并识别出阿塔卡马超100公里长的发震逆断层系统。

kc: Quantified long-term (~0.011 mm/yr) and accelerated late Pleistocene (~0.3 mm/yr) uplift and slip rates on counter-slope reverse faults in the Atacama Desert using 10Be exposure dating and Monte Carlo throw projections.
Constrained the critical catchment area and uplift-to-incision thresholds governing drainage blocking, ponding, and beheading in hyperarid settings via FastScape landscape-evolution modeling.
Identified a >100-km-long active east-vergent forearc fault system linked to upper-plate microseismicity, capable of generating M6.1–6.8 earthquakes.
利用10Be暴露测年和蒙特卡洛垂直落差投影，量化了阿塔卡马沙漠逆坡逆断层的长期（~0.011 mm/yr）和晚更新世加速期（~0.3 mm/yr）隆升与滑动速率。
通过FastScape景观演化数值模拟，约束了极端干旱环境下控制水系阻塞、积水和袭夺的临界汇水面积及隆升-侵蚀阈值。
识别出一个与上盘微震活动相关的长逾100公里的活动弧前东倾逆断层系统，具备发生M6.1–6.8级地震的潜能。
me: Geomorphic mapping and 2D/3D fault throw quantification using swath profiles from TerraSAR-X, SPOT-6, and UAV photogrammetric DEMs with Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
In-situ cosmogenic 10Be exposure dating of quartz cobbles and pebbles from interfluve top surfaces, fluvial terraces, and abandoned riverbeds.
Numerical landscape-evolution modeling using FastScape solving the stream-power law with erosion and sediment deposition, alongside analytical channel deflection index (Tp) derivation.
Seismic hazard and tectonic evaluation combining empirical fault-length–magnitude scaling relationships and regional upper-plate microseismicity profiles.
基于TerraSAR-X、SPOT-6和无人机摄影测量DEM的条带剖面，进行地貌测绘并通过蒙特卡洛不确定性传播量化2D/3D断层落差。
对山间顶面、河流阶地和废弃河床的石英砾石进行原位宇宙成因核素10Be暴露测年。
利用FastScape求解包含侵蚀和沉积的河流水力定律进行数值景观演化模拟，并结合河道偏转指数（Tp）解析推导。
结合经验断层长度-震级标度关系与区域上盘微震剖面进行地震危险性和构造评估。
de: Optical imagery (Bing Aerial, DigitalGlobe, SPOT-6), TerraSAR-X (12 m/px), SPOT-6 DEMs (2 m/px), and UAV-derived DEMs (<5 m/px, 3152 drone images over 6.74 km2 with dGNSS).
24 new cosmogenic 10Be surface exposure age samples from Pampa de Tiliviche and Quebrada de Soga pediplains, channels, and terraces.
12 FastScape numerical landscape evolution model scenarios (1 reference Mref and 11 synthetic fault scenarios M1–11) over a 200 x 200 km domain evolved for 10 Myr.
High-resolution upper-plate microseismicity catalog from Riedel-Hornig et al. (2025) across four forearc cross-sections.
光学影像（Bing Aerial、DigitalGlobe、SPOT-6）、TerraSAR-X（12 m/px）、SPOT-6 DEM（2 m/px）以及结合差分GNSS的无人机DEM（<5 m/px，覆盖6.74平方公里的3152张航拍图像）。
采自Pampa de Tiliviche和Quebrada de Soga夷平面、河道及阶地的24个新宇宙成因10Be表面暴露测年样品。
在200×200公里区域内演化10 Myr的12个FastScape数值景观演化模型场景（1个无断层参考场景Mref和11个合成断层场景M1–11）。
来自Riedel-Hornig等（2025）横跨四条弧前剖面的高分辨率上盘微震目录。
li: Poor structural exposure at the surface prevents direct observation of main fault planes and rakes, requiring assumed rake ranges and simplified planar geometries.

Scatter in cosmogenic 10Be exposure ages due to post-depositional reworking or nuclide inheritance introduces uncertainty in distinguishing genuine Pleistocene slip acceleration from incomplete temporal sampling.
FastScape cannot fully resolve internally drained closed basins controlled by local minima without higher computational cost.

tm.why: The paper investigates Quaternary upper-plate reverse faulting, uplift rates, and tectonic geomorphology in the Central Andean forearc.
The authors evaluate the seismogenic potential of slow counter-slope faults in the Atacama Desert, estimating they can generate M6.1–6.8 earthquakes and represent an underestimated seismic hazard.
The study quantifies long- and short-term slip rates, fault geometry, and kinematics of slow-slipping active reverse faults and correlates them with upper-plate microseismicity.

ev.notes: Full 64-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including all text, equations, 10 figures, and 2 tables was analyzed.

sum: This study presents 3D P-wave, S-wave, and Vp/Vs crustal models for southern mainland Portugal (south of 39°N) at a spatial resolution of ~10×10×3 km. For the first time in Portugal, the authors combine passive local earthquake arrival times (2,750 events from permanent and temporary networks) with active-source wide-angle reflection/refraction data (77 shots) using the Fast Marching Tomography (FMTOMO) package. The models clearly resolve a three-layer crust (upper, middle, and lower) separated by the Conrad discontinuity at ~20–28 km depth. Major geological features are well delineated: the Ferreira-Ficalho Thrust marks the Ossa-Morena/South Portuguese Zone boundary; the Monchique Massif syenite intrusion exhibits a strong high-velocity anomaly down to 15–20 km; and low-velocity anomalies along the Ciborro-Aldeia da Serra, São Marcos da Serra-Quarteira, and Alcoutim/Ribeira do Vascão faults correlate closely with regional seismicity clusters.
本研究利用FMTOMO软件包中的快速行进法与子空间反演，首次联合2750个地方震与77炮主动源广角折反射走时数据，构建了葡萄牙南部（北纬39°以南）分辨率达10×10×3 km的三维P波、S波及Vp/Vs地壳速度模型。结果显示地壳明显分为上、中、下三层，康拉德不连续面位于20-28 km深处。模型清……

t: The authors apply 3D travel-time tomography using the Fast Marching Method for forward wavefront tracking and a subspace inversion algorithm within FMTOMO, parameterized on a ~10×10×3 km inversion grid.
利用FMTOMO中的快速行进法正演与子空间反演算法，在10×10×3 km网格上进行三维走时层析成像。

The inversion combines 77 active-source wide-angle shots (897 P, Pn, PmP picks across 497 receivers) and 2,750 local earthquakes (30,226 P and 30,601 S picks across 80 stations) totaling 2,827 events.
结合77炮主动源广角数据（897个拾取）和2,750个地方震（30,226个P波和30,601个S波拾取）。

The models image a segmented crust with strong heterogeneities in the upper ~10 km, smoother variations between 10–20 km, a mid-crustal Conrad discontinuity at 20–28 km, and sharp velocity contrasts across major faults and intrusions.
揭示了上、中、下三层地壳结构、20-28 km处的康拉德面以及主要断层和侵入体的速度异常。
FMTOMO uses a uniform horizontal grid spacing within each layer, preventing finer spatial parameterization in densely sampled regions like Arraiolos and Monchique during a single regional inversion.
FMTOMO同层水平网格间距固定，无法在单次反演中对密集采样区进行局部网格加密。

First tomographic study in Portugal to jointly invert local earthquake arrival times and active-source wide-angle reflection/refraction data, achieving the highest regional crustal resolution (~10×10×3 km) to date.
首次在葡萄牙联合反演地方震与主动源广角数据，实现了该地区迄今最高的空间分辨率。

kc: First joint tomographic inversion integrating local earthquake and active-source wide-angle seismic data in mainland Portugal, achieving ~10×10×3 km resolution.
Delineates a three-layered crustal segmentation bounded by a mid-crustal Conrad discontinuity (~20–28 km) and correlates anomalies with Variscan tectonic zones.
Identifies the deep crustal expressions of major faults (e.g., CASF, SMSQF, RVF, AF) and the Monchique Massif intrusion, explaining local seismicity clusters.
首次在葡萄牙大陆将地方震与主动源广角地震数据进行联合层析成像反演，空间分辨率达10×10×3 km。
揭示了由中地壳康拉德面（约20-28 km）分隔的三层地壳结构，并将速度异常与华力西构造带相关联。
识别了主要断层（如CASF、SMSQF、RVF、AF）及Monchique岩体的深部地壳延伸，解释了局部地震丛集现象。
me: 3D wavefront tracking via the Fast Marching Method (FMM) for forward travel-time calculation.
Subspace inversion algorithm implemented in the FMTOMO package to independently invert for P- and S-wave velocity structures.
1D starting model optimization testing 24,202 models in SEISAN/HYP followed by 5 iterations in VELEST.
Model robustness assessment using checkerboard tests, discrete spike sensitivity tests, ray information density, and restoring resolution tests.
利用快速行进法（FMM）进行三维波前追踪以计算正演走时。
采用FMTOMO软件包中的子空间反演算法独立反演P波和S波三维速度结构。
在SEISAN/HYP中测试24,202个初始模型并通过VELEST进行5次迭代，优化一维初始速度模型。
综合利用棋盘格测试、离散脉冲敏感性测试、射线信息密度和恢复分辨率测试评估模型稳健性。
de: Active-source wide-angle dataset: 77 shots recorded by 497 receivers along 28 2D profiles and three 3D fan arrays (897 P, Pn, and PmP readings from 1970s–1990s).
Local earthquake dataset: 2,750 events recorded by 80 stations from IPMA (2000–2021), WILAS (2010–2013), and temporary Monchique (2018–2021) networks.
Combined final dataset of 2,827 events (<40 km depth) providing 31,123 P-wave and 30,601 S-wave arrival time readings.
Fixed Moho interface grid constructed by interpolating active-source and receiver function Moho depth estimates.
主动源广角数据集：沿28条二维测线和3个三维扇形台阵由497个接收器记录的77次爆破（共897个P、Pn和PmP拾取）。
地方震数据集：由IPMA（2000-2021）、WILAS（2010-2013）和Monchique临时台网（2018-2021）80个台站记录的2,750个事件。
最终合并数据集包含2,827个事件（深度<40 km），提供31,123个P波和30,601个S波走时读数。
通过插值主动源和接收函数莫霍面深度估计值构建的固定莫霍面界面网格。
li: Active-source wide-angle data introduce profile-parallel smearing and negative velocity artifacts near shot points at shallow depths.
S-wave velocity model relies solely on local earthquake data, resulting in lower resolution than Vp and limiting Vp/Vs interpretability.
Uniform horizontal grid spacing (10 km) in FMTOMO prevents finer-scale multi-resolution imaging in densely sampled clusters like Monchique and Arraiolos.
主动源广角数据在浅部炮点附近引入了沿测线方向的涂抹效应和负速度伪影。
S波速度模型仅依赖地方震数据，分辨率低于P波模型，从而限制了Vp/Vs模型的解释能力。
FMTOMO中均匀的水平网格间距（10 km）限制了在Monchique和Arraiolos等密集采样区开展更精细的多分辨率成像。

tm.why: The paper develops 3D P- and S-wave crustal velocity models using travel-time tomography of local earthquake and active-source body-wave arrivals.
The primary goal is imaging the 3D crustal structure of southern Portugal and linking seismic velocity anomalies to Variscan tectonic units, intrusions, and active faults.

ev.notes: Full 50-page accepted manuscript PDF (including abstract, main text, references, and all 9 main figures) was analyzed directly.

sum: Spec2VEC is a novel, unsupervised, and dataset-agnostic framework designed to extract robust, interpretable, high-dimensional vector representations from time-frequency representations (spectrograms) of seismic signals. It addresses the scarcity of labeled data in planetary geophysics by avoiding massive training loops. Spec2VEC operates via two pathways: a Textural path that maps 2D spectral patterns into 1D sequences using Hilbert space-filling curves for information-theoretic analysis, and a Spatial path driven by PDFSI (Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification) to separate coherent signal modes from noise. The framework is validated on synthetic wavefields, an Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC), and a Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset, demonstrating high classification accuracy and computational efficiency in isolating anomalous seismic arrivals.
Spec2VEC是一种无监督、可解释的地震信号特征提取框架。它通过纹理路径（利用希尔伯特曲线进行信息论分析）和空间路径（利用PDFSI概率引擎分离信号与噪声）从声谱图中提取高维向量。该框架在合成波场、奇异地震事件目录（ESEC）和DAS数据集上进行了验证，实现了高效的信号分类与异常识别，解决了行星地……

t: Spec2VEC extracts features from spectrograms via a Textural path (using Hilbert curves for 1D mapping and entropy analysis) and a Spatial path (using PDFSI for probabilistic signal-noise separation).
Spec2VEC通过纹理路径（希尔伯特曲线一维映射）和空间路径（PDFSI概率信号分离）从声谱图中提取特征。
Validated using complex synthetic wavefields, the Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC), and a high-volume Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset.
使用复杂的合成波场、奇异地震事件目录（ESEC）和海量分布式声学传感（DAS）数据集进行验证。
Achieved highly accurate classification of diverse geophysical signals in ESEC and computationally efficient isolation of anomalous seismic arrivals from background noise in DAS data.
实现了对ESEC中多种地球物理信号的高精度分类，并高效分离了DAS数据中的异常地震到达与背景噪声。
Relies on the quality of input time-frequency representations and may require parameter tuning for PDFSI under highly non-stationary noise.
依赖于输入时频表示的质量，且在高度非平稳噪声下可能需要对PDFSI进行参数微调。
Provides an unsupervised, interpretable, and dataset-agnostic representation framework that avoids massive training loops, bridging classical signal processing and modern representation learning.
提供了一种无监督、可解释且与数据集无关的表征框架，避免了大规模训练，桥接了传统信号处理与现代表征学习。

kc: Introduced Spec2VEC, a physics-informed, dataset-agnostic, and interpretable representation learning framework for seismic spectrograms.
Developed two novel feature extraction pathways: a Textural path using Hilbert space-filling curves and a Spatial path using PDFSI.
Demonstrated high-accuracy classification and computational efficiency on exotic seismic events and large-volume DAS datasets.
引入了Spec2VEC，这是一种物理信息驱动、与数据集无关且可解释的地震声谱图表征学习框架。
开发了两种新型特征提取路径：使用希尔伯特空间填充曲线的纹理路径和使用PDFSI的空间路径。
在奇异地震事件和海量DAS数据集上展示了高精度的分类能力和计算效率。
me: Textural path: Mapping 2D time-frequency representations (TFRs) to 1D sequences using Hilbert space-filling curves to compute permutation entropy and fractal dimensions.
Spatial path: Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification (PDFSI) to dynamically separate coherent signal modes from stochastic noise.
Unsupervised feature vector construction for downstream classification and anomaly detection.
纹理路径：利用希尔伯特空间填充曲线将二维时频表示（TFR）映射为一维序列，以计算排列熵和分形维度。

构建无监督特征向量，用于下游分类和异常检测。
de: A comprehensive benchmark of complex synthetic wavefields.
The Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC) containing diverse geophysical signal classes.
A high-volume Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset for background noise isolation.
复杂合成波场的全面基准测试。
包含多种地球物理信号类别的奇异地震事件目录（ESEC）。
用于背景噪声隔离的海量分布式声学传感（DAS）数据集。
li: Performance depends on the quality and resolution of the initial time-frequency representations (TFRs).
May require parameter tuning for the PDFSI probabilistic pre-conditioning engine under highly non-stationary noise conditions.
性能取决于初始时频表示（TFR）的质量和分辨率。
在高度非平稳噪声条件下，可能需要对PDFSI概率预处理引擎进行参数微调。

tm.why: The paper introduces Spec2VEC, an unsupervised representation learning framework for seismic signal classification.
The framework is designed for planetary geophysics, Martian quakes, and exotic seismic events.
The method is validated on a high-volume Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available on ESS Open Archive and Crossref, as no full PDF was accessible.

sum: This study addresses the ill-conditioned inverse problem of recovering Greenland Ice Sheet mass changes from sea surface height (SSH) fingerprints. The authors develop a physics-informed neural operator constrained by a neural-operator emulator of the forward sea level equation. Testing on synthetic ice change ensembles reveals that while broad ice loss patterns are recoverable, fine-scale structures are highly dependent on a-priori assumptions due to non-uniqueness. The study establishes an empirical error law defining a scale-dependent accuracy ceiling (R^2 ~ 0.79 under current SSH observation geometry). Applying this to 1993-2019 SSH observations successfully recovers large-scale fingerprints, while residuals correlate with bathymetry, highlighting the limits of fingerprint-only inversions and the need for complementary datasets.
本研究针对从海面高度（SSH）指纹恢复格陵兰冰盖质量变化的病态反演问题，开发了一种受正向海平面方程神经算子模拟器约束的物理信息神经算子。通过合成冰川变化集成测试，发现虽然可以恢复大尺度冰流失模式，但微细结构高度依赖先验假设。研究建立了一个经验误差定律，定义了尺度相关的准确度上限（当前SSH观测几何下……

t: A physics-informed neural operator constrained by a neural-operator emulator of the forward sea level equation is developed to solve the ill-conditioned inverse problem.
开发了受正向海平面方程神经算子模拟器约束的物理信息神经算子来解决病态反演。
Synthetic ice change ensembles and satellite-altimetry-derived sea surface height (SSH) rate data from 1993–2019 are used to evaluate the inversion.
使用合成冰川变化集成以及1993-2019年卫星测高海面高度变化率数据进行评估。
An empirical error law defines a scale-dependent accuracy ceiling of R^2 ~ 0.79, with the leading three principal components explaining 99.76% of fingerprint variance.
经验误差定律定义了R^2约0.79的准确度上限，前三个主成分解释了99.76%的方差。
Fine-scale ice loss recovery is highly non-unique and depends heavily on the assumed a-priori distribution, with residuals affected by sterodynamic variability.
微细尺度恢复具有非唯一性，高度依赖先验分布，且残差易受热盐动力学变化干扰。
Provides the first systematic, scale-resolved quantification of Greenland Ice Sheet mass change structure recoverable from sea level fingerprints using neural operators.
首次利用神经算子系统地量化了从海平面指纹中可恢复的格陵兰冰盖质量变化结构。

sum: Initially cataloged as an Mw 7.2 and 7.5 doublet, the devastating 2026 Venezuela earthquake is shown here to be a single continuous ~220 km eastward rupture (Mw 7.6) across the Boconó–San Sebastián fault system. The authors integrate NISAR and ALOS-2 InSAR, optical pixel offsets, teleseismic P-wave backprojection, and two-stage Ensemble Kalman Inversion for Multiple Centroid Moment Tensors (EKI-MultiCMT) and 3D SeisSol dynamic rupture simulations (EKI-DR). Results reveal three major slip asperities (peak slip up to 2.6 m) and fitful propagation: the rupture accelerated across the fault bend to near/supershear speeds (~3.8 km/s), decelerated to ~0.8–1.0 km/s for ~20 s near the 1967 Mw 6.6 Caracas earthquake rupture zone, and re-accelerated to release ~26% of its moment beneath coastal cities. Novel EKI-driven dynamic modeling demonstrates that stress transfer from the arrested primary front and a bend-generated trailing slip pulse overcame the 1967 low-prestress barrier without re-nucleation.
2026年委内瑞拉破坏性地震最初被编目为Mw 7.2和7.5双震。本研究综合NISAR与ALOS-2雷达干涉、光学像素偏移、远震P波反投影，以及基于集合卡尔曼反演的多质心矩张量（EKI-MultiCMT）和三维动态破裂模拟（EKI-DR），证实其为沿Boconó–San Sebastián断层系统向……

t: Integrates static finite-fault InSAR inversion, teleseismic P-wave backprojection, two-stage Ensemble Kalman Multi-CMT inversion (EKI-MultiCMT), and EKI-constrained 3D ADER-DG dynamic rupture simulations (EKI-DR) in SeisSol.
结合静态有限断层InSAR反演、远震反投影、两阶段EKI-MultiCMT及SeisSol三维动态破裂EKI反演。
Combines 4 NISAR and 3 ALOS-2 L-band interferograms, PlanetScope/Sentinel pixel offsets, 36 teleseismic 3-component stations for EKI-MultiCMT, and 1,272 teleseismic P-wave records for backprojection.
融合4景NISAR与3景ALOS-2干涉图、光学像素偏移、36个远震台站三分量波形及1272条P波记录。

Resolves a single ~220-km Mw 7.6 rupture with three asperities (peak slip 2.6 m) that accelerated to ~3.8 km/s, slowed to ~0.8–1.0 km/s at a 1967 earthquake barrier, and re-accelerated to release ~26% of moment.
解析出长约220公里的单次Mw 7.6破裂（最大滑移2.6米），经1967年震区减速至1 km/s后再加速释放26%地震…

Simulations assume linear slip-weakening friction, a 1D velocity model without basin sediments or attenuation, and simplified 80°-dipping geometry, neglecting frictional healing and bimaterial effects.
采用线性滑移弱化、无沉积层衰减的一维速度模型和简化几何，忽略了摩擦愈合与双材料效应。
Proves the cataloged Venezuela doublet was a single fitful Mw 7.6 rupture and shows how a bend-generated trailing slip pulse dynamically breached a historical earthquake stress barrier.
证实委内瑞拉双震实为单次间歇性破裂，揭示断层弯曲产生的尾随脉冲如何动态突破历史应力障。

kc: Demonstrated that the 2026 Venezuela earthquake was a single ~220-km-long Mw 7.6 rupture rather than an Mw 7.2–7.5 doublet using L-band NISAR/ALOS-2 InSAR, optical offsets, and teleseismic imaging.

Resolved a 7-subevent multistage kinematic evolution via two-stage EKI-MultiCMT and backprojection, capturing acceleration to ~3.8 km/s, a 20-s slowdown to ~0.8–1.0 km/s, and terminal re-acceleration.

Identified via EKI-constrained 3D dynamic rupture simulations that a trailing secondary slip pulse and stress transfer allowed the rupture to breach a ~30-km low-stress barrier inherited from the 1967 Mw 6.6 Caracas earthquake.
结合L波段NISAR/ALOS-2干涉测量、光学偏移与远震成像，证实2026年委内瑞拉地震为单次约220公里长的Mw 7.6级连续破裂，而非Mw 7.2–7.5双震。
通过两阶段EKI-MultiCMT与反投影解析了包含7个子事件的多阶段运动学演化，捕捉到破裂加速至约3.8 km/s、在障碍区减速至约0.8–1.0 km/s持续20秒及最终再加速的过程。
利用EKI约束的三维动态破裂模拟揭示，受阻主前缘的应力传递与尾随次生滑移脉冲使破裂无需重新成核即可突破1967年Mw 6.6加拉加斯地震遗留的约30公里低应力障碍。
me: 3D surface displacement recovery and finite-fault slip inversion using piece-wise linear triangular dislocation elements in a layered half-space with spatially blocked cross-validation.
Time-domain teleseismic P-wave backprojection (0.2–1.0 Hz) with fourth-root stacking across 1,272 stations.
Two-stage Tikhonov-regularized Ensemble Kalman Multiple Centroid Moment Tensor Inversion (EKI-MultiCMT) with randomized-then-optimization uncertainty quantification.
Ensemble Kalman Inversion of 3D SeisSol ADER-DG dynamic rupture simulations (EKI-DR) with linear slip-weakening friction and Drucker-Prager off-fault viscoplasticity.
基于分层半空间分段线性三角形位错元的三维地表位移恢复与静态有限断层滑移反演，采用空间分块交叉验证确定正则化参数。
利用1272个台站0.2–1.0 Hz远震P波记录进行四次方根叠加的时域反投影分析。

基于SeisSol（ADER-DG方法）的三维动态破裂模拟集合卡尔曼反演（EKI-DR），包含线性滑移弱化摩擦与Drucker-Prager断层外弹粘塑性本构。
de: 4 NASA-ISRO NISAR and 3 JAXA ALOS-2 L-band interferograms, plus Sentinel-1/2 and 3-m PlanetScope optical pixel-offset maps and continuous GNSS station CCS1.
Teleseismic waveforms from 36 stations (24 P, 21 SH, 61 surface-wave records) for EKI-MultiCMT and 1,272 vertical P-wave velocity records (30°–95°) for backprojection.
Large-scale 3D SeisSol dynamic rupture simulations on a ~17-million-cell tetrahedral mesh resolving up to 1 Hz (250 m on-fault edge length), testing uniform vs. heterogeneous prestress and Dc.
4景NISAR和3景ALOS-2 L波段干涉图、Sentinel-1/2及3米分辨率PlanetScope光学像素偏移图，以及连续GNSS台站CCS1数据。
用于EKI-MultiCMT的36个远震台站波形（24条P波、21条SH波、61条面波）及用于反投影的1272条远震垂直分量P波速度记录（震中距30°–95°）。

li: Dynamic rupture simulations use linear slip-weakening friction, a 1D velocity structure without low-velocity basin sediments (<1.95 km/s) or anelastic attenuation, and a simplified 80°-dipping fault geometry.
Neglects time-dependent frictional healing, bimaterial fault contrasts, and thermal pressurization/pore-pressure changes.
Transient supershear propagation in the central asperity is favored by kinematic migration speeds but is not uniquely required by geodetic and moment-rate data.
动态破裂模拟采用线性滑移弱化摩擦、不包含低速盆地沉积层（<1.95 km/s）或非弹性衰减的一维速度结构，以及简化的80°倾角断层几何。
忽略了时间依赖的摩擦愈合、断层两侧双材料介质差异以及热增压/孔隙水压力动态变化。
中部凹凸体的瞬态超剪切破裂虽获运动学迁移速度支持，但并非大地测量和矩率观测唯一要求的解。

tm.why: The paper investigates the kinematic and dynamic rupture evolution of the 2026 Mw 7.6 Venezuela earthquake using finite-fault inversions, backprojection, multi-CMT inversions, and 3D dynamic rupture simulations.

The study employs Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) with randomized-then-optimization procedures to quantify uncertainties in multiple centroid moment tensor parameters and initial stress conditions for dynamic rupture models.

The authors run large-scale 3D elastodynamic and off-fault viscoplastic rupture simulations using the ADER-DG code SeisSol on 17 million tetrahedral elements across major GPU/CPU supercomputing clusters.

ev.notes: Full main text (pp. 1–26) and supplementary materials (pp. 27–74, S1–S48) from the provided PDF were used.

sum: This study analyzes multi-frequency S-wave coda attenuation across the continental United States using USArray seismic recordings. The authors demonstrate a clear frequency-dependent transition in the dominant attenuation mechanisms. At lower frequencies (1.5 and 3 Hz), coda attenuation is primarily driven by scattering from crustal heterogeneities and velocity contrasts. In contrast, at higher frequencies (6 and 12 Hz), intrinsic absorption becomes dominant, showing a strong correlation with surface heat flow and indicating temperature-dependent viscoelastic dissipation. By comparing these results with other attenuation models, the study highlights the distinct depth and frequency sensitivities of different seismic phases. The findings emphasize the value of multi-frequency coda attenuation in resolving crustal heterogeneity and thermal structure, providing crucial constraints for geodynamic interpretations.
本研究利用USArray地震记录分析了美国大陆地壳的多频S波包络（coda）衰减。结果表明，衰减机制具有显著的频率依赖性：在低频段（1.5和3 Hz），衰减主要由地壳非均匀性和速度对比引起的散射控制；而在高频段（6和12 Hz），固有吸收成为主导机制，且与地表热流高度相关，符合温度依赖的粘弹性耗散特……

t: Multi-frequency S-wave coda attenuation analysis at 1.5, 3, 6, and 12 Hz to separate scattering and intrinsic attenuation mechanisms.
利用1.5、3、6和12 Hz的多频S波包络衰减分析，分离散射与固有衰减机制。
Seismic waveform recordings from the USArray network across the continental United States.
覆盖美国大陆的USArray台网地震波形记录。
Low-frequency (1.5-3 Hz) attenuation is scattering-dominated, while high-frequency (6-12 Hz) attenuation is intrinsic-dominated and correlates strongly with surface heat flow.
低频衰减由散射主导，高频衰减由固有吸收主导且与地表热流强相关。

Established a strong correlation between high-frequency intrinsic attenuation and surface heat flow, linking it to thermal structure.

sum: This paper introduces Stein mixture variational inference (SMVI) to address the computational challenges of high-dimensional, multimodal, or complex posterior probability density functions in Bayesian geophysical inversion. SMVI combines parametric variational inference with Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), approximating the posterior as a mixture of distributions optimized jointly. The method is validated on two synthetic seismic inverse problems and applied to real Love wave tomography data of the British Isles. SMVI successfully captures non-Gaussian, complex, and bimodal uncertainties (e.g., in the East Irish Sea sedimentary basins) with high computational efficiency, providing a practical framework for complex uncertainty quantification in seismic imaging.
本文提出了一种名为斯坦混合变分推断（SMVI）的新型贝叶斯地球物理反演方法，旨在高效解决高维、多峰或复杂的后验概率密度函数估计难题。该方法结合了参数化变分推断与斯坦变分梯度下降（SVGD），将后验分布近似为混合分布并进行联合优化。通过两个合成地震反演问题以及不列颠群岛真实爱神波（Love wave）……

t: SMVI combines parametric variational inference with Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) to approximate the posterior as a mixture of distributions optimized jointly.
SMVI结合了参数化变分推断与斯坦变分梯度下降，将后验近似为联合优化的混合分布。
Two synthetic seismic datasets and real seismic data for Love wave tomography of the British Isles.
两个合成地震数据集以及用于不列颠群岛爱神波断层成像的真实地震数据。
SMVI successfully recovered complex, non-Gaussian, and bimodal posterior uncertainties, such as alternative basin boundary locations in the East Irish Sea.
SMVI成功恢复了复杂的非高斯和双峰后验不确定性，揭示了东爱尔兰海盆地边界的多种可能结构。
Computational scaling to very high-dimensional 3D problems and the choice of the number of mixture components are potential challenges.

First application of Stein mixture variational inference to geophysical inversion, enabling efficient representation of multimodal posterior distributions.

Demonstrated the method's capability to capture bimodal uncertainties in real Love wave tomography of the British Isles.

sum: La Soufrière de Guadeloupe volcano has experienced increasing hydrothermal activity, raising concerns about phreatic eruptions and summit flank instability. In 2023, the authors deployed 39 3-component nodal geophones around the volcano for one month to perform Nodal Ambient Noise Tomography (NANT). Rayleigh wave group velocity dispersion curves (0.15–0.6 s) were picked using a convolutional autoencoder (DisperPicker) and manually reviewed, followed by 2D non-linear multiscale tomography and 1D transdimensional Bayesian McMC depth inversion. The resulting 3D S-wave velocity model (down to ~0.75 km depth) resolves a sub-vertical central low-velocity conduit (L1, Vs 1.0–1.5 km/s), shallow low-velocity flank detachment zones (L2, Vs < 1.25 km/s), and rigid high-velocity bodies (H1, H2) representing cooled intrusions and gas-saturated rock. This provides the first high-resolution 3D seismic velocity image for volcanic slope stability assessment, linking hydrothermal fluid pathways and alteration to potential flank collapse hazards.
针对瓜德罗普苏弗里耶尔火山日益增强的热液活动及侧翼失稳风险，本研究于2023年布设39个三分量节点检波器开展为期1个月的节点背景噪声层析成像（NANT）。利用卷积自编码器拾取并人工核查0.15–0.6秒瑞利波群速度频散曲线，结合二维非线性多尺度反演与一维跨维贝叶斯McMC深度反演，构建了浅部三维S波……

t: Ambient noise cross-correlations yield Rayleigh wave group velocity dispersion curves (picked via DisperPicker CAE), inverted into 2D group velocity maps using non-linear multiscale tomography and 1D S-wave profiles via transdimensional Bayesian McMC (BayHunter).
利用DisperPicker提取互相关瑞利波群速度频散，经二维多尺度反演及一维跨维贝叶斯McMC反演获取三维Vs模型。

One month of continuous ambient seismic noise recorded at 250 Hz by 39 3-component 5 Hz nodal geophones deployed at La Soufrière de Guadeloupe in 2023, yielding 178 quality-controlled dispersion curves (0.15–0.6 s).
2023年在苏弗里耶尔火山布设39台5 Hz三分量节点检波器连续记录1个月，筛选出178条0.15–0.6秒频散曲线。

The 3D Vs model resolves a central sub-vertical low-velocity conduit (L1, 1.0–1.5 km/s), flank low-velocity detachment zones (L2, <1.25 km/s, volume ~15×10^6 m^3), and rigid high-velocity bodies (H1, 2.2–2.8 km/s; H2, 1.8–2.3 km/s).
三维Vs模型揭示中央垂直低速通道L1（1.0–1.5 km/s）、侧翼低速带L2（<1.25 km/s）及高速体H1和H…

Tomographic inversions are restricted to narrow periods (0.15–0.6 s) and shallow depths (~0.75 km) due to the 5 Hz geophone corner frequency and 1-month deployment; anomaly H2 is below checkerboard resolution.

Provides the first high-resolution 3D seismic velocity imaging for slope stability assessment in volcanic environments, resolving 3D detachment zone geometry and hydrothermal pathways beneath La Soufrière de Guadeloupe.
首次提供用于火山斜坡稳定性评估的高分辨率三维地震速度图像，揭示三维滑脱带几何形态与热液通道。

kc: Constructed the first high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity model of the shallow edifice of La Soufrière de Guadeloupe down to 600 m a.s.l. (~0.75 km depth) using 39 nodal geophones.
Resolved a central sub-vertical low-velocity conduit (L1, Vs = 1.0–1.5 km/s) and lateral low-velocity flank zones (L2, Vs < 1.25 km/s) with an estimated volume of 15 × 10^6 m^3.

Identified rigid high-velocity domains (H1, Vs = 2.2–2.8 km/s; H2, Vs = 1.8–2.3 km/s) juxtaposed against hydrothermally altered weak zones, explaining local fault deformation and flank collapse hazards.
利用39个节点检波器构建了瓜德罗普苏弗里耶尔火山浅部山体（至海拔600米，深度约0.75公里）的首个高分辨率三维S波速度模型。
揭示了中央近垂直低速通道（L1，Vs = 1.0–1.5 km/s）和侧翼低速滑脱区（L2，Vs < 1.25 km/s，估计体积为15 × 10^6 m^3）。
识别出与热液蚀变弱带相邻的刚性高速域（H1，Vs = 2.2–2.8 km/s；H2，Vs = 1.8–2.3 km/s），解释了局部断层变形机制与侧翼坍塌风险。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation of vertical-vertical components (0.1–12.5 Hz) using 5-min windows stacked over 1 month.
Rayleigh wave fundamental-mode group velocity dispersion extraction via FTAN and convolutional autoencoder (DisperPicker) followed by strict manual quality control.
Non-linear multiscale 2D group velocity tomography accounting for topography, paired with transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) 1D depth inversion (BayHunter).
使用5分钟时间窗对1个月的垂直-垂直分量（0.1–12.5 Hz）进行背景噪声互相关叠加。
通过时频分析（FTAN）和卷积自编码器（DisperPicker）提取基阶瑞利波群速度频散曲线，并进行严格的人工质量控制。
采用考虑地形的非线性多尺度二维群速度层析成像，结合跨维贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（McMC）一维深度反演（BayHunter）。
de: 1-month continuous passive seismic recording (250 Hz sampling rate) from 39 3-component 5 Hz nodal geophones (Smartsolo IGU-16HR 3C) deployed in 2023.
178 manually verified Rayleigh wave group velocity dispersion curves (24% kept from 736 automatic picks across 739 station pairs) spanning periods of 0.15 to 0.60 s.
Synthetic checkerboard (0.22 × 0.22 km and 0.33 × 0.33 km), spike resolution tests, and Rayleigh wave depth sensitivity kernel analyses.
2023年布设的39台三分量5 Hz节点检波器（Smartsolo IGU-16HR 3C）连续1个月的被动源地震记录（采样率250 Hz）。
经人工核查保留的178条瑞利波群速度频散曲线（占739个台站对自动拾取的736条曲线的24%），周期范围为0.15至0.60秒。
人工合成检测板（0.22 × 0.22 km和0.33 × 0.33 km）、脉冲分辨率测试以及瑞利波深度敏感核分析。
li: Narrow usable period range (0.15–0.6 s) and depth resolution limit (~0.75 km) due to the 5 Hz geophone corner frequency, local noise conditions, and short 1-month deployment.
High rejection rate of dispersion curves (only 24% kept after manual review) and unviable phase velocity picks.
The lateral extent of the shallow high-velocity anomaly H2 is smaller than the minimum feature size resolvable by checkerboard tests.
受5 Hz检波器拐角频率、噪声条件及1个月短部署期限制，可用周期范围较窄（0.15–0.6秒），深度分辨率受限（约0.75公里）。
频散曲线剔除率高（人工审核后仅保留24%），且相速度拾取结果不可用。
浅部高速异常体H2的横向范围小于检测板测试可分辨的最小特征尺度。

tm.why: The core methodology is Nodal Ambient Noise Tomography (NANT) using cross-correlations of vertical-vertical components from 39 nodal geophones.
The study images the shallow hydrothermal system, central conduit, and flank detachment zones of La Soufrière de Guadeloupe volcano.
1D depth profiles of S-wave velocity are obtained via transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) inversion using BayHunter.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 12-page GRL PDF including text, figures, and citations to Supporting Information.

sum: The magnitude scaling of seismic radiated energy and apparent stress has long been debated due to poorly constrained source spectra, which also often overpredict ground-motion variability. This study uses observed peak ground velocity (PGV) from 445 shallow crustal earthquakes in Japan (Mw 3.4–7.5) recorded by K-NET and KiK-net as an independent constraint on double-corner-frequency source spectral estimates. By predicting PGV via random-vibration theory and comparing it with observations at a 50-km reference distance, the authors show that apparent stress increases with magnitude for small-to-moderate earthquakes but becomes nearly constant above Mw 5–6. The spectral estimates accurately reproduce both the broken-slope scaling and between-event variability of observed PGV (standard deviation 0.35 vs. 0.37). Comparisons with NGA-West2 models and western US data confirm this scaling break is not a bandwidth artifact, reconciling conflicting views on apparent-stress scaling and providing a quality-control criterion for radiated-energy estimates.
本研究利用日本K-NET和KiK-net记录的445次浅源地壳地震（Mw 3.4–7.5）的峰值地面速度（PGV）观测数据，结合双拐角频率震源模型与随机振动理论，对地震辐射能量和视应力的标度律及变异性进行独立约束。结果表明，视应力在中小型地震中随震级增加，而在Mw 5–6以上趋于恒定。该震源谱估计准……

t: Radiated energy and apparent stress are computed from double-corner-frequency (DCF) source spectra using an equivalent corner frequency, while PGVs at 50 km are predicted via random-vibration theory and compared with attenuation-adjusted observed PGVs.
利用双拐角频率震源谱计算辐射能量和视应力，通过随机振动理论预测50公里处PGV并与观测值对比。

The study analyzes 445 shallow crustal earthquakes in Japan (Mw 3.4–7.5, 2004–2024, depth 4–15 km) recorded by at least 10 K-NET/KiK-net stations within 200 km, alongside compiled DCF source spectral parameters.
分析日本445次浅源地壳地震（Mw 3.4–7.5）的K-NET/KiK-net强震PGV记录及DCF震源谱参数。

Apparent stress increases with magnitude up to Mw 5–6 and becomes nearly constant above it, with a log-residual standard deviation of 0.62, matching observed and predicted PGV between-event standard deviations of 0.37 and 0.35 (r = 0.95).
视应力在Mw 5–6以下随震级增加而后近似恒定（残差标准差0.62），观测与预测PGV变异性一致（0.37与0.35）。
Between-event PGV variability for very small earthquakes with high corner frequencies may include non-negligible contributions from regional differences in average path attenuation and site terms.
极小地震的事件间PGV变异性可能受区域平均路径衰减和场地差异的影响。

Introduces PGV scaling and variability consistency as an independent constraint on seismic radiated energy, resolving the variability discrepancy and reconciling long-standing competing hypotheses on apparent-stress scaling.
引入PGV标度律与变异性作为辐射能量的独立约束，调和了视应力标度律的长期争议。

kc: Reconciles conflicting views on apparent-stress scaling by showing it increases up to Mw 5–6 and becomes nearly constant for larger crustal earthquakes.
Resolves the variability discrepancy between source spectral estimates (apparent stress residual SD of 0.62) and observed between-event PGV variability (SD of 0.37).
Establishes PGV consistency as a stringent quality-control criterion for evaluating seismic radiated-energy datasets and disproving high-frequency bandwidth artifact hypotheses.
调和了视应力标度律的争议，表明其在Mw 5–6以下随震级增加，而在更大震级地壳地震中近似恒定。
解决了震源谱估计（视应力残差标准差0.62）与观测PGV事件间变异性（标准差0.37）之间的变异性不一致问题。
确立了PGV一致性作为评估地震辐射能量数据集和排除高频带宽假象的严格质量控制标准。
me: Analytical calculation of seismic radiated energy and apparent stress using a double-corner-frequency (DCF) source spectral model and an equivalent corner frequency.
Extraction of event-specific observed PGVs at a 50-km reference rupture distance via attenuation model fitting.
Prediction of PGV from source velocity spectra using the random-vibration theory framework and broken-slope regression analysis.
基于双拐角频率（DCF）震源谱模型和等效拐角频率解析计算地震辐射能量与视应力。
通过拟合衰减模型提取50公里参考破裂距离处的事件特定观测PGV。
利用随机振动理论框架从震源速度谱预测PGV，并进行折线回归分析。
de: Surface strong-motion PGV (RotD50) records from K-NET and KiK-net and F-net seismic moments for 445 shallow crustal earthquakes in Japan (Mw 3.4–7.5, depth ~4–15 km, 2004–2024).
Double-corner-frequency source spectral parameters compiled from previous spectral ratio and empirical studies.
Cross-regional comparison with NGA-West2 empirical ground-motion models and the Mayeda and Walter (1996) western US coda-derived apparent-stress dataset.
日本K-NET和KiK-net的445次浅源地壳地震（Mw 3.4–7.5，深度约4–15 km，2004–2024年）地表强震PGV（RotD50）记录及F-net地震矩数据。
汇编自先前谱比分析和经验研究的双拐角频率震源谱参数。
与NGA-West2经验地震动模型以及Mayeda和Walter（1996）美国西部尾波视应力数据集的跨区域对比。
li: Between-event PGV variability for very small earthquakes with high corner frequencies may include non-negligible contributions from regional differences in average path attenuation and site terms.
Random-vibration PGV predictions focus on relative scaling and between-event variability, omitting exact absolute amplitude normalization and site-specific amplifications.
对于具有高拐角频率的极小地震，事件间PGV变异性可能包含来自区域平均路径衰减和场地项差异的不可忽略的贡献。
随机振动PGV预测侧重于相对标度律和事件间变异性，省略了精确的绝对振幅归一化和特定场地放大效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates the magnitude scaling and variability of seismic radiated energy and apparent stress using double-corner-frequency source spectral estimates.

The study uses observed peak ground velocity (PGV) from dense strong-motion networks and empirical ground-motion models (NGA-West2) to constrain source spectral estimates and ground-motion variability.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of Geophysical Research Letters article analyzed, including equations, regression statistics, and all four main figures.

sum: To understand what controls final earthquake magnitude, this study analyzes the 2021 Mw 7.0 Miyagi-Oki megathrust earthquake and neighboring events along the Japan Trench. Using waveform cross-correlation relocation that separates hypocenters from centroids, empirical Green's function deconvolution, and finite-fault slip inversions of onshore and S-net ocean-bottom records, the authors show that the Mw 7.0 mainshock initiated within ~130 m of an Mw 3.8 repeating earthquake with nearly identical P-wave onsets (correlation 0.94 over 0.05 s). After rupturing the Mw 3.8 patch in 0.1 s, the mainshock cascaded through Mw 5–6 patches within 2 s before breaking the main locked patch at 3–6 s. Four preceding Mw 5.1–6.1 events shared similar initial growth but arrested at the main patch margin. This provides the first clear observational evidence for an Mw 7.0 event initiating identically to a small repeater, proving final size is governed by surrounding fault readiness.
为探究决定地震最终震级的因素，本研究结合走时与波形互相关重定位（区分震源与矩心）、经验格林函数反褶积和有限断层滑动反演，分析了日本海沟2021年Mw 7.0宫城近海地震及邻近事件。研究发现Mw 7.0主震起始位置距Mw 3.8重复地震仅约130米，且前0.05秒P波初动波形几乎完全一致（相关系数0.……

t: The authors combine network cross-correlation relocation separating hypocenters (<0.1 s P-onsets) from centroids (2–5 Hz), empirical Green's function deconvolution for apparent moment-rate functions, and finite-fault SH-wave slip inversions.
结合区分震源与矩心的网络互相关重定位、经验格林函数反褶积求取视矩率函数以及SH波有限断层滑动反演。
Waveforms from 48–51 stations (Tohoku University, JMA, NIED Hi-net, and 11 offshore S-net stations) for the 2021 Mw 7.0 Miyagi-Oki earthquake and 137 nearby events (2011–2023).
2021年Mw 7.0宫城近海地震及周边137个事件在48–51个陆地及S-net海底台站的波形记录。
The Mw 7.0 hypocenter lies ~130 m from the 2016 Mw 3.8 repeater with a 0.94 P-onset correlation over 0.05 s, cascading through Mw 5–6 patches within 2 s into the main patch after 3 s.
Mw 7.0震源距Mw 3.8重复地震仅约130米，前0.05秒P波相关性达0.94，经2秒Mw 5–6级联后于3秒进入…
High-resolution P-wave moment-rate deconvolution relied on a single broadband station (TU.KWT), and finite-fault inversions only resolve gross extent for Mw < 5.5 events.
P波反褶积仅依赖单个高信噪比宽频带台站TU.KWT，且有限断层反演对Mw<5.5事件仅能分辨大体范围。
Demonstrates for the first time that a large Mw 7.0 megathrust earthquake initiated nearly identically to an Mw 3.8 repeating event, extending identical-initiation observations beyond Mw < 5.1.
首次证实Mw 7.0大震与Mw 3.8小重复地震具有几乎完全相同的起始破裂过程，突破了以往Mw<5.1的观测上限。

kc: Demonstrated nearly identical P-wave onset (NCC = 0.94 over 0.05 s) and hypocenter co-location (~130 m) between the 2021 Mw 7.0 mainshock and a 2016 Mw 3.8 repeating earthquake.
Resolved a multi-scale hierarchical cascading growth process: from an Mw 3.8 patch (<0.1 s) through Mw 5–6 regions (<2 s) into the main locked megathrust patch (3–6 s).

Showed that four earlier Mw 5.1–6.1 earthquakes initiated from the same compact region with comparable or higher initial moment rates (<1–2 s) but arrested at the margin of the main Mw 7.0 slip patch.
Proposed a progressive unlocking model where post-2011 Tohoku afterslip loaded the main locked patch at ~0.5–1 MPa/year, bringing it close to failure by 2021.
证实2021年Mw 7.0主震与2016年Mw 3.8重复地震具有几乎一致的P波初动（前0.05秒网络互相关系数0.94）及极近的初始震源位置（约130米）。
揭示了从Mw 3.8尺度（<0.1秒）经Mw 5–6区域（<2秒）最终进入主闭锁区（3–6秒）的多尺度层级级联破裂过程。
发现此前4次Mw 5.1–6.1地震同样起始于该紧凑区域且前1–2秒矩率相当甚至更高，但均在Mw 7.0主滑动区边缘停止。
提出2011年东北大地震后的震后滑移以约0.5–1 MPa/年的速率加载主闭锁区并促使其逐步解锁，至2021年达到临界失稳状态。
me: Separate hypocenter and centroid relative relocation using network cross-correlations (NCCs) of unfiltered P-wave onset (<0.1 s) acceleration waveforms and 2–5 Hz waveforms.
Apparent moment-rate function (AMRF) estimation via empirical Green's function (eGF) deconvolution of direct P and SH waves using Mw 3.8–3.9 repeaters as eGFs.
Finite-source spatiotemporal slip inversion of low-pass filtered (1.5 Hz) SH-wave AMRFs following the Hartzell and Heaton (1983) approach.
利用P波初动（<0.1秒）未滤波加速度波形和2–5 Hz带通波形的网络互相关（NCC），分别进行高精度的相对起始震源和相对矩心重定位。
以Mw 3.8–3.9重复地震作为经验格林函数（eGF），对直达P波和SH波进行反褶积以估算视矩率函数（AMRF）。
基于Hartzell和Heaton（1983）方法，利用1.5 Hz低通滤波后的SH波视矩率函数反演矩形板间断层面的时空滑动分布。
de: Waveform records of the 2021 Mw 7.0 Miyagi-Oki earthquake and 137 surrounding events (including five Mw 5.1–6.1 events and three Mw 3.8–3.9 repeaters).
Seismic stations from Tohoku University (including broadband station TU.KWT), JMA, NIED Hi-net, and 11 offshore S-net ocean-bottom stations (48–51 stations total).
2021年Mw 7.0宫城近海地震及周边137个地震事件（含5个Mw 5.1–6.1事件和3个Mw 3.8–3.9重复地震）的波形记录。
来自东北大学（含宽频带台站TU.KWT）、日本气象厅（JMA）、NIED Hi-net陆地台网以及11个S-net海底地震仪台站的观测数据（共48–51个台站）。
li: Relative hypocenter formal uncertainties (<10 m) do not account for systematic errors in the velocity model or absolute locations.
High-resolution P-wave AMRF deconvolution up to 10 s relied essentially on a single broadband station (TU.KWT) that recorded the Mw 3.8 eGF clearly above microseismic noise.
Finite-fault inversion parameterization was tuned for the Mw 6.1 event, limiting resolution to gross rupture location and spatial extent for Mw < 5.5 earthquakes.
相对震源重定位的形式不确定度（<10米）未包含速度模型系统误差和绝对位置误差。
长达10秒的高分辨率P波视矩率函数反褶积主要依赖唯一能清晰记录Mw 3.8经验格林函数且信噪比高于微震噪声的宽频带台站（TU.KWT）。
有限断层反演参数化针对较长的Mw 6.1破裂设计，因此对Mw < 5.5地震仅能约束其大体破裂位置与空间范围。

tm.why: The paper investigates the multi-scale initiation, cascading rupture growth, moment-rate functions, and finite-fault slip distributions of an Mw 7.0 earthquake and surrounding Mw 3.8–6.1 events.
The study examines repeating earthquakes, fault patch hierarchy, fracture energy, and progressive unlocking of a locked megathrust patch driven by post-Tohoku aseismic afterslip.
High-precision relative hypocenter and centroid relocations using network cross-correlations are central to demonstrating co-located initiation between the Mw 7.0 and Mw 3.8 events.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 5 figures and detailed methodological and quantitative results.

sum: Stacked or migrated seismic images often suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), low dominant frequency, and sparse sampling. Traditional multi-step enhancements accumulate errors and increase computation. This paper proposes a single-step Seismic Image Super-Resolution Transformer (SIST) that simultaneously performs denoising, interpolation, and frequency extrapolation. The method extracts binarized edges via the Canny algorithm and multiplies them element-wise with raw data to form a two-channel amplitude-preserving input. The backbone consists of six residual groups containing Swin-Transformer blocks (using window and shifted-window multi-head self-attention) to fuse local and global structural features. Pixel shuffle layers upsample both the backbone output and raw input via a skip connection to sharpen edges and preserve weak amplitudes. Trained on 2D slices from 3D synthetic volumes with mixed strong/weak amplitudes using a combined L1 and MS-SSIM loss, SIST outperforms U-Net on synthetic, Marmousi, and 3D field datasets (F3, Parihaka, Volve).
针对叠加或偏移地震图像低信噪比、低主频及采样稀疏问题，本文提出地震图像超分辨率Transformer（SIST）单步实现去噪、插值与拓频。方法利用Canny算子提取边缘掩膜并与原始数据相乘构建双通道输入，骨干网络采用含Swin-Transformer块的残差组融合局部与全局特征，结合像素洗牌层与跳跃……

t: SIST combines a Canny true-amplitude edge-masked two-channel input, a six-Residual-Group Swin-Transformer backbone (using W-MSA and SW-MSA), and dual pixel-shuffle upsampling with a raw-input skip connection trained via a mixed L1 and MS-SSIM loss.
结合Canny真振幅边缘双通道输入、6残差组Swin-Transformer骨干网与双路像素洗牌上采样。

3000 synthetic 2D LR/HR pairs sliced from 3D volumes (half with mixed strong/weak amplitudes), tested on synthetic data, the Marmousi model, and 3D field datasets (Netherlands F3, New Zealand Parihaka, North Sea Volve).
3000对含强弱振幅混合的2D合成切片，并在Marmousi及F3、Parihaka、Volve实际数据测试。

On synthetic testing data, SIST achieves an RMSE of 0.0564, PSNR of 28.4962 dB, and SSIM of 0.9576, substantially outperforming U-Net (RMSE 0.2892, PSNR 14.2979 dB, SSIM 0.3752) while preserving weak fault/fold structures in field data.
合成测试集上SIST的RMSE为0.0564、PSNR达28.50、SSIM达0.9576，显著优于U-Net。
SIST currently processes 2D slices independently rather than 3D volumes directly, requiring future extension to 3D to improve inter-slice prediction continuity.
目前仅对2D切片独立处理，尚未直接对3D数据体进行超分辨率重建以保证切片间连续性。

Applies Swin-Transformer with true-amplitude Canny edge masks and pixel-shuffle skip connections to perform single-step seismic denoising, interpolation, and frequency extrapolation while preserving weak event amplitudes.
将Swin-Transformer与真振幅边缘掩膜及跳跃上采样结合，单步实现去噪、插值、拓频与弱事件保幅。

kc: Proposed a single-step deep learning framework (SIST) combining Swin-Transformer residual groups and pixel shuffle layers to simultaneously denoise, interpolate, and extrapolate frequencies of post-stack/migrated seismic images.

Introduced a two-channel input incorporating Canny-based true-amplitude edge masks and a direct pixel-shuffle skip connection on raw input data to preserve relative amplitudes and recover weak reflection events.
Designed a realistic supervised training dataset generation strategy using 2D slices from 3D synthetic volumes where half the slices contain randomized mixtures of strong and weak amplitudes.
提出结合Swin-Transformer残差组与像素洗牌层的单步深度学习框架（SIST），同步实现叠后/偏移地震图像的去噪、插值与频率外推。
引入融合Canny真振幅边缘掩膜的双通道输入及原始数据像素洗牌跳跃连接，有效保持相对振幅并恢复弱反射同相轴。
设计了逼真的监督学习数据集生成策略，从3D合成数据体中随机抽取2D切片，并将一半切片设置为强弱振幅随机混合分布。
me: Canny edge detection multiplied element-wise with raw low-resolution seismic images to construct a two-channel input with true-amplitude edge constraints.

Swin-Transformer backbone comprising 6 Residual Groups (RGs), each containing 3 groups of Swin-Transformer Layers (W-MSA and SW-MSA) and 3x3 convolutions to extract and fuse local and global structural features.
Dual pixel-shuffle upsampling applied to both the backbone feature maps and the two-channel raw input via a skip connection to reconstruct double-sized high-resolution images.
Supervised training using a mixed loss function combining L1 loss (weight 0.6) and multiscale structural similarity (MS-SSIM, weight 0.4) optimized via Adam.
利用Canny边缘检测与原始低分辨率地震图像逐元素相乘，构建具有真振幅边缘约束的双通道输入。
采用包含6个残差组（RG）的Swin-Transformer骨干网络，每个RG含3组Swin-Transformer层（W-MSA和SW-MSA）及3×3卷积，提取并融合局部与全局构造特征。
对骨干网络特征图和双通道原始输入（通过跳跃连接）同时应用像素洗牌上采样，重建双倍尺寸的高分辨率图像。
采用结合L1损失（权重0.6）和多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM，权重0.4）的混合损失函数，通过Adam优化器进行监督训练。
de: 3000 pairs of 2D synthetic LR (128x128, 10–25 Hz Ricker wavelet with colored noise) and HR (256x256, 35–55 Hz Ricker wavelet) seismic slices extracted from 3D reflectivity volumes (2400 training, 300 validation, 300 testing).
Synthetic seismic profile generated from the Marmousi velocity model convolved with 15 Hz (LR with colored noise) and 50 Hz (HR) Ricker wavelets.
3D marine field seismic data patches (high SNR and low SNR) from the Netherlands Offshore F3 block.
Inline (1376th) and crossline (4025th) field profiles from the New Zealand Parihaka 3D seismic survey.
Ablation study conducted on low-SNR post-stack field seismic profiles from the North Sea Volve field.
